battleTraits.name: Lethal Surprise
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with any friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. In addition, for the rest of the turn, the target’s weapons cannot be affected by the **Charge (+1 Damage)** weapon ability.
battleTraits.lore: As the enemy charges into the Kruleboyz line, little do they know that they have been lured into a series of cunningly concealed traps.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Kruleboyz armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Noisy Racket
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with any friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.

Effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
battleTraits.lore: After a sustained barrage of hurled insults and the clanging of weapons on shields, the Kruleboyz have driven some of their foes to distraction.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Kruleboyz armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Venom-encrusted Weapons
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY** unit to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target’s attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+.
battleTraits.lore: These weapons are smeared with a lethal mix of toxins extracted from poison sludge, venomous swamp creatures and spit.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Kruleboyz armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Dirty Tricks
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description: Effect: The effect of a **DIRTY TRICK** ability is only applied if you make a successful dirty trick roll. The success of a dirty trick roll depends on the number of **DIRTY TRICK** abilities your army has already used this battle round.
battleTraits.lore: Kruleboyz will use whatever devious means they can to gain the upper hand over the foe.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Kruleboyz armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Sneaky Sneakin'
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY** unit that has 10 or fewer models, is not in combat and has not been the target of a **DIRTY TRICK** ability this turn to be the target, then make a dirty trick roll.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.
battleTraits.lore: Cloying swamp-mists mask the Kruleboyz’ movements.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Kruleboyz armies can use the following abilities:

ability.name: Swamp Shroud
ability.description: Effect: Friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units that are wholly within 3" of a terrain feature are not visible to enemy units that are more than 12" away from them.
ability.lore: Before the warriors of a Kruleboyz Klaw strike, the shamans enact a mighty ritual to smother the battlefield in a thick, stinky mist that conceals them from the enemy.

abilities.name: Swamp Shroud
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units that are wholly within 3" of a terrain feature are not visible to enemy units that are more than 12" away from them.
abilities.lore: Before the warriors of a Kruleboyz Klaw strike, the shamans enact a mighty ritual to smother the battlefield in a thick, stinky mist that conceals them from the enemy.

ability.name: Ded Sneaky
ability.description: Effect: You can use the ‘Sneaky Sneakin'’ **DIRTY TRICK** ability twice per turn instead of only once per turn.
ability.lore: Comprised of hobgrots and ‘yoofs’, the ladz of the Light Finga are in charge of ‘nikkin’ stuff and are skilled at sneaking up on the enemy.

abilities.name: Ded Sneaky
abilities.description: Effect: You can use the ‘Sneaky Sneakin'’ **DIRTY TRICK** ability twice per turn instead of only once per turn.
abilities.lore: Comprised of hobgrots and ‘yoofs’, the ladz of the Light Finga are in charge of ‘nikkin’ stuff and are skilled at sneaking up on the enemy.

ability.name: Far-killa Bolts
ability.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Man‑skewer Boltboyz** or **Beast-skewer** **Killbow** units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the Range characteristic of the targets’ ranged weapons.
ability.lore: The many Deffspikerz of the Middul Finger often keep a limited supply of bolts fletched with bog-shryke feathers, which give their shots that extra bit of distance when needed.

abilities.name: Far-killa Bolts
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Man‑skewer Boltboyz** or **Beast-skewer** **Killbow** units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the Range characteristic of the targets’ ranged weapons.
abilities.lore: The many Deffspikerz of the Middul Finger often keep a limited supply of bolts fletched with bog-shryke feathers, which give their shots that extra bit of distance when needed.

ability.name: Meanest Beasts
ability.description: Effect: **Companion** weapons used by friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units have **Crit (2 Hits)**.
ability.lore: The warbeasts ridden by the orruks of the Trophy Finga are particularly foul and belligerent specimens of their kind.

abilities.name: Meanest Beasts
abilities.description: Effect: **Companion** weapons used by friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units have **Crit (2 Hits)**.
abilities.lore: The warbeasts ridden by the orruks of the Trophy Finga are particularly foul and belligerent specimens of their kind.

heroicTraits.name: Egomaniak
heroicTraits.description:
Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly non-**HERO KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY** unit:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**HERO KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
heroicTraits.lore: This self-important boss is willing to use anyone to protect their own hide.

heroicTraits.name: Slippery Skumbag
heroicTraits.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, it can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.
heroicTraits.lore: This wily boss has mastered the art of the feint, breaking away from fights that aren’t going his way and then coming back for another go when the odds are in his favour.

heroicTraits.name: Backstabba
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with both this unit and another friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit to be the target.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Add 1 to the mortal damage inflicted for each friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit in combat with the target in addition to the first two **KRULEBOYZ** units.
heroicTraits.lore: When their enemy’s back is turned, this boss has no qualms about sticking a dagger in it.

artefacts.name: Mork's Eye Pebble
artefacts.phase: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared an ATTACK ability
artefacts.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units have **WARD** **(5+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
artefacts.lore: When rubbed, this dark-grey rock produces a swirling bank of thick fog that protects the bearer and their allies from harm.

artefacts.name: Swamp Staff
artefacts.description: Effect: If this unit is not a **WIZARD**, it can use the ‘Unbind’ ability as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. Otherwise, add 1 to this unit’s power level.
artefacts.lore: Hewn from a root of an ancient bogwood, this gnarled staff grants its bearer mastery over the swamps and can be used to ward off enemy magics.

artefacts.name: Eye-biter Ash
artefacts.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
artefacts.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
artefacts.lore: Stored in a heatproof pouch, this strange ash never stops smouldering. The bearer can cast it at a foe, creating a blistering ash cloud that blinds the targets and causes them terrible pain.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Tattermask
aqshyArtefacts.description: Effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-3, that attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: Patched together from assorted flaps of flayed skin, this enchanted mask has the unsurprisingly off-putting effect of turning the wearer’s bellows into keening cries for help in the native tongues of nearby enemies.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Spell in a Rattle
aqshyArtefacts.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
aqshyArtefacts.description: Effect: This unit can use a non‐**SUMMON SPELL** ability from a spell lore you picked during army composition as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. Instead of making a casting roll for that spell, the casting roll is 9 and cannot be modified. That spell cannot be unbound.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: With a shake of this unassuming, knobbly rattle, the bearer releases the spell stored within.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Woggly Bogstikk
aqshyArtefacts.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: Plucked from the grasp of a bog-drowned shaman, this gnarled staff can turn the earth beneath a foe’s feet into acidic slime.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Quick 'Un
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: Add half your **fury level** (rounding up) to run rolls and charge rolls for this unit.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: Getting the drop on this hot‐tempered creature is nigh on impossible.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: **KRULEBOYZ MONSTER** only

aqshyEnhancements.name: Sly 'Un
aqshyEnhancements.phase: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: Whether covered in mud or submerged in a mire, this brute emerges from the muck with little warning, ready to ambush the enemy.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: **KRULEBOYZ MONSTER** only

aqshyEnhancements.name: Spittin' 'Un
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Effect: This unit is armed with the ranged weapon below, where **X** is equal to your **fury level**.

Ranged Weapon
**Caustic Saliva**
Rng: 12"
Atk: X
Hit: 4+
Wnd: 3+
Rnd: 2
Dmg: D3
aqshyEnhancements.lore: This beast has specialised glands that allow it to spit corrosive saliva that can burn flesh and eat through armour. The more riled up the creature is, the greater the volume of spittle it produces.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: **KRULEBOYZ MONSTER** only

spells.name: Da Black Pit
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
spells.lore: The shaman taps his staff on the ground. Forking out from that spot, and surging towards a nearby foe, the earth turns into a noisome quagmire that sucks victims below its surface to their doom.

spells.name: Mork's Kunnin'
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit wholly within 12" of them, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to save rolls for the target.
spells.lore: The shaman channels the raw power of Mork to imbue their allies with uncanny cunning so they might evade enemy blows.

spells.name: Choking Mist
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s weapons until the start of your next turn.
spells.lore: The shaman summons a cloud of corrosive vapour that scorches the lungs of any caught within it.

manifestations.name: Gork-Roara

abilities.name: Bellowing Waaagh!-Cries
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ** or **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** or **PRIEST** within 3" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.

Effect: Pick either 1 or 2 to add to casting rolls or chanting rolls for the target until the start of your next turn. Then, roll a number of dice equal to the number picked. For each 1-2, allocate 1 damage point to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). For each 5+, until the start of your next turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **KRULEBOYZ** or **IRONJAWZ** units while they are wholly within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION**.

Friendly units can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.
abilities.lore: Spurred on by the carnage sweeping the battlefield, the Gork-Roara spews out great drifts of Waaagh! energy that orruks tap into – knowingly or otherwise.

manifestations.lore: From the jaws of a Gork-Roara spews forth the destructive magic of the Waaagh!. Shamans who breathe in this glowing mist find their connection to that primal energy heightened – all for the measly risk of being driven entirely out of their minds. Gork-Roaras share the orruks’ exuberance in battle, howling bloodthirsty invective and jeering battle cries. Should they linger after the din of combat has faded, they will bellow and howl in indignation. Given that the same is true of especially warlike bosses, no orruk really seems to mind.

summonSpell.name: Summon Gork-Roara
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Gork-Roara** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Gork-Roara** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: The shaman summons a leering visage of Gorkamorka that spills forth Waaagh! power.

manifestations.name: Morkspit Marsh

abilities.name: Tricksy Footing
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION**.
abilities.lore: Those who stagger into these eldritch quagmires must use all their strength simply to avoid being pulled under.

abilities.name: Grasping Gunge
abilities.description: Effect: Enemy units cannot use **RUN** abilities while they are within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION**.
abilities.lore: The arcane protoplasm of a Morkspit Marsh seizes limbs tight, dragging at those who draw too close.

manifestations.lore: Morkspit Marshes are amongst the most grisly examples of orruk kunnin’. These squelchy spells transform hard earth into bogland formed of brackish waters, stinking tar, or any other disgusting substance they can think of. From them emerge tendrils of glowing protoplasm that grasp an enemies’ limbs and drag them towards their doom. With their victims otherwise occupied, the orruks can easily move in behind them and bash them across the back of the head.

summonSpell.name: Summon Morkspit Marsh
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Morkspit Marsh** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Morkspit Marsh** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
summonSpell.lore: The shaman summons a cruel, glowing swamp that channels memories of Gorkamorka’s past brawls.

manifestations.name: Foot of Gork

abilities.name: Wandering Destruction
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a part of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 9" of the other part of this **MANIFESTATION**.

Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 3" of the target. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
• That unit has the **STOMPED** keyword until the start of your next turn.
• Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for **STOMPED** units, to a minimum of 1.
abilities.lore: You can’t expect Gork to stand still when there’s fighting about.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.description: Effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **MANIFESTATION**’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **MANIFESTATION** is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

manifestations.lore: No spell is as beloved of orruk-kind as the Foot of Gork. It is brutality made manifest: a huge, warty green foot formed of riotous magic that descends from the sky and squashes anything beneath it flat. One foot follows the descent of the other, smashing colossal craters in the earth that glow with a weird Waaagh!-light. The fact that the Foot of Gork is almost impossible to direct once it has landed doesn’t much bother the orruks, for wherever it stomps, it’s bound to result in a good time.

summonSpell.name: Summon Foot of Gork
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Foot of Gork** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Foot of Gork** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Foot of Gork** has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.
summonSpell.lore: Stamping a furiously belligerent beat, the shaman dares Gork himself to stomp the battlefield flat.

terrain.name: Skaregob Totem

abilities.name: Up We Go!
abilities.description:
Declare: If this terrain feature does not have a Shouty Boss, pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY HERO** that is not in combat and is within 3" of it to be the target.

Effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now a Shouty Boss (see ‘Man da Tower!’).
abilities.lore: The orruk hauls themselves up to the idol’s platform.

abilities.name: I'm Off!
abilities.description: Effect: If this terrain feature has a Shouty Boss that was not placed on it this turn, set up the Shouty Boss on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a Shouty Boss.
abilities.lore: The orruk makes a quick exit.

abilities.name: Man Da Tower!
abilities.description:
Effect: While this terrain feature has a Shouty Boss:

• The Shouty Boss cannot use **Move** abilities.
•Instead of measuring range or visibility to and from the Shouty Boss, measure to and from this terrain feature instead.
•All attacks that would target the Shouty Boss target this terrain feature instead.
•If this terrain feature is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the Shouty Boss. Then, set up the Shouty Boss on the battlefield within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer the Shouty Boss. If it is not possible to set up the Shouty Boss, it is slain.
abilities.lore: Orruk bosses know they look dead impressive when lording it up from an idol of their god.

abilities.name: Sinister Stare
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to dirty trick rolls for friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units wholly within 12" of this terrain feature or for enemy units within 12" of this terrain feature. If this terrain feature has a Shouty Boss, add 1 to dirty trick rolls for friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units wholly within 18" of this terrain feature instead of wholly within 12" or for enemy units within 18" of this terrain feature instead of within 12".
abilities.lore: Kruleboyz find it hilarious to subject foes under the insidious influence of a Skaregob Totem’s hallucinogenic fogs to a host of nasty surprises.

terrain.lore: Skaregob Totems leer ominously through the marsh-murk. Each acts as a lodestone of Morkish magic, the energies of sinister cunning spiralling around them and seeing the strange algae splattered across them glowing with psychedelic frenzy. One who looks upon a Skaregob finds themselves assailed by whispers and jeers, their secrets laid bare through hostile mutterings and their nerves stretched to breaking point. As order breaks down, the Kruleboyz draw in closer, chuckling to themselves – just waiting for the distracted foe to stumble into the traps they have prepared...

units.name: Hobgrot Slittaboss

abilities.name: Kompany Taktikz
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **Hobgrot Slittaz** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Slittabosses drill their hobgrots without mercy – after all, the more decisively they strike, the better chance they have of grabbing up the loot.

abilities.name: Toxic Stash
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed.
abilities.lore: A Slittaboss’s swindling talents are used to secure choice poisons that can overwhelm even a stamping ogor.

details.notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a *Mob Wrangler*.

units.lore: Slittabosses command the hobgrot kompanies that maraud across the realms in search of plunder. They are not only the most physically imposing and dark-hearted of their kind but also the canniest. Each is a master swindler and murderous in ripping loot from the battlefield, no matter who currently possesses it.

units.name: Killaboss with Stab-grot

abilities.name: Keep 'Em In Line
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘All-out Attack’ command for a friendly KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY unit
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is wholly within 12" of the unit using the ‘All-out Attack’ command, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by that unit for the rest of the phase.
abilities.lore: With a threatening glare and barked commands, the Killaboss keeps their boyz in formation.

abilities.name: Unleash the Stab-grot!
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

• Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
• This unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.

After resolving either effect, remove this unit’s **Stab-grot** from the battlefield.
abilities.lore: A Stab-grot isn’t just good for stabbin’ – they double up as an effective living shield when things get dicey.

abilities.name: Stab-grot
abilities.description: Effect: This unit’s **Stab-grot** is a token. If this unit’s **Stab-grot** has been removed, it can no longer attack with its **Stab-grot’s Shiv** and it cannot use the ‘Unleash the Stab-grot!’ ability.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Mob Wrangler*.

units.lore: Killabosses are the warlords of the Kruleboyz. Each has wrested their position from rivals by being not only a potent warrior but also possessed of true Morkish kunnin’, willing to use anyone or anything to garner an advantage.

units.name: Killaboss on Great Gnashtoof

abilities.name: All Part of Da Plan
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick another friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit wholly within 9" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 3 to the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Kruleboyz tend to be very impressed by a Killaboss’s kunnin’ feats – so long as the boss has a plan, they are willing to face down even the most unlikely odds.

abilities.name: That's Ours, Ya Gitz!
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is contesting an objective you do not control, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Kruleboyz are raiders by nature, and the Killabosses are expert at getting the boyz all worked up when they see territory or loot that they’d love to get their dirty hands on.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Swamp Beast*.

units.lore: Particularly storied Killabosses are able to procure all manner of terrifying, swamp-dwelling mounts from the Beast-breakaz to show off their status. Great Gnashtoofs are one such monster, huge and vicious hounds whose swiftness is matched only by their ferocity.

units.name: Kragnos, the End of Empires

abilities.name: Avatar of Destruction
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
abilities.lore: Kragnos is the embodiment of Ghur’s relentless ferocity. No single strike can lay him low.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **The** **Dread Mace** is 4 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

abilities.name: The End of Empires
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for friendly **DESTRUCTION** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit, to a maximum of 3.
abilities.lore: Where Kragnos goes, the hordes of Destruction follow.

abilities.name: The Shield Inviolate
abilities.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **SPELL** ability.
abilities.lore: Tuskbreaker has the power to guard Kragnos against even the most potent magical force.

abilities.name: Rampaging Destruction
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit charged this phase, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Roll a dice for each enemy unit within 1" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
• Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit and roll 2D6. On a 7, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the results on the dice used for the 2D6 roll multiplied together. For example, a 2D6 roll of 2 and 6 would inflict 12 mortal damage (2 × 6).
abilities.lore: Kragnos rampages through the press of his foes, his hooves flattening all in his path.

units.lore: One of the most destructive races to have ever lived, the Drogrukh were centauroid warriors who built a great nation in the Realm of Beasts. From their number rose a champion so powerful that he ascended to godhood: Kragnos, the End of Empires. Having led his people in warfare against a draconic empire that left the Drogrukh all but extinct, Kragnos was sealed away for the protection of the realms – only to be freed centuries later.

units.name: Marshcrawla Sloggoth

abilities.name: On Da March
abilities.description: Effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly **KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY** units can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The drummer that rides with a snatcha-krew beats out a powerful rhythm upon his kettle drum that inspires the Kruleboyz around them to race headlong toward the enemy.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: Effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.
abilities.lore: Troggoths are able to regrow injured flesh almost as quickly as it is harmed.

units.lore: Creeping along on all fours come the Marshcrawla Sloggoths, sniffing the air to home in on fresh prey. On their backs are howdahs full of sneaky grots, banging war-drums and cackling as their vile beasts catch and squish the foe.

units.name: Kruleboyz Monsta-killaz

abilities.name: Bait and Trap
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is damaged. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Monsta‑killaz have perfected the art of baiting even the most fearsome monsters into debilitating traps.

abilities.name: A Tough Grot To Swallow
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a RAMPAGE ability for an enemy MONSTER within 6" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, that **RAMPAGE** ability has no effect. On a 1, remove this unit’s **Klutcha-grot** from the battlefield.
abilities.lore: The spiky-armoured Klutcha-grot is usually gobbled up by the Monsta-killaz’ prey, causing it to choke, retch and vomit up the little git. Of course, sometimes the grot just gets eaten, which the orruks find equally hilarious.

abilities.name: Klutcha-grot
abilities.description: Effect: This unit’s **Klutcha-grot** is a token. If it is removed from the battlefield, this unit cannot use the ‘A Tough Grot to Swallow’ ability.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: Masters of the sudden ambush and the devious ruse, the Kruleboyz known as Monsta-killaz are sadistic, underhanded beast-hunters who eagerly employ every kunnin’ trick in the book to capture their quarry and defeat those who would stand in their way.

units.name: Breaka-boss on Mirebrute Troggoth

abilities.name: Tear Limb From Limb
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit within 1" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.
abilities.lore: Mirebrute Troggoths take great delight plucking foes from the enemy ranks and pulling off their limbs one by one.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: Effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.
abilities.lore: Troggoths are able to regrow injured flesh almost as quickly as it is harmed.

abilities.name: Breaka-harness
abilities.description:
Effect: Make a breaka-roll of D3.

•  Inflict an amount of mortal damage on this unit equal to the breaka-roll.
•  Double the breaka-roll and add that value to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Mirebrute’s Clubs** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: When a Breaka-boss enters combat, they yank their Mirebrute Troggoth’s harness savagely to get the beast good and angry!

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Swamp Beast.*

units.lore: The Breaka-boss towers over their minions, largely because they ride upon the shoulders of a massive Mirebrute Troggoth. By goading this dim-witted beast, they can drive it into a frenzy – though it is the enemy that feels its wrath.

units.name: Swampboss Skumdrekk

abilities.name: Aggravate Wounds
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of damage points the target has. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: The ornery and near-sighted Sloppklaw has developed a keen scent for weakness, and he will eagerly tear into wounded prey in a savage frenzy.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Sloppklaw’s Talons** is 4.

abilities.name: Kountin' Krew
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Hobgrot Slittaz** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, the target’s **Slitta-knives** have **Crit (Mortal)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Swampboss Skumdrekk keeps his hobgrot lackeys, known as his ‘Kountin’ Krew’, close to hand. So close, in fact, that it is they who get first dibs on the toxic sludge that coats the underbelly of his Sludgeraker.

abilities.name: Bet-master
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit on the battlefield to be **the bet**.

Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by this unit and friendly **Hobgrot Slittaz** units that target **the bet**.
abilities.lore: Skumdrekk and his hobgrot Kountin’ Krew take bets at the start of a battle as to which of the enemy will be first to die.

units.lore: Swampboss Skumdrekk is something of a legend amongst the Gitsnatchaz, for not only does he excel in the shifting tides of battle, he makes a fortune out of bidding on the outcome. He and his hobgrot Kountin’ Krew are the bane of enemies and treasuries alike.

units.name: Murknob with Belcha-banna

abilities.name: Breath of the Mire-drakes
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 1, this ability has no effect. On a 2-5, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. On a 6, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Belcha-bannas are typically built around the severed tongue of a mire-drake, creatures so vile that even after death, their remains belch forth clouds of soulshrivelling gas.

abilities.name: Power of Kragnos
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **KRULEBOYZ** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: When the energy of the Waaagh! hangs thick in the air, the Belcha-banna channels the mighty power of Kragnos himself, emboldening the Kruleboyz around it and warding off harmful sorcery.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Mob Wrangler*.

units.lore: Murknobs are champion warriors amongst the Kruleboyz, and they revel in taking the heads of their adversaries – honestly or otherwise. They alone are granted the honour of carrying the Belcha-bannas into battle, each a foul relic with all manner of strange powers.

units.name: Man-skewer Boltboyz

abilities.name: Pick 'Em Off
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Boltboyz prefer to remain stationary to fire carefully aimed shots.

abilities.name: Man-skewer Crossbows
abilities.description: Effect: Each time this unit uses a **SHOOT** ability, pick either the **Hasty Shot** or **Aimed Shot** weapon characteristics for all the attacks it makes with its **Man‑skewer Crossbows**.
abilities.lore: Boltboyz either unleash quick volleys at nearby foes or take careful aim at far-off targets.

units.lore: The fiendish crossbows wielded by the Man-skewer Boltboyz are powerful enough to take down a charging grunta with one shot, while the poisons coating their projectiles induce spasming deaths that are highly entertaining to these cruel orruks.

units.name: Hobgrot Slittaz

abilities.name: Scrap-bang
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:

• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• This unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.
abilities.lore: By detonating their scrap-grenades at the feet of the foe, Hobgrot Slittaz can scarper off to a safe distance.

units.lore: Mobs of Hobgrot Slittaz have often been witnessed accompanying the Kruleboyz orruks to war. These malicious little brutes delight in eviscerating the foe with their slitta-knives and employing explosive devices pilfered from their duardin paymasters to blow unlucky enemies apart.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Killaboss on Great Gnashtoof

abilities.name: Prowling the Flanks
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The Killaboss lurks at the edges of the battle looking for weaknesses in the enemy’s lines.

abilities.name: Drag 'Em Out
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2D6. This unit can move a distance in inches up to the value of the roll. Then, if possible, your opponent must remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The Killaboss picks the toughest-looking git and has their Gnashtoof drag them away from their allies.

details.notes:
This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Swamp Beast*.

This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: Mounted atop a tireless and tremendously foul-tempered Gnashtoof, a Killaboss can more easily run down and impale his victims. These beasts are perfectly suited for the deadly terrain of Ghyran’s battlegrounds, prowling amidst the undergrowth and searching for unworthy prey to drag down and disembowel.

units.name: Snatchaboss on Sludgeraker Beast

abilities.name: Sludgeraker Venom
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: That unit has the **SLUDGERAKER VENOM** keyword for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The underbelly of a Sludgeraker Beast is coated in rotting detritus, encrusted marsh-slime and the beast’s own secretions – a highly virulent mixture that is used by nearby Kruleboyz to coat their weapons.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Sludgeraker’s Talons** is 4.

abilities.name: Festering Wounds
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units that had any damage points allocated to them this turn by attacks made by this unit or a friendly unit with the **SLUDGERAKER VENOM** keyword to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the end of the next turn.
abilities.lore: A Sludgeraker’s talons and fangs are so coated with toxins and grime that wounds they inflict swiftly turn foul and gangrenous.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Swamp Beast*.

units.lore: Experts at capturing prisoners in the mayhem of battle, Snatchabosses regard war as an opportunity to scoop up some prize captives. The Sludgeraker Beasts that bear them into the fighting smell so appalling their scent alone can unman a prospective target.

units.name: Beast-skewer Killbow

abilities.name: Skewering Bolts
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Beast-skewer Bolts** is 6 if the target is a **MONSTER**.
abilities.lore: When sighting a particularly large target, the crew load vicious skewering bolts that can tear through even the mightiest of beasts.

abilities.name: Pick 'Em Off
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Once set up in position, the Beast-skewer Killbow takes its time to line up every shot with deadly results.

units.lore: The idea of an orruk that can shoot straight seems like a contradiction, but they do exist – those who operate the portable ballistas known as Beast-skewer Killbows can not only bullseye a target but also slay several smaller enemies with a single shot.

units.name: Gobsprakk, the Mouth of Mork

abilities.name: Crush to Death
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.
abilities.lore: Gobsprakk’s mount, Killabeak, takes wicked delight in crushing smaller foes in its talons.

abilities.name: Strangle Hex
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic, to a maximum of 10. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Coiling tendrils of magic burst from Gobsprakk’s outstretched hand, choking the life from the target.

abilities.name: Mork Sez No!
abilities.description: Effect: Each time this unit unbinds a spell, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster. If the unbinding roll was 10+, inflict D6 mortal damage on the caster instead.
abilities.lore: As enemy wizards foolishly attempt to weave their magics, Gobsprakk summons tapewyrm sguigs into their guts and fills their minds with so much Waaagh! energy that they sometimes explode!

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Killabeak’s Talons and Beak** is 5.

abilities.name: Screamin' Mandrakk
abilities.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.description: Effect: This unit uses the ‘Unbind’ ability but the unbinding roll is 3D6 instead of 2D6.
abilities.lore: The awful sound this plant emits wreaks havoc on the concentration of enemy wizards.

units.lore: Most infamous of all Swampcalla Shamans is Gobsprakk. He is the greatest prophet of orruk-kind, the Mouth of Mork, and it is clear the favour of the kunnin’ god is upon him. Green energy crackles around Gobsprakk when his ire is raised, and even the biggest orruks have learnt to fear the narrowing of the shaman’s eyes, for someone’s sudden demise follows soon after. Those who cross him have a strange habit of choking to death as their lungs fill with swamp water, even if they are standing upon an arid plain. Should an enemy survive his perfidious spells, they are snatched up in the talons of his beloved Corpse-rippa Vulcha, Killabeak.

units.name: Swampcalla Shaman with Pot-grot

abilities.name: Foul Elixirs
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **KRULEBOYZ INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Swampcalla Shamans brew up disgusting but life-saving elixirs, which they distribute to their Kruleboyz mates to aid them in battle.

abilities.name: Pot-grot
abilities.description: Effect: This unit’s **Pot-grot** is a token. Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit while its **Pot-grot** is on the battlefield. If you make an unmodified casting roll of 4 or less for this unit, remove its **Pot-grot** from the battlefield.
abilities.lore: This little grot is given the important role of ‘stirrin’ da pot’.

units.lore: Even for Kruleboyz, Swampcalla Shamans are foul creatures. These spell-flingers have an innate connection to the mires they inhabit, which they channel into noisome spells of debilitation while brewing up vile elixirs to aid their green- skinned kin.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Swampboss Skumdrekk

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Sloppklaw’s Bite and Talons** is 4.

abilities.name: Thrashing Tail
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than or equal to the number of models in the target unit, for the rest of the turn, each time this unit uses an **ATTACK** ability, if all of the attacks target that enemy unit, those attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+. This ability also affects **Companion** weapons.
abilities.lore: Sloppklaw sweeps his tail through a group of foes, throwing them to the ground so that he can trample and gore them with impunity.

abilities.name: Rigged Odds
abilities.description:
Effect: The first time you fail a dirty trick roll each turn, give this unit 1 **betting chip**.

Each time you make a dirty trick roll for an ability that targets a unit wholly within 12" of this unit, you can spend any number of **betting chips** after seeing the result of the roll. For each **betting chip** you spend, add 1 to that dirty trick roll.
abilities.lore: Skumdrekk never takes a bet unless the outcome is heavily swayed his way.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: Always eager to take advantage of death and mayhem, the sadistic Swampboss Skumdrekk travels to Ghyran in search of beasts and prisoners for his monster pits. Mounted atop his repulsive mount Sloppklaw, Skumdrekk doles out pain wherever he roams, gambling with the lives of his minions and enemies alike.

units.name: Gutrippaz

abilities.name: Scare Taktikz
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by non-**HERO** units that target this unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Gutrippaz use all manner of means to unnerve and soften up their foes before the first blow is struck, from gruesome ‘skareshields’ to ululating battle cries that echo from the boggy mists.

units.lore: Gutrippaz form the slimy heart of the Kruleboyz. These mobs of sadistic greenskins are known for their vicious kunnin’ and the spiteful amusement they find in laying low the enemy with their wicked, poisoned weapons.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Killaboss with Stab-grot

abilities.name: Just Keep Stabbin'
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your **fury level**. You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:

• Add 1 to each roll.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, for each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: The Killaboss angrily kicks their luckless Stab-grot towards an enemy, where the little git does what they do best.

abilities.name: Jump 'Em, Ladz, Or Else!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick a friendly **Gutrippaz** or **Hobgrot Slittaz** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Killaboss knows just how to motivate their boyz: threats, intimidation and a very real demonstration of what will happen to them if they don’t get stuck in.

details.notes:
This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Mob Wrangler*.

This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: The warlords of the Kruleboyz, Killabosses lead their ladz across the Great Parch, keeping them in line using violence and intimidation. Some Killabosses are accompanied by vicious Stab‐grots that they punt at nearby foes to slash at ankles and slice tendons.

units.name: Killaboss on Corpse-rippa Vulcha

abilities.name: Vulcha Dive
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified charge roll. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: The Corpse-rippa crashes down into the enemy’s ranks from on high, tearing into reeling warriors with cruel relish.

abilities.name: Commanding View
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a friendly Gutrippaz unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
abilities.lore: From his position high above the battlefield, a Killaboss riding a Corpse-rippa Vulcha can keep a careful eye on the battle, guiding the movements of their ladz.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Vulcha’s Talons and Beak** is 5.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Swamp Beast*.

units.lore: The Killaboss rules through strength as well as cunning, for they have an expert eye for picking out an enemy’s weak spot and driving a blade into it. In battle, those who ride the immense raptor-like creatures known as Corpse-rippa Vulchas dive out of the mists without warning, striking from nowhere to gut the enemy force.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Killaboss on Great Gnashtoof

abilities.name: Prowling the Flanks
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The Killaboss lurks at the edges of the battle looking for weaknesses in the enemy’s lines.

abilities.name: Drag 'Em Out
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2D6. This unit can move a distance in inches up to the value of the roll. Then, if possible, your opponent must remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The Killaboss picks the toughest-looking git and has their Gnashtoof drag them away from their allies.

details.notes:
This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Swamp Beast*.
This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Killabosses bound for Aqshy often ride Great Gnashtoofs; already foul tempered and hot headed, these beasts are quick to adjust to the battlegrounds of the Bright Realm, ready to snatch up unsuspecting prey in their powerful jaws.

battleTraits.name: Mighty Destroyers
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit that was not set up this turn to be the target.

Effect: The target can move up to 3". It can move into combat. If it was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.
battleTraits.lore: The Ironjawz won’t let anything get between them and a good scrap.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Ironjawz armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Ironjawz Waaagh!
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ HERO** to be the target. You cannot pick the same **HERO** to be the target of this ability more than once per battle.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the following effects apply to friendly **IRONJAWZ** units while they are wholly within 18" of the target:

• Add 1 to charge rolls for those units.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of those units’ melee weapons.
battleTraits.lore: With a roar that shakes the battlefield, the Ironjawz charge as one, eager to crack skulls.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Ironjawz armies can use the following abilities:

ability.name: Natural Disaster
ability.description: Effect: If you make an unmodified charge roll of 8+ for a friendly non-**HERO IRONJAWZ** unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: A mass of heavily armoured orruks and their bulky beasts of war, an Ironjawz Brawl hits the enemy line like a landslide if it gains enough momentum, leaving a trail of carnage and blazing ruin in its wake.

abilities.name: Natural Disaster
abilities.description: Effect: If you make an unmodified charge roll of 8+ for a friendly non-**HERO IRONJAWZ** unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A mass of heavily armoured orruks and their bulky beasts of war, an Ironjawz Brawl hits the enemy line like a landslide if it gains enough momentum, leaving a trail of carnage and blazing ruin in its wake.

ability.name: Spirit of Gork
ability.description: Effect: Friendly **IRONJAWZ INFANTRY** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARDS** or **PRIESTS**.
ability.lore: The roiling Waaagh! energy that emanates from the Weirdfist shamans fills nearby Ironjawz with the fighting spirit and hardiness of Gork.

abilities.name: Spirit of Gork
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **IRONJAWZ INFANTRY** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARDS** or **PRIESTS**.
abilities.lore: The roiling Waaagh! energy that emanates from the Weirdfist shamans fills nearby Ironjawz with the fighting spirit and hardiness of Gork.

ability.name: Smashin' and Bashin'
ability.description: Effect: The first time each turn that an enemy unit is destroyed by a **FIGHT** ability used by a friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by the next friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit that is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: The orruks of an Ironfist won’t be outdone by each other – when one mob duffs up the enemy, it inspires others to show them how to do it properly!

abilities.name: Smashin' and Bashin'
abilities.description: Effect: The first time each turn that an enemy unit is destroyed by a **FIGHT** ability used by a friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by the next friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit that is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The orruks of an Ironfist won’t be outdone by each other – when one mob duffs up the enemy, it inspires others to show them how to do it properly!

ability.name: 'Ere We Come!
ability.description: Effect: Add the number of enemy units that have been destroyed this battle to the Move characteristic of friendly **Gore-gruntas** and **MAW-GRUNTA** units, to a maximum of +4.
ability.lore: Once a grunta stampede gets going and the hogs are all riled up, there are few forces in the realms with the power to halt its momentum.

abilities.name: 'Ere We Come!
abilities.description: Effect: Add the number of enemy units that have been destroyed this battle to the Move characteristic of friendly **Gore-gruntas** and **MAW-GRUNTA** units, to a maximum of +4.
abilities.lore: Once a grunta stampede gets going and the hogs are all riled up, there are few forces in the realms with the power to halt its momentum.

heroicTraits.name: An Eye For Da Fight
heroicTraits.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a friendly IRONJAWZ unit wholly within 12" of this unit
heroicTraits.description: Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
heroicTraits.lore: This orruk is among the most dangerous of their brutal kind: one who instinctively understands the flow of battle and knows just where the best fights are likely to kick off.

heroicTraits.name: Mega Bossy
heroicTraits.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **IRONJAWZ** units while they are wholly within 18" of this unit.
heroicTraits.lore: This boss’s booming voice constantly rings out across the battlefield, ‘encouraging’ their ladz to get krumpin’.

heroicTraits.name: Hulking Brute
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If this unit’s unmodified charge roll this turn was 8+, roll a D6 instead of a D3.
heroicTraits.lore: Even by orruk standards, this boss is huge, and he is ever eager to throw his immense weight around in battle.

artefacts.name: Trophy Skulls
artefacts.description: Effect: Add 10 to this unit’s control score.
artefacts.lore: Festooned with the skulls of those who crossed them, be they ferocious beast or mighty warrior, there’s no doubt that this orruk means business.

artefacts.name: Armour of Gork
artefacts.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (6+)**.
artefacts.lore: This bashed-together armour is thick, heavy and possessed of its own fierce fighting spirit.

artefacts.name: Amberbone Whetstone
artefacts.description: Effect: Pick 1 of this unit’s weapons. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the battle.
artefacts.lore: This prized sharpening stone, laced with veins of realmstone, is found deep in the crags of Ghur. It is loved by the Ironjawz for its ability to make a weapon ‘ded sharp’.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Chimeric Mantle
aqshyArtefacts.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract D3 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s **Companion** weapons while it is in combat with this unit.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: Crudely stitched together from the pelts and hides of myriad different creatures, this orruk’s ragged cloak causes beasts to recoil in fear.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Weird Skullz
aqshyArtefacts.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the target is within 12" of this unit, add 1 to the roll. On a 4+:

• Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
• Subtract 1 from the target’s power level until the start of your next turn.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: Originally belonging to Weirdnobs who died of ‘unknown causes’, these caved-in skulls exude Waaagh! energy that can give nearby foes pounding headaches, making it difficult for them to focus.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Horn of Shattatusk
aqshyArtefacts.phase: Reaction: You declared the 'Ironjawz Waaagh!' ability and picked this unit to be the target
aqshyArtefacts.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by friendly **IRONJAWZ** units while they are wholly within 18" of this unit.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: Purportedly crafted from one of the godbeast’s tusks, a blast from this horn imbues the Ironjawz’ charging beasts with the same bellicosity as their riders.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Fast 'Un
aqshyEnhancements.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: If this unit was not set up this turn, it can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: The beast lurches forward at a speed that would take anyone by surprise.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: **IRONJAWZ MONSTER** only

aqshyEnhancements.name: Angry 'Un
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your **fury level**. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: Particularly irascible, this beast takes its rage out on anything that gets in its way.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: **IRONJAWZ MONSTER** only

aqshyEnhancements.name: Big 'Un
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** weapons.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: This beast is noticeably more muscular and krumpier than others of its kind.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: **IRONJAWZ MONSTER** only

spells.name: Bash 'Em Ladz!
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** until the start of your next turn.
spells.lore: Pulsing waves of Waaagh! energy radiate from the shaman, boosting the fighting prowess of nearby Ironjawz.

spells.name: Da Great Big Green Hand of Gork
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 24" of the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.
spells.lore: A ghostly green hand picks up a mob of Ironjawz and plonks them back down where they are most needed.

spells.name: Mighty 'Eadbutt
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the target is a **WIZARD**, inflict 3 mortal damage on the target instead.
spells.lore: The shaman headbutts the air, projecting a wave of green energy that seeks out enemies, especially spell-flingas, to nut.

prayers.name: Fixin' Beat
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: **Heal (D6)** the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, **Heal (D3+3)** the target instead.
prayers.lore: The Warchanter pounds a restorative rhythm that gives the ladz a second wind.

prayers.name: Get 'Em Beat
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to charge rolls for the target. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a maximum of 3.
prayers.lore: A pounding rhythm is played by the Warchanter, inspiring nearby Ironjawz to wreak destruction and ruin upon their enemies.

prayers.name: Killa Beat
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **IRONJAWZ** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.
prayers.lore: The Warchanter drums a thumping beat that causes raw Waaagh! energy to course through the weapons of the orruks.

manifestations.name: Gork-Roara

abilities.name: Bellowing Waaagh!-Cries
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ** or **KRULEBOYZ WIZARD** or **PRIEST** within 3" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.

Effect: Pick either 1 or 2 to add to casting rolls or chanting rolls for the target until the start of your next turn. Then, roll a number of dice equal to the number picked. For each 1-2, allocate 1 damage point to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). For each 5+, until the start of your next turn, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **KRULEBOYZ** or **IRONJAWZ** units while they are wholly within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION**.

Friendly units can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.
abilities.lore: Spurred on by the carnage sweeping the battlefield, the Gork-Roara spews out great drifts of Waaagh! energy that orruks tap into – knowingly or otherwise.

manifestations.lore: From the jaws of a Gork-Roara spews forth the destructive magic of the Waaagh!. Shamans who breathe in this glowing mist find their connection to that primal energy heightened – all for the measly risk of being driven entirely out of their minds. Gork-Roaras share the orruks’ exuberance in battle, howling bloodthirsty invective and jeering battle cries. Should they linger after the din of combat has faded, they will bellow and howl in indignation. Given that the same is true of especially warlike bosses, no orruk really seems to mind.

summonSpell.name: Summon Gork-Roara
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Gork-Roara** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Gork-Roara** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: The shaman summons a leering visage of Gorkamorka that spills forth Waaagh! power.

manifestations.name: Foot of Gork

abilities.name: Wandering Destruction
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn, Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a part of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 9" of the other part of this **MANIFESTATION**.

Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 3" of the target. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
• That unit has the **STOMPED** keyword until the start of your next turn.
• Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for **STOMPED** units, to a minimum of 1.
abilities.lore: You can’t expect Gork to stand still when there’s fighting about.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.description: Effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **MANIFESTATION**’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **MANIFESTATION** is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

manifestations.lore: No spell is as beloved of orruk-kind as the Foot of Gork. It is brutality made manifest: a huge, warty green foot formed of riotous magic that descends from the sky and squashes anything beneath it flat. One foot follows the descent of the other, smashing colossal craters in the earth that glow with a weird Waaagh!-light. The fact that the Foot of Gork is almost impossible to direct once it has landed doesn’t much bother the orruks, for wherever it stomps, it’s bound to result in a good time.

summonSpell.name: Summon Foot of Gork
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Foot of Gork** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Foot of Gork** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Foot of Gork** has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.
summonSpell.lore: Stamping a furiously belligerent beat, the shaman dares Gork himself to stomp the battlefield flat.

manifestations.name: Morkspit Marsh

abilities.name: Tricksy Footing
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION**.
abilities.lore: Those who stagger into these eldritch quagmires must use all their strength simply to avoid being pulled under.

abilities.name: Grasping Gunge
abilities.description: Effect: Enemy units cannot use **RUN** abilities while they are within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION**.
abilities.lore: The arcane protoplasm of a Morkspit Marsh seizes limbs tight, dragging at those who draw too close.

manifestations.lore: Morkspit Marshes are amongst the most grisly examples of orruk kunnin’. These squelchy spells transform hard earth into bogland formed of brackish waters, stinking tar, or any other disgusting substance they can think of. From them emerge tendrils of glowing protoplasm that grasp an enemies’ limbs and drag them towards their doom. With their victims otherwise occupied, the orruks can easily move in behind them and bash them across the back of the head.

summonSpell.name: Summon Morkspit Marsh
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Morkspit Marsh** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **IRONJAWZ WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Morkspit Marsh** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
summonSpell.lore: The shaman summons a cruel, glowing swamp that channels memories of Gorkamorka’s past brawls.
