terrain.name: Fane of Slaanesh

abilities.name: Damned Conduit
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this terrain feature to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, while the target is within **X"** of this terrain feature, the target’s weapons have the **Companion** weapon ability, where **X** is determined by the current battle round as follows:

**Battle Round - X**
1 - 9"
2 - 12"
3 - 15"
4 - 18"
5 - 21"
abilities.lore: The corruptive energies of Slaanesh and his daemonic courtiers emanate from a Fane, undermining and perverting the virtues of those nearby.

terrain.lore: Fanes of Slaanesh are profane altars to the Lord of Delights. As unnatural creations, they may be coaxed into reality upon a battlefield by supplicants, if they have worthy tribute to provide. Through a Fane, the denizens of Slaanesh’s domain have a conduit directly to the Mortal Realms – a gate through which their power to corrupt and undermine can gradually flood the field.

units.name: Symbaresh Twinsouls

abilities.name: Pah! Unworthy!
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is damaged or has fewer than half its starting models, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of its melee weapons.
abilities.lore: Seeing other possessed warriors fall merely convinces surviving Symbaresh of their own superiority.

abilities.name: Ego-Driven Excess
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target an enemy unit that has a higher Control characteristic than this unit.
abilities.lore: The Symbaresh have twisted their very souls in the hope of standing paramount amongst warriors. Nothing infuriates them more, therefore, than the sight of a potentially worthy rival.

units.lore: Even by the standards of the Sybarites, the Symbaresh are proud indeed. These former Myrmidesh have forged dark pacts with the lesser daemons of Slaanesh, sharing their mortal forms in return for a measure of otherworldly power.

units.name: Synessa, the Voice of Slaanesh

abilities.name: Whispers of Desire
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
abilities.lore: Synessa whispers words that reveal the enemy’s darkest urges, breaking their concentration and causing them to falter in their attack.

abilities.name: Enthralling Splendour
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit with a lower Control characteristic than this unit, that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A mere glance at Synessa’s magnificence leaves those nearby captivated.

abilities.name: Arcane Seductor
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is higher than the target’s power level, for the rest of the battle round, while the target is within 18" of this unit:
• Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for enemy units while they are within 18" of this unit.
• Add 1 to this unit’s power level.
abilities.lore: Those with some mystical aptitude are especially vulnerable to Synessa’s wiles; the Voice relishes unpicking their minds, working plots to steal their power for itself.

regimentOptions: 0-1 HEDONITES OF SLAANESH Dexcessa or *Slaaneshi Beguiler*
details.notes: This **HERO** can join **Dexcessa**’s regiment.

units.lore: Where their sibling adores physical excess, Synessa’s power lies in the manipulation of the mind. Even a glance at their splendour leaves those nearby enthralled, and the daemons of Slaanesh enter raptures of obedience at their every word.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Syll'Esske, the Vengeful Allegiance

abilities.name: Champions of the Gilded Throne
abilities.description: Effect: When players are alternating picking units to use a **FIGHT** ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, instead of picking 1 unit, you can pick a friendly non-**HERO HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON** unit wholly within 18" of this unit and a friendly non-**HERO SYBARITE** unit wholly within 18" of this unit. Resolve the second **FIGHT** ability immediately after the first.
abilities.lore: Blessed by Syll’Esske, nearby daemons and mortals fight with a synergy that defies comprehension.

abilities.name: Violent Offerings
abilities.description: Effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** by this unit’s combat attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed, add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.
abilities.lore: Esske will go to great lengths to please Syll, delicately prising magical trinkets from severed heads and limbs to gift to the source of his obsession.

abilities.name: Wandering Minds
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 1 visible friendly non-**HERO SYBARITE INFANTRY** unit and up to 1 visible friendly non-**HERO HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON INFANTRY** unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If you picked a **SYBARITE** target, subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by its combat attacks until the start of your next turn. If you picked a **DAEMON** target, it has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The dark enchantments woven by Syll and the domineering aura of Esske cause mystical wards and mental defences to slip away like silk sliding from burnished silver.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: Not a single Slaaneshi fiend but a mortal and daemon joined in malicious harmony, Syll’Esske has entered the war in Ghyran in the hope of gathering sycophants to join their host. They aim to achieve this via gratuitous acts of violence, cutting a bloody swathe across the land and impressing each other with particularly vile feats of depravity.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Slaangor Fiendbloods

abilities.name: Veiled Threat
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up this unit in reserve **waiting in ambush**. It has now been deployed.
abilities.lore: Slaangors can move as smoothly and soundlessly as silk before bursting out into a bleating, bellowing charge.

abilities.name: Instinctive Advance
abilities.phase: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 12" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can move up to 3" immediately after that command has been resolved, unless that command is a reaction, in which case this unit can move after the ability that it was reacting to has been resolved. That move can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units, and can end in combat.
abilities.lore: The Slaangors are drawn to the screams of the battlefield as a hungering predator is drawn to wounded prey.

abilities.name: Bestial Onslaught
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is **waiting in ambush**.

Effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: With primal savagery, the Slaangor Fiendbloods take to the battlefield, ready to surround their enemies.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: Hideous beastmen blessed by the Dark Prince with chitinous pincer-limbs, Slaangor Fiendbloods pursue violent excess with a single-minded intensity. They delight in the chaotic slaughter that has overrun the Everspring Swathe, slicing their prey into pieces and taking every opportunity to indulge their primal urge for mayhem and torment.

units.name: Syll'Esske, the Vengeful Allegiance

abilities.name: Champions of the Gilded Throne
abilities.description: Effect: When players are alternating picking units to use a **FIGHT** ability, when it is your turn to pick a unit, instead of picking 1 unit, you can pick a friendly non-**HERO HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON** unit wholly within 18" of this unit and a friendly non-**HERO** **SYBARITE** unit wholly within 18" of this unit. Resolve the second **FIGHT** ability immediately after the first.
abilities.lore: Blessed by Syll’Esske, nearby daemons and mortals fight with a synergy that defies comprehension.

abilities.name: Unholy Symbiosis
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 1 visible friendly **SYBARITE** unit and up to 1 visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON** unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If you picked a **SYBARITE** target, subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by its combat attacks until the start of your next turn. If you picked a **DAEMON** target, it has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The dark enchantments woven by the twin entity Syll’Esske can offer power to both mortal and daemon alike – though there must always be a balance, a reflection of their own wicked union.

abilities.name: Violent Offerings
abilities.description: Effect: If any damage points were allocated this turn by this unit’s combat attacks to an enemy **WIZARD**, **PRIEST**, **UNIQUE** unit or unit with an artefact of power, and that enemy unit has been destroyed, add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.
abilities.lore: Esske will go to great lengths to please Syll, delicately prising magical trinkets from the severed heads and limbs of the enemy to gift to the source of his obsession.

units.lore: Syll Lewdtongue has inspired thousands of warlords to acts of tyranny and misrule, but since uniting their powers with the megalomaniacal daemon-monarch Esske, the Herald of Slaanesh has become a force of conquest like no other.

units.name: Dexcessa, the Talon of Slaanesh

abilities.name: Joyous Battle Fury
abilities.description: Effect: If any enemy models were slain by this unit’s combat attacks this turn, **Heal (D3)** this unit and add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Impaling Talons** for the rest of the battle. This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.
abilities.lore: Once Dexcessa begins to fight, they become invigorated by the glorious thrill of combat.

abilities.name: Fleeting Dance of Death
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it is in combat.
abilities.lore: Dexcessa rarely stays locked in combat in one place for long, flitting swiftly all over the battlefield and bringing death wherever they alight.

abilities.name: You! Amuse Us!
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **PARAGON** that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range and visible to this unit to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Cruel Dexcessa is patron to many warrior-champions, and they expect these favoured souls to prove their worth.

abilities.name: Redolence of Violence
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2D6. If this unit charged this turn, add 2 to the roll. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target is automatically slain. If the target is a **MANIFESTATION** and the roll exceeds its banishment value, it is banished and removed from play.
abilities.lore: Should Dexcessa fall into a truly ecstatic rampage, very little can hope to survive the whirling, spiteful onslaught that they unleash – let alone remain in one piece.

regimentOptions: 0-1 HEDONITES OF SLAANESH Synessa or *Slaaneshi Beguiler*
details.notes: This **HERO** can join **Synessa**’s regiment.

units.lore: Dexcessa considers themselves to be the right hand of Slaanesh, made manifest in the realms to sunder and unpick the alliances of his enemies. If that means that they can revel in the glorious, everescalating excess of battle, so much the better.

units.name: Seeker Chariot

abilities.name: Mutilating Blades
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: A Slaaneshi chariot inflicts carnage when it ploughs into the foe.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Seeker Chariots lead the charge of many Hedonite armies, for the beasts that pull them to war are as fleet-footed as Aqshian cheetahs. Whips lash out to strip flesh from bone as the Allurer drives the bladewheeled conveyance into the thick of the foe.

units.name: Glutos Orscollion, Lord of Gluttony

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Kyazu’s Greatblade and Mutants’ Claws** is 4.

abilities.name: Gorge on Excess
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYBARITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: **Heal (6)** the target or return a number of slain models to the target with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
abilities.lore: Glutos’s followers grow strong on acts of gross indulgence.

abilities.name: Crippling Famishment
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:
• Halve the target’s Move characteristic.
• Halve run rolls and charge rolls for the target.
abilities.lore: With a snap of his fingers, Glutos afflicts his prey with debilitating hunger pangs that see them double over and stumble in bouts of sudden weakness.

abilities.name: Paragon of Gluttony
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following delicacies for Glutos to savour. You cannot pick a delicacy that you picked in the previous turn. The effect applies for the rest of the turn:

***Heart of a Shadow Daemon***: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly non-**MONSTER** **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them.

***Blood of an Aelven Princeling***: Each time a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses a **RUN** ability, if you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

***Crushed Incarnate’s Core***: Add 1 to unbinding rolls and banishment rolls for this unit.

***Unspeakable Viscera***: Inflict D6 mortal damage on each other unit (friendly and enemy) within this unit’s combat range.
abilities.lore: None embody gluttony better than Glutos, who is ever craving new, extreme and excessive delicacies.

units.lore: Guided by the daemon Loth’shar, Glutos Orscollion is on a quest to sample the most exotic tastes in the Mortal Realms. Riding atop an opulent palanquin and surrounded by his devoted court, he can unmake whole armies through his loathsome magics.

units.name: Shalaxi Helbane

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Soulpiercer** is 4.

abilities.name: Supernatural Grace
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.
abilities.lore: Whether they turn blows aside or simply dodge out of harm’s way, it is extremely difficult to pin down a Keeper of Secrets.

abilities.name: Paramount Hunter
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a CHARGE ability for a HERO within 12" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is not in combat, it can immediately move up to 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but it must end that move within ½" of that **HERO**. If it does so, this unit has charged, and that **HERO**’s **CHARGE** ability has no effect.
abilities.lore: Shalaxi will permit none save themselves the honour of striking down their chosen quarry.

abilities.name: An Exquisite Trophy
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the phase, the following effects apply:

• This unit's combat attacks that target that enemy unit have **Crit (2 Hits)** and score critical hits on unmodified hit roll of 5+.

• If the target is destroyed by this unit's combat attacks this phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by other friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.
abilities.lore: Shalaxi Helbane delights in making examples of the enemy's greatest champions, redoubling their aggression to ensure victory and shatter enemy morale.

abilities.name: Refine Senses
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Add 1 to the casting roll if this unit is the target.

Effect: The target has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Shalaxi draws upon sensory magics to sharpen their followers' instincts and render them more decisive hunters.

units.lore: Known as the Monarch of the Hunt, Shalaxi Helbane is Slaanesh’s weapon against the daemons of the other Chaos Gods. Able to discern the secrets of the Dark Prince’s foes through blended senses, this statuesque warlord has slain a thousand rivals and more.

units.name: The Masque

abilities.name: Captive Audience
abilities.description: Effect: Enemy units cannot use **RETREAT** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: The Masque’s hypnotic movements make it nigh impossible for a viewer to focus their attention elsewhere.

abilities.name: The Endless Dance
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

***The Dance of Dreaming***: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, if the unmodified hit roll for an attack made by that enemy unit that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

***The Pavane of Slaanesh***: This unit can move 2D3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.

***The Waltz of Lethargy***: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the turn, the target cannot use commands while it is in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: The Masque is master of every breed of quickstep, pivot and sauté imaginable – and many that appear to defy both imagination and the limits of the flesh.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Slaaneshi Beguiler*.

units.lore: The Masque once entertained Slaanesh, but they were exiled upon displeasing him. Since then, the Herald has been cursed to dance across the Mortal Realms. Those drawn into this endless performance are doomed to a swift and spectacular death.

units.name: Keeper of Secrets

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Elegant Greatblade** is 3.

abilities.name: Supernatural Grace
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.
abilities.lore: Whether they turn blows aside or simply dodge out of harm’s way, it is extremely difficult to pin down a Keeper of Secrets.

abilities.name: Locus of Slaanesh
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON** unit that started the battle with 3 or more models and has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: With violence and excess, the walls of reality can be made thin enough to draw forth reinforcements of Slaaneshi daemons.

abilities.name: Cacophonic Choir
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick any number of visible enemy units within 12" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6. Subtract 1 from the casting roll for each target you picked after the first.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.
abilities.lore: The Keeper of Secrets unleashes a sanity-shattering chorus of magical sound.

abilities.name: Dark Temptations
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following musks. Its effects apply for the rest of the turn.

***Alluring Musk***:
• This unit’s weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** for attacks that target that enemy unit.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by that enemy unit that target this unit.

***Psychotropic Musk***:
• Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by that enemy unit that target this unit.
• Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.
abilities.lore: With a flourish and an ecstatic sigh, the Keeper of Secrets alters its scent to elicit the desired effect in its victims and plunge itself into a blissful state of combat euphoria.

units.lore: A Keeper of Secrets is a greater daemon of Slaanesh, a consummate warrior and spellmaster of the Dark Prince’s hosts. Its four powerful arms move languidly as it slinks forwards, only to explode into lethal motion when its prey is in reach.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Blissbarb Seekers

abilities.name: Numbing Toxins
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.

Effect: The target cannot use reactions or be picked to be the target of reactions used by your opponent or by units in your opponent’s army for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Some Blissbarbs dip their arrows in substances that deprive those they strike of sensation, dulling their reactions.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Hurtling across the battlefield, Blissbarb Seekers deal death at a blistering pace. Astride their daemonic Exalted Steeds, such is these Sybarite archers’ obsession with speed that not even the lava‐fields of the Great Parch can slow them.

units.name: Daemonettes

abilities.name: Lithe and Swift
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, it can move D3+3". It can pass through enemy models and the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move within ½" of a visible enemy unit.
abilities.lore: Daemonettes move so fast that the mortal eye almost cannot follow; they vault, twirl and leap through enemy ranks like some marvellous troupe of performers, though their laughter soon turns savage as their claws go to work.

units.lore: Possessed of impossible grace and grotesque beauty, Daemonettes of Slaanesh bound across the battlefield with sadistic glee. They are in constant competition with one another to see who can inflict the most pain on the enemies of the Dark Prince.

units.name: Shardspeaker of Slaanesh

abilities.name: Bargain with the Mist-Daemons
abilities.phase: Once per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict 2 mortal damage on this unit. On a 3+, add 2 to the casting roll.
abilities.lore: The entities bound into the mists that surround a Shardspeaker can offer power – but one must take caution in dealing with such spiteful creatures...

abilities.name: Truths of the Twisted Mirror
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is a **PARAGON**, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of it to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target.
abilities.lore: When flushed with the favour of Slaanesh, a Shardspeaker can use their sorcerous ability and cursed mirror to show an enemy a reflection of their darkest and most unspeakable desires, lowering their guard at a crucial moment.

units.lore: Shardspeakers of Slaanesh are favoured sorcerers who have been gifted with a relic from the Temple of Twisted Mirrors. By tapping into the power of these artefacts, they can reduce a disciplined regiment to a pack of howling beasts ripe for the slaughter.

units.name: Seekers

abilities.name: Quicksilver Speed
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn and has not used the ‘Power Through’ command this turn, it can immediately use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
abilities.lore: The thrill of the chase is everything to the daemonic Seekers; if no prey lies before them, their steeds will simply keep powering onwards, tongues flicking out as they search for soul- traces of new, enticing quarry.

units.lore: Seekers of Slaanesh are the vanguard of the Dark Prince’s daemon armies, insatiable outriders who track their foes with unrelenting swiftness, feeding on the growing terror of their prey.

units.name: Sigvald, Prince of Slaanesh

abilities.name: Shardslash
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by this unit’s combat attacks.
abilities.lore: This majestic blade slices through armour and arcane wards alike as if they were the thinnest silk.

abilities.name: Gaze Upon My Magnificence and Weep
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Your opponent must decide whether the target will **adulate** or **reject** Sigvald.

***Adulate:*** Until the start of your next turn, while the target is in combat with this unit, it must pick this unit to be the target of pile-in moves it makes.

***Reject:*** Inflict D3+3 mortal damage on the target, then **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is the number of damage points inflicted on the target this turn by this ability.
abilities.lore: It is said that to look upon Sigvald is to have one’s mind stolen. Those who resist are cut down by outraged fellows – much to the petulant prince’s delight.

abilities.name: Paragon of Vainglory
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit charged this turn and the unmodified charge roll was 6+ , for the rest of the turn:

• This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST**.
• The Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Shardslash** is equal to the unmodified charge roll.
• Melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, used by other friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** units have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.
abilities.lore: Sigvald is the epitome of vainglory, one of Slaanesh’s favourite sins. So great is his sense of superiority that few can stand before his prideful assaults.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Dark Egotist*.

units.lore: Sigvald the Magnificent considers himself to be the favoured son of Slaanesh. Few would dare question this belief. In battle, the master of the Decadent Host fights as a golden blur, laughing cruelly as his elegant blade slices through rabble and champions alike.

units.name: Infernal Enrapturess, Herald of Slaanesh

abilities.name: Spell-Shredding Symphony
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** and **BANISH** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**. In addition, each time this unit successfully unbinds a spell, inflict D3 mortal damage on the caster and each time this unit successfully banishes a **MANIFESTATION**, inflict D3 mortal damage on the unit that summoned that **MANIFESTATION**.
abilities.lore: The vile tunes of torture strummed by these daemon-heralds are so unpalatable that even magic comes undone at their vibrations. So too, as it happens, do the casters.

abilities.name: Maestros of Discordance
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick another visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the friendly target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the enemy target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the enemy target.

Then, you can pick 1 of the following effects:
• **Heal (X)** the friendly target, where **X** is the number of enemy models slain by this ability this phase.
• Return a number of slain models to the friendly target unit with a total Health characteristic equal to or less than the number of enemy models slain by this ability this phase.
abilities.lore: An Infernal Enrapturess can play music so dissonant that it causes physical harm to enemies while captivating other daemonic entities beyond the veil of reality.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Slaaneshi Beguiler*.

units.lore: Maestros of discordance, Infernal Enrapturesses fill the battlefield with screams of pain and unrestrained elation. They are virtuosos among Slaanesh’s infernal choirs, towards whom the Dark Prince’s daemonic legions are drawn.

units.name: Fiends

abilities.name: Arcane Disruption
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls and unbinding rolls for enemy **WIZARDS** while they are within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Fiends of Slaanesh let out a keening chorus that shreds the sanity of spellcasters who hear it.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Disharmonious Song
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit that did not use a **CHARGE** or **FIGHT** ability this turn to be a target.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. You can re-roll the dice if the target is a **WIZARD** or **PRIEST**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: The trilling song of the Fiends is hideous to perceive, breaking and twisting the mind. For those with arcane gifts or a divine connection, it is even more excruciating.

units.lore: Horrific nightmares given bestial shape, Fiends of Slaanesh emit a harsh, trilling call as they race towards their prey. A dream-inducing scent hangs thick around the Fiends, reducing their foes to a stupor and sapping them of their will to fight.

units.name: Contorted Epitome

abilities.name: The Mirror's Depths
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: If the target is within 6" of this unit, the target is **gazing into eternity** until the start of your next turn. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, the target is **gazing into eternity** until the start of your next turn.

While the target is **gazing into eternity**, it must end all moves no further from this unit than it was at the start of the move and it cannot be removed from the battlefield by an ability that would allow it to be set up again on the battlefield.

**Designer’s Note:** *This includes pile-in moves.*
abilities.lore: When a warrior stares into a Contorted Epitome’s mirror, they see all their hopes and fears reflected there and cannot tear their eyes away.

abilities.name: Swallow Energy
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible **MANIFESTATION** within 12" of this unit and that was not summoned this turn to be the target, then make a banishment roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the banishment value on the target’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play.

The next time a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses a **SUMMON** ability, roll an additional D6, to a maximum of 3, when making the casting roll for that ability.
abilities.lore: A Contorted Epitome’s mirror absorbs the most deep-seated conceits of those who look into it, channelling those fantasies back to Slaanesh’s Temple of Twisted Mirrors, where they can be blended into delicious torments.

units.lore: Contorted Epitomes are a rare thing: a pair of Daemonettes who can abide one another’s company, rather than constantly seeking to humiliate and disgrace a rival. Such devilish duos are granted command over the accursed Mirrors of Absorption. These darkling relics slither forth on metallic tentacles, their shimmering glass soon enrapturing the weak-minded and dragging their souls into an eternity of torment.

units.name: Lord of Hysteria

abilities.name: Slaughterous Celebrants
abilities.description: Effect: While they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit, melee weapons used by friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH INFANTRY** units have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)**.
abilities.lore: Those Hedonites who follow a Lord of Hysteria have been stoked into such an inferno of depraved and mindless revelry that to approach them is to be dragged into a pit of wild, slavering animals and soon ripped to shreds.

abilities.name: Master of the Revels
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn, pick a visible friendly **SYBARITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: If the target is a **PARAGON**, apply the following effect to the target. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the following effect to the target:

• For the rest of the turn, while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
abilities.lore: Empowered by the lordly daemon that shares their soul, a Lord of Hysteria knows many means by which to inspire a wild frenzy in their followers.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Dark Egotist.*

units.lore: Lords of Hysteria are champions devoted to the Sacred Seduction of Paramountcy. Obsessed are they with being known as the greatest and grossest of revellers, they have sold their souls to powerful pleasure-daemons in exchange for both physical prowess and, more dangerously, the ability to plunge otherwise reasoning souls into fits of truly orgiastic violence.

units.name: Thricefold Discord

abilities.name: Gifts of Pain and Pleasure
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick either a visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit or a visible enemy unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the target is a friendly unit, add 2" to its Move characteristic until the start of your next turn. If the target is an enemy unit, inflict **X** mortal damage on it, then **Heal (X)** this unit. **X** is equal to the number of models in this unit.
abilities.lore: When working in concert, the daemons of a Thricefold Discord can harness the magics of their chosen debaucheries to wrack enemies with torment or offer boons to diverting allies.

abilities.name: Thricefold Court
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects that you did not pick in the previous turn. The effect applies for the rest of the turn:

***Sins of Soul***: While an enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** is visible to this unit, add 1 to this unit’s power level.

***Sins of Flesh***: This unit’s attacks score critical hits on unmodifed hit rolls of 5+.

***Sins of Mind***: Each time a visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you receive 3 additional rally points.
abilities.lore: The daemons of a Thricefold Discord are exalted creatures, each steeped in a particular Sacred Seduction and determined to prove that its favoured sin is the most ensnaring.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: The courts of the Palace of Pleasure are filled with wicked daemons known as Slaanesh’s Heralds. The choicest vices and most appalling perversions are theirs to command, and they are always eager to bring such delights to the realms. Heralds take to the battlefield in trios known as Thricefold Discords – an apt name, as for all their sorcerous and martial prowess, the real source of their power is their seething need to one-up their rivals.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Infernal Enrapturess, Herald of Slaanesh

abilities.name: Like Nails on a Chalkboard
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared the 'Eruption of Fury' ability for a unit within 12" of and visible to this unit.
abilities.description: Effect: You and your opponent must roll off. If you roll higher, pick a unit (friendly or enemy) other than the enemy unit using the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability within that enemy unit’s combat range. That unit is now the target of that ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability. Your opponent must spend as many **rage dice** as possible as part of that ability, to a maximum of 3.
abilities.lore: The jarring, discordant sounds emanating from the Enrapturess’s lyre are enough to drive anyone over the edge of sanity.

abilities.name: Delightful Defeatism
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, your opponent must make 3 fewer rally rolls of D6.
abilities.lore: Those who see how willingly the Herald’s ‘instrument’ submits to torment are struck by the realisation that fighting the Dark Prince’s followers is a futile endeavour.

details.notes:
This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Slaaneshi Beguiler*.

This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Cutting through the roars of anger and screams of pain that fill the battlefields of Aqshy come the horrific melodies created by the Infernal Enrapturess as it plucks the tendinous strings of its living lyre.

units.name: Blissbarb Seekers

abilities.name: Adrenaline Archers
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **SHOOT** abilities this turn even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, for the rest of the turn, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.
abilities.lore: Blissbarb Seekers live in such a heightened sensory state that enemies seem to move in slow motion; they weave to and fro through the most vicious combats, loosing arrows all the while.

units.lore: Blissbarb warriors who acquire for themselves an Exalted Steed of Slaanesh conduct war at a breakneck pace. Charging across the battlefield with astonishing speed, these Sybarites launch flights of cruel arrows with an incredible accuracy.

units.name: Lord of Hubris

abilities.name: Allow Me To Demonstrate
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO SYBARITE** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by this unit and the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: For all their boasting and crushing arrogance, Lords of Hubris truly are astounding to behold in combat – a fact that inevitably galvanises their devoted sycophants.

abilities.name: You First, I Insist...
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has not used a **TEMPTATION** ability this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Your opponent must decide whether the target will **accept** or **decline** this unit’s challenge:

If they **accept**, for the rest of the turn, if this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks and all of the target’s attacks must target this unit.

If they **decline**, for the rest of the turn:
• The target has **STRIKE-LAST**.
• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit.
abilities.lore: So confident is this champion of excess that they allow their foe a futile swipe for free.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Dark Egotist*.

units.lore: Utterly enamoured with their own magnificence, the strutting peacocks known as Lords of Hubris swagger into battle, loudly demanding that the enemy’s finest face them in single combat. Those foolish enough to answer this challenge are cut to ribbons in a matter of seconds.

units.name: Myrmidesh Painbringers

abilities.name: False Serenity
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has not charged this turn, it has **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Myrmidesh take pains to appear unflappable.

abilities.name: Dance of the Wailing Blade
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by that enemy unit that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: The Myrmidesh are masters of a martial form known as the Dance of the Wailing Blade – a sword-kata that emphasises quick, cruel and painful counter-attacks.

units.lore: The Myrmidesh are an elite warrior-cult who exemplify the pride of the Dark Prince. Each of their blade-sects considers their own favoured technique to be supreme, and on the rare occasions they are proved wrong, their spiteful rage is terrible to behold.

units.name: Slaangor Fiendbloods

abilities.name: Veiled Threat
abilities.description: Effect: Set up this unit in reserve **waiting in ambush**. It has now been deployed.
abilities.lore: Slaangors can move as smoothly and soundlessly as silk before bursting out into a bleating, bellowing charge.

abilities.name: Bestial Onslaught
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is **waiting in ambush**.

Effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: With primal savagery, the Slaangor Fiendbloods take to the battlefield, ready to surround their enemies.

abilities.name: Instinctive Advance
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 12" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can move 3" immediately after that command has been resolved, unless that command is a reaction, in which case this unit can move after the ability that it was reacting to has been resolved. It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat. If this unit was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat with the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move.
abilities.lore: The Slaangors are drawn to the screams of the battlefield as a hungering predator is drawn to wounded prey.

units.lore: When the madness of battle descends upon Slaangor Fiendbloods, the carnage left in their wake is truly sickening. These gangly beasts are frighteningly strong and swift, and they fight with a frenzied disregard for their own survival.

units.name: Hellflayer

abilities.name: Threshing Doom
abilities.description: Effect: When this unit moves, it can pass through models in enemy **INFANTRY** units and can pass through the combat ranges of enemy **INFANTRY** units, but it cannot end a move in combat unless specified in the ability used.
abilities.lore: Hellflayers were created to messily plough through screaming victims without slowing. Few beings possess the willpower to stand in their path or the strength to stop them in their tracks.

abilities.name: Soulscent
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units that this unit passed across this phase to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If any models are slain by this ability, this unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The whirling blades of this fearsome chariot mow down the enemy, transmuting their souls into an exhilarating incense that drives its riders into an ecstatic frenzy.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Hellflayer chariots drive through the meadows of Slaanesh’s realm, dismembering those cursed to lie there in purgatory. On the battlefields of the Mortal Realms, they are roving weapons of war, their many scythes delivering gruesome death.

units.name: Bladebringer, Herald on Exalted Chariot

abilities.name: Mutilating Blades
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: A Slaaneshi chariot inflicts carnage when it ploughs into the foe.

abilities.name: Soulgorgers
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly non-**UNIQUE HEDONITES OF SLAANESH WAR MACHINES** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn. This ability also affects **Companion** weapons.
abilities.lore: The grandest Bladebringers excel in stoking fits of manic violence in their fellow daemonic chariot crews and their steeds.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Some Heralds of Slaanesh become so intoxicated by the act of riding flesh-shredding chariots into the enemy that they demand ever larger and grander conveyances, the better to harvest the souls of mortals.

units.name: Hellstriders

abilities.name: Maiming Charge
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy **INFANTRY** units while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: As they crash into the melee, the cruel wounds inflicted by the Hellstriders not only cause horrible carnage but leave any survivors shocked and agonised.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Devotees of torment, Hellstriders are mortals who have dedicated their lives to dealing out pain in return for power. They ride daemonic Steeds to war – indeed, they have no choice, for once they climb into the saddle, they can never dismount.

units.name: Blissbarb Archers

abilities.name: Blissbrew Homonculus
abilities.description:
Effect: This unit’s **Blissbrew Homonculi** are tokens. There is 1 **Blissbrew Homonculus** for every 10 models in this unit.

This unit has **WARD (6+)** while it has any **Blissbrew Homonculi**. If you make an unmodified ward roll of 1 for this unit, remove 1 of this unit’s **Blissbrew Homonculi** from the battlefield (the damage point is still inflicted).
abilities.lore: These imps carry censers that belch sickly incense that tricks the senses and blinds hostile eyes.

abilities.name: The Thrill of Combat
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit in combat to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit’s ranged weapons have **Shoot in Combat** and they also have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for attacks that target that enemy unit.
abilities.lore: The sensory bombardment of a nearby melee gives the Blissbarbs a heady surge of adrenaline, heightening their reactions and the accuracy of their bowfire.

units.lore: Blissbarb Archers are the lowest class of Sybarite, but they are no less deadly for it. Even when running pell-mell across the field, they fire with unerring accuracy, laughing with glee as their sharp and toxin-laced projectiles strike home.

units.name: Lord of Pain

abilities.name: Atrocious Ministrations
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: You can allocate 1 damage point to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point). Then, roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: To be the subject of a Lord of Pain’s monstrous arts is always energising for a true Hedonite – provided they survive the experience…

abilities.name: Share The Pain
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)** while it is in combat. In addition, each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit for a damage point inflicted by a combat attack, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Lords of Pain have mastered every kind of torment; they shrug off agony as if it were nothing, all while doling out the same hideous sensations to their foes.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Dark Egotist*.

units.lore: Lords of Pain are champions of Slaanesh who have sampled countless vices and excesses. Armed with wicked soulpiercer maces, they lead warbands of devoted followers and are always eager to demonstrate their mastery of all forms of agony.

units.name: Slickblade Seekers

abilities.name: Unrivalled Velocity
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **CHARGE** ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: You can re-roll the charge roll.
abilities.lore: Slickblade Seekers are obsessed with high-speed kills, tearing towards the foe with relentless haste.

units.lore: Slickblade Seekers believe themselves to be aristocrats of war, the chosen knights of the Dark Prince. They desire nothing more than to charge into the thickest portion of the fighting, their whistling glaives lashing out to neatly sever heads and limbs.

armiesOfRenown.name: Court of the Godlings
armiesOfRenown.description:
Dexcessa is an arrogant force of nature who cannot abide taking orders from another. They see themselves as Slaanesh’s chief warlord, often overthrowing lesser champions and ordering their warhosts to abandon long-fought campaigns and focus on new, bizarre objectives more pleasing to the Talon. Only Synessa’s wicked tongue can convince Dexcessa to listen – and even then the daemon rails at the patience advised by their despised sibling, ever liable to suddenly act.
When you pick the Hedonites of Slaanesh faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Court of the Godlings Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules described in Army of Renown: Court of the Godlings instead of the Hedonites of Slaanesh faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box opposite. All units in your army gain the **COURT OF THE GODLINGS** keyword.

roster: Scourge of Aqshy: Infernal Enrapturess, Herald of Slaanesh
armiesOfRenown.source: Army of Renown: Court of the Godlings

battleTraits.name: The Voice and the Talon
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description: Effect: The friendly **Synessa** and **Dexcessa** have the **TWIN** keyword.
battleTraits.lore: For all their mutual and endless antipathy, Slaanesh’s twin heirs are most deadly when they work in tandem.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Court of the Godlings
battleTraits.groupName: Court of the Godlings Battle Traits

battleTraits.name: The More Glorious Slaughter
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn, Start of Any Turn
battleTraits.description:
Declare: If a friendly **TWIN** destroyed an enemy unit in the previous turn and the other did not, pick the one that did not to use this ability.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by units in the regiment of the unit using this ability.
battleTraits.lore: In a flush of vainglory, one of the Twins boasts extravagantly of their superior acts of death-dealing, goading their sibling and their entourage to new heights of lethality in their efforts not to be overshadowed.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Court of the Godlings
battleTraits.groupName: Court of the Godlings Battle Traits

battleTraits.name: The Longer Shadow
battleTraits.phase: Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: If a friendly **TWIN** is contesting an objective you control and the other is not, pick the one that is not to use this ability.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the unit using this ability is contesting an objective you control, add 5 to the control scores of units in its regiment.
battleTraits.lore: Both Synessa and Dexcessa are forever competing to prove themselves the more domineering of their god-father’s spawn.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Court of the Godlings
battleTraits.groupName: Court of the Godlings Battle Traits

battleTraits.name: The Grander Visage
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: If either friendly **TWIN** is damaged, pick the one with fewer or no damage points to use this ability.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the unit using this ability has **WARD (4+)**.
battleTraits.lore: Should one of the Twins show a sign of weakening, the other will seize the chance to better display their own immaculacy.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Court of the Godlings
battleTraits.groupName: Court of the Godlings Battle Traits

battleTraits.name: The Swifter Surge
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: If a friendly **TWIN** charged in the previous turn and the other did not, pick the one that did not to use this ability.

Effect: For the rest of the phase, when making charge rolls for units in the regiment of the unit using this ability, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.
battleTraits.lore: To be the first into the fray is a mark of honour between the vindictive Twins. Should one of them fall behind for even a moment, they will act swiftly lest they leave themselves open to their sibling’s ridicule.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Court of the Godlings
battleTraits.groupName: Court of the Godlings Battle Traits

battleTraits.name: The More Cunning Ruse
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.description:
Declare: If both friendly **TWINS** are within 12" of and visible to each other, pick one of them to use this ability.

Effect: Remove the unit using this ability from the battlefield and set it up on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
battleTraits.lore: Strategic intellect is another arena of mastery – one that both Twins are eager to prove the superior in.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Court of the Godlings
battleTraits.groupName: Court of the Godlings Battle Traits

heroicTraits.name: Tethered to the Twins
heroicTraits.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **TWIN** that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
heroicTraits.lore: This daemon is a vassal of Synessa or Dexcessa – or both. So long as they persist, so will the accursed Twins.
heroicTraits.source: Army of Renown: Court of the Godlings
heroicTraits.groupName: Court of the Godlings Heroic Trait

artefacts.name: The Triplet Trinket
artefacts.description:
Effect: While a friendly **TWIN** is within 3" of and visible to this unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that **TWIN** and this unit.
While 2 friendly **TWINS** are within 3" of and visible to this unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks that target those **TWINS** and this unit instead.
artefacts.lore: This bipartite charm is given to the Twins’ latest plaything – a supposed mark of favour that protects the godlings also.
artefacts.source: Army of Renown: Court of the Godlings
artefacts.groupName: Court of the Godlings Artefact of Power

spellLores.name: Court of the Godlings Spell Lore

spells.name: Essence Transfusion
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **COURT OF THE GODLINGS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **TWIN** to be the donor, pick another visible friendly **TWIN** to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Allocate any number of damage points to the donor (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). Then, **Heal (X)** the target, where **X** is double the number of damage points allocated to the donor by this use of this ability.
spells.lore: Though bitter rivals, the Twins are ultimately born of the same godly stuff and can share strength between them if necessary.

spells.name: Sibilant Whispers
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **COURT OF THE GODLINGS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, while a friendly **TWIN** is visible to the target, halve the target’s Move characteristic. In addition, while 2 friendly **TWINS** are visible to the target, your opponent must roll 1 fewer dice, to a minimum of 1, when making charge rolls for it.
spells.lore: The commands of the Twins are cast into the enemies’ minds, leaving them stumbling, uncertain and vulnerable.

spells.name: Ecstatic Furore
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **COURT OF THE GODLINGS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **TWIN** wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **COURT OF THE GODLINGS** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to the target.
spells.lore: The baser, bloodier aspects of Slaanesh’s nature are channelled through one of the Twins, filling their sycophants with rapturous murder‑lust.

manifestations.name: Dreadful Visage

abilities.name: Flensing Tongues
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.

Effect: Until this **MANIFESTATION** is banished or destroyed, the target is **tongue-tied** while it is within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION**. While the target is **tongue-tied**:

• It cannot use **RUN** abilities.
• Your opponent must roll a D6 instead of a D3 when determining the amount of mortal damage inflicted on the target when it uses a **RETREAT** ability.
abilities.lore: Opening its soul-sucking maw, the Dreadful Visage lets fly a plethora of hooked tongues that lash and flense the flesh of those nearby.

manifestations.lore: The Dreadful Visage is a manifestation conjured in one of the many likenesses of the Dark Prince, hooked and lash-like tongues flailing from its mouth. These serpentine appendages snare limbs and lance deep into flesh, tearing and mangling with a wild glee, leaving its victims both immobilised and agonised.

summonSpell.name: Summon Manifestation of Depravity
summonSpell.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **COURT OF THE GODLINGS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH MANIFESTATION** that is not on the battlefield and that was not removed from play earlier in the same turn.

If you picked a **Dreadful Visage** or **Wheels of Excruciation**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a **Mesmerising Mirror**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
summonSpell.lore: The god-spawn of Slaanesh and their chosen retainers are masters of the most extreme and decadent forms of magical conjuration.

manifestations.name: Wheels of Excruciation

abilities.name: Exquisite Agony
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.

Effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: The Wheels of Excruciation deliver death by a thousand exquisite cuts to those who get in their way.

manifestations.lore: Wheels of Excruciation are sorcerous flocks of living, bladed discuses that tear mortals into slivers of bleeding flesh. They are a magical echo of the many devices that can be found in the torment-boudoirs of the Palace of Pleasure; they spin across the battlefield at terrible velocity, seemingly drawn to those whose screams will echo loudest and most delightfully.

summonSpell.name: Summon Manifestation of Depravity
summonSpell.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **COURT OF THE GODLINGS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Pick a friendly **HEDONITES OF SLAANESH MANIFESTATION** that is not on the battlefield and that was not removed from play earlier in the same turn.

If you picked a **Dreadful Visage** or **Wheels of Excruciation**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you picked a **Mesmerising Mirror**, set it up wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
summonSpell.lore: The god-spawn of Slaanesh and their chosen retainers are masters of the most extreme and decadent forms of magical conjuration.

manifestations.name: Mesmerising Mirror

abilities.name: Irresistible Lure
abilities.phase: Once Per Phase (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a **MOVE** ability for a unit within 18" of and visible to this **MANIFESTATION**
abilities.description: Effect: If that enemy unit does not end that move closer to this **MANIFESTATION** than it was at the start of the move, inflict D6 mortal damage on that enemy unit after the **MOVE** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: The Mirror lures mortals as a candle draws moths to its light. Those strong enough to turn away feel knives of anguish and loss driven into their hearts.

manifestations.lore: The wise know to swiftly avert their gaze when faced with the manifestations known as Mesmerising Mirrors, no matter the tearing sensation in their souls. Those who stare into the spell’s depths at first see visions of majesty, but as they look on, these turn to horrific displays. Entranced by the obscenities they witness, they cannot move away, even as Slaanesh’s rapacious warriors close in.
