abilities.lore: The fell contraptions wielded by these ratmen were created by the Clans Skryre’s most ingenious weaponsmiths.

heroicTraits.name: Skilled Manipulator
heroicTraits.description:
Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly non-**HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
heroicTraits.lore: This Skaven warlord is particularly devious and selfserving, deftly ensuring that their minions are always conveniently positioned between themselves and potential threats.

heroicTraits.name: Scurry Away
heroicTraits.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
heroicTraits.lore: This Skaven chief does not think twice about scampering to safety when things look to be going south. Perhaps that’s why they have lived so long.

heroicTraits.name: Short-tempered
heroicTraits.description: Effect: Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **SKAVEN** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
heroicTraits.lore: This twitching and irascible Skaven has succeeded in making their minions more afraid of their displeasure than of the enemy.

artefacts.name: Skavenbrew
artefacts.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
artefacts.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
artefacts.lore: This foul concoction, brewed from blood and warpstone, is dispensed to expendable underlings to drive them into a short-lived but devastating killing frenzy.

artefacts.name: Foulhide
artefacts.description: Effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.
artefacts.lore: Fashioned from the flensed flesh of Rat Ogors and soaked in cloying alchemical agents, this stinking armour sticks to its wearer like a bloated second skin and regrows as fast as it can be hacked apart.

artefacts.name: Warpstone Charm
artefacts.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
artefacts.lore: This foul talisman radiates mutating energy that can be directed at an enemy unit to erode their armour.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Serrated Bone Protrusions
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by an enemy unit that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: The jagged shards of bone that jut out from these abominations can inflict nasty injuries on careless attackers.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText:
Moulder Mutations are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO** non-**WAR MACHINE** **SKAVEN** units.
A unit can only have 1 Moulder Mutation.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Anabolic Accelerators
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: If this unit was set up this turn, when making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: The limbs of these mutants have been injected with a serum that promotes rapid tissue growth, giving them a monstrous – if short-lived – burst of speed.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText:
Moulder Mutations are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO** non-**WAR MACHINE** **SKAVEN** units.
A unit can only have 1 Moulder Mutation.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Transplanted Brains
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following brains. Its effects apply for the rest of the turn:

***Warpstone Addict’s Brain***:
• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
• This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

***Warlock Whelp’s Brain***: Add 10 to this unit’s control score.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: The grey matter of various ‘willing’ Moulder volunteers has been grafted onto these mutants’ brains, allowing them to change their personalities in an instant.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText:
Moulder Mutations are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO** non-**WAR MACHINE** **SKAVEN** units.
A unit can only have 1 Moulder Mutation.

spells.name: Skitterleap
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **SKAVEN HERO** wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
spells.lore: Vanishing in a puff of foul-smelling smoke, the verminkin reappear elsewhere on the battlefield an eye-blink later.

spells.name: Wither
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
spells.lore: The spellcaster hurls a glowing green globe of magical energy at the foe. Anyone touched by the globe starts to shrivel and wither away.

spells.name: Warpgale
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
spells.lore: Screeching in an unholy tongue, the caster parts the veil of reality and draws a ravening gale of unnatural energies forth.

prayers.name: Bile-torrent
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 4+ instead.
prayers.lore: The priest screeches with glowing green eyes as a torrent of bile sweeps over their foe.

prayers.name: Rabid-tough
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that unit until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.
prayers.lore: The priest snarls and conjures a dense cloud of toxins that sends their followers into a frenzy that numbs them to pain.

prayers.name: Filth-crust
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKAVEN PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** until the start of your next turn.
prayers.lore: The Great Horned Rat heeds the call of this priest to encrust the weapons of their minions with irresistible contagions.

manifestations.name: Vermintide

abilities.name: More-more Rats
abilities.description: Effect: **Heal (D6)** this **MANIFESTATION**.
abilities.lore: An endless tide of unholy vermin pours through the cracks in reality, their eyes aglow and their fangs unnaturally sharp.

manifestations.lore: Blight City, the abominable domain of the Skaven, lurks beyond the barriers of conventional reality. Through the depths of that sub-realm swarm billions upon billions of rats, their eyes filled with malice and their teeth unnaturally sharpened by exposure to the corrupting energies of the Great Horned Rat. The Skaven excel in unpicking the logical underpinnings of creation, spreading cracks and fractures across the surface of sanity. In times of need, their sorcerers can open such a crack wide enough to allow a living wave of these rodents to spill into the realms – a grim occurrence known as a Vermintide.

summonSpell.name: Summon Vermintide
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Vermintide** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Vermintide** wholly within 13" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: A Skaven spellcaster can summon forth a seething mass of arcane rodents that consumes everything in its path.

manifestations.name: Warp Lightning Vortex

abilities.name: Warp Lightning Bolts
abilities.description:
Declare: If this **MANIFESTATION** was not set up this turn, pick each enemy unit within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 4+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Coruscating bolts of warp lightning leap outwards from the Warp Lightning Vortex, obliterating those nearby.

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.description: Effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **MANIFESTATION**'s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **MANIFESTATION** is destroyed and all its parts are removed from play.

abilities.name: Warp Vortex
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 2 from run rolls and charge rolls for enemy units while they are within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION**. In addition, if an enemy unit passes across this **MANIFESTATION** and/or the round-cornered triangle formed by drawing a line around all the bases of the **MANIFESTATION**’s parts, inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit after the **MOVE** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: The sheer destructive anarchy that surrounds a Warp Lightning Vortex slows the progress of warriors caught in its midst.

manifestations.lore: Warp lightning is often used for the crude but satisfying purpose of destruction, but it possesses more subtle qualities also. By hurling a clawful of warpstone shards onto the earth and rasping the necessary invocations, a Skaven sorcerer can see them grow into sizable prisms, linked by chains of crackling warp lightning. The space within these arcane chains becomes a swirling vortex of corruptive magical energy. Any trapped within this zone find their strength sapped and waning, as if dragged out by the flickering tongues of lightning.

summonSpell.name: Summon Warp Lightning Vortex
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Warp Lightning Vortex** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up the first part of the **Warp Lightning Vortex** within 18" of the caster and visible to them, then set up the second and third parts exactly 7" from the first part and exactly 7" from each other so that they form a triangle.
summonSpell.lore: Warpstone shards are cast into the air, growing impossibly large and discharging bolts of warp lightning.

manifestations.name: Bell of Doom

abilities.name: Toll of Doom
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 13" of this **MANIFESTATION**.
abilities.lore: The dreadful ringing of the Bell of Doom fills the minds of the Skaven’s foes with a deep despair.

manifestations.lore: The Bell of Doom is a thing of ruinous sorcery. The ratmen have long been fascinated with such instruments, viewing them as relics charged with the ruinous will of the Great Horned Rat. Skaven sorcerers possess the means to render this belief a reality; by ringing a small hand-bell of refined warpstone and hissing the thirteen incantations of Kavzar, they can shape the aether into a clanging tool of apocalypse. Each peal from a Bell of Doom shakes the very fabric of creation. The earth splits asunder, mortar shakes loose from walls and proud statues topple. What remains is ruin, fit only for vermin to swarm over.

summonSpell.name: Summon Bell of Doom
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Bell of Doom** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Bell of Doom** wholly within 13" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: Invoking ancient creation myths, the spellcaster causes a great Bell of Doom to manifest upon the battlefield.
