units.name: Hell Pit Abomination

abilities.name: Regenerating Monstrosity
abilities.description: Effect: **Heal (D6)** this unit.
abilities.lore: Hell Pit Abominations are notoriously difficult to slay and can even regrow severed limbs.

abilities.name: Too Horrible To Die
abilities.description:
Effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect:

**1 - *Dead***
This unit is destroyed.

**2-4 - *The Rats Emerge***
Roll a D3 for each enemy unit in combat with this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll. Then, this unit is destroyed.

**5-6 - *It’s Alive!***
This unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D6)** this unit.
abilities.lore: As it twitches in its shuddering death throes, there is a chance that either the Abomination’s unholy metabolism will restart one of its many foul hearts or its carcass will disgorge the revolting tide of parasitic rats that had been gnawing upon its innards.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Gnashing Teeth and Flailing Fists** is 8.

abilities.name: Avalanche of Flesh
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: A Hell Pit Abomination can rear up to its fullest height before crashing back to the ground, crushing foes beneath its sickening bulk.

units.lore: Named for the gruesome subterranean laboratories in which they are crafted, Hell Pit Abominations are the pinnacle of the Master Moulders' sciences. An Abomination is created by melding and mutating the flesh of plentiful hapless subjects as well as employing warpstone and other, more secretive arts. Foes are soon overwhelmed by an avalanche of flailing limbs - many of which sport various murderous 'upgrades'. Yet the insensate bulk of the Abomination remains its greatest weapon, capable of breaking a flank single-handedly.

units.name: Thanquol on Boneripper

abilities.name: Boneripper Rampage
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3-5, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. On a 6, inflict 2D3 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Thanquol’s monstrous Rat Ogor, Boneripper, pulverises enemies that dare stray too close.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Warpfire Braziers** is 4.

abilities.name: Terrible Madness
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 13" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target cannot use commands until the start of your next turn. In addition, roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Thanquol can inflict madness on his enemies, causing them to lash out at close allies.

abilities.name: Warp-amulet
abilities.description: Effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.
abilities.lore: Thanquol wears a thrumming green warpstone amulet, the mutating magics of which serve to meld and rapidly heal his, or Boneripper’s, flesh.

abilities.name: Staff of the Horned Rat
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
abilities.lore: Said to be crafted from scrap thieved from the Horned Rat’s lair, Thanquol’s staff thrums with malign potency.

units.lore: Fuelled by an addiction to warpstone and delusional self-confidence remarkable even for a Skaven, Thanquol is constantly devising new schemes to secure a seat upon the Council of Thirteen. That most of these plans go awry is irrelevant; Thanquol is a master at spinning disasters to his advantage - as well as obliterating the bodies and minds of enemies and naysayers with powerful spellcraft. Thanquol is accompanied at all times by a colossal Rat Ogor that he calls Boneripper.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Brood Terror

abilities.name: Regenerating Terror
abilities.description: Effect: **Heal (D6)** this unit.
abilities.lore: Brood Terrors are a nightmare of mutation and overwhelming strength.

abilities.name: Lend a Claw
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 4 other friendly non-**SKRYRE MOULDER** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Loosely Attached Bladed Limbs** for the rest of the phase for each target picked. Add 1 to hit rolls for the targets’ attacks for the rest of the phase, including those made with **Companion** weapons.
abilities.lore: In a horrifying bout of lucidity and multiple flailing appendages, the remains of the Master Moulder who was stitched into this abomination exert a degree of control over the other creatures in its menagerie before swiftly falling back into a pit of insanity.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: Ghyran has suffered terribly from the ravages of Brood Terrors, horrors created when a Master Moulder stitches himself into a hulking war-form fashioned from brass and alchemised meat. From within this two-headed titan the Master directs his minions’ attacks with frantic, jabbing motions of its weapon-limbs, before plunging headfirst into the fray to test his latest flesh-grafts upon the enemy.

units.name: Brood Terror

abilities.name: Regenerating Terror
abilities.description: Effect: **Heal (D6)** this unit.
abilities.lore: Brood Terrors are a nightmare of mutation and overwhelming strength.

abilities.name: Warpstone Fumes
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The belching, flesh-twisting smoke that clings to a Brood Terror obscures the clawpacks from view.

units.lore: Amongst the most hideous aberrations of Skaven fleshcraft, a Brood Terror is created when a Master Moulder is stitched into a monstrous form. These twin-headed titans lurch between bouts of low cunning and bestial rage. Surrounded by clouds of mutagenic fog, they lumber forth with an ungainly but definite purpose, From one mutilated limb hangs a hooked flail that the Terror uses to drag its prey closer, whereupon the victim is bathed in the fires that leap from its warpflame scourger or vivisected by clusters of swift knife-arms.

units.name: Rat Ogors

abilities.name: Unleashed Warp-fury
abilities.description: Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit. Then, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The warpstone hammered into the flesh of these creatures crackles with volatile energies, driving them into a frenzy.

units.lore: The power of the Clans Moulder is built on the broad shoulders of the Rat Ogors. These rabid war-mutants are created by grafting nimble Skaven to the muscled bulk of ogorkind through strange cryptosorcery and infusing them with warpstone shards and unguents. These misbegotten warriors are pumped full of all manner of toxic serums designed to magnify both their regenerative properties and their natural frenzy. A mixture of pain and gnawing hunger sees them tear at enemies in a blind fury, ripping off limbs and wolfing down flesh.

units.name: Master Moulder

abilities.name: Lord of Flesh-grafting
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick another friendly **MOULDER** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: **Heal (3)** the target.
abilities.lore: These burly commanders are the breeders, mutators and healers of the Clans Moulder.

abilities.name: Tyrannical Packmaster
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick another friendly **MOULDER** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Master Moulders use pain and terror to drive their fighting beasts into a battle frenzy.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Skaven Overclaw*.

units.lore: It takes an especially deranged Skaven to rise to the rank of Master Moulder. They are the overlords of the Clans Moulder, dark luminaries in the arts of flesh-grafting, each devoted to crafting ever more grotesque nightmare-beasts. Master Moulders are experts in stitching muscle and flesh into new forms, and they use warpstone to trigger mutations that twist a mortal corpus beyond recognition. Master Moulders take a warped pride in the monsters they have brought into unholy life and consider the battlefield successes of these creatures to be firmly their own.

units.name: Stormfiends

abilities.name: Shock Gauntlets
abilities.description: Effect: Each time an attack made with this unit’s **Shock Gauntlets** scores a critical hit, that attack scores D6 hits on the target unit instead of 1. Make a wound roll for each hit.
abilities.lore: The electrical discharge created by shock gauntlets can trigger a series of linked explosions.

abilities.name: Grinderfist Tunnellers
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is **in the tunnels below** and includes any models armed with **Grinderfists**.

Effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Grinderfists can be used to create underground tunnels.

units.lore: The Clans Moulder and Clans Skryre have long enjoyed a profitable, if fraught, alliance. Stormfiends are one of the many horrors engendered by these collaborations. In appearance, they resemble a Rat Ogor granted even greater bulk through potent warpstone serums, and they can wield various deadly Skryre firearms without tearing themselves apart through recoil.

armiesOfRenown.name: The Great-Grand Gnawhorde
armiesOfRenown.description: Reports circulated of blood-smeared ratmen so ravenous they took bites out of one another on the march. Pale armour splattered with gore, their Clawlords wore muzzled helms to mark control over their hunger.Only the Grey Seers, speakers of Vizzik's will, seemed unaffected, though even they twitched at the ever- present droning of bells that accompanied their advance.
armiesOfRenown.lore:
Reports circulated of blood-smeared ratmen so ravenous they took bites out of one another on the march. Pale armour splattered with gore, their Clawlords wore muzzled helms to mark control over their hunger.Only the Grey Seers, speakers of Vizzik's will, seemed unaffected, though even they twitched at the ever- present droning of bells that accompanied their advance.

Consecrated with Vizzik's infernal blood, these Warpshatter Bells stoked the black hunger to an inferno, sparing only his chosen. One had been narrowly destroyed by Sigmar's storm-things on the isle of Hel's Claw, but so long as thirteen 'blessed' bell towers screamed a wicked toll, the famine-frenzy would seize more clans. There could be no more of these structures, no less - much to the irritation of Skaven who craved status through raising their own ramshackle equivalent.

Leading this Great-grand Gnawhorde, as he dubbed his holy army, Vizzik first purged his domain of both outsiders and recusant ratmen. Amidst an unholy cacophony, he conspired to strike the Adamantine Chain, where his foes had established defensive cordons. If the mountains could be breached by his frenzied swarms, the Parch's innards would be laid bare...

When you pick the Skaven faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Great-grand Gnawhorde Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Skaven faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options as described in Army of Renown: The Great-Grand Gnawhorde. All units in your army gain the Gnawhorde keyword.

battleTraits.name: Reckless Abandon
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **WARPSHATTER THROES** abilities this turn. Pick up to 3 friendly **GNAWHORDE** units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets' melee weapons.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks that target those friendly units.
battleTraits.lore: With the death frenzy upon them, the Gnawhorde's warriors show a most unusual disregard for self-preservation.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: The Great-Grand Gnawhorde

battleTraits.name: Disciples of Vizzik
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description:
Effect: While a friendly **Vizzik Skour** is within the combat range of another friendly **GNAWHORDE** Unit:

• That **Vizzik Skour** has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for that **Vizzik** **Skour**, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **GNAWHORDE** Unit within its combat range after the damage sequence has been resolved.
battleTraits.lore: The clawpacks of the Great-grand Gnawhorde protect their daemon-prophet by any means necessary.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: The Great-Grand Gnawhorde

battleTraits.name: Frenzied Momentum
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **WARPSHATTER THROES** abilities this turn. Pick up to 3 friendly **GNAWHORDE** units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

• Add 2 to run rolls and charge rolls for the targets.
• Subtract 1 from the targets' control scores.
battleTraits.lore: Hateful bells clanging in their minds, the swarms of the Great-grand Gnawhorde surge into the fray.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: The Great-Grand Gnawhorde

battleTraits.name: Unstoppable Warp-volley
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **WARPSHATTER THROES** abilities this turn. Pick up to 3 friendly **GNAWHORDE** units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

• Add 3" to the Range characteristic of the targets' ranged weapons.
• The targets cannot use commands.
battleTraits.lore: The Warlocks of the Gnawhorde are no less aggressive than their Verminus kin - they are simply able to strike from further away.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: The Great-Grand Gnawhorde

heroicTraits.name: Harbinger of the Great Ascendancy
heroicTraits.phase: Once Per Battle, Start of Any Turn
heroicTraits.description: Effect: If this unit is not in combat, you can use 2 different **WARPSHATTER THROES** abilities this turn instead of 1.
heroicTraits.lore: In the eyes of this Skaven warlord, nothing can stop the Horned Rat's ascendancy and the ruination of the Mortal Realms.
heroicTraits.source: Army of Renown: The Great-Grand Gnawhorde

artefacts.name: Icon of Great-total Supremacy
artefacts.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
artefacts.description: Effect: You can return up to D3 slain models to each friendly **GNAWHORDE INFANTRY** unit with a Health characteristic of up to 3.
artefacts.lore: Within this jagged brass reliquary lies a cutting from the Horned Rat's whiskers. It exerts a natural hold over the Skaven, drawing frothing warriors to it.
artefacts.source: Army of Renown: The Great-Grand Gnawhorde
artefacts.groupName: The Great-Grand Gnawhorde Artefact of Power

spells.name: Deafening Frenzy
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GNAWHORDE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **GNAWHORDE INFANTRY** unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6. The casting roll for this spell cannot be modified.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:

• The target has **STRIKE-FIRST**.
• The target cannot use commands.
spells.lore: The caster enhances the clangour of the thirteen Warpshatter Bells in the minds of a nearby swarm, driving them to even greater heights of fury.

prayers.name: Reverberating Ritual
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **GNAWHORDE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **GNAWHORDE INFANTRY** unit wholly within 13" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target can move an extra 3" when it makes a pile-in move. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to the target's control score until the start of your next turn.
prayers.lore: The priest chants in time with the tolling of the Warpshatter Bells, sonically shattering the last dregs of sanity from nearby ratmen and filling them with dreadful hunger.

manifestations.name: Vermintide

abilities.name: More-more Rats
abilities.description: Effect: **Heal (D6)** this **MANIFESTATION**.
abilities.lore: An endless tide of unholy vermin pours through the cracks in reality, their eyes aglow and their fangs unnaturally sharp.

manifestations.lore: Blight City, the abominable domain of the Skaven, lurks beyond the barriers of conventional reality. Through the depths of that sub-realm swarm billions upon billions of rats, their eyes filled with malice and their teeth unnaturally sharpened by exposure to the corrupting energies of the Great Horned Rat. The Skaven excel in unpicking the logical underpinnings of creation, spreading cracks and fractures across the surface of sanity. In times of need, their sorcerers can open such a crack wide enough to allow a living wave of these rodents to spill into the realms – a grim occurrence known as a Vermintide.

summonSpell.name: Summon Vermintide
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Vermintide** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Vermintide** wholly within 13" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: A Skaven spellcaster can summon forth a seething mass of arcane rodents that consumes everything in its path.

manifestations.name: Vermintide

abilities.name: More-more Rats
abilities.description: Effect: **Heal (D6)** this **MANIFESTATION**.
abilities.lore: An endless tide of unholy vermin pours through the cracks in reality, their eyes aglow and their fangs unnaturally sharp.

manifestations.lore: Blight City, the abominable domain of the Skaven, lurks beyond the barriers of conventional reality. Through the depths of that sub-realm swarm billions upon billions of rats, their eyes filled with malice and their teeth unnaturally sharpened by exposure to the corrupting energies of the Great Horned Rat. The Skaven excel in unpicking the logical underpinnings of creation, spreading cracks and fractures across the surface of sanity. In times of need, their sorcerers can open such a crack wide enough to allow a living wave of these rodents to spill into the realms – a grim occurrence known as a Vermintide.

summonSpell.name: Summon Vermintide
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Vermintide** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SKAVEN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Vermintide** wholly within 13" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: A Skaven spellcaster can summon forth a seething mass of arcane rodents that consumes everything in its path.

units.name: Grey Seer on Screaming Bell

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Bulk** is 4.

abilities.name: Peal of Doom
abilities.description:
Effect: Roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect:

**1 - *Magical Backlash***
Inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.

**2-4 - *Wall of Unholy Sound***
Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are within 13" of this unit.

**5-6 - *Apocalyptic Doom***
Roll a D3 for each enemy unit within 13" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: The ominous tolling of a Screaming Bell resounds above the clamour of battle, crying out ‘Doom! Doom! Doom!’

abilities.name: Cracks Call
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit that does not have **FLY** and is within 13" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the casting roll exceeds the target’s Move characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the difference between the casting roll and its Move characteristic.
abilities.lore: Harnessing the thunderous peals of the Screaming Bell, the Grey Seer channels a sorcerous blast into the ground beneath the foe’s feet. Gaping chasms yawn wide, sending screaming victims vanishing into the depths.

abilities.name: Altar of the Horned Rat
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** units have **WARD (6+)** while they are wholly within 13" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Throngs of rat-thralls swarm around this mighty construct in battle and will sell their lives to see it from harm.

units.lore: Of all the strange constructs fashioned by the Skaven, Screaming Bells are perhaps the most diabolical. From a rickety conveyance of wood hangs a great brass bell, studded with warpstone and marked with glowing runes. A Grey Seer, a prophet of the Horned Rat, scrabbles across the bell, hurling commands at their minions below and conjuring storms of magic from their bizarre pulpit. Then the device rings, and all hell breaks loose.

units.name: Warp-Grinder

abilities.name: Tunnel Skulkers
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly non-**MONSTER SKAVEN** unit if those units have not been deployed.

Effect: Set up those units in reserve **in the tunnels below**. They have now been deployed.
abilities.lore: A Warp-Grinder can be used to tunnel through reality, allowing the Skaven to strike from unexpected quarters.

abilities.name: Warp-ambush
abilities.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if this unit is **in the tunnels below**.

Effect: Roll a dice and pick one of the following effects.

•  On a 4+, pick an enemy unit that is more than 6" from all other enemy units. You can set up this unit on the battlefield in combat with that enemy unit and not in combat with any other enemy units. Then, if another friendly unit was set up **in the tunnels below** with the ‘Tunnel Skulkers’ ability, you can set up that unit wholly within 6" of this unit, in combat with that enemy unit, and not in combat with any other enemy units.

•  You can set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, if another friendly unit was set up **in the tunnels below** with the ‘Tunnel Skulkers’ ability, you can set up that unit wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: As the Warp-Grinder's tip tears open the realms, Skaven warriors burst forth shrieking and with blades drawn.

details.notes: You cannot include more than 1 **SKRYRE WAR MACHINE** in a regiment led by a non-**SKRYRE HERO**.

units.lore: The primary function of a Warp-Grinder is as an arcane reality-borer. Manoeuvred by straining thralls and operated by Warlocks who have taken their obsession with undermining their foes to terrifying extremes, these bulky constructs project powerful - if erratic - blasts of energy to punch through the skin of reality. Using these devices, the Skaven can open gnawholes or tunnel into vulnerable regions of a battlefield to allow screeching warrior swarms to set upon enemies from quarters unforeseen.

units.name: Warpvolt Scourgers

abilities.name: Hidden Weapon Team
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **Clanrats** unit that has 5 or more models, and there are no other friendly **WEAPON TEAM** units within that unit's combat range, this unit is not visible to enemy units more than 13" away.
abilities.lore: Skryre weapon teams often lurk amidst larger formations.

details.notes: You cannot include more than 1 **SKRYRE WEAPON TEAM** in a regiment led by a non-**SKRYRE HERO**.

units.lore: One of the many forms of weapon forged in the hellish foundries of the Warlocks, Warpvolt Scourgers channel the power of warpstone into volatile warp lightning, which travels between twin orb-like conductors before leaping forth to bring voltaic destruction to the enemy. Flesh and soul make perversely fine conductors for warp lightning and foes who are packed in tight are sure to be caught in a Scourger's fury, blasting them to oblivion and leaving them fatally convulsing.

units.name: Clanrats

abilities.name: Seething Swarm
abilities.description: Effect: You can return D3 slain models to this unit.
abilities.lore: Clanrats overwhelm their enemies with their seemingly endless numbers – biting, stabbing and trampling their own fallen beneath their bloody claws.

units.lore: Clanrats are the unwashed masses of the Clans Verminus. They are the dregs of the ratmen’s society, considered utterly disposable by their masters. No matter how many are spitted on pikes, crushed by bludgeons or riddled with arrows, the tide of mangy fur never seems to slacken. In turn, they fight with whatever rusted spears and blades they can scrounge up, as well as their own claws and teeth when necessary. Clanrats are nimble but undisciplined soldiers and, like most Skaven, are prone to wavering at the slightest threat. Only when sufficiently motivated by fear, hunger or overwhelming advantage can they be trusted to press the advance – but when they do, they can reduce entire armies to piles of gnawed bones.

units.name: Doom-Flayers

abilities.name: Whirling Doom
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Doom-Flayers crash into the foe with hellish results, leaving a trail of gore in their wake.

details.notes: You cannot include more than 1 **SKRYRE WAR MACHINE** in a regiment led by a non-**SKRYRE HERO**.

units.lore: The whirling globes of death known as Doom-Flayers were originally designed as mining devices. It speaks to the Skaven mindset that an enterprising Warlock observed the devastation they wrought on rock and immediately began considering military applications. Doom-Flayers now trundle along behind massed formations of Clanrats and Stormvermin, their operators revving the warp-engine impatiently. Eventually, their destructive urges overtake them and they gun the acceleration to churn a great furrow forward through the earth.

units.name: Hell Pit Abomination

abilities.name: Regenerating Monstrosity
abilities.description: Effect: **Heal (D6)** this unit.
abilities.lore: Hell Pit Abominations are notoriously difficult to slay and can even regrow severed limbs.

abilities.name: Too Horrible To Die
abilities.description:
Effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect:

**1 - *Dead***
This unit is destroyed.

**2-4 - *The Rats Emerge***
Roll a D3 for each enemy unit in combat with this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll. Then, this unit is destroyed.

**5-6 - *It’s Alive!***
This unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D6)** this unit.
abilities.lore: As it twitches in its shuddering death throes, there is a chance that either the Abomination’s unholy metabolism will restart one of its many foul hearts or its carcass will disgorge the revolting tide of parasitic rats that had been gnawing upon its innards.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Gnashing Teeth and Flailing Fists** is 8.

abilities.name: Avalanche of Flesh
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: A Hell Pit Abomination can rear up to its fullest height before crashing back to the ground, crushing foes beneath its sickening bulk.

units.lore: Named for the gruesome subterranean laboratories in which they are crafted, Hell Pit Abominations are the pinnacle of the Master Moulders' sciences. An Abomination is created by melding and mutating the flesh of plentiful hapless subjects as well as employing warpstone and other, more secretive arts. Foes are soon overwhelmed by an avalanche of flailing limbs - many of which sport various murderous 'upgrades'. Yet the insensate bulk of the Abomination remains its greatest weapon, capable of breaking a flank single-handedly.

units.name: Doomwheel

abilities.name: Rolling Doom
abilities.description:
Effect: This unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. This unit can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, but it cannot end that move in combat.

Then, pick up to 3 enemy units that this unit passed across during that move to be the targets. Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

**Designer’s Note:** *This unit can use this ability even if it is in combat.*
abilities.lore: A Doomwheel will mercilessly crush anything in its path.

details.notes: You cannot include more than 1 **SKRYRE WAR MACHINE** in a regiment led by a non-**SKRYRE HERO**.

units.lore: Many uncanny war engines have emerged from the forges of the Clans Skryre, but the Doomwheels are arguably the most bizarre. These contraptions can appear almost amusing to incredulous foes; resembling giant wheels, they roll forwards at an unsteady pace. Yet amusement gives way to terror as the Doomwheel picks up speed, erratic blasts of warp lightning leaping from the ruinous realmstone crystals affixed to prongs on its flanks. Any caught in its path will be either blasted to blackened corpses or simply ground to bloody smears.

units.name: Clawlord on Gnaw-beast

abilities.name: Cruel Commander
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO VERMINUS INFANTRY** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, add 5 to the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The Clawlord strikes down one of their underlings to show their cruel power and then, with shrieks and hissed threats, commands their swarming underlings to overrun the foe.

abilities.name: Cornered Rat
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is damaged, add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of its **Warpforged Halberd**.
abilities.lore: A Clawlord in fear for their life fights with rabid ferocity.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Skaven Overclaw*.

units.lore: The title of Clawlord is not awarded through ceremony; it must be seized via cunning and violence. Clawlords of sufficient prestige may acquire a freakish mount known as a Gnaw-beast. These gangly-limbed and whipcord-fast horrors are bred by the Clans Moulder to possess a self-destructively swift metabolism. No matter how voraciously it feeds, the black hunger pains the Gnaw-beast constantly, granting it a frenzy that only fear of its master can curb.

units.name: Warp Lightning Cannon

abilities.name: More-more Warp Lightning!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **SKRYRE HERO**, add 6 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Warp Lightning Blast** for the rest of the turn.

However, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for an attack made with this unit’s **Warp Lightning Blast**, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit after the **SHOOT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Warlock Engineer can increase the power output of a Warp Lightning Cannon at the risk of harming the weapon and its crew.

abilities.name: Warp Lightning Blast
abilities.description: Effect: Each attack made with this weapon in a single phase must target the same enemy unit. Each hit inflicts 1 mortal damage on the target and the attack sequence ends.
abilities.lore: A Warp Lightning Cannon fires massive bolts of warp lightning that disintegrate any who are struck by them.

details.notes: You cannot include more than 1 **SKRYRE WAR MACHINE** in a regiment led by a non-**SKRYRE HERO**.

units.lore: Warp Lightning Cannons are the most infamous creations of the Clans Skryre. A dense warpstone core is attached to a long metallic barrel, etched with runes that magnify power channelled along it. Said power is focused in the warpstone 'tip' of the cannon before being discharged in a bolt of sizzling energy. The erratic nature of warpstone ensures that even the most skilled Skaven artillerist cannot accurately determine how much power will be exerted when the weapon is fired. Usually, they must simply pick their moment and hope for the best.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Brood Terror

abilities.name: Regenerating Terror
abilities.description: Effect: **Heal (D6)** this unit.
abilities.lore: Brood Terrors are a nightmare of mutation and overwhelming strength.

abilities.name: Lend a Claw
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 4 other friendly non-**SKRYRE MOULDER** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Loosely Attached Bladed Limbs** for the rest of the phase for each target picked. Add 1 to hit rolls for the targets’ attacks for the rest of the phase, including those made with **Companion** weapons.
abilities.lore: In a horrifying bout of lucidity and multiple flailing appendages, the remains of the Master Moulder who was stitched into this abomination exert a degree of control over the other creatures in its menagerie before swiftly falling back into a pit of insanity.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: Ghyran has suffered terribly from the ravages of Brood Terrors, horrors created when a Master Moulder stitches himself into a hulking war-form fashioned from brass and alchemised meat. From within this two-headed titan the Master directs his minions’ attacks with frantic, jabbing motions of its weapon-limbs, before plunging headfirst into the fray to test his latest flesh-grafts upon the enemy.

units.name: Brood Terror

abilities.name: Regenerating Terror
abilities.description: Effect: **Heal (D6)** this unit.
abilities.lore: Brood Terrors are a nightmare of mutation and overwhelming strength.

abilities.name: Warpstone Fumes
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The belching, flesh-twisting smoke that clings to a Brood Terror obscures the clawpacks from view.

units.lore: Amongst the most hideous aberrations of Skaven fleshcraft, a Brood Terror is created when a Master Moulder is stitched into a monstrous form. These twin-headed titans lurch between bouts of low cunning and bestial rage. Surrounded by clouds of mutagenic fog, they lumber forth with an ungainly but definite purpose, From one mutilated limb hangs a hooked flail that the Terror uses to drag its prey closer, whereupon the victim is bathed in the fires that leap from its warpflame scourger or vivisected by clusters of swift knife-arms.

units.name: Rat Ogors

abilities.name: Unleashed Warp-fury
abilities.description: Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit. Then, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The warpstone hammered into the flesh of these creatures crackles with volatile energies, driving them into a frenzy.

units.lore: The power of the Clans Moulder is built on the broad shoulders of the Rat Ogors. These rabid war-mutants are created by grafting nimble Skaven to the muscled bulk of ogorkind through strange cryptosorcery and infusing them with warpstone shards and unguents. These misbegotten warriors are pumped full of all manner of toxic serums designed to magnify both their regenerative properties and their natural frenzy. A mixture of pain and gnawing hunger sees them tear at enemies in a blind fury, ripping off limbs and wolfing down flesh.

units.name: Stormvermin

abilities.name: Elite Bodyguard
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY HEROES** have **WARD (5+)** while they are within this unit’s combat range.
abilities.lore: Every ratman of rank knows the value and prestige of Stormvermin bodyguard – they are even almost loyal…

units.lore: Unlike most Skaven warriors, who tend towards being stooped and rangy, Stormvermin are immediately identifiable by their comparative bulk and general aura of menace. Hand-picked from the most promising spawn of a litter – usually marked by having devoured many of their brood-mates – they are subjected to especially brutal training regimes by their Clawlords. This results in ratmen that are able to fight with a degree of precision and focus uncommon to their kin.

units.name: Warplock Jezzails

abilities.name: Warpstone Snipers
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit's **Warplock Jezzails** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Having set up the Warplock Jezzail in position, the gunner can wait for the perfect moment to fire their shot.

units.lore: Long-range warfare is a respected art amongst the Skaven; it is, after all, the method of combat least likely to involve personal danger. Skilled snipers amongst the Clans Skryre take up Warplock Jezzails, from which they can spit death from the rearmost ranks. Two ratmen are needed to carry a Jezzail; the second Skaven makes themselves useful by clutching a pavise shield that props up the heavy rifle and provides a measure of defence against return fire.

units.name: Warlock Engineer

abilities.name: More-more Warp Energy!
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit, it was not set up this turn and it has not used a MOVE ability this turn
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, set the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Warplock Musket** to 3 for the rest of the turn. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.
abilities.lore: The Engineer overcharges their weapon with volatile energy.

abilities.name: Sniper-master
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit and friendly **Warplock Jezzails** units wholly within 13" of this unit can ignore the effects of the ‘Guarded Hero’ ability (Core Rules, 25.0) when picking the target for their shooting attacks.
abilities.lore: No enemy is safe from the warp-laced bullets of a Warlock Engineer and his underlings.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Skaven Overclaw*.

units.lore: The most common class of Warlocks are known simply as Engineers. These are responsible for the construction and operation of the many mass-produced wonder weapons of the Clans Skryre. Less inclined to face their foes head on, many Warlock Engineers carry ranged weapons of their own creation, with warplock muskets being a perennial favourite. Of course, the Engineers cannot help but attempt to push these weapons to their limits, thoroughly convinced of their own genius - until the musket detonates in their claws, that is.

units.name: Verminlord Warpseer

abilities.name: Arch-Manipulator
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Those who dare face a Warpseer find themselves utterly pre-empted and outmanoeuvred.

abilities.name: Tectonic Splintering
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.
abilities.lore: Hissing invocations of ruin and collapse, the Verminlord compels the earth to break and belch forth hostile warpgales, leaving their enemies staggering.

abilities.name: Hurl Scry-orb
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: This unit cannot use the ‘Divine the Future’ ability for the rest of the battle. Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: The Warpseer throws its scry-orb into the midst of the foe, where it explodes in a shattering cloud of madness and destruction.

abilities.name: Divine The Future
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is on the battlefield, add 2" to the distance friendly units can move when using the ‘Always Three Clawsteps Ahead’ ability.
abilities.lore: The swirling scry-orbs of the Warpseer can show it glimpses of the future.

units.lore: All Verminlords are conniving, as befits the daemonic progeny of the Great Horned Rat. The Warpseers, however, are manipulation given form. Their eldritch abilities go beyond those of even their fellow rat-daemons; they wheeze the stuff of sorcery, tugging at the threads of possibility and ploy with each swift lash of the tail. Engulfed by billowing gales of warp-energy, these Verminlords orchestrate the doom of armies, gleefully sending thousands of minions to their deaths to facilitate their deranged stratagems.

units.name: Ratling Warpblaster

abilities.name: Overwhelming Fire
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks that target an enemy unit that has 10 or more models.
abilities.lore: Large enemy formations are decimated by the sheer volume of fire a Ratling Warpblaster unleashes upon them.

abilities.name: More-more Warpstone Bullets!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **SKRYRE HERO**, this unit’s **Hail of Warpstone Bullets** has an Attacks characteristic of 6D6+3 instead of 3D6+3 for the rest of the turn.

However, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for an attack made with this unit’s **Hail of Warpstone Bullets**, inflict 1 mortal damage on this unit after the **SHOOT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Under the dubious supervision of the Warlocks of Clans Skryre, the gunner cranks up the Ratling Warpblaster’s velocity to the max.

details.notes: You cannot include more than 1 **SKRYRE WAR MACHINE** in a regiment led by a non-**SKRYRE HERO**.

units.lore: Given their vast population and penchant for internecine warfare, Skaven appreciate the benefits of culling massed infantry. The Ratling Warpblasters were developed for expressly this purpose. A complex series of rotary cannons mounted upon a stocky wooden frame, the device is powered by a ludicrously overcharged warpstone accelerator battery. Once wheeled into place, its Warlock gunner will flick the levers that draw power from this reserve. The Warpblaster's barrels begin to revolve before spitting out a torrent of warpstone-infused missiles.

units.name: Acolyte Globadiers

abilities.name: Hidden Weapon Team
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **Clanrats** unit that has 5 or more models, and there are no other friendly **WEAPON TEAM** units within that unit’s combat range, this unit is not visible to enemy units more than 13" away.
abilities.lore: Skryre weapon teams often lurk amidst larger formations.

abilities.name: Gas Clouds
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Poisoned Wind Globes** for attacks that target an enemy unit that has 10 or more models.
abilities.lore: Poisoned wind globes are crystal orbs filled with deadly warp-gas that can engulf and lethally transmute an enemy regiment.

details.notes: You cannot include more than 1 **SKRYRE WEAPON TEAM** in a regiment led by a non-**SKRYRE HERO**.

units.lore: The Acolyte Globadiers of the Clans Skryre are tinkerers and artificers, miners and munitions carriers. They are a step above the thrall-rats that toil on the production lines or serve as fodder for weapons testing, and they scheme constantly about attaining the status of Warlock. The masters of the Clans Skryre are well aware of this, and they are little disposed to acquiring new rivals.

units.name: Verminlord Warbringer

abilities.name: Tyrant of Battle
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **VERMINUS INFANTRY** units wholly within 13" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: The targets can each use the ‘All-out Attack’ or ‘All-out Defence’ command this phase even if that command has been used by a friendly unit this phase.
abilities.lore: These towering monstrosities are the commanders of the seething hordes of Clans Verminus.

abilities.name: Killing Blow
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a damaged enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is less than the number of damage points the target has, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Warbringers drive their spike-fists into already wounded enemies, exploiting the slightest gap in their foe’s defences to deliver a bloody coup de grâce.

units.lore: Warbringers are the most commonly seen of the Verminlord broods. They embody the Great Horned Rat's desire for carnage, his hunger to sweep away all that stands proud and replace it with shattered ruins through which rodents swarm. Arrogant, belligerent and territorial, Warbringers are often found dominating the Clans Verminus, who share much of their bloodthirsty world view. This stewardship, however, resembles less a protective guardian spirit and more a fell-handed tyrant bidding their screeching minions to fight with ever greater ferocity - or else face their inevitably fatal judgement.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Grey Seer on Screaming Bell

abilities.name: Echoes of the Vermindoom
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **SKAVEN** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: **Heal (D3)** each target.
abilities.lore: As the bell rings in time with one of its counterparts in sacred Blight City, it releases a pulse of ruinous energies that invigorate the swarm.

abilities.name: Gnaw Through Reality
abilities.description:
Declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, this unit counts as a friendly **Gnawhole** for the purposes of the ‘Gnawhole Ambush’, ‘Tunnels Through Reality’ and ‘The Endless Vermintide’ abilities.
abilities.lore: The Grey Seer focuses their energy to keep open a tear in reality from which fellow Skaven can pour.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Bulk** is 4.

abilities.name: The Bell Tolls
abilities.description: Effect: If the current battle round number is odd, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **SKAVEN** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit. If the current battle round number is even, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units that target a friendly **SKAVEN** unit while it is wholly within 13" of this unit.
abilities.lore: With a swing and a clang, the bell doth peal; Skaven march and man-things squeal!

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: Rattling through the Ghyranite jungle on ironbound wheels comes the hellish contraption known as a Screaming Bell, a Grey Seer riding atop it and shrieking praises to the Great Horned Rat. Each bone-jarring toll of the bell invigorates nearby Skaven, healing their wounds and hastening their scurrying advance.

units.name: Warlock Bombardier

abilities.name: Explosive Payload
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks that target an enemy unit that has 10 or more models.
abilities.lore: Nothing is more satisfying to a Bombardier than seeing their doomrocket go off in the midst of a tightly packed swarm of enemies.

abilities.name: More-more Doom!
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit, it was not set up this turn and it has not used a MOVE ability this turn
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, set the Damage characteristic of its **Doomrocket** to D3+3 for the rest of the turn. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.
abilities.lore: An extra doomrocket warhead can be attached to the payload if the wielder dares.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Skaven Overclaw*.

units.lore: Warlock Bombardiers are besotted with indiscriminate carnage. Their obsession with ballistic devastation finds realisation in the creation of Doomrockets. These are amongst the most potent, and temperamental, weapons that a single Skaven can wield, capable of blasting formations to ashes. More is always better, says the ratman mindset, and so Bombardiers gleefully strap additional warheads and power sources to their missiles. This certainly results in a satisfying explosion - though not always one that consumes the intended target...

units.name: Master Moulder

abilities.name: Lord of Flesh-grafting
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick another friendly **MOULDER** unit wholly within 13" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: **Heal (3)** the target.
abilities.lore: These burly commanders are the breeders, mutators and healers of the Clans Moulder.

abilities.name: Tyrannical Packmaster
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick another friendly **MOULDER** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Master Moulders use pain and terror to drive their fighting beasts into a battle frenzy.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Skaven Overclaw*.

units.lore: It takes an especially deranged Skaven to rise to the rank of Master Moulder. They are the overlords of the Clans Moulder, dark luminaries in the arts of flesh-grafting, each devoted to crafting ever more grotesque nightmare-beasts. Master Moulders are experts in stitching muscle and flesh into new forms, and they use warpstone to trigger mutations that twist a mortal corpus beyond recognition. Master Moulders take a warped pride in the monsters they have brought into unholy life and consider the battlefield successes of these creatures to be firmly their own.

units.name: Arch-Warlock

abilities.name: Overseers of the Enginecovens
abilities.description: Effect: If a friendly **SKRYRE** unit wholly within 13" of this unit uses the 'Covering Fire' command, no command points are spent.
abilities.lore: The Arch-Warlocks of the Clans Skryre command their enginecovens with a blend of deadly efficiency and overt sadism.

units.lore: At the head of every Skyre clan stands an Arch-Warlock. They are the masters of the various schools of lethal science practised by their clan, and they have personally overseen the creation of all manner of temperamental, but utterly deadly, techno-arcane superweapons. An Arch-Warlock's mind is a thing of whirring brass gears, constantly churning out new schematics of death.

units.name: Grey Seer

abilities.name: Warpstone Shards
abilities.description:
Effect: The next time you make a casting roll for this unit this phase, roll 3D6 instead of 2D6. This roll cannot be rerolled or modified.

If the casting roll is 13, the spell is successfully cast and cannot be unbound. After the effect of that spell has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit.

If the casting roll is not 13, remove 1 dice of your choice from the casting roll and use the remaining 2D6 as the casting roll.
abilities.lore: Grey Seers consume potentially lethal shards of warpstone to enhance their spellcasting.

units.lore: Most devious of all Skaven are the Grey Seers. These are the agents of the Masterclan who work to manipulate Skaven society from the shadows. With a hissed incantation and flick of their claws, a Seer can summon storms of warp lightning, blast enemies with withering energy or teleport great distances in a blink. Grey Seers also possess a natural affinity for warpstone; their staffs of office are imbued with chunks of the corruptive realmstone, and many will consume shards of the substance to fuel their ruinous spellcraft.

units.name: Ratling Guns

abilities.name: Hidden Weapon Team
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **Clanrats** unit that has 5 or more models, and there are no other friendly **WEAPON TEAM** units within that unit’s combat range, this unit is not visible to enemy units more than 13" away.
abilities.lore: Skryre weapon teams often lurk amidst larger formations.

details.notes: You cannot include more than 1 **SKRYRE WEAPON TEAM** in a regiment led by a non-**SKRYRE HERO**.

units.lore: Ratling Guns are amongst the most commonplace of the weapon teams that emerge from the forges of the Clans Skryre. Powered by complex warp-steam batteries and activated by a hand-crank operated by the weapon's loader, Ratling Guns are notoriously difficult to aim. The sheer volume of bullets they unleash, however, can shred an enemy cohort regardless.

units.name: Clawlord

abilities.name: Cornered Rat
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is damaged, add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of its **Warpforged Blade**.
abilities.lore: A Clawlord in fear for their life fights with rabid ferocity.

abilities.name: Gnash-gnaw On Their Bones!
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO VERMINUS INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: At a Clawlord’s command, their minions hurl themselves at the foe.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Skaven Overclaw*.

units.lore: Clawlords command from the very back ranks - the most honourable of all positions within Skaven society. After all, why should a leader sully their own blade with violence when there are plenty of minions able to die on their behalf? Clawlords expend the lives of their underlings freely, safe in the knowledge that there are always more where they came from. The wisest amongst them also make sure that they always have an escape route to paw - even if they must cut through enemies and allies alike in the process.

units.name: Stormfiends

abilities.name: Shock Gauntlets
abilities.description: Effect: Each time an attack made with this unit’s **Shock Gauntlets** scores a critical hit, that attack scores D6 hits on the target unit instead of 1. Make a wound roll for each hit.
abilities.lore: The electrical discharge created by shock gauntlets can trigger a series of linked explosions.

abilities.name: Grinderfist Tunnellers
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is **in the tunnels below** and includes any models armed with **Grinderfists**.

Effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Grinderfists can be used to create underground tunnels.

units.lore: The Clans Moulder and Clans Skryre have long enjoyed a profitable, if fraught, alliance. Stormfiends are one of the many horrors engendered by these collaborations. In appearance, they resemble a Rat Ogor granted even greater bulk through potent warpstone serums, and they can wield various deadly Skryre firearms without tearing themselves apart through recoil.

units.name: Warlock Galvaneer

abilities.name: More-More Warpvolt Doom!
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit's **Warpvolt Obliterator** to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each other enemy unit within the target's combat range. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: This warpvolt weapon unleashes an all-consuming wave of sparking death that vaporises nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Lightning Master
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Warpvolt Scourgers** unit within this unit's combat range to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, set the Attacks characteristic of the target's **Warpvolt Scourgers** to 10 for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: None are better than a Warlock Galvaneer at engineering storms of electrical carnage.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Skaven Overclaw*.

units.lore: A Warplock Galvaneer is a connoisseur of electrically charged annihilation. These twitchy maniacs are obsessed with channelling the voltaic energies that course through the veins of the Dark Innovator, and they see the battlefield as the perfect arena in which to test their latest creations. Wielding battery-powered warpvolt obliterators, they scamper into the fray, their weapons spitting crackling arcs of warp-corrupted lightning that scorch flesh and turn even heavily armoured foes into jerking, smoking corpses.

units.name: Vizzik Skour, Prophet of the Horned Rat

abilities.name: Prophet of the Horned Rat
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: You can re-roll chanting rolls for this unit until the start of your next turn
abilities.lore: Vizzik endlessly schemes to extend his god's influence - alongside his own.

abilities.name: The Death Frenzy
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 13"of this unit or a visible friendly **SKAVEN INFANTRY** unit within 13" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the target is an enemy unit, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons until the start of your next turn.

If the target is a friendly unit, it can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this turn. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.

If the chanting roll was 12+, you can pick 2 targets instead of 1.
abilities.lore: Such is the force of Vizzik's screeching oratory that the verminous hordes froth and spasm under his influence as mere mortals unravel to visions of their inevitable doom.

abilities.name: Gaze of the Gnaw
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, for the rest of the turn:

• If this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability, all of the target's attacks must target this unit.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target's combat attacks that target this unit.
abilities.lore: To catch Vizzik's gaze is to be driven from one's mind by agonising raptures.

abilities.name: Fissures In Reality
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Those who resist Vizzik's will are swallowed by fang-mouthed fissures that wrench open in his presence.

units.lore: Created in the apocalyptic fires of the Vermindoom, Vizzik Skour is the chief priest of the Horned Rat, Lord of the Gnaw and master of the mind-shattering death frenzy. The force of this daemon's diabolic zeal is enough to crack the land and drive the Skaven swarms into a frothing madness.

units.name: Warpfire Throwers

abilities.name: Hidden Weapon Team
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **Clanrats** unit that has 5 or more models, and there are no other friendly **WEAPON TEAM** units within that unit’s combat range, this unit is not visible to enemy units more than 13" away.
abilities.lore: Skryre weapon teams often lurk amidst larger formations.

details.notes: You cannot include more than 1 **SKRYRE WEAPON TEAM** in a regiment led by a non-**SKRYRE HERO**.

units.lore: Within the voluminous barrel of a Warpfire Thrower sloshes a particularly incendiary and evil concoction. When the Skaven gunner depresses a trigger, this liquid is fed through crude piping to spew out of a brass nozzle, igniting on contact with the air to produce sheets of blinding green flame. So deadly is this compound that it cannot be doused through conventional means; those whom it strikes can only burn to death in agony as the fire leaps across tightly packed ranks of infantry.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Grey Seer on Screaming Bell

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Bulk** is 4.

abilities.name: The Bell Tolls
abilities.description: Effect: If the current battle round number is odd, add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **SKAVEN** units while they are wholly within 13" of this unit. If the current battle round number is even, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units that target a friendly **SKAVEN** unit while it is wholly within 13" of this unit.
abilities.lore: With a swing and a clang, the bell doth peal; Skaven march and man-things squeal!

abilities.name: Pealing Portal
abilities.description:
Declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, this unit counts as a friendly **Gnawhole** for the purposes of the ‘Gnawhole Ambush’, ‘Tunnels Through Reality’ and ‘The Endless Vermintide’ abilities.
abilities.lore: The Grey Seer channels dark sorceries to rip open a gnawhole at the base of their hellish contraption.

abilities.name: Echoes of the Vermindoom
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **SKAVEN** units wholly within 13" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: **Heal (D3)** each target.
abilities.lore: As the bell rings in time with one of its counterparts in sacred Blight City, it releases a pulse of ruinous energies that invigorate the swarm.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Riding across the Great Parch atop a rickety wheeled altar known as a Screaming Bell, the Grey Seer unleashes dark magics in the name of the Horned Rat. The ruinous peals of the bell invigorate nearby Skaven even as the sonic assault enervates the foe.

battleTraits.name: Eat 'Em Alive
battleTraits.phase: End of Any Turn
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR** unit that used a **FIGHT** ability that targeted a unit, excluding **FACTION TERRAIN**, this turn to use this ability. Then, you can pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target. The same enemy unit cannot be picked to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target (if any). Then, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that friendly **OGOR** unit for the rest of the battle. If any of these effects already apply to it, you can pick a different effect to replace the current effect.

• ***Raw and Bloody Flesh***: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that unit.

• ***Exotic Giblets***: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by that unit’s combat attacks made with non-**Companion** weapons.

• ***Steaming Brains***: Add 2 to that unit’s Control characteristic.

• ***Crunchy Bones***: That unit’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)**. If that unit’s melee weapons already have **Crit (2 Hits)**, they have **Crit (Mortal)** instead.

• ***Slick Innards***: That unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.

• ***Mystery Meat***: Subtract 1 from the power level of enemy units while they are in combat with that unit, to a minimum of 0.

**Designer’s Note**: *Only 1 of these effects can apply to the same unit at the same time unless specified otherwise. Also note that Steaming Brains affects the Control characteristic, not the control score.*
battleTraits.lore: For ogors, there is no real distinction between fighting and feasting.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Ogor Mawtribes armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Bull Charge
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that charged this turn and has not used a **RAMPAGE** ability this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Your opponent must move the target up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of your units and can end that move in combat.

After your opponent has done so, roll a dice for each model in the unit using this ability that is within 3" of the target. Add 1 to the roll if the unit using this ability is a **GUTBUSTERS** unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

Then, the unit using this ability can make a pile-in move. If the target of this ability is still in combat with the unit using this ability, then the target of this ability must be picked as the target of the pile‑in move.

**Designer’s Note**: *Your opponent may not be able to move the models in the target unit (or may choose to leave them where they are) but the target still counts as having moved for rules purposes.*
battleTraits.lore: The bulk and surprising speed of ogors can see them trample right over enemies.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Ogor Mawtribes armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Jaws of the Beast
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BEASTCLAW HERO** that is leading a regiment and that has not been deployed, then pick a non-**HERO** unit in that **HERO**'s regiment that has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up those units in reserve **tracking the prey**. They have now been deployed.
battleTraits.lore: Beastclaw ogors are inevitably skilled hunters and trackers.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Ogor Mawtribes armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Closing the Jaws
battleTraits.phase: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BEASTCLAW HERO** that is **tracking the prey**.

Effect: Set up that **HERO** wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up the other friendly unit that is **tracking the prey** wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge, wholly within 9" of that **HERO** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
battleTraits.lore: The chieftains of the Beastclaw signal when it is time to strike.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Ogor Mawtribes armies can use the following abilities:

ability.name: Feast of Bloodshed
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.description:
Declare: For each enemy unit that was destroyed this turn, pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that is not in combat and has not used the ‘Power Through’ command this turn to be the target.

Effect: Each target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.
ability.lore: Monstrous by nature, ogors are never more energised than when tearing meat and guzzling down gore.

abilities.name: Feast of Bloodshed
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: For each enemy unit that was destroyed this turn, pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that is not in combat and has not used the ‘Power Through’ command this turn to be the target.

Effect: Each target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: Monstrous by nature, ogors are never more energised than when tearing meat and guzzling down gore.

ability.name: Prowling Predators
ability.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** units while they are wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and have not charged this turn.
ability.lore: Ogors are surprisingly skilful trackers; they surround their prey, carefully avoiding retribution before striking with terrible savagery.

abilities.name: Prowling Predators
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** units while they are wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and have not charged this turn.
abilities.lore: Ogors are surprisingly skilful trackers; they surround their prey, carefully avoiding retribution before striking with terrible savagery.

ability.name: Smash and Grab
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that charged this turn and for which the unmodified charge roll was 8+ to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was in combat with at the start of the move.
ability.lore: These rampaging ogor raiders crash through the enemy lines without stopping, always seeking more to eat and loot.

abilities.name: Smash and Grab
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that charged this turn and for which the unmodified charge roll was 8+ to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was in combat with at the start of the move.
abilities.lore: These rampaging ogor raiders crash through the enemy lines without stopping, always seeking more to eat and loot.

ability.name: Grub's Up, Mateys!
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that has used the ‘Eat ’Em Alive’ ability this battle to be the targets.

Effect: **Heal** (**D3**) each target.
ability.lore: Guts roiling with a divine hunger, these fanatical ogors relish gulping down revitalising blood and offal.

abilities.name: Grub's Up, Mateys!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that has used the ‘Eat ’Em Alive’ ability this battle to be the targets.

Effect: **Heal** (**D3**) each target.
abilities.lore: Guts roiling with a divine hunger, these fanatical ogors relish gulping down revitalising blood and offal.

heroicTraits.name: Leave Not a Morsel
heroicTraits.description: Effect: While they are within 6" of and visible to this unit, enemy units cannot be healed or have slain models returned to them.
heroicTraits.lore: If it’s eaten, so says this ogor, then it stays eaten.

heroicTraits.name: Dreaded Far and Wide
heroicTraits.description:
Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to:

• This unit’s control score.
• Hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s non-**Companion** attacks.
• Charge rolls for this unit.
• The number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit.
heroicTraits.lore: Terrifying tales cross the frontiers of the atrocities perpetrated by this ogor; their shadow looms large both literally and psychologically.

heroicTraits.name: The Crusherguts
heroicTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is automatically slain and the target cannot make pile-in moves for the rest of the turn.
heroicTraits.lore: An ogor who has mastered the Crusherguts – an ancient and feared belly flop technique – has weedier enemies at their mercy.

artefacts.name: Carvalox Hide
artefacts.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (6+)**. It also has **WARD (4+)** against damage points inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**.
artefacts.lore: Carvalox are colossal birds of prey found in the arctic regions of Ghur. They are favoured quarry of ogor Hunters, for their meat can be used to barter with the Yhetee clans while their feathered hides offer protection from magic.

artefacts.name: Mantle of Entrails
artefacts.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
artefacts.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a command, roll a dice as a reaction. On a 3+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.
artefacts.lore: This crown of guts, sinew and burned flesh was ‘woven’ by a vision-wracked Butcher over three restless nights. It is horrific to look upon, instilling a terror that seems to reach right into the beholder’s bowels.

artefacts.name: Trophy Rack
artefacts.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following trophies. For the rest of the battle, melee weapons used by other friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** units have the corresponding weapon ability while they are wholly within 6" of and visible to this unit:

• ***Squeezed Head***: **Anti‑MONSTER (+1 Rend)**

• ***Smashed City Rubble***: **Anti‑WAR MACHINE (+1 Rend)**

• ***Torn Appendages***: **Anti‑CAVALRY (+1 Rend)**
artefacts.lore: These gruesome trophies prove that an ogor has lived up to their many boasts, encouraging their tribemates to follow their lead.

aqshyArtefacts.name: A Choice Cut
aqshyArtefacts.description:
Effect: • This unit cannot use **RUN** abilities.
• Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each friendly **OGOR INFANTRY** unit each phase while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: The sight of this colossal slab of meat being awkwardly hefted across the battlefield inspires nearby ogors to fight through the pain – the quicker they flatten the foe, the quicker they can get to feasting.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Rusty Grater
aqshyArtefacts.description: Effect: Each time this unit uses the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal (D3)** this unit.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: By attaching this crudely perforated metal sheet to their favoured blade, this ogor is gifted a snack of shredded flesh when they wield their weapon with enough ferocity.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Key to the Larder
aqshyArtefacts.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR INFANTRY** unit on the battlefield to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: This ogor has promised their favoured warriors access to one of the legendary larders in the Great Gutfort – if they are suitably impressive in battle.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Extremely Obstinate
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: This unit has a Control characteristic of 15.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: Once this beast has laid claim to something, there is no shifting it.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: **OGOR MAWTRIBES MONSTER** only

aqshyEnhancements.name: Horn Toss
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that has no more than 1 model, that is in combat with this unit and that has charged this turn to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of this unit. Then, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: Dipping its head against an onrushing foe, with an effortless flick of its horns, this beast sends its attacker flying into the air.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: **OGOR MAWTRIBES MONSTER** only

aqshyEnhancements.name: Grumpy Alpha
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Declare: If this unit is in combat, pick another visible friendly **OGOR MONSTER** wholly within 12" of this unit that is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, roll a dice. The target can move a distance in inches up to the roll. It can end that move in combat. If it does so, the target has charged.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: Having established its dominance, this irascible beast can bring another member of the herd to its side with a single bellow.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: **OGOR MAWTRIBES MONSTER** only

spells.name: Shincruncher
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target ends a move or is set up on the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target after the ability has been resolved.

**Designer’s Note**: *The ‘Bull Charge’ ability in the battle traits forces an enemy unit to move.*
spells.lore: The shaman strips the meat and splits the bone of a huge beast haunch; as they do so, the limbs of their enemies crack and splinter at the slightest movement.

spells.name: Blood Feast
spells.description:
