Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
spells.lore: The liver of a powerful beast is held high over the shaman’s head. Gore drips and runs down their face before they take a great bite from it, filling nearby ogors with a frenzied blood-lust.

spells.name: Tallowflage
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the target is not visible to enemy units more than 12" away from it.
spells.lore: Smearing their flesh with sizzling, heated fat, the Butcher conjures a hazy shroud that conceals a band of nearby ogors from the enemy’s sight.

prayers.name: Freezing Tailwinds
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target. Add 2 instead if the chanting roll was 6+.
prayers.lore: At the priest’s urging, the howling winds of the Everwinter blow with greater ferocity, biting at the ogors and speeding the horde onwards.

prayers.name: Pulverising Hailstorm
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Then, inflict 3 mortal damage on the target(s).
prayers.lore: The harsh bellowing of the priest summons a rain of fist-sized hailstones to pummel the enemy from above.

prayers.name: Fortifying Hoarfrost
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that friendly unit.
prayers.lore: As the priest growls a command to winter itself, a glittering layer of ice starts spreading over the flesh of their followers, a mystical armour capable of turning blades.

terrain.name: Great Mawpot

abilities.name: Battlebroth
abilities.description: Effect: If the **Great Mawpot** is full, **Heal (D3)** each visible friendly unit wholly within 18" of it. After you have done so, the **Great Mawpot** is **empty**.
abilities.lore: The contents of the Mawpot are suffused with strange magic; a single mouthful can restore an ogor’s vitality and stitch up their wounds.

abilities.name: Throw 'Em In
abilities.description:
Effect: This Great Mawpot is either **full** or **empty**. It starts the battle **full**.

If an enemy model is slain within 12" of this **Great Mawpot** while it is **empty**, it becomes **full**.
abilities.lore: The bludgeoned and hacked remains of dead foes are thrown into the bubbling cauldron to thicken the stew.

abilities.name: Vessel of the Gulping God
abilities.description:
Declare: If the **Great Mawpot** is **full**, pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD** within 3" of it to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Swirling gastromantic fumes emanate from the Great Mawpot when it is full to the brim.

details.notes: This terrain feature will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

terrain.lore: Blessed with the strange, hungry essence of the Gulping God, the Great Mawpot is a mawtribe’s most sacred possession. All manner of ingredients are thrown into this metal cauldron and boiled up into a thick magical broth that reinvigorates any ogors who taste it.

terrain.name: Mawpit

abilities.name: Step Away From The Maw
abilities.description: Effect: If this terrain feature has a **Head Butcher** that was not placed on it this turn, set up the **Head Butcher** on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a **Head Butcher**.
abilities.lore: The Head Butcher descends from the platform in search of fresh meat.

abilities.name: Feed the Maw
abilities.description:
Declare: If this terrain feature does not have a **Head Butcher**, pick a friendly **Butcher** within 3" of it and not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now a **Head Butcher** (see 'Hungry Sinkhole').

If this terrain feature is demolished, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the **Head Butcher**. Then, set up the **Head Butcher** on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a **Head Butcher**. If it is not possible to set up the **Head Butcher**, it is slain.
abilities.lore: The new Head Butcher ascends the platform above the Mawpit.

abilities.name: Hungry Sinkhole
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this **Mawpit** to be a **sinkhole**. Then, you can pick another terrain feature within 12" of this **Mawpit** and that you have not already picked to be a **sinkhole** this battle to be a **sinkhole** for the rest of the turn.

Then, pick each enemy unit within 3" of the **sinkhole(s)** to be the targets.

From the second battle round onwards, increase the range at which another terrain feature can be picked to be a **sinkhole** by 3" for each previous battle round. If this terrain feature has a **Head Butcher**, increase the range at which another terrain feature can be picked to be a **sinkhole** by 6" for each previous battle round instead of 3".

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: The appearance of a Mawpit is irrefutable evidence of the Gulping God’s eagerness to feast upon the land itself, a hunger that only becomes more ravenous wherever the ogors roam.

terrain.lore: As gastromantic magic floods the battlefield, the ground itself opens hungrily in response. These Mawpits are capable only of consuming, dragging in wayward enemies to crush and digest with their many circular rows of teeth.

units.name: Maulbeast Cavalry

abilities.name: Ravenous Counter-Attack
abilities.description: Effect: Enemy units do not count as having charged while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: Maulbeasts are always hungry; they do not let foes get close without leaping to attack.

abilities.name: Shock and Gore
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks.
abilities.lore: The impact and ferocity of a Maulbeast Cavalry charge inevitably leave any survivors staggered and shaken.

units.lore: Maulbeast Cavalry are unleashed when a Gutbuster warlord wants something properly and thoroughly savaged. The brutish beasts these veterans ride upon are far from intelligent, but they are always hungry and up for the hunt. When such mountains of frenzied meat crash into the foe, the mess left behind must be seen to be believed.

units.name: Leadbelchers

abilities.name: Firing from the Belly
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: An ogor’s sturdy frame easily absorbs the recoil of even cannon-sized weapons.

abilities.name: Powder Gnoblars
abilities.description:
Effect: This unit’s **Powder Gnoblars** are tokens. There are 2 **Powder Gnoblars** for every 4 models in this unit.

Each time this unit uses a **SHOOT** ability, for each of this unit’s **Powder Gnoblars** that are on the battlefield, you can re-roll 1 hit roll of 1 but if that attack misses, remove 1 of this unit’s **Powder Gnoblars** from the battlefield after that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: When assisted by a Gnoblar minion, Leadbelchers can cause even more carnage.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: The blackpowder-obsessed gunners known as Leadbelchers lumber into battle, blasting away with their massive guns and utilising them as makeshift bludgeons should the foe be foolish enough to engage them in hand-to-hand combat.

units.name: Gluttons

abilities.name: Wall of Meat
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit if it has not charged this turn.
abilities.lore: Bulky and stubborn, Gluttons are remarkably hard to shift.

units.lore: Ogor Gluttons are hulking, muscle-bound brutes driven entirely by an unending desire for food. They thunder into battle like a landslide of sweaty flesh, taking great bites out of their foes even as they bash and hack with crude clubs and cleavers.

units.name: Mournfang Pack

abilities.name: Alpha Cavalry
abilities.description: Effect: The **Charge (+1 Damage)** weapon ability has no effect on attacks that target this unit.
abilities.lore: Those Mournfangs that have risen to the top of the fighting pits have done so by repeatedly charging equally massive rivals head-on and coming out on top.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Ogors mounted on Mournfangs wield clubs, blades and pistols, firing point-blank into their foes before laying about them with brutal abandon. Their foultempered beasts trample and gore anything that gets in their way.

units.name: Huskard on Stonehorn

weapons.name: Chaintrap, Harpoon Launcher or Blood Vulture

abilities.name: Stone Skeleton
abilities.description: Effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.
abilities.lore: The thick, rocklike skeletons of these beasts can take substantial punishment.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stonehorn’s Rock-hard Horns and Hooves** is 4.

abilities.name: Primal Bellow
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target or pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Add 2 to the roll if this unit charged this turn. On a 4+:

•  If the target is a friendly unit, its **Companion** weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn.

•  If the target is an enemy unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Huskard drives their Stonehorn to unleash a mighty roar that sends nearby monsters into a frenzy.

units.lore: Many Huskard Jorls and Huskard Eurls lead their warriors from atop the backs of formidable Stonehorns. Together, the beasts and their brutish riders are master linebreakers, using their impressive strength to batter their way through all obstacles.

units.name: Bloodpelt Hunter

abilities.name: Biggest-Game Hunter
abilities.description: Effect: The Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Skullshatter Crossbow and Impaling Spear** is 4 if the target is a **MONSTER**.
abilities.lore: A Bloodpelt Hunter’s arsenal is tailored to the killing of the largest prey.

abilities.name: The First Shot's Mine
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by friendly **BEASTCLAW** units that target that enemy unit.
abilities.lore: Glory-seekers all, Bloodpelt Hunters insist on shooting first. Their example and confidence inevitably inspires other ogors to follow suit.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Maw Nomad.*

units.lore: Bloodpelt Hunters seek out the largest and most formidable creatures in battle, stalking them unseen with the guile and cunning of an alpha predator. When their quarry is within reach, they close in for the kill, maiming the creature with crude iron crossbow bolts before hacking them apart with their axe and machete.

units.name: Slaughtermaster

abilities.name: Great Cauldron
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit’s cauldron is **filled with grisly remains**, pick a visible friendly **MAWSEEKERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: This unit’s cauldron is now **empty**. Pick 1 of the following effects:
***Bloodgruel***: The target has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.
***Spinemarrow***: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Lashed to a Slaughtermaster is a great cauldron containing the remains of foes, which the ogor gobbles down in order to unleash gastromantic powers.

abilities.name: Fill the Pot
abilities.description: Effect: This unit’s cauldron is either **filled with grisly remains** or **empty**. It starts the battle **empty**. If an enemy unit that was in combat with this unit this turn is destroyed and this unit’s cauldron is **empty**, it becomes **filled with grisly remains**.
abilities.lore: As enemies are cut down by the ogors, the Slaughtermaster collects their remains to fill his cauldron.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Slaughtermasters have entirely lost themselves to their cravings, hacking off their limbs and replacing them with rusty hooks and blades. They drag a cookpot into battle behind them so that they may boil up a tasty broth even as they slice up their prey.

units.name: Hunters with Sabrefangs

abilities.name: Through the Frosts
abilities.description: Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units. This unit cannot use **MOVE** abilities in the first turn of the first battle round.
abilities.lore: Despite their size, Hunters are skilled in the art of the ambush, advancing under the cover of lingering icy mists.

abilities.name: Ferocious Sabrefangs
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2 dice for each **Sabrefang** in this unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Sabrefangs are apex predators in their natural environment. Suffering no competitors, they will meet any aggression towards them with terrifying savagery.

units.lore: Hunters form the bulk of the Beastclaw alfrostuns. Each of these hardy ogors is well versed in facing down the elemental wilds and the monsters that lurk therein. They are skilled tamers and trackers, and thanks to the perpetual frosty mists that dog their steps, they can often move into position to take a satisfying crossbow shot long before the prey ever notices their presence.

units.name: Maulbeast Raiders

abilities.name: Relentless Predators
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Movement Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is more than 9" from all enemy units, it can move up to D6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
abilities.lore: Maulbeast Raiders are ever on the move, pursuing their quarry with impressive stamina and determination in even the harshest conditions.

units.lore: Where icy winds howl, packs of Maulbeast Raiders can often be found on the hunt. These Beastclaw cavalry ride brutish quadrupeds, but they choose their specific mounts for signs of low cunning as much as ferocity. The most important trait, though, is tenacity – a quality that Maulbeasts possess in abundance, allowing their riders to keep pace with their quarry and impair them with cruel, maiming crossbow shots.

units.name: Ironblaster

abilities.name: Obliterating Blast
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has not used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of it to be the target. Then, draw a straight line between the closest points on the bases of this unit and the target. Each other unit (friendly and enemy) that the line passes across is a **collateral damage target**.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on each **collateral damage target**.
abilities.lore: The sheer size of an Ironblaster means that collateral damage is effectively guaranteed – not that the ogors care.

units.lore: The most destructive blackpowder weapon deployed by the Gutbuster warglutts, the Ironblaster is an immense cannon that hurls solid shot into the heart of the enemy’s ranks, blasting foes into scraps of charred meat.

units.name: Stonehorn Beastriders

weapons.name: Chaintrap, Harpoon Launcher or Blood Vulture

abilities.name: Stone Skeleton
abilities.description: Effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.
abilities.lore: The thick, rocklike skeletons of these beasts can take substantial punishment.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stonehorn’s Rock-hard Horns and Hooves** is 4.

abilities.name: Stonehorn Avalanche
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn and has not used the ‘Bull Charge’ ability this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit or an enemy faction terrain feature within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• If the target is a unit, inflict 3 mortal damage on it.
• If the target is a faction terrain feature, inflict 6 mortal damage on it.
abilities.lore: Stonehorns will headbutt mountains without flinching. Needless to say, lesser edifices and foes in the path of their charge are crushed with practical impunity.

units.lore: The ground shakes under a Stonehorn’s headlong charge, each footfall a toll of doom. From its back, a pair of Beastriders bring down foes with snapping chaintraps and harpoons, hauling in their kills to add to the mawtribe’s meat harvest.

units.name: Butcher

abilities.name: Trogg-Guts
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **WARD (6+)** until the start of your next turn. If you picked a **MAWSEEKERS** unit, it has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn instead.
abilities.lore: By wolfing down the thick guts of a troggoth, a Butcher can mystically imbue fellow ogors with greater resilience. Or, sometimes, they just get indigestion.

abilities.name: More Meat for the Pot
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description: Effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit this turn by this unit’s combat attacks or by combat attacks made by a **MANIFESTATION** summoned by this unit, and that enemy unit has been destroyed, add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: The more bloody ingredients a Butcher tosses into their sacred cauldron, the more their arcane power seems to grow.

units.lore: The Gulping God speaks through the blood-smeared shamans known as Butchers. Channelling the gastromantic magic of their deity, these swollen brutes can cause the very earth to come alive and munch upon their foes.

units.name: Huskard on Thundertusk

weapons.name: Chaintrap, Harpoon Launcher or Blood Vulture

abilities.name: Freezing Aura
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Winter storms gather about this Huskard, freezing and slowing those foolish enough to remain in their presence for long.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Thundertusk’s Colossal Tusks** is 2.

abilities.name: Winter's Cruelty
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the number of damage points allocated to the target by attacks made with this unit’s **Ice Blast** this phase, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of the target’s weapons until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: A Huskard Torr can compel the Everwinter to blast cowardly foes with its full, icy disdain.

units.lore: The Huskard Torr leads the Thundertusks to war. At the ogor elder’s command, the creatures breathe out gales of frost. The ground on all sides grows thick with ice as enemies are turned into gleaming statues and the very life is leeched from their bones.

units.name: Frostlord on Stonehorn

abilities.name: Stone Skeleton
abilities.description: Effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.
abilities.lore: The thick, rocklike skeletons of these beasts can take substantial punishment.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stonehorn’s Rock-hard Horns** **and Hooves** is 4.

abilities.name: Earth-shattering Charge
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn and has not used the ‘Bull Charge’ ability this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target and then roll 2D6. This unit can move a distance in inches up to the value of the roll. It can pass through models in the target unit but must end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: Enemies are crushed and trampled beneath the unstoppable ferocity of a Frostlord upon a charging Stonehorn.

abilities.name: Enraged Roar
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is damaged, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by other friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** units while they are within this unit’s combat range.
abilities.lore: The ear-splitting enraged roar of a Stonehorn sends the beasts of the Mawpath into a frenzy.

units.lore: A Frostlord and their Stonehorn are an unstoppable force. The warlord’s booming voice directs the raiders while the bodies of foes are broken and ground to a bloody paste by the horns and hooves of their granite-boned steed.

units.name: Thundertusk Beastriders

weapons.name: Chaintrap, Harpoon Launcher or Blood Vulture

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Thundertusk’s Colossal Tusks** is 2.

abilities.name: Plough the Icepath
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a non-**CHARGE MOVE** ability for this unit in your movement phase
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY** unit that has not been reinforced, is wholly within 6" of this unit and has not been set up this turn to be the target. Remove the target from the battlefield. After this unit ends its move, you must set up the target unit wholly within 6" of this unit and not in combat. The target cannot use **CHARGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Thundertusks are hardy creatures capable of shovelling through huge snowdrifts, and it is not uncommon for nearby ogors to hitch a ride by grabbing on to their shaggy hides.

abilities.name: Chilling Onslaught
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks.
abilities.lore: Gales of punishing cold drive before an oncoming Thundertusk, numbing or entirely freezing enemies’ limbs.

units.lore: The Everwinter clings to the Thundertusks and follows them wherever they tread, the air around them thick with glimmering frost. Guided into battle by a pair of savage Beastriders, these mammoth beasts smash and grind their prey to bloody ruin.

units.name: Ironguts

abilities.name: Personal Enforcers
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is within the combat ranges of any friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY HEROES**, both this unit and those **HEROES** have **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Ironguts are the bodyguards and cronies of the tribe’s toughest leaders.

abilities.name: Displays of Might
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use the ‘Bull Charge’ ability even if another friendly unit has used it this turn.
abilities.lore: Ironguts love any opportunity to remind everyone watching of just how violent they can be.

units.lore: Ironguts are the meanest ogors around, the elite warriors of their warglutt. Protected by thick metal armour plates and carrying immense two-handed weapons, they wade into the thick of the fighting, hacking and bashing their foes to bloody chunks.

units.name: Frostlord on Thundertusk

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Thundertusk’s Colossal Tusks** is 2.

abilities.name: Sweeping Tusks
abilities.phase: Once per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: With a deafening bellow, the Thundertusk swings its huge frost-wreathed tusks from side to side, sending enemies flying.

abilities.name: Blessed of the Old Ice
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, the target can still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** or **RUN** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The chilling presence of a Frostlord and the freezing breath of their Thundertusk mount invigorates Beastclaw warriors.

units.lore: A Frostlord who rides to battle on a Thundertusk is a blizzard-cloaked warlord, a true herald of the Everwinter. The permanent aura of cold emanating from their mount has chilled the ogor’s very soul, leaving them a pitiless master of the frozen wastes.

units.name: Mantrapper

abilities.name: Just A Little Closer...
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.description:
Declare: If any of this unit’s **Mantrapper accomplices** are next to this unit, pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: Place 1 of this unit’s **Mantrapper accomplices** next to the target.
abilities.lore: It is the job of a Mantrapper’s pets and cronies to lure prey into the ogor’s snares.

abilities.name: Trapped!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.

Effect: Make a **trapped roll** of D6. Subtract 1 from the roll for each friendly **Mantrapper accomplice** next to the target. If the roll is less than the target’s Save characteristic, until the start of your next turn:

• Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

• The target does not have **FLY**.
abilities.lore: The jaws of an ogor trap can hobble even the most belligerent of prey.

abilities.name: Mantrapper's Accomplices
abilities.description:
Effect: This unit’s **Sabrefang**, **Gnoblars** and **Trap** are **Mantrapper accomplice** tokens. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place all its tokens next to it.

If an enemy unit is destroyed or removed from the battlefield while any of this unit’s **Mantrapper accomplices** are next to it, remove those **Mantrapper accomplices** from the battlefield.
abilities.lore: Mantrappers are accompanied by motley gaggles of gnoblars and hunting beasts.

details.notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Maw Nomad.

units.lore: Mantrappers are particularly irascible and cruel ogor hunters who see no issue with using various flesh-mangling traps or snare-launchers to even the odds with enemies. While they are committed loners, they inevitably accrue small gaggles of followers – ornery hunting beasts and bickering gnoblars – who are tolerated so long as they prove useful in setting, and serving as bait for, the ogor’s traps.

units.name: Frost Sabres

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Hunters of the Frozen Wilds
abilities.description: Effect: This unit is not visible to enemy units while it is within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The pale coats of Frost Sabres act as a natural camouflage in the bleak wilderness.

abilities.name: Gutless
abilities.description: Effect: This unit cannot use the ‘Bull Charge’ ability.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Beasts of winter, Frost Sabres bound across the landscape like shadows ghosting over the snow. Icy blood runs in their veins, and their prey seldom sees them coming until they feel the bite of the great cats’ sword-like fangs.

units.name: Morga The Mighty, Overtyrant

abilities.name: The Right Motivation
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the following effects apply:

•  While the target has not had any damage points allocated to it this phase, each time the unmodified hit roll for a combat attack that targets it is 1, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.

•  If the target has had any damage points allocated to it this phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
abilities.lore: A shrewd judge of character, Morga knows how to get the most from those she commands - even if the occasional threat is needed.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Grutta's Horn and Hooves** is 5

abilities.name: An Ogor's Ogor
abilities.description: Effect: More than 1 effect of the ‘Eat ’Em Alive’ ability can apply to this unit at the same time; however, each effect can only be applied to this unit once.
abilities.lore: Morga is a firm believer in embracing the wild heart of her race, and she makes no effort to hide her ravenous nature.

abilities.name: A Light Snack
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is automatically slain.
abilities.lore: Morga and her loyal mount Grutta will happily take a bite out of enemies mid-brawl.

abilities.name: Been There, Ate That
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

• If any enemy non-**MONSTER** models were slain by this unit’s combat attacks this turn, **Heal (D3)** this unit.

• If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **MONSTER** unit by this unit’s combat attacks this turn and that enemy **MONSTER** has been destroyed, **Heal (D3+3)** this unit.
abilities.lore: Morga has travelled across the Ghurish Hinterlands, and there is very little she has not dared to gorge herself on.

units.lore: Morga the Mighty is the Overtyrant of the Meatfist and the most fearsome ogor warlord alive. Though named the champion of the Gulping God by the Butchers, the truth is she has little interest in spiritual matters. Conquest and consumption alone enthuse this brutish matriarch, and she will use any method – be it inspirational acts of gluttony, canny promises of plunder or good-old fashioned extreme violence – to motivate her hordes to deliver it.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Ironblaster

abilities.name: Shrapnel Blast
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: For the rest of the phase:

• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s ranged weapons.
• This unit’s ranged weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)**.
abilities.lore: The gunner thrusts a few handfuls of rusty iron shards into the barrel of the cannon.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: The massive cannons known as Ironblasters must be hauled into battle by snorting rhinoxen and are unsurprisingly ill-suited to the close confines of the Ghyranite forests. Ogor gunners have instead resorted to stuffing the weapons’ gaping barrels with fistfuls of iron, ironwood splinters and whatever else they can grab, firing this lethal payload point-blank into the faces of ambushing foes.

units.name: Redd the Maw, High Slaughtermaster

weapons.name: Mawseeker Acolytes' Blades and Gorger's Claws

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Mawseeker Acolytes' Blades and Gorger's Claws** is 5.

abilities.name: From the Depths of the Cauldron
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**HERO OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: The target can immediately use the ‘Eat ’Em Alive’ ability as if it were the end of the turn and it were eligible to do so.
abilities.lore: Redd’s cauldron never seems to run dry, and the bloody broths he prepares invoke primal murder-lust in other ogors.

abilities.name: Son of the Hungering One
abilities.description:
Effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit:

•  Friendly non-**MAWSEEKERS OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY** units have **WARD (6+)**.

•  Friendly **MAWSEEKERS** units have **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Redd claims to have seen the Gulping God, and his manic fervour suggests he does not lie – a fact that inspires awe in other ogors.

abilities.name: The Maw Opens
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the target is not in combat, it can move up to D3+3" but must end that move no further from the nearest enemy unit that is visible to it. It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

If the target is in combat, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the target, then **Heal (D3)** the target. If the target is a **MAWSEEKERS** unit, instead inflict 3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with the target, then **Heal (3)** the target.
abilities.lore: As Redd guzzles down his own gory concoctions and babbles ranting invocations, other ogors nearby are overcome by a wave of insane blood-hunger unlike anything they have ever known. None endure it unchanged.

units.lore: To the ogors, Redd the Maw is a prophet – one who has been favoured to glimpse their monstrous god. To outsiders, he is a blood-caked avatar of primeval terror. Following an odyssey into deepest Shyish, Redd’s proficiency with gut magic has grown great indeed, but it is power of a base and bestial sort, for ogors who breathe in the vapours of his cauldron are overcome with a frothing, gluttonous frenzy.

units.name: Firebelly

abilities.name: Torrent of Flame
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Fire Breath** if the target is **INFANTRY**.
abilities.lore: The flames spewed by a Firebelly are perfect for incinerating packed formations of infantry.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Wandering shamans who worship Gorkamorka as the Sun-eater, Firebellies gobble up the spiciest and deadliest ingredients to stoke the flames within their gut. Should a foe stray too close, they will be incinerated by a gout of fiery breath.

units.name: Cleavers

abilities.name: A Taste for the Arcane
abilities.description:
Effect: If a friendly or enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** is within 6" of this unit, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:

• This unit’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

• If this unit’s melee weapons already have **Crit (2 Hits)**, they have **Crit (Mortal)**.
abilities.lore: The flesh of shamans and other cunning folk is a prized delicacy to the Cleavers. Simply being in the presence of those who are mystically attuned, be they friend or foe, whets their palate for carnage, seeing them lay into the enemy with terrifying vigour.

units.lore: The most numerous of the Mawseekers, Cleavers are ogor zealots who have entirely given themselves to the Gulping God and his demand for mindless, cosmic consumption. They serve the Butchers by collecting bloody ‘ingredients’ for the meat-masters’ pots, empowering their primitive magics while seeking enemy mages and invokers to feast on.

units.name: Gutseers

abilities.name: Arcane Contortions
abilities.description:
Effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for visible enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.

Add 1 to casting rolls for visible friendly **MAWSEEKERS WIZARDS** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: While not shamans themselves, the gastromantic practices of the Gutseers twist the flow of magic around them.

abilities.name: Conduits of Gut Magic
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Measure the range and visibility of the next **SPELL** ability used by a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD** that is wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit from this unit instead of that **WIZARD**. This unit is treated as the caster for the purpose of other abilities or spell effects, such as ‘Unbind’.
abilities.lore: The Gutseers’ faith and grisly acts of divination make them conduits of the gastromantic magic of the Butchers, who can channel their power through these disciples of the Maw.

units.lore: Gutseers are amongst the most unnerving acolytes of the Mawseeker cult, for they think they have perceived the infinite ravenous truth of the great god of ogorkind. Their belching chants disrupt the aether, while their bodies - bloated by the strange and vile ingredients they digest - can channel the gastromantic power of ogor shamans.

units.name: Gnoblar Scraplauncher

weapons.name: Rhinox’s Sharp Horns and Crew's Weapons

abilities.name: Rain of Scrap
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract **X**" from the target’s Move characteristic (to a minimum Move characteristic of 1"), where **X** is the number of damage points allocated to the target this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks.

Then, roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target cannot use **RUN** or **RETREAT** abilities and cannot use or be picked to be the target of abilities that would allow it to be set up on the battlefield.
abilities.lore: Salvaged weapons, shards of metal and the odd screaming gnoblar rain down upon the enemy, forcing them to take cover or dodge out of the way.

units.lore: The height of gnoblar ingenuity is the Scraplauncher, a catapult that hurls bucketfuls of sharp metal high into the air to rain down upon the enemy. Despite its crude construction, it is a surprisingly lethal war machine.

units.name: Tyrant

abilities.name: Brawlerguts
abilities.phase: Reaction: You delcared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a visible friendly non-**HERO OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Combining brutish strength with devastating bulk, the Tyrant leads other ogors into combat like the crown of an avalanche.

abilities.name: Big Name
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle. You cannot pick an effect that has already been picked for another friendly **Tyrant**.

• ***Neck-wringer***: Enemy **INFANTRY** units that have a Health characteristic of 1 or 2 cannot contest objectives while they are in combat with this unit.

• ***Steed-eater***: Enemy **CAVALRY** units cannot use **RETREAT** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

• ***Giant-wrestler***: Enemy **MONSTERS** cannot use **RAMPAGE** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: Tyrants are fond of assuming crudely grandiose titles that speak of their monstrous deeds.

details.notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a *Maw Nomad*.

units.lore: The ferocious warleaders of the Gutbuster warglutts, Tyrants are living mountains of iron and blubbery flesh. Despite their girth, they move with surprising speed, hacking their prey into bloody chunks for easier consumption.

units.name: Icefall Yhetees

abilities.name: Bounding Leaps
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: Adapted to an environment of plunging chasms and sheer cliffs, Icefall Yhetees possess long limbs with corded strength that see them close the distance to their prey in a single mighty bound.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Icefall Yhetees are savage creatures of the frozen wastelands. They appear from the howling blizzard that follows in the Beastclaw Raiders’ wake to hack apart their prey with weapons touched by magical frost.

units.name: Maneaters

abilities.name: Been There, Done That
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
abilities.lore: Having travelled the realms and eaten every conceivable foe, Maneaters just laugh off the puny tricks and magics of their enemies.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Maneaters are swaggering mercenaries who have travelled the realms and killed and eaten all manner of foes. Wielding a variety of esoteric weapons stolen from distant lands, they cut an imposing sight as they carve their way across the battlefield.

units.name: Gnoblars

abilities.name: Gutless
abilities.description: Effect: This unit cannot use the ‘Bull Charge’ ability.

abilities.name: Nasty Traps And Tricks
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: These cunning creatures specialise in fighting dirty and laying all manner of lethal and cunning traps.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Devious little creatures obsessed with scooping up scrap metal and other detritus, gnoblars perform a variety of tasks for their ogor masters, including charging into battle in a vast screeching mob.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Gnoblar Scraplauncher

weapons.name: Rhinox’s Sharp Horns and Crew's Weapons

abilities.name: Scrap Away!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Save characteristic, halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn. In addition, on a 5+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.
abilities.lore: The enemy’s manoeuvres are disrupted as a hail of scrap pummels them from above.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: Gnoblars prefer stuffing their ramshackle Scraplauncher catapults with scraps of iron and broken blades, but in Ghyran, they have learnt that shards of splintered wood, poisonous fungi and bloodwasp nests are just as lethal. They blindly lob this ammunition towards the enemy, chortling evilly when they hear the telltale screams of a barrage hitting home.

units.name: Kragnos, the End of Empires

abilities.name: Rampaging Destruction
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit charged this phase, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Roll a dice for each enemy unit within 1" of this unit. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
• Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit and roll 2D6. On a 7, this ability has no effect. Otherwise, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the results on the dice used for the 2D6 roll multiplied together. For example, a 2D6 roll of 2 and 6 would inflict 12 mortal damage (2 × 6).
abilities.lore: Kragnos rampages through the press of his foes, his hooves flattening all in his path.

abilities.name: The Shield Inviolate
abilities.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **SPELL** ability.
abilities.lore: Tuskbreaker has the power to guard Kragnos against even the most potent magical force.

abilities.name: Avatar of Destruction
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit would be automatically destroyed, it is not automatically destroyed. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
abilities.lore: Kragnos is the embodiment of Ghur’s relentless ferocity. No single strike can lay him low.

abilities.name: The End of Empires
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for friendly **DESTRUCTION** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit, to a maximum of 3.
abilities.lore: Where Kragnos goes, the hordes of Destruction follow.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **The Dread Mace** is 4 and this unit has a Control characteristic of 10.

units.lore: A roaring, trampling god of earthquakes and wanton destruction, Kragnos is known as the End of Empires. In his gnarled hands, the Dread Mace can shatter the walls of cities even as the shield Tuskbreaker keeps him all but inviolate.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Frostlord on Thundertusk

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Thundertusk’s Colossal Tusks** is 2.

abilities.name: Snow Plough
abilities.phase: Once per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities this turn even if it is in combat. If the charge roll is 2 or less when it does so, it does not count as having charged.
abilities.lore: Thundertusks are massive creatures whose broad frames and long, scooping tusks allow them to crash through snow drifts and enemy formations with equal ease.

abilities.name: Cold Fury
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability for this unit
abilities.description:
Effect: When resolving attacks as part of that ability:

• For each unmodified hit roll of 6, inflict an additional 3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with this unit instead of D3.
• For each unmodified hit roll of 1, allocate 1 mortal damage to this unit instead of D3 (ward rolls cannot be made for that damage point.
abilities.lore: The elemental energies of the Everwinter and the Realm of Fire combine within the Thundertusk to explosive effect.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: The frigid aura that emanates from a Thundertusk cannot be quelled even by the arid climes of the Aqshian deserts, and Frostlord warleaders who ride upon these mammoth-like mounts have a particular connection to the eldritch Everwinter.

units.name: Gorger Mawpack

abilities.name: Frenzied Hunters
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is **lurking on the fringes**.

Effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Overwhelmed with bloodlust, the Gorger Mawpack launch themselves from their hiding place in a futile frenzy to end their eternal hunger.

abilities.name: Troglodytic Lurkers
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up this unit in reserve **lurking on the fringes**. It has now been deployed.
abilities.lore: Gorgers are shunned and reviled creatures. When a mawtribe goes to war, they often lurk on the edge of the battlefield, waiting to strike.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: The Gorger Mawpacks are strange gatherings of ogors afflicted with the Empty Belly curse. Wild-eyed and starving, they launch themselves at their prey, using huge clubs or their bare hands to pulverise those unfortunate enough to be their next unsatisfying meal.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Huskard on Thundertusk

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Thundertusk’s Colossal Tusks** is 2.

abilities.name: Cool Tempers
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is wholly outside friendly territory and not in combat, your opponent must reduce their **fury level** by 1, to a minimum of 0.
abilities.lore: So bitterly cold is the aura that surrounds a Thundertusk that it can even extinguish the fires of rage that burn within those who fight in the Bright Realm.

abilities.name: Everwinter's Ire
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Effect: For the rest of the turn:

•  While your opponent’s **fury level** is equal to or up to 2 levels below your **fury level**, add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit.
•  While your opponent’s **fury level** is 3 or more levels below your **fury level**, add 2 to chanting rolls for this unit.
abilities.lore: As the Everwinter rages, the Huskard draws power from its icy embrace.

details.notes:
This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Voice of the Everwinter*.
This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Said to have been chosen by the Everwinter itself, a Huskard Torr always rides a Thundertusk, possessing a natural affinity with the icewreathed beast. As they journey across the Great Parch, the pair channel the magical blizzard to see the realm’s elemental fury quenched.

units.name: Grell Firefist

abilities.name: Ogor-Made Ammunition
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the phase:
•  All of this unit’s shooting attacks must target that enemy unit.
•  The Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Blastbelch** is D6+2 instead of D3+2.
abilities.lore: Anything that could even slightly be considered as ammunition is shoved into Grell’s pilfered cannon.

abilities.name: Thunderous Diversion
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit that is in combat with an enemy unit that had any damage inflicted on it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.

Effect: The target can immediately use a **RETREAT** ability as if it were your movement phase and can still use **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn. No mortal damage is inflicted on the target by that **RETREAT** ability.
abilities.lore: Ogors who have fought alongside Grell for any length of time learn to take advantage of the distraction caused by the blasting mayhem she wreaks to avoid more troublesome foes, freeing them up to pursue easier meat.

abilities.name: Oi! Pay Attention, Slobs!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: You must allocate D3 damage points to another visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit within 3" of this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points). Then, that command has no effect and still counts as having been used, but the command points spent to use it are regained by your opponent.
abilities.lore: Grell’s many mercenary adventures have taught her how to counter many tactics – though sometimes, other ogors need heavy-handed ‘encouragement’ to listen…

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Maw Nomad.*

units.lore: If there is something someone needs killing, then Grell Firefist has likely killed its kind before - and taken a bite out of it too. This veteran mercenary has travelled all over the Mortal Realms, selling her skills with her beloved cannon Blastbelch to the highest bidder. Grell keeps a fondness for her ogor kin and can usually be convinced to join a passing raid - for the right price.

units.name: Tyrant on Glutthorn

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Glutthorn’s Horn and Hooves** is 5.

abilities.name: Pitiless Warlord
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **CHARGE** ability for an **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Re-roll 1 dice in that charge roll.
abilities.lore: Anyone caught slacking under the gaze of a Tyrant is sure to regret it; better to put the effort in before they notice.

abilities.name: Glutthorn Stampede
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target is **INFANTRY**. On a 4+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Glutthorns are heavy and ponderous beasts, and when they pick up momentum on the charge, the very earth shakes at their onset. Any foes who avoid being gored or trampled in the initial impact are sent sprawling, and it takes crucial moments for them to regather themselves.

units.lore: Tyrants who really want to impress with size and status require a suitable mount, and few are seen as more suitable than the glutthorns. Bulky and bad-tempered, these beasts shake the earth with every step, snorting in simple annoyance at suffering apparently grievous wounds, while the Tyrant crushes skulls and bellows for tardy underlings to start pulling their weight.

units.name: Icebrow Hunter

abilities.name: The Hunt is On
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is **outflanking the prey**.

Effect: Set up this unit wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up each **Frost Sabres** unit that was set up **outflanking the prey** with this unit wholly within 12" of it and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Sensing the time is right, the Icebrow Hunter and their Frost Sabre companions launch their ambush.

abilities.name: Masters of Ambush
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 friendly **Frost Sabres** units if those units have not been deployed.

Effect: Set up those units in reserve **outflanking the prey**. They have now been deployed.
abilities.lore: Always on the move, Icebrow Hunters range ahead of the main ogor force alongside packs of trained Frost Sabres.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Maw Nomad*. This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: An Icebrow Hunter is a cunning stalker who utilises their surroundings to launch ambushes with the aid of their Frost Sabres. Not only do they slay opponents with spear and bolt, they also have the power to breathe a killing blizzard over their foes.

armiesOfRenown.name: The Roving Maw
armiesOfRenown.description: Where the ground itself groans with hunger and opens in undulating gullets, twisted, feral shapes slaughter errant warriors to feed to the grisly apertures. These are the Gorger Mawpacks, ogors afflicted with a terrible curse that keeps them in a permanent state of starvation. Ogor Butchers will often travel with these creatures in Roving Maws, testing new recipes upon them and opening Mawpits with gastromantic rituals.
armiesOfRenown.lore:
Where the ground itself groans with hunger and opens in undulating gullets, twisted, feral shapes slaughter errant warriors to feed to the grisly apertures. These are the Gorger Mawpacks, ogors afflicted with a terrible curse that keeps them in a permanent state of starvation. Ogor Butchers will often travel with these creatures in Roving Maws, testing new recipes upon them and opening Mawpits with gastromantic rituals.

When you pick the Ogor Mawtribes faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a The Roving Maw Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Ogor Mawtribes faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options, as described in Army of Renown: The Roving Maw. All units in your army gain the Roving Maw keyword.
armiesOfRenown.source: Army of Renown: The Roving Maw

battleTraits.name: Mawpits of Ghur
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.description:
Effect: Roll 2D6 and add the number of **tasty morsels** you have to the roll. Apply the corresponding effect below for the rest of the battle round. Then, reset your **tasty morsels** to 0.

**2-3 – *Subdued*:**
No effect.

**4-5 – *Peckish*:**
Subtract 3 from the control scores of units that are **vulnerable to Mawpits**.

**6-8 – *Rumbling*:**
Roll a dice for each unit that is **vulnerable to Mawpits**. On a 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.

**9-11 – *Famished*:**
Units that are **vulnerable to Mawpits** cannot use commands.

**12+ – *Ravenous*:**
Roll a D3 for each unit that is **vulnerable to Mawpits**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
battleTraits.lore: These highly aggressive, teeth-filled rents in the ground are drawn to the wider realms by the Butchers’ gastromantic magic.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: The Roving Maw

battleTraits.name: Driven By Starvation
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description: Effect: Friendly **Gorger Mawpack** units can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** ability in the same turn unless they are wholly within 3" of a terrain feature.
battleTraits.lore: Each offering the Head Butcher submits to the Mawpit is one fewer scrap for a ravening Gorger.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: The Roving Maw

battleTraits.name: Trampling Charge
battleTraits.phase: Any Charge Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ROVING MAW** unit that charged this turn to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
battleTraits.lore: The charge of bellowing ogors resembles a living avalanche of blubber and metal. Anything in their path is quickly squished into an edible paste.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: The Roving Maw

battleTraits.name: The Realm Hungers
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description: Effect: Units and **MANIFESTATIONS** are **vulnerable** **to Mawpits** while they are on the battlefield unless they are wholly within 1" of a terrain feature that is not a **Mawpit**. This ability has no effect on **ROVING MAW** units or units that have **FLY**.
battleTraits.lore: None can tell where hungry, chomping Mawpits will next manifest in the ground.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: The Roving Maw

battleTraits.name: Tasty Morsels
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description: Effect: Each time a model is slain by a friendly **Mawpit**’s ‘Hungry Sinkhole’ ability, you gain 1 **tasty morsel**.
battleTraits.lore: Ogors hate wasting even a scrap of meat. Any foes they do not gobble down on the spot are hacked to pieces and saved for the Butcher’s pot.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: The Roving Maw

heroicTraits.name: Prime Gutserver
heroicTraits.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
heroicTraits.description: Effect: If this unit is within 1" of a friendly **Mawpit**, gain 1 **tasty morsel**.
heroicTraits.lore: This general has fed entire armies to the Mawpits.
heroicTraits.source: Army of Renown: The Roving Maw

artefacts.name: Flasks of Congealed Maw-juices
artefacts.description: Effect: Friendly **Mawpits** within this unit’s combat range have **WARD** **(5+)**.
artefacts.lore: These vessels contains greasy, pungent fluids that squirted from a Mawpit as it gobbled down a victim. They have fortifying effects on those chomping sinkholes into which they are poured.
artefacts.source: Army of Renown: The Roving Maw
artefacts.groupName: The Roving Maw Artefact of Power

spells.name: Retcher
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ROVING MAW WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 2 to the Rend characteristic of the caster’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
spells.lore: As they cast this spell, the Butcher spews their stomach contents over their weaponry, giving their blades ‘extra bite’.

spells.name: Mawmeat
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ROVING MAW WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible terrain feature within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, units on or within 1" of the target are **vulnerable to Mawpits**. This ability has no effect on **ROVING MAW** units or units that have **FLY**.
spells.lore: Chunks of meat glistening with ichor are flung into overgrown ruins and undergrowth to attract more Mawpits to the battlefield.

terrain.name: Mawpit

abilities.name: Step Away From The Maw
abilities.description: Effect: If this terrain feature has a **Head Butcher** that was not placed on it this turn, set up the **Head Butcher** on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a **Head Butcher**.
abilities.lore: The Head Butcher descends from the platform in search of fresh meat.

abilities.name: Feed the Maw
abilities.description:
Declare: If this terrain feature does not have a **Head Butcher**, pick a friendly **Butcher** within 3" of it and not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now a **Head Butcher** (see 'Hungry Sinkhole').

If this terrain feature is demolished, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the **Head Butcher**. Then, set up the **Head Butcher** on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a **Head Butcher**. If it is not possible to set up the **Head Butcher**, it is slain.
abilities.lore: The new Head Butcher ascends the platform above the Mawpit.

abilities.name: Hungry Sinkhole
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this **Mawpit** to be a **sinkhole**. Then, you can pick another terrain feature within 12" of this **Mawpit** and that you have not already picked to be a **sinkhole** this battle to be a **sinkhole** for the rest of the turn.

Then, pick each enemy unit within 3" of the **sinkhole(s)** to be the targets.

From the second battle round onwards, increase the range at which another terrain feature can be picked to be a **sinkhole** by 3" for each previous battle round. If this terrain feature has a **Head Butcher**, increase the range at which another terrain feature can be picked to be a **sinkhole** by 6" for each previous battle round instead of 3".

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: The appearance of a Mawpit is irrefutable evidence of the Gulping God’s eagerness to feast upon the land itself, a hunger that only becomes more ravenous wherever the ogors roam.

terrain.lore: As gastromantic magic floods the battlefield, the ground itself opens hungrily in response. These Mawpits are capable only of consuming, dragging in wayward enemies to crush and digest with their many circular rows of teeth.

units.name: Maulbeast Cavalry

abilities.name: Ravenous Counter-Attack
abilities.description: Effect: Enemy units do not count as having charged while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: Maulbeasts are always hungry; they do not let foes get close without leaping to attack.

abilities.name: Shock and Gore
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks.
abilities.lore: The impact and ferocity of a Maulbeast Cavalry charge inevitably leave any survivors staggered and shaken.

units.lore: Maulbeast Cavalry are unleashed when a Gutbuster warlord wants something properly and thoroughly savaged. The brutish beasts these veterans ride upon are far from intelligent, but they are always hungry and up for the hunt. When such mountains of frenzied meat crash into the foe, the mess left behind must be seen to be believed.

units.name: Leadbelchers

abilities.name: Firing from the Belly
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: An ogor’s sturdy frame easily absorbs the recoil of even cannon-sized weapons.

abilities.name: Powder Gnoblars
abilities.description:
Effect: This unit’s **Powder Gnoblars** are tokens. There are 2 **Powder Gnoblars** for every 4 models in this unit.

Each time this unit uses a **SHOOT** ability, for each of this unit’s **Powder Gnoblars** that are on the battlefield, you can re-roll 1 hit roll of 1 but if that attack misses, remove 1 of this unit’s **Powder Gnoblars** from the battlefield after that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: When assisted by a Gnoblar minion, Leadbelchers can cause even more carnage.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: The blackpowder-obsessed gunners known as Leadbelchers lumber into battle, blasting away with their massive guns and utilising them as makeshift bludgeons should the foe be foolish enough to engage them in hand-to-hand combat.

units.name: Gluttons

abilities.name: Wall of Meat
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit if it has not charged this turn.
abilities.lore: Bulky and stubborn, Gluttons are remarkably hard to shift.

units.lore: Ogor Gluttons are hulking, muscle-bound brutes driven entirely by an unending desire for food. They thunder into battle like a landslide of sweaty flesh, taking great bites out of their foes even as they bash and hack with crude clubs and cleavers.

units.name: Slaughtermaster

abilities.name: Great Cauldron
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit’s cauldron is **filled with grisly remains**, pick a visible friendly **MAWSEEKERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: This unit’s cauldron is now **empty**. Pick 1 of the following effects:
***Bloodgruel***: The target has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.
***Spinemarrow***: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Lashed to a Slaughtermaster is a great cauldron containing the remains of foes, which the ogor gobbles down in order to unleash gastromantic powers.

abilities.name: Fill the Pot
abilities.description: Effect: This unit’s cauldron is either **filled with grisly remains** or **empty**. It starts the battle **empty**. If an enemy unit that was in combat with this unit this turn is destroyed and this unit’s cauldron is **empty**, it becomes **filled with grisly remains**.
abilities.lore: As enemies are cut down by the ogors, the Slaughtermaster collects their remains to fill his cauldron.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Slaughtermasters have entirely lost themselves to their cravings, hacking off their limbs and replacing them with rusty hooks and blades. They drag a cookpot into battle behind them so that they may boil up a tasty broth even as they slice up their prey.

units.name: Ironblaster

abilities.name: Obliterating Blast
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has not used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of it to be the target. Then, draw a straight line between the closest points on the bases of this unit and the target. Each other unit (friendly and enemy) that the line passes across is a **collateral damage target**.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on each **collateral damage target**.
abilities.lore: The sheer size of an Ironblaster means that collateral damage is effectively guaranteed – not that the ogors care.

units.lore: The most destructive blackpowder weapon deployed by the Gutbuster warglutts, the Ironblaster is an immense cannon that hurls solid shot into the heart of the enemy’s ranks, blasting foes into scraps of charred meat.

units.name: Butcher

abilities.name: Trogg-Guts
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **WARD (6+)** until the start of your next turn. If you picked a **MAWSEEKERS** unit, it has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn instead.
abilities.lore: By wolfing down the thick guts of a troggoth, a Butcher can mystically imbue fellow ogors with greater resilience. Or, sometimes, they just get indigestion.

abilities.name: More Meat for the Pot
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description: Effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit this turn by this unit’s combat attacks or by combat attacks made by a **MANIFESTATION** summoned by this unit, and that enemy unit has been destroyed, add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: The more bloody ingredients a Butcher tosses into their sacred cauldron, the more their arcane power seems to grow.

units.lore: The Gulping God speaks through the blood-smeared shamans known as Butchers. Channelling the gastromantic magic of their deity, these swollen brutes can cause the very earth to come alive and munch upon their foes.

units.name: Ironguts

abilities.name: Personal Enforcers
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is within the combat ranges of any friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY HEROES**, both this unit and those **HEROES** have **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Ironguts are the bodyguards and cronies of the tribe’s toughest leaders.

abilities.name: Displays of Might
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use the ‘Bull Charge’ ability even if another friendly unit has used it this turn.
abilities.lore: Ironguts love any opportunity to remind everyone watching of just how violent they can be.

units.lore: Ironguts are the meanest ogors around, the elite warriors of their warglutt. Protected by thick metal armour plates and carrying immense two-handed weapons, they wade into the thick of the fighting, hacking and bashing their foes to bloody chunks.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Ironblaster

abilities.name: Shrapnel Blast
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: For the rest of the phase:

• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s ranged weapons.
• This unit’s ranged weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)**.
abilities.lore: The gunner thrusts a few handfuls of rusty iron shards into the barrel of the cannon.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: The massive cannons known as Ironblasters must be hauled into battle by snorting rhinoxen and are unsurprisingly ill-suited to the close confines of the Ghyranite forests. Ogor gunners have instead resorted to stuffing the weapons’ gaping barrels with fistfuls of iron, ironwood splinters and whatever else they can grab, firing this lethal payload point-blank into the faces of ambushing foes.

units.name: Firebelly

abilities.name: Torrent of Flame
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Fire Breath** if the target is **INFANTRY**.
abilities.lore: The flames spewed by a Firebelly are perfect for incinerating packed formations of infantry.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Wandering shamans who worship Gorkamorka as the Sun-eater, Firebellies gobble up the spiciest and deadliest ingredients to stoke the flames within their gut. Should a foe stray too close, they will be incinerated by a gout of fiery breath.

units.name: Cleavers

abilities.name: A Taste for the Arcane
abilities.description:
Effect: If a friendly or enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** is within 6" of this unit, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:

• This unit’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)**.

• If this unit’s melee weapons already have **Crit (2 Hits)**, they have **Crit (Mortal)**.
abilities.lore: The flesh of shamans and other cunning folk is a prized delicacy to the Cleavers. Simply being in the presence of those who are mystically attuned, be they friend or foe, whets their palate for carnage, seeing them lay into the enemy with terrifying vigour.

units.lore: The most numerous of the Mawseekers, Cleavers are ogor zealots who have entirely given themselves to the Gulping God and his demand for mindless, cosmic consumption. They serve the Butchers by collecting bloody ‘ingredients’ for the meat-masters’ pots, empowering their primitive magics while seeking enemy mages and invokers to feast on.

units.name: Gutseers

abilities.name: Arcane Contortions
abilities.description:
Effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for visible enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.

Add 1 to casting rolls for visible friendly **MAWSEEKERS WIZARDS** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: While not shamans themselves, the gastromantic practices of the Gutseers twist the flow of magic around them.

abilities.name: Conduits of Gut Magic
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Measure the range and visibility of the next **SPELL** ability used by a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES WIZARD** that is wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit from this unit instead of that **WIZARD**. This unit is treated as the caster for the purpose of other abilities or spell effects, such as ‘Unbind’.
abilities.lore: The Gutseers’ faith and grisly acts of divination make them conduits of the gastromantic magic of the Butchers, who can channel their power through these disciples of the Maw.

units.lore: Gutseers are amongst the most unnerving acolytes of the Mawseeker cult, for they think they have perceived the infinite ravenous truth of the great god of ogorkind. Their belching chants disrupt the aether, while their bodies - bloated by the strange and vile ingredients they digest - can channel the gastromantic power of ogor shamans.

units.name: Tyrant

abilities.name: Brawlerguts
abilities.phase: Reaction: You delcared a **FIGHT** ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a visible friendly non-**HERO OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Combining brutish strength with devastating bulk, the Tyrant leads other ogors into combat like the crown of an avalanche.

abilities.name: Big Name
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle. You cannot pick an effect that has already been picked for another friendly **Tyrant**.
