units.name: Mournfang Pack

abilities.name: Alpha Cavalry
abilities.description: Effect: The **Charge (+1 Damage)** weapon ability has no effect on attacks that target this unit.
abilities.lore: Those Mournfangs that have risen to the top of the fighting pits have done so by repeatedly charging equally massive rivals head-on and coming out on top.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Ogors mounted on Mournfangs wield clubs, blades and pistols, firing point-blank into their foes before laying about them with brutal abandon. Their foultempered beasts trample and gore anything that gets in their way.

units.name: Huskard on Stonehorn

weapons.name: Chaintrap, Harpoon Launcher or Blood Vulture

abilities.name: Stone Skeleton
abilities.description: Effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.
abilities.lore: The thick, rocklike skeletons of these beasts can take substantial punishment.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stonehorn’s Rock-hard Horns and Hooves** is 4.

abilities.name: Primal Bellow
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target or pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Add 2 to the roll if this unit charged this turn. On a 4+:

•  If the target is a friendly unit, its **Companion** weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn.

•  If the target is an enemy unit, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Huskard drives their Stonehorn to unleash a mighty roar that sends nearby monsters into a frenzy.

units.lore: Many Huskard Jorls and Huskard Eurls lead their warriors from atop the backs of formidable Stonehorns. Together, the beasts and their brutish riders are master linebreakers, using their impressive strength to batter their way through all obstacles.

units.name: Bloodpelt Hunter

abilities.name: Biggest-Game Hunter
abilities.description: Effect: The Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Skullshatter Crossbow and Impaling Spear** is 4 if the target is a **MONSTER**.
abilities.lore: A Bloodpelt Hunter’s arsenal is tailored to the killing of the largest prey.

abilities.name: The First Shot's Mine
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by friendly **BEASTCLAW** units that target that enemy unit.
abilities.lore: Glory-seekers all, Bloodpelt Hunters insist on shooting first. Their example and confidence inevitably inspires other ogors to follow suit.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Maw Nomad.*

units.lore: Bloodpelt Hunters seek out the largest and most formidable creatures in battle, stalking them unseen with the guile and cunning of an alpha predator. When their quarry is within reach, they close in for the kill, maiming the creature with crude iron crossbow bolts before hacking them apart with their axe and machete.

units.name: Hunters with Sabrefangs

abilities.name: Through the Frosts
abilities.description: Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units. This unit cannot use **MOVE** abilities in the first turn of the first battle round.
abilities.lore: Despite their size, Hunters are skilled in the art of the ambush, advancing under the cover of lingering icy mists.

abilities.name: Ferocious Sabrefangs
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2 dice for each **Sabrefang** in this unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Sabrefangs are apex predators in their natural environment. Suffering no competitors, they will meet any aggression towards them with terrifying savagery.

units.lore: Hunters form the bulk of the Beastclaw alfrostuns. Each of these hardy ogors is well versed in facing down the elemental wilds and the monsters that lurk therein. They are skilled tamers and trackers, and thanks to the perpetual frosty mists that dog their steps, they can often move into position to take a satisfying crossbow shot long before the prey ever notices their presence.

units.name: Maulbeast Raiders

abilities.name: Relentless Predators
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Movement Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is more than 9" from all enemy units, it can move up to D6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
abilities.lore: Maulbeast Raiders are ever on the move, pursuing their quarry with impressive stamina and determination in even the harshest conditions.

units.lore: Where icy winds howl, packs of Maulbeast Raiders can often be found on the hunt. These Beastclaw cavalry ride brutish quadrupeds, but they choose their specific mounts for signs of low cunning as much as ferocity. The most important trait, though, is tenacity – a quality that Maulbeasts possess in abundance, allowing their riders to keep pace with their quarry and impair them with cruel, maiming crossbow shots.

units.name: Stonehorn Beastriders

weapons.name: Chaintrap, Harpoon Launcher or Blood Vulture

abilities.name: Stone Skeleton
abilities.description: Effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.
abilities.lore: The thick, rocklike skeletons of these beasts can take substantial punishment.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stonehorn’s Rock-hard Horns and Hooves** is 4.

abilities.name: Stonehorn Avalanche
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn and has not used the ‘Bull Charge’ ability this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit or an enemy faction terrain feature within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• If the target is a unit, inflict 3 mortal damage on it.
• If the target is a faction terrain feature, inflict 6 mortal damage on it.
abilities.lore: Stonehorns will headbutt mountains without flinching. Needless to say, lesser edifices and foes in the path of their charge are crushed with practical impunity.

units.lore: The ground shakes under a Stonehorn’s headlong charge, each footfall a toll of doom. From its back, a pair of Beastriders bring down foes with snapping chaintraps and harpoons, hauling in their kills to add to the mawtribe’s meat harvest.

units.name: Huskard on Thundertusk

weapons.name: Chaintrap, Harpoon Launcher or Blood Vulture

abilities.name: Freezing Aura
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Winter storms gather about this Huskard, freezing and slowing those foolish enough to remain in their presence for long.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Thundertusk’s Colossal Tusks** is 2.

abilities.name: Winter's Cruelty
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the number of damage points allocated to the target by attacks made with this unit’s **Ice Blast** this phase, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of the target’s weapons until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: A Huskard Torr can compel the Everwinter to blast cowardly foes with its full, icy disdain.

units.lore: The Huskard Torr leads the Thundertusks to war. At the ogor elder’s command, the creatures breathe out gales of frost. The ground on all sides grows thick with ice as enemies are turned into gleaming statues and the very life is leeched from their bones.

units.name: Frostlord on Stonehorn

abilities.name: Stone Skeleton
abilities.description: Effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.
abilities.lore: The thick, rocklike skeletons of these beasts can take substantial punishment.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stonehorn’s Rock-hard Horns** **and Hooves** is 4.

abilities.name: Earth-shattering Charge
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn and has not used the ‘Bull Charge’ ability this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target and then roll 2D6. This unit can move a distance in inches up to the value of the roll. It can pass through models in the target unit but must end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: Enemies are crushed and trampled beneath the unstoppable ferocity of a Frostlord upon a charging Stonehorn.

abilities.name: Enraged Roar
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is damaged, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by other friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** units while they are within this unit’s combat range.
abilities.lore: The ear-splitting enraged roar of a Stonehorn sends the beasts of the Mawpath into a frenzy.

units.lore: A Frostlord and their Stonehorn are an unstoppable force. The warlord’s booming voice directs the raiders while the bodies of foes are broken and ground to a bloody paste by the horns and hooves of their granite-boned steed.

units.name: Thundertusk Beastriders

weapons.name: Chaintrap, Harpoon Launcher or Blood Vulture

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Thundertusk’s Colossal Tusks** is 2.

abilities.name: Plough the Icepath
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a non-**CHARGE MOVE** ability for this unit in your movement phase
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES INFANTRY** unit that has not been reinforced, is wholly within 6" of this unit and has not been set up this turn to be the target. Remove the target from the battlefield. After this unit ends its move, you must set up the target unit wholly within 6" of this unit and not in combat. The target cannot use **CHARGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Thundertusks are hardy creatures capable of shovelling through huge snowdrifts, and it is not uncommon for nearby ogors to hitch a ride by grabbing on to their shaggy hides.

abilities.name: Chilling Onslaught
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks.
abilities.lore: Gales of punishing cold drive before an oncoming Thundertusk, numbing or entirely freezing enemies’ limbs.

units.lore: The Everwinter clings to the Thundertusks and follows them wherever they tread, the air around them thick with glimmering frost. Guided into battle by a pair of savage Beastriders, these mammoth beasts smash and grind their prey to bloody ruin.

units.name: Frostlord on Thundertusk

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Thundertusk’s Colossal Tusks** is 2.

abilities.name: Sweeping Tusks
abilities.phase: Once per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: With a deafening bellow, the Thundertusk swings its huge frost-wreathed tusks from side to side, sending enemies flying.

abilities.name: Blessed of the Old Ice
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **OGOR MAWTRIBES** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, the target can still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** or **RUN** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The chilling presence of a Frostlord and the freezing breath of their Thundertusk mount invigorates Beastclaw warriors.

units.lore: A Frostlord who rides to battle on a Thundertusk is a blizzard-cloaked warlord, a true herald of the Everwinter. The permanent aura of cold emanating from their mount has chilled the ogor’s very soul, leaving them a pitiless master of the frozen wastes.

units.name: Mantrapper

abilities.name: Just A Little Closer...
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.description:
Declare: If any of this unit’s **Mantrapper accomplices** are next to this unit, pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: Place 1 of this unit’s **Mantrapper accomplices** next to the target.
abilities.lore: It is the job of a Mantrapper’s pets and cronies to lure prey into the ogor’s snares.

abilities.name: Trapped!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.

Effect: Make a **trapped roll** of D6. Subtract 1 from the roll for each friendly **Mantrapper accomplice** next to the target. If the roll is less than the target’s Save characteristic, until the start of your next turn:

• Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

• The target does not have **FLY**.
abilities.lore: The jaws of an ogor trap can hobble even the most belligerent of prey.

abilities.name: Mantrapper's Accomplices
abilities.description:
Effect: This unit’s **Sabrefang**, **Gnoblars** and **Trap** are **Mantrapper accomplice** tokens. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place all its tokens next to it.

If an enemy unit is destroyed or removed from the battlefield while any of this unit’s **Mantrapper accomplices** are next to it, remove those **Mantrapper accomplices** from the battlefield.
abilities.lore: Mantrappers are accompanied by motley gaggles of gnoblars and hunting beasts.

details.notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a Maw Nomad.

units.lore: Mantrappers are particularly irascible and cruel ogor hunters who see no issue with using various flesh-mangling traps or snare-launchers to even the odds with enemies. While they are committed loners, they inevitably accrue small gaggles of followers – ornery hunting beasts and bickering gnoblars – who are tolerated so long as they prove useful in setting, and serving as bait for, the ogor’s traps.

units.name: Frost Sabres

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Hunters of the Frozen Wilds
abilities.description: Effect: This unit is not visible to enemy units while it is within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The pale coats of Frost Sabres act as a natural camouflage in the bleak wilderness.

abilities.name: Gutless
abilities.description: Effect: This unit cannot use the ‘Bull Charge’ ability.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Beasts of winter, Frost Sabres bound across the landscape like shadows ghosting over the snow. Icy blood runs in their veins, and their prey seldom sees them coming until they feel the bite of the great cats’ sword-like fangs.

units.name: Icefall Yhetees

abilities.name: Bounding Leaps
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can move up to 3". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: Adapted to an environment of plunging chasms and sheer cliffs, Icefall Yhetees possess long limbs with corded strength that see them close the distance to their prey in a single mighty bound.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Icefall Yhetees are savage creatures of the frozen wastelands. They appear from the howling blizzard that follows in the Beastclaw Raiders’ wake to hack apart their prey with weapons touched by magical frost.

units.name: Icebrow Hunter

abilities.name: The Hunt is On
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is **outflanking the prey**.

Effect: Set up this unit wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up each **Frost Sabres** unit that was set up **outflanking the prey** with this unit wholly within 12" of it and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Sensing the time is right, the Icebrow Hunter and their Frost Sabre companions launch their ambush.

abilities.name: Masters of Ambush
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 friendly **Frost Sabres** units if those units have not been deployed.

Effect: Set up those units in reserve **outflanking the prey**. They have now been deployed.
abilities.lore: Always on the move, Icebrow Hunters range ahead of the main ogor force alongside packs of trained Frost Sabres.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Maw Nomad*. This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: An Icebrow Hunter is a cunning stalker who utilises their surroundings to launch ambushes with the aid of their Frost Sabres. Not only do they slay opponents with spear and bolt, they also have the power to breathe a killing blizzard over their foes.

battleTraits.name: Endless Growth
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **SYLVANETH** unit that is wholly within the creeping overgrowth to be the targets.

Effect: For each target, roll a D3 and pick 1 of the following effects:

• **HEAL (X)** the target, where **X** is equal to the roll.
• Return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to the value of the roll.
battleTraits.lore: As the land itself is roused to wrath, life energies bloom and surge, filling the Sylvaneth with renewed vigour.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Sylvaneth armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Creeping Dread
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within the **creeping overgrowth** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time your opponent declares a command for the target while it is not wholly within 12" of a **HERO** in their army, unless your opponent spends 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as being used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.
battleTraits.lore: The creaking of the trees and the oppressive hum of the spirit-song in their subconscious makes the enemy jumpy and distracted, causing them to hesitate and second- guess orders in the absence of clear leadership.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Sylvaneth armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: The Land Awakens
battleTraits.phase: End of Your Turn
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO REVENANT INFANTRY** unit or friendly **DRYADS** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
battleTraits.lore: The spirit-song thrums with strident aggression and the shrill lamentations of the fallen, rousing dormant forest spirits in the vicinity and drawing them to battle.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Sylvaneth armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Fury of the Forest
battleTraits.phase: Enemy Combat Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** and that is in combat with only 1 enemy unit to use this ability.

Effect: The unit using this ability has **STRIKE‑FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
battleTraits.lore: The Sylvaneth are overcome with rage at the presence of interlopers in their sacred forest homes.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Sylvaneth armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Reclaimed by Nature
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.description: Effect: If there are fewer than 3 friendly **Awakened Wyldwoods** on the battlefield, you can set up an **Awakened Wyldwood** on the battlefield more than 3" from all objectives and enemy units, more than 12" from all other friendly **Awakened Wyldwoods** and more than 1" from all other terrain features.
battleTraits.lore: In twisting profusions of unfurling branches, shivering leaves and billowing pollen, trees that would normally take many cycles to reach maturity attain their full, bountiful potential in mere moments.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Sylvaneth armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: The Creeping Overgrowth
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description:
Effect: The **creeping overgrowth** is measured from each terrain feature that has a friendly overgrown token. The range of the **creeping overgrowth** is based on the number of friendly **overgrown tokens** on the battlefield as shown:

Overgrown Tokens - Creeping Overgrowth Range
0-2 - 6"
3-5 - 9"
6-8 - 12"
9+ - Whole battlefield

**Designer’s Note:** *Awakened Wyldwoods are your main way of generating overgrown tokens. Some unit abilities allow you to do so too.*
battleTraits.lore: As children of Ghyran, the Sylvaneth are redolent with the energies of life, which cause the ambient flora to rapidly grow and spread.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Sylvaneth armies can use the following abilities:

ability.name: Memories of the Fallen
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: For each friendly **SYLVANETH** unit or friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** that was destroyed in the previous turn, you can pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit to be a target.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: As the spirit-song resounds with the memories of the recently slain, the Sylvaneth are driven to a vengeful fury.

abilities.name: Memories of the Fallen
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: For each friendly **SYLVANETH** unit or friendly **Awakened Wyldwood** that was destroyed in the previous turn, you can pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit to be a target.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of each target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: As the spirit-song resounds with the memories of the recently slain, the Sylvaneth are driven to a vengeful fury.

ability.name: Nature's Titans
ability.description: Effect: When using the ‘Endless Growth’ ability, do not roll a D3 for **MONSTER** targets. Instead, **Heal (3)** each of those targets.
ability.lore: The eldest beings of the glades are so saturated with the life-giving magic of Ghyran that their wounds swiftly gum up with sticky sap and seal over with knotted barkflesh.

abilities.name: Nature's Titans
abilities.description: Effect: When using the ‘Endless Growth’ ability, do not roll a D3 for **MONSTER** targets. Instead, **Heal (3)** each of those targets.
abilities.lore: The eldest beings of the glades are so saturated with the life-giving magic of Ghyran that their wounds swiftly gum up with sticky sap and seal over with knotted barkflesh.

ability.name: Fear of the Deepwoods
ability.description: Effect: In the ‘Creeping Dread’ ability, replace ‘while it is not wholly within 12" of a **HERO** in their army’ with ‘while it is not wholly within 6" of a **HERO** in their army’.
ability.lore: The flitting shadows of lurking spites and the cruel laughter of these malicious Sylvaneth instil paranoia in the enemy; clearly they are not welcome in this place.

abilities.name: Fear of the Deepwoods
abilities.description: Effect: In the ‘Creeping Dread’ ability, replace ‘while it is not wholly within 12" of a **HERO** in their army’ with ‘while it is not wholly within 6" of a **HERO** in their army’.
abilities.lore: The flitting shadows of lurking spites and the cruel laughter of these malicious Sylvaneth instil paranoia in the enemy; clearly they are not welcome in this place.

ability.name: Sacred Quarry
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks while it is wholly within 12" of the enemy general or an enemy **WARMASTER**.
ability.lore: There can be no hunt without a quarry. Once the followers of Kurnoth have marked the enemy’s commander, they will stop at nothing until its blood stains their spears and claws.

abilities.name: Sacred Quarry
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks while it is wholly within 12" of the enemy general or an enemy **WARMASTER**.
abilities.lore: There can be no hunt without a quarry. Once the followers of Kurnoth have marked the enemy’s commander, they will stop at nothing until its blood stains their spears and claws.

heroicTraits.name: Spellsinger
heroicTraits.description:
Effect: If this unit is a **WIZARD**, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.

If this unit is not a **WIZARD**, it can use the ‘Unbind’ ability as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.
heroicTraits.lore: The magical motes of the realms are drawn to this champion like pollinating insects, enhancing their arcane aptitude.

heroicTraits.name: Spirit of the Dark Forest
heroicTraits.phase: Once Per Battle, Enemy Hero Phase
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** to be the target.

Effect: Halve the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.
heroicTraits.lore: This Sylvaneth’s grim aspect strikes atavistic terror into those who meet its gaze.

heroicTraits.name: Realmroot Guide
heroicTraits.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**. Pick this unit and up to 1 other friendly **SYLVANETH** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.

Effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
heroicTraits.lore: The spirit paths offer swift egress to this realms-wise Sylvaneth, who has an intricate knowledge of their wending ways.

artefacts.name: Seed of Rebirth
artefacts.description: Effect: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (D3)** this unit.
artefacts.lore: Should the bearer of this seed ever fall, its rejuvenating energies will grant them new life.

artefacts.name: Wychwood Glaive
artefacts.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it by this unit’s combat attacks this turn to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the battle. This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed.
artefacts.lore: The blade of this polearm, which glows dully with the bleak white- grey of a snow-laden sky, inflicts a bone-deep chill on those it does not slay outright.

artefacts.name: Amberglade Nectar
artefacts.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
artefacts.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of **Companion** weapons used by friendly **SYLVANETH** units for attacks that target that enemy unit.
artefacts.lore: Collected from the fearsome elder trees of Ghur, the scent of this sticky sap sends spites into a feral frenzy.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Dancing Mystflies
aqshyArtefacts.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a **SPELL** ability for an unit within 30" of this unit
aqshyArtefacts.description:
Effect: • If this unit is not a **WIZARD**, it can use the
'Unbind' ability as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.
Otherwise, it can use the 'Unbind' ability an additional time each phase.

• If this unit successfully unbinds the spell being reacted to and the caster is within the **creeping overgrowth**, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the caster equal to the difference between the casting roll and the unbinding roll, to a maximum of 6.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: Their abdomens aglow with jade magic, these spites flutter across the battlefield, intercepting and absorbing arcane outbursts. In areas redolent with life energies, they have power enough to twist these captured spells and fire them back at the caster.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Amulet of Resonance
aqshyArtefacts.description: Effect: If this unit used the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability this turn or you spent **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability when resolving the damage sequence for this unit this turn, give 1 ritual point to each visible friendly **SYLVANETH PRIEST** wholly within 12" of this unit.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: This charm serves to amplify the spirit-song, ensuring it cuts through even the most furious tumult of battle.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Glamourweave
aqshyArtefacts.description: Effect: Each phase, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll and 1 save roll for this unit.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: The Glamourweave’s illusory enchantments both enhance the wearer’s forest camouflage and conceal their strikes when battle is joined.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Aspect of Ironbark
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Effect: When resolving the damage sequence for this unit, if you spend **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability, you can re-roll any of the dice that determine whether damage points are removed from this unit’s damage pool.

After the damage sequence has been resolved, if you rolled a total of 10+ on those re-rolls, this ability has no effect for the rest of the battle
aqshyEnhancements.lore: These Sylvaneth can rapidly draw forth minerals from the earth in order to grant their barkflesh greater durability.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: Aspects of the Deepwoods are unique enhancements that can only be given to non-**HERO** non-**MONSTER** **SYLVANETH** units. A unit can only have 1 Aspect of the Deepwoods.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Aspect of Heartwood
aqshyEnhancements.phase: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared the ‘Endless Growth’ ability
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Effect: If this unit is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth**, for each target of that ability that is wholly within 12" of this unit, you can pick 1 of the following effects:

•  When resolving that ability, roll a D6 for the target instead of a D3. If, as a result of another ability, you would **Heal (3)** the target instead of rolling a dice, **Heal (6)** the target instead.
•  If the target is **KURNOTHI**, instead of rolling a D3 and picking 1 of the effects of that ability to apply to it, you can return 1 slain model to the target unit.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: Brave and true, these warriors are loyal to all Sylvaneth, regardless of glade, and seek to aid them however they can.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: Aspects of the Deepwoods are unique enhancements that can only be given to non-**HERO** non-**MONSTER** **SYLVANETH** units. A unit can only have 1 Aspect of the Deepwoods.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Aspect of Harvestboon
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: Add 2" to this unit’s Move characteristic while it is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth.**
aqshyEnhancements.lore: These forest spirits are possessed of a youthful energy and vibrant enthusiasm.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: Aspects of the Deepwoods are unique enhancements that can only be given to non-**HERO** non-**MONSTER** **SYLVANETH** units. A unit can only have 1 Aspect of the Deepwoods.

spells.name: Grasping Roots
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:

• The target cannot use **RUN** abilities.
• Subtract 1 from charge rolls for the target.
spells.lore: The caster commands the undergrowth to bind and slow the enemy.

spells.name: Zephyrspite Rush
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **SYLVANETH** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.
spells.lore: The caster calls on a swarm of zephyrspites to carry their allies swiftly into battle.

spells.name: Jade Thorns
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **SYLVANETH** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn, including attacks made with **Companion** weapons.
spells.lore: The caster enhances the blades and claws of the Sylvaneth and their spite companions with spectral thorns that rake flesh and cause horrific ragged wounds.

prayers.name: Song of War
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit that is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to them and wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target(s) melee weapons.
prayers.lore: The spirit-song becomes an angry, staccato beat that awakens something primal in the Sylvaneth, seeing them crush bones and twist steel with the latent strength in their barkflesh.

prayers.name: Song of Dread
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick an enemy unit that is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to them and within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, each time a target uses a **MOVE** ability and ends that move within the **creeping overgrowth**, inflict D3 mortal damage on that target after that **MOVE** ability has been resolved.
prayers.lore: Discordant notes and eerie wails herald a sinister change in the spirit-song, causing the shadows to gather thick around a group of foes. It takes but a single misstep to discover what lurks within the dark…

prayers.name: Song of the Lost
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SYLVANETH PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **SYLVANETH** unit that is wholly within the **creeping overgrowth** or that is visible to them and wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit. In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, pick 1 of the following effects:
• You can **Heal (3)** the target.
• If the target is not a **MONSTER**, ignore modifiers to save rolls for the target (positive and negative) until the start of your next turn.
prayers.lore: The chanter alters the spirit-song to remind the Sylvaneth of the fallen, inspiring them with heroic resolve.

manifestations.name: Spiteswarm Hive

abilities.name: Anger the Hive
abilities.description: Effect: If this **MANIFESTATION** was not set up this turn, add 10 to the Attacks characteristic of this **MANIFESTATION**’s ranged weapons for the rest of the phase, but all of the shooting attacks it makes this phase must target an enemy unit within 9" of it.
abilities.lore: As enemies draw closer to the hive, the spites attack with heightened ferocity to protect their home.

manifestations.lore: With a humming chant, those versed in the magic of Ghyran can summon a Spiteswarm Hive. As enemies cautiously approach the comb, the air thrums angrily before the inhabiting spites buzz forth, their swarms swirling around the foe, crawling between gaps in armour to burrow into eyes, chew through jugulars and clog screaming throats.

summonSpell.name: Summon Spiteswarm Hive
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Spiteswarm Hive** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SYLVANETH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Spiteswarm Hive** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
summonSpell.lore: The air is filled with the buzzing of a thousand wings as a swarm of iridescent insects bursts from its hive.

manifestations.name: Vengeful Skullroot

abilities.name: Vengeful Terrors
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION**.
abilities.lore: Wherever this rogue spirit drifts, creeping ominously through the air, its roots churn open the shallow graves of battles past, dragging grotesque remains to the surface that chill the hearts of the forest’s foes.

manifestations.lore: Also known as the Drifting Death or the Creeping Willow, the Vengeful Skullroot is a manifestation of a forest’s fury. Black-hearted and hateful, these arcane plants can be summoned by Sylvaneth versed in magic. As the tree stalks across the battlefield, its tentacle-like roots bludgeon, crush and strangle all they pass over.

summonSpell.name: Summon Vengeful Skullroot
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **VENGEFUL SKULLROOT** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SYLVANETH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Vengeful Skullroot** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: From the shadows comes a nightmarish form: the wretched husk of a tortured tree, the skeletal remains of past victims tangled among its writhing root mass.

manifestations.name: Gladewyrm

abilities.name: Eldritch Hunters
abilities.description: Effect: If this **MANIFESTATION** is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy non-**WIZARD** non-**PRIEST** units and more than 3" from all enemy **WIZARDS** and enemy **PRIESTS**.
abilities.lore: Gladewyrms are magical creatures, and their prey of choice is similarly arcane in nature. During battle, they burrow beneath the surface, reemerging to devour spellcasters and other mystics, whom they sense with greater clarity than other beings.

abilities.name: Feed on Eldritch Energy
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls, unbinding rolls, chanting rolls and banishment rolls for enemy units while they are in combat with this **Manifestation**.
abilities.lore: As predators of preternatural threats, Gladewyrms readily devour the energies that the enemy draws upon to fuel their spells and rituals.

manifestations.lore: Gladewyrms are ferocious subterranean creatures formed from concentrated life magic, used by the Sylvaneth to protect the realmroots from eldritch invaders. When called upon, they leave their patrols along the spirit paths and erupt from the earth to aid their summoners.

summonSpell.name: Summon Gladewyrm
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Gladewyrm** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SYLVANETH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Gladewyrm** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: The earth splits apart as a huge serpentine form heaves itself free of the earth, its eyes blazing with jade energy.
