details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Armed with fast-firing repeater crossbows, formations of Darkshards unleash a withering hail of iron-tipped bolts into their enemies, each volley piercing eyes and puncturing hearts.

units.name: Dreadspears

abilities.name: Coven Guard
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit did not charge this turn, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: These warriors are trained to wait for the perfect moment before thrusting their spears into the hearts of their foes.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Dreadspear shieldwalls form the armoured core of the Darkling Covens’ armies. Fully enthralled to the service of their masters, these cruel warriors fight and slay with unnerving focus.

units.name: Assassin

abilities.name: Hidden Murderer
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **INFANTRY** unit that has 5 or more models and there are no enemy units within this unit’s combat range, this unit is not visible to enemy units.
abilities.lore: Stalking the shadows, the Assassin only reveals their position when they launch a killing strike.

abilities.name: In For The Kill
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** if it charged in the same turn.
abilities.lore: With their target in sight, the Assassin bursts from the shadows and unleashes a flurry of attacks upon the unsuspecting victim.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: T here is no fortress, city or fortified war camp that the feared Shadowblade Assassins cannot infiltrate, and few foes can hope to survive the potent poisons delivered by their wicked daggers.

units.name: Sorceress on Black Dragon

abilities.name: Dark Sorcery
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for each **dark sorcery token** it has.
abilities.lore: The Sorceress draws power from the blood spilled by her Black Dragon.

abilities.name: Command Underlings
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR AELF INFANTRY** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be targets.

Effect: Add 3" to the Move characteristic of each target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The cold-hearted rulers of the Darkling Covens wield absolute control over their ensorcelled underlings, commanding them to do their bidding unquestioningly.

abilities.name: Feed on Life Force
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If any enemy models are slain by this ability, place a **dark** **sorcery** token next to this unit for the rest of the battle, to a maximum of 3 tokens.
abilities.lore: The Black Dragon tears into the enemy, spilling copious blood as the Sorceress completes her dark ritual.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Black Dragon’s Claws** is 4.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Many Sorceresses go to war upon fearsome Black Dragons, delighting in the terror in the eyes of their enemies as the scaled beasts spit clouds of choking fumes and rip their prey apart with sword-sized talons.

units.name: Hammerers

abilities.name: Oathsworn
abilities.description: Effect: While any friendly **Warden Kings** are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly **Warden Kings** have **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: These warriors are oathsworn to protect their liege.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Hammerers are traditionally tasked with guarding the Warden Kings in battle. The rhythmic rise and fall of their gromril mauls instils fear in their enemies just as it lifts the spirits of their fellow duardin.

units.name: Black Guard

abilities.name: Steel and Sorcery
abilities.description: Effect: While any friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR AELF INFANTRY HEROES** are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Black Guard are often charged with protecting heroes on the field of battle.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: These fanatical warriors guard the rulers of the Darkling Covens. Armed with ebon halberds and clad in ensorcelled plate, they present an impassable and deadly obstacle to any who threaten their wards.

units.name: Steam Tank

abilities.name: More Pressure!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll is less than the number of damage points this unit has, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit. Otherwise, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to this unit until the start of your next turn:

***Power the Wheels:*** This unit can use a **RUN** ability and still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

***Power the Guns:*** Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Steam Gun**.
abilities.lore: Pumping pressure into the valves and pistons of a Steam Tank can improve its performance – but risks a catastrophic backfire.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Clanking monstrosities of steel and iron, Steam Tanks rattle across the battlefield, blasting away at targets with their cannons and steam-spewing guns while grinding yet more to paste beneath their metal-clad wheels.

units.name: Bleakswords

abilities.name: Merciless Conquerors
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while it is contesting an objective you do not control.
abilities.lore: While the Dreadspears hold the line, the Bleakswords are tasked with seizing objectives, viciously cutting down any opponents in a storm of flashing steel.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Bleakswords leap into the fray in a blur of flashing steel. Wielding their duelling swords with unnatural grace, they slice their foes to ribbons with an unstoppable flurry of strikes.

units.name: Freeguild Steelhelms

abilities.name: Steel of Helm and Heart
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has 5 or more models, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: If this unit is **under orders**, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. Subtract 1 from the roll if the target is a **MONSTER**. On a 4+, apply the effect below.

For the rest of the turn, if this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability:
• This unit must be picked to be the target of pile-in moves made by the target.
• All attacks made by models in the target unit within this unit’s combat range must target this unit.
abilities.lore: The Steelhelms force enemy attention on themselves in a heroic effort to blunt attacks on their allies.

units.lore: While the rank and file of the Freeguilds are often individually outmatched by the myriad threats they face in their mission to retake the realms, they have three things on their side: discipline, gutsy determination and their faith in Sigmar.

units.name: Freeguild Grenadiers

abilities.name: Cinders and Ashes
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit contains a **Cindergout**, pick a terrain feature or objective contested by this unit, then pick any enemy units contesting that terrain feature or objective to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Freeguild Grenadiers carry specialised gear that allows them to reduce a dug-in enemy to a panicked, screaming bonfire of melting flesh and charred hair.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced

units.lore: Experts in close-quarters combat, the Freeguild Grenadiers are always the first into the breach. Outfitted with the finest blackpowder weapons, flame-hurlers and deadly polearms, they rely on overwhelming force to reduce their enemies to charred corpses and smouldering piles of ash.

units.name: Freeguild Command Corps Adjutants

abilities.name: Freeguild Adjutants
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SIGMARITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders** to be the target.

Effect: If this unit is in combat, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

Add 5 to the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The adjutants’ trumpets and bellowed speeches are a clarion call to victory for hard-pressed Freeguilders.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: A Freeguild officer's adjutants stand ready to assist them in their martial duties. Arch-Knights employ years of hard-won experience and ruthless skill to ensure that no foe gets within a dozen yards of their superior, while Great Heralds and Mascot Gargoylians embody the fighting spirit of the regiment, encouraging the rank and file to victory in Sigmar's name.

units.name: Battlemage on Celestial Hurricanum

abilities.name: Storm of Shemtek
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Make a number of D3 rolls equal to the current battle round number. For each 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: A Celestial Hurricanum can summon a magical storm to batter the foe with the fury of the heavens. As the battle rages, the tempest grows ever stronger.

abilities.name: Portents of Battle
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Celestial Hurricanums leak magical energy, granting nearby soldiers visions of the imminent future that allow them to land their blows with uncanny accuracy.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Celestial Battlemages harness the cosmic power of High Azyr to bring down storms and send arcs of lightning cascading through the ranks of the enemy, unleashing raw elemental power that is terrible to witness.

units.name: Executioners

abilities.name: Severing Strike
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, this unit’s melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)**.
abilities.lore: Heads roll and crimson arcs of hot blood spurt into the air as these warriors swing their deadly blades.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: T hese skull-masked killers are the most feared warriors of the Darkling Covens. True virtuosos of slaughter, they have mastered the art of severing heads with every swing of their curved Executioner’s draichs.

units.name: Battlemage

abilities.name: Protective Focus
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a **SPELL** ability that this unit can use. For the rest of the battle, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit if it miscasts that spell.
abilities.lore: Such is this Battlemage’s unwavering concentration on one facet of their arcane arsenal that it renders them immune to the adverse effects of spellcasting.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Masters of the arcane arts, the grizzled Battlemages of the Collegiate Arcane summon lethal storms of magic to lay waste to their foes and shield their comrades from harm with protective enchantment.

armiesOfRenown.name: The Iron March
armiesOfRenown.description: Cannons roar and the gun-studded walking castles known as Cogforts lumber forwards, their every step an earthquake and their every barrage gouging gaping holes in the enemy line. Once, these engines of war were used to anchor the ever-expanding borders of Sigmar’s empire. Now First Marshal Tahlia Vedra has ordered them forward en masse, risking her most precious assets to blunt the enemy’s surge and throw them back. Such bold actions might be humanity’s only chance to snatch triumph from the precipice of catastrophe.
armiesOfRenown.lore:
Cannons roar and the gun-studded walking castles known as Cogforts lumber forwards, their every step an earthquake and their every barrage gouging gaping holes in the enemy line. Once, these engines of war were used to anchor the ever-expanding borders of Sigmar’s empire. Now First Marshal Tahlia Vedra has ordered them forward en masse, risking her most precious assets to blunt the enemy’s surge and throw them back. Such bold actions might be humanity’s only chance to snatch triumph from the precipice of catastrophe.

When you pick the Cities of Sigmar faction for your army, you can choose for it to be the Iron March Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Cities of Sigmar faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed as described in Army of Renown: The Iron March. All units in your army gain the **IRON MARCH** keyword.
armiesOfRenown.source: Army of Renown: The Iron March

battleTraits.name: Form Up, Iron March!
battleTraits.phase: Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRON MARCH** unit to use this ability, then pick either 1 or 2 other visible friendly **IRON MARCH** units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.

The unit using this ability and the targets:

• cannot be **under orders**.
• must each be a different unit type.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are **under orders**.

**Designer’s Note:** *‘Unit type’ refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. ‘Cannonade Cogfort’ or ‘Mallus Forgepriest’.*
battleTraits.lore: Once the order is given, Cogforts and infantry alike link up to form a fortress of flesh and steel that little can stand against.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: The Iron March

prayers.name: The Chant of Iron
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IRON MARCH PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick either a visible enemy unit within 18" of them or a visible friendly **IRON MARCH** unit that is wholly within 12" of them and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If you picked an enemy unit:

• If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible enemy unit to be a second target.
•Subtract 2" from each target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.

If you picked a friendly unit, **Heal (D3)** the target and the chanter. If the chanting roll was 8+, **Heal (D3)** each visible friendly **IRON MARCH** unit that is wholly 12" of the chanter and that has not been healed by this ability this turn instead.
prayers.lore: The alliance between Grungni the Maker and Sigmar the God-King is writ large upon the priest’s brow as divine creation and celestial wrath combine.

units.name: Conqueror Cogfort

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
• The Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Iron Feet** is 3.
• It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: All Aboard!
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 1 friendly **SIGMARITE INFANTRY HERO** and up to 1 friendly non-**HERO SIGMARITE INFANTRY** unit that have not been deployed.

Effect: Set up those units in reserve as this unit’s **passengers**. They have now been deployed.
abilities.lore: The warriors clamber aboard the Conqueror Cogfort and ready themselves for battle.

abilities.name: Full Charge!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 or more of the following effects. For each effect you pick, give this unit a number of **heat tokens** equal to the number beside it.

***1 Breaching Assist!:*** If this unit uses the ‘Sally Forth’ ability this turn, melee weapons used by the targets of that ability have **Charge (+1 Damage)** for the rest of the turn.

***2 Full Throttle!:*** For the rest of the turn, this unit’s Move characteristic is 10".

***3 Repel Boarders!:*** For the rest of the turn, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Crew’s Leadshotters** and **Crushing Iron Feet**.

***4 Disengage Safeties!:*** For the rest of the turn, the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Realmscorcher Flame Cannon** is 22.

***6 Get Us Out of Here!:*** For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The Cogsmith kicks the arco-combustor into high gear, causing the Cogfort to surge forwards and allowing the crew to obliterate the enemy.

abilities.name: Sally Forth
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has not used a **RUN** ability this turn, pick this unit’s **passengers** to be the targets.

Effect: Set up each target wholly within 6" of this unit and either not in combat or within ½" of an enemy unit. If a target is set up in combat, it has charged. Then, if this unit is not **under orders**, this unit and the targets are **under orders** for the rest of the battle round.
abilities.lore: The warriors aboard the Conqueror Cogfort hurl themselves into battle.

abilities.name: Overheating
abilities.description: Effect: Immediately after resolving this unit’s ‘Full Charge!’ ability, you must roll a number of dice equal to the number of **heat tokens** this unit has. For each 5+, allocate 1 damage point to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points), then remove 1 of this unit’s **heat tokens**.
abilities.lore: If pushed too hard, a Cogfort’s arco‑combustor can overheat and cause serious damage.

regimentOptions: Any ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES

units.lore: The Conqueror Cogfort exchanges a conventional main gun for a realmscorcher flame cannon: a truly terrifying weapon that swathes the battlefield in sheets of flesh- melting fire. Outfitted with an underbelly transport cage, the Conqueror is typically used in an assault role, delivering troops right into the heart of the enemy’s battleline.

units.name: Freeguild Gallants

abilities.name: Break Them Upon the Walls
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is **under orders**, the melee weapons of other visible friendly **SIGMARITE** units, excluding **Freeguild Gallants** units, have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The sight of Freeguild Gallants bringing wrath and ruin to enemy attackers rouses their fellows to bloody deeds.

abilities.name: Not One Step Back
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has not charged this turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic and Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.
abilities.lore: The elite infantry of the Cities of Sigmar lead defensive positions against all manner of terrible foes.

units.lore: Freeguild Gallants are knightly champions who prefer to fight on foot. They favour one-handed weapons and broad shields, intercepting enemy charges with stoic resolve and then slowly driving the foe back with their superior bladecraft. Their skill and dash is an example to all nearby Sigmarite troops.

units.name: Cannonade Cogfort

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
• The Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Iron Feet** is 3.
• It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: Full Power!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 or more of the following effects. For each effect you pick, give this unit a number of **heat tokens** equal to the number beside it.

***1 Launch Countermeasures!:*** Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target other friendly **SIGMARITE** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and are **under orders**.

***2 Full Throttle!:*** For the rest of the turn, this unit’s Move characteristic is 10".

***3 Calculate Firing Solution!:*** For the rest of the turn, each time this unit uses a **SHOOT** ability, you can re‑roll 1 hit roll and 1 wound roll for shooting attacks made with this unit’s **Godbreaker Cannon**.

***6 Get Us Out of Here!:*** For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The Castellan-Captain orders their crew to push the Cannonade Cogfort to its absolute limits.

abilities.name: Overheating
abilities.description: Effect: Immediately after resolving this unit’s ‘Full Power!’ ability, you must roll a number of dice equal to the number of **heat tokens** this unit has. For each 5+, allocate 1 damage point to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points), then remove 1 of this unit’s **heat tokens**.
abilities.lore: If pushed too hard, a Cogfort’s arco‑combustor can overheat and cause serious damage.

abilities.name: Special Ammunition
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for this unit
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit is **under orders**, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects.

***Nullshot:*** Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by attacks made with this unit’s **Godbreaker Cannon** this phase.

***Heavy Shot:*** Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Godbreaker Cannon** this phase.

***Grapeshot:*** After that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, if all of the attacks made with this unit’s **Godbreaker Cannon** targeted the same enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within that enemy unit’s combat range.
abilities.lore: At a word, the Cogfort’s crew swiftly load specialised ammunition into the godbreaker cannon.

regimentOptions: Any ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES

units.lore: Built for total battlefield domination, the Cannonade Cogfort towers above the fray like a god of war, grinding enemies to paste beneath its stone and iron feet. When its main godbreaker cannon fires, the report can be heard for miles around – and whatever is unfortunate enough to lie in the Cogfort’s path is reduced to splintered fragments and ash.

units.name: Mallus Forgepriest

abilities.name: Consecrate the Land
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an objective you control that this unit is contesting to be the target.

Effect: If there are no enemy units contesting the target objective, it is considered by you to be **consecrated**. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, the target objective is considered by you to be **consecrated**.

While they are wholly within 6" of a **consecrated** objective and **under orders**:
• Friendly non-**WAR MACHINE SIGMARITE** units have **WARD (5+)**.
• Friendly **SIGMARITE WAR MACHINES** have **WARD (6+)**.

If your opponent gains control of a **consecrated** objective, it is no longer **consecrated**.
abilities.lore: Bellowing Sigmarite hymns, the Mallus Forgepriest purges the taint of Chaos from the land and consecrates it in the name of the God-King.

units.lore: The clergy of the Brethren of the Forge often serve in Sigmar’s armies as blacksmiths, chaplains and battlefield exorcists. With a chanted hymn and a blessed strike of their warhammers, they can blast the lingering corruption from contested ground, turning it into a haven for Sigmarite troops.

units.name: Immolator Cogfort

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
• The Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Iron Feet** is 3.
• It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: Power to Maximum!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 or more of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn. For each effect you pick, give this unit a number of **heat tokens** equal to the number beside it.

***1 Load Triple Shot!:*** This unit’s **Breacher Cannon** has **Crit (2 Hits)**.

***1 Go, Go, Go!:*** When making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

***2 Get Us In There!:*** This unit’s **Crushing Iron Feet** have **Charge (+1 Damage)**.

***3 Load Chain Shot!:*** Each time this unit uses a **SHOOT** ability, after that ability has been resolved, if any enemy models were slain by attacks made with this unit’s **Breacher Cannon**, for each model slain by those attacks, inflict 1 mortal damage on that model’s unit.

***4 Disengage Safeties!:*** The Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Realmscorcher Flame Cannon** is 22.
abilities.lore: The Castellan-Captain orders their crew to push the Immolator Cogfort to its absolute limits.

abilities.name: Overheating
abilities.description: Effect: Immediately after resolving this unit’s ‘Power to Maximum!’ ability, you must roll a number of dice equal to the number of **heat tokens** this unit has. For each 5+, allocate 1 damage point to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points), then remove 1 of this unit’s **heat tokens**.
abilities.lore: If pushed too hard, a Cogfort’s arco‑combustor can overheat and cause serious damage.

details.notes: This unit can only be taken in an Iron March Army of Renown

units.lore: The Immolator Cogfort eschews a transport galley in favour of a breacher cannon and more ammunition for its terrifying realmscorcher flame cannon. Its experimental dual capacity arco-combustor allows for brief periods of increased firepower and speed, although careless use of this design feature can lead to a truly catastrophic explosion.

units.name: Linebreaker Cogfort

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
• The Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Iron Feet** is 3.
• It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: Overheating
abilities.description: Effect: Immediately after resolving this unit’s ‘Output to Maximum!’ ability, you must roll a number of dice equal to the number of **heat tokens** this unit has. For each 5+, allocate 1 damage point to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points), then remove 1 of this unit’s **heat tokens**.
abilities.lore: If pushed too hard, a Cogfort’s arco‑combustor can overheat and cause serious damage.

abilities.name: Venture Forth
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has not used a Run ability this turn, pick this unit’s **passengers** to be the targets.

Effect: Set up each target wholly within 6" of this unit and either not in combat or within ½" of an enemy unit. If a target is set up in combat, it has charged. Then, if this unit is not **under orders**, this unit and the targets are **under orders** for the rest of the battle round.
abilities.lore: The warriors aboard the Linebreaker Cogfort hurl themselves into battle.

abilities.name: Output to Maximum!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 or more of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn. For each effect you pick, give this unit a number of **heat tokens** equal to the number beside it.

***1 Trample Them to Dust!:*** This unit’s **Crushing Iron Feet** have **ANTI‑MONSTER (+1 Rend)**.

***1 Go, Go, Go!:*** When making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.

***2 Get Us In There!:*** This unit’s **Crushing Iron Feet** have **Charge (+1 Damage)**.

***2 Load Heavy Shot!:*** Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Godbreaker Cannon**, but all of this unit’s attacks made with that weapon this turn must target the same enemy unit.

***2 Full Throttle!:*** This unit’s Move characteristic is 10".
abilities.lore: Few are the Linebreaker commanders who will not use every last shred of fuel and ammunition to destroy whatever hated monsters their enemies hurl at them.

abilities.name: Ride to Glory
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 1 friendly **IRON MARCH INFANTRY HERO** and up to 1 friendly non-**HERO IRON MARCH INFANTRY** unit that have not been deployed.

Effect: Set up those units in reserve as this unit’s **passengers**. They have now been deployed.
abilities.lore: The warriors climb aboard the Cogfort, praying for the strength and resolve they know will be sorely needed in the hours to come.

details.notes: This unit can only be taken in an Iron March Army of Renown

units.lore: The Linebreaker Cogfort is a hybrid assault and bombardment design that is intended to provide adaptability on the battlefield. The sheer recoil of a godbreaker cannon makes for an uncomfortable experience for the Freeguilders riding in the Linebreaker’s belly. It does at least assure that when they pour out of the hold to engage with the foe, most of their opposition has already been reduced to smoke and ashes.

armiesOfRenown.name: Allies of the Free Cities
armiesOfRenown.description: The free cities of the God-King stand as bulwarks against the brutality of the daemon, the gheist and the orruk. Founded in an era of rekindled hope, these vast, fortified strongholds are interspersed throughout the Mortal Realms, each home to a bustling population of faithful citizens.
armiesOfRenown.lore:
The free cities of the God-King stand as bulwarks against the brutality of the daemon, the gheist and the orruk. Founded in an era of rekindled hope, these vast, fortified strongholds are interspersed throughout the Mortal Realms, each home to a bustling population of faithful citizens.

When you pick the Cities of Sigmar faction for your army, you can choose for it to be an Allies of the Free Cities Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Cities of Sigmar faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed as described in Army of Renown: Allies of the Free Cities. All units in your army gain the **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** keyword.
roster: Allies of the Free Cities Auric Hearthguard
Allies of the Free Cities Vanari Auralan Sentinels
Allies of the Free Cities Vanari Auralan Wardens
Allies of the Free Cities Vulkyn Flameseekers
armiesOfRenown.source: Army of Renown: Allies of the Free Cities

battleTraits.name: Form up, Allies!
battleTraits.phase: Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** unit to use this ability, then pick 2 other visible friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.

The unit using this ability and the targets:
• cannot be **under orders**.
• must each be a different unit type.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are **under orders**.

**Designer’s Note:** *‘Unit type’ refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. ‘Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal’ or ‘Allies of the Free Cities Auric Hearthguard’.*
battleTraits.lore: Once the order is given, humans, aelves and duardin alike link up to form a fortress of flesh and steel that little can stand against.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Allies of the Free Cities
battleTraits.groupName: Allies of the Free Cities Battle Traits

battleTraits.name: Forces of Order
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description:
Effect: While 3 friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** units are wholly within 12" of each other and 1 of those units has the **AELF** keyword, 1 of those units has the **DUARDIN** keyword and 1 of those units has the **SIGMARITE** keyword:

• Those units have **WARD (5+)** against shooting attacks.
• Add 3 to those units’ control scores.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for those units’ combat attacks.
battleTraits.lore: The soldiers who stand shoulder to shoulder against the evil ravaging the Mortal Realms are hardy and bold, and they take strength from their shared bonds of fellowship.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Allies of the Free Cities
battleTraits.groupName: Allies of the Free Cities Battle Traits

heroicTraits.name: Respected Commander
heroicTraits.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a visible **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** unit wholly within 18" of this unit
heroicTraits.description: Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
heroicTraits.lore: This commander is hailed as a paragon of virtue by all goodly beings, and their orders are followed with the utmost haste.
heroicTraits.source: Army of Renown: Allies of the Free Cities
heroicTraits.groupName: Allies of the Free Cities Heroic Trait

artefacts.name: Signet of the City
artefacts.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Hero Phase
artefacts.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and each visible friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

• The targets are **under orders**.
• The targets have **WARD (6+)**.
• The targets have a maximum control score of 1.
artefacts.lore: This piece of jewellery is bestowed upon those who have performed a great service to one of Sigmar’s cities, giving their opinion considerable weight in matters military. The bearers do tend to overstep their authority, however, countermanding earlier orders and sowing confusion.
artefacts.source: Army of Renown: Allies of the Free Cities
artefacts.groupName: Allies of the Free Cities Artefact of Power

spellLores.name: Allies of the Free Cities Spell Lore

spells.name: These Realms are Ours
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick an objective within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, melee weapons used by friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** units have **Charge (+1 Damage)** for attacks that target enemy units that are contesting the target objective.
spells.lore: The allies of Sigmar share a desire to restore civilisation and stability to the realms, whatever the cost.

prayerLores.name: Allies of the Free Cities Prayer Lore

prayers.name: Divine Mandate
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with any of the targets.
prayers.lore: Sigmar’s quest to drive Chaos from reality and reconquer the Mortal Realms imbues his faithful with his dread aspect of war, that of a furious and all-conquering warrior king.

units.name: Steam Tank Commander

abilities.name: Division Commander
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **Steam Tank** units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by this unit and by each target.
abilities.lore: From atop the turret, the commander directs the other tanks in their division upon the battlefield.

abilities.name: More Pressure!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll is less than the number of damage points this unit has, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit. Otherwise, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to this unit until the start of your next turn:

***Power the Wheels:*** This unit can use a **RUN** ability and still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

***Power the Guns:*** Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Steam Gun**.
abilities.lore: Pumping pressure into the valves and pistons of a Steam Tank can improve its performance – but risks a catastrophic backfire.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: At the forefront of larger Steam Tank formations ride the Steam Tank Commanders, veterans of countless battles who are deft at coordinating shock assaults that leave the enemy shattered and reeling.

units.name: Drakespawn Knights

abilities.name: Bestial Instincts
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Drakespawn’s Ferocious Jaws** while it is in combat with any enemy units that had any damage points allocated to them this phase or that had any models slain this phase.
abilities.lore: As the Drakespawn tear apart their prey, the scent of fresh gore sends them into a frenzy.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Cold-blooded Drakespawn make formidable mounts, for not only do they carry their lance-bearing riders towards the enemy with sure-footed speed, their fangs and claws are sharp enough to tear through metal and bone with ease.

units.name: Black Ark Fleetmaster

abilities.name: 'At Them, You Curs!'
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **Black Ark Corsairs** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Under the gaze of their Fleetmaster, Scourge Corsairs slaughter the enemy without mercy.

details.notes: This Hero can join a **Dreadlord on Black Dragon’s**, **Sorceress**’ or **Sorceress on Black Dragon’s** regiment. This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Fleetmasters are rulers of the high seas, Corsair lords who command the marauding Black Arks of the Scourge Privateers. Peerless swordfighters, they delight in seeking out worthy foes against whom to test their skill.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Alchemite Warforger

abilities.name: Crucible of Rage
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:

• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** units while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The Warforger harnesses the elemental fury of the Bright Realm to enhance their own spellcasting and empower their fellow mages.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Well used to the heat radiated by their runic crucibles, Alchemite Warforgers are quite comfortable in the sweltering Aqshian climes. So too can these mages tap into the realm’s furious energies and use them to enhance arcane might.

units.name: Ironweld Great Cannon

abilities.name: Relentless Bombardment
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this unit’s shooting attacks this phase to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit is **under orders**. On a 3+, subtract 2 from charge rolls and run rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Ironweld gunners can relentlessly pour fire down into oncoming enemies, slowing their advance if not outright stopping it.

units.lore: The massive artillery pieces known as Ironweld Great Cannons act as the bastions of the Castelite formations. Protected by thick oaken gun-shields affixed to the weapon’s fore, the crew tirelessly load and reload their weapon to ensure the barrage upon the enemy is relentless.

units.name: Allies of the Free Cities Auric Hearthguard

abilities.name: Lava-Encrusted
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is **under orders**, each time a shooting attack made by this unit scores a critical hit, subtract 1" from the target unit’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn (this effect is cumulative). This ability cannot reduce the target unit’s Move characteristic below half its starting value.
abilities.lore: Enemies struck by the allied duardin’s magmapike bolts find their movements becoming increasingly sluggish as the rock cools and rapidly solidifies on their armour and flesh.

details.notes: This unit can only be taken in an Allies of the Free Cities Army of Renown.

units.lore: Auric Hearthguard are the trusted custodians of a Fyreslayer lodge’s magma-vault. Armed with lava-spewing pikes, they have been known to fight alongside humans of Sigmar’s cities, reasoning that offensive action with allied support is the best way to safeguard their lodge’s precious ur-gold.

units.name: Kharibdyss

abilities.name: Abyssal Howl
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: These creatures let loose spine-chilling roars when they scent the blood of their prey.

abilities.name: Goaded and Whipped
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Double the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Kharibdyss’s handlers lash the creature into a murderous frenzy.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: The Kharibdyss is a deep-sea abomination that inspires primal terror in its prey. These beasts are employed by the Scourge Privateers to shatter enemy formations, whereupon the scattered and broken survivors are picked off by the cruel Corsairs.

units.name: Black Ark Corsairs

abilities.name: Swift Shots
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, it can immediately use the ‘Shoot’ ability as if it were your shooting phase. All attacks must target the same enemy unit, and the enemy unit picked to be the target of the attacks must be in combat with this unit and have charged this phase.
abilities.lore: As the enemy bears down upon them, the Corsairs flick their repeater handbows out from beneath their cloaks and fire them point blank at the surprised foe.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Cruel-hearted and avaricious, Black Ark Corsairs are the footsoldiers of the Scourge Privateers. Wielding a variety of lethal weapons, they thrive in the chaos of a swirling melee, where their superior swordsmanship can be put to deadly use.

units.name: War Hydra

abilities.name: Impossible to Destroy
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll 6 dice. Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled for each **destroyed head token** this unit has.

If any of the rolls are a 5+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (1)** this unit for each 5+. Finally, give this unit 1 **destroyed head token.**
abilities.lore: It is almost impossible to kill a Hydra, for they regenerate wounds and regrow severed heads with alarming speed.

abilities.name: Six-headed Strike
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 6 dice. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Stoked into a killing rage by their handlers’ goads and whips, War Hydras lumber forward into battle, each of their six heads lashing out to strike the enemy.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Greatest of all the abominations spawned by the experiments of the Order Serpentis are the monstrosities known as War Hydras, each one created through dark sorcery and perfectly tailored for the battlefield. Driven forward by the lashes of scarred handlers, these creatures are imprecise but devastating living weapons.

units.name: Ironbreakers

abilities.name: Gromril Shieldwall
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, attacks that target this unit cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).
abilities.lore: Once formed up into a shieldwall, a line of gromril-clad Ironbreakers is nigh impenetrable.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Ironbreakers are the elite guardians of the Dispossessed’s underground fortresses. Clad from head to toe in impervious gromril and wielding masterwork axes and hammers, they form a formidable wall against which the enemy is soon shattered.

units.name: Warden King

abilities.name: Fearless Leader
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Warden Kings are often first into the fray, with their oathsworn kin following closely in their wake swinging gromril hammers and settling grudges.

abilities.name: Ancestral Grudgebearer
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in your opponent’s army to bear a grudge against. You can pick an enemy unit that is in reserve.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN** units that target that unit.
abilities.lore: Every Warden King knows the names of those who wronged their forebears. As they march out to defend or reclaim their holds, they seek to settle those grudges.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Warden Kings are the leaders of the Dispossessed duardin, venerable fighters and strategists who seek out the most fearsome enemy combatants and bludgeon them to death with rune-carved warhammers.

units.name: Freeguild Marshal and Relic Envoy

abilities.name: Attendant Relic Envoy
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit’s **Relic Envoy** is a token. Pick a visible friendly **SIGMARITE** unit wholly within 18" of this unit and not **under orders** to be the target.

Effect: Place this unit’s **Relic Envoy** next to the target. While this unit is **under orders** and on the battlefield and this unit’s **Relic Envoy** is next to the target, the target is **under orders**.
abilities.lore: It is a great honour for a Relic Envoy to serve beneath a Freeguild Marshal. Their duties include hand- delivering messages to the soldiers of the line.

abilities.name: Front-Line Commander
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is **under orders**, pick a friendly **SIGMARITE** **INFANTRY** or **MONSTER** unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit or has this unit’s **Relic Envoy** next to it and that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, the target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: In the face of the oncoming enemy, the Marshal stands alongside their fellows in the front lines, bellowing orders and coordinating attacks.

regimentOptions: Any ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES
details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Freeguild Veteran*.

units.lore: Freeguild Marshals who lead from the front are perhaps the most heroic of all. The respect they have won from their warriors is stronger than any shield, and their Relic Envoys ensure their orders always get to where they are needed. When battlelines clash, their skill with sword, hammer and pistol swiftly becomes clear.

units.name: Amethyst Knellmage

abilities.name: Deathly Candlelight
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Knellmage channels so much Shyishan energy through their Reikenorian candle that they wreathe themselves in an eerie, disconcerting witchlight.

abilities.name: Ominous Presence
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Make an arcane manipulation roll of D6. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, when picking a target for the ‘Deathly Candlelight’ ability, you can pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit instead of within 12".
abilities.lore: The Knellmage heightens the intensity of their Reikenorian candlelight, taking on an even more dreadful aspect.

units.lore: Strange and unnerving are the Amethyst Knellmages, masters of Shyishan magic. Their bizarre, bell-shaped helms are topped by hammer-wielding skeletal figures that toll a percussive rhythm; the wizards swing their deadly scythes in time to each soul-shaking peal.

units.name: Luminark of Hysh

abilities.name: Searing Beam of Light
abilities.description: Effect: Each time this unit attacks with its **Searing Beam of Light**, pick a point on the battlefield within range to be the target. If the attack scores a hit, draw a straight line between that point and the closest point on this unit’s base. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each visible unit (friendly and enemy) that the line passes across.
abilities.lore: As interlocking lenses of aetherquartz click into place, a beam of blinding white light shoots forth to incinerate all before it.

abilities.name: Aura of Protection
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has **WARD (6+)** while it is wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.
abilities.lore: Luminarks of Hysh have a protective magical aura that can be activated in times of need.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: T he Luminark of Hysh is a devastating arcane war machine, capable of focusing light through its aetherquartz optics in order to unleash a beam of soulfire that vaporises everything in its path.

units.name: Aqshian Pyrocaster

abilities.name: The Flames of Aqshy
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Make an arcane manipulation roll of D6. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, when picking a target for the ‘Incandescent Incineration’ ability, you can pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit instead of within 12".
abilities.lore: The Pyrocaster turns their body into a living conduit for Aqshian magic, heightening their fiery spellcasting.

abilities.name: Incandescent Incineration
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the target was not **incandescent** when they were picked to be the target of this spell:
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
• The target is **incandescent** for the rest of the battle.

If the target was **incandescent** when they were picked to be the target of this spell:
•Allocate 3 damage points to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
• The target is no longer **incandescent**.
abilities.lore: The Pyrocaster’s wand glows white hot as they unleash an incendiary assault, the arcane flames creating a veritable bonfire of bright magic for them to tap into.

units.lore: Battlemages who dedicate themselves to the Aqshian school of magic are fiery and aggressive souls. Known as Pyrocasters, they channel the tremendous power of bright magic through their emberstone wands, annihilating their foes in an explosion of flame.

units.name: Gyrobomber

abilities.name: Grudgebuster Bombs
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit used a **MOVE** ability this phase, pick an enemy unit that does not have **FLY** and that this unit passed across this turn to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

***Tactical Bombing:*** Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

***Drop It All!:*** Make 2 rolls of D3. For each 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, roll a D3 for each unit (friendly and enemy) within the target’s combat range that does not have **FLY**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll. Once the ‘Drop It All!’ effect of this ability has been resolved, this unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: Gyrobombers swoop over the enemy lines, dropping a lethal payload onto the hapless warriors below.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Gyrobombers are heavy assault aircraft equipped with racks of devastating bombs that they rain on the heads of their targets, enveloping them in a deadly storm of explosions and f lying shrapnel.

units.name: Gyrocopter

abilities.name: Guild Bombs
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit used a **MOVE** ability this phase, pick an enemy unit that does not have **FLY** and that this unit passed across this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Every Gyrocopter goes to battle with a single payload of these volatile blackpowder explosives.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Small and nimble single-duardin fighter craft, Gyrocopters roar over the heads of their targets in tight formation, strafing them with flames or scalding steam before wheeling away to begin another attack run.

units.name: Conqueror Cogfort

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
• The Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Iron Feet** is 3.
• It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: All Aboard!
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 1 friendly **SIGMARITE INFANTRY HERO** and up to 1 friendly non-**HERO SIGMARITE INFANTRY** unit that have not been deployed.

Effect: Set up those units in reserve as this unit’s **passengers**. They have now been deployed.
abilities.lore: The warriors clamber aboard the Conqueror Cogfort and ready themselves for battle.

abilities.name: Full Charge!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 or more of the following effects. For each effect you pick, give this unit a number of **heat tokens** equal to the number beside it.

***1 Breaching Assist!:*** If this unit uses the ‘Sally Forth’ ability this turn, melee weapons used by the targets of that ability have **Charge (+1 Damage)** for the rest of the turn.

***2 Full Throttle!:*** For the rest of the turn, this unit’s Move characteristic is 10".

***3 Repel Boarders!:*** For the rest of the turn, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Crew’s Leadshotters** and **Crushing Iron Feet**.

***4 Disengage Safeties!:*** For the rest of the turn, the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Realmscorcher Flame Cannon** is 22.

***6 Get Us Out of Here!:*** For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The Cogsmith kicks the arco-combustor into high gear, causing the Cogfort to surge forwards and allowing the crew to obliterate the enemy.

abilities.name: Sally Forth
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has not used a **RUN** ability this turn, pick this unit’s **passengers** to be the targets.

Effect: Set up each target wholly within 6" of this unit and either not in combat or within ½" of an enemy unit. If a target is set up in combat, it has charged. Then, if this unit is not **under orders**, this unit and the targets are **under orders** for the rest of the battle round.
abilities.lore: The warriors aboard the Conqueror Cogfort hurl themselves into battle.

abilities.name: Overheating
abilities.description: Effect: Immediately after resolving this unit’s ‘Full Charge!’ ability, you must roll a number of dice equal to the number of **heat tokens** this unit has. For each 5+, allocate 1 damage point to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points), then remove 1 of this unit’s **heat tokens**.
abilities.lore: If pushed too hard, a Cogfort’s arco‑combustor can overheat and cause serious damage.

regimentOptions: Any ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES

units.lore: The Conqueror Cogfort exchanges a conventional main gun for a realmscorcher flame cannon: a truly terrifying weapon that swathes the battlefield in sheets of flesh- melting fire. Outfitted with an underbelly transport cage, the Conqueror is typically used in an assault role, delivering troops right into the heart of the enemy’s battleline.

units.name: Freeguild Command Corps Auxiliaries

abilities.name: Seize the Souls
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit contains a **Soul Shepherd**, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot be healed or have slain models returned to it until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The Soul Shepherd can trap enemies’ souls, preventing them from being forcibly returned to life should they fall.

abilities.name: Field Surgery
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat and contains a **War Surgeon**, pick a visible friendly non-**WAR MACHINE SIGMARITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:

• If the target is a non-**HERO INFANTRY** unit, return D3 slain models to it.
• If the target is a non-**HERO CAVALRY** unit, return 1 slain model to it.
• If the target is a **HERO** or **MONSTER**, **Heal (D3)** the target.
abilities.lore: With a deft hand and careful eye, the War Surgeon patches up those under their care.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced. This unit can only be taken in a regiment that contains a **Freeguild Command Corp Adjutant** unit and no other **Freeguild Command Corp Auxiliaries**. This unit does not count towards the number of friendly units that can accompany a **HERO**.

units.lore: Each Command Corps is assisted by auxiliary specialists trained in medicine and other, more sinister arts. War Surgeons patch up grievous wounds with startling efficiency, while the unsettling Soul Shepherds bind enemy souls in place, preventing necromancers and other nefarious types from bringing the dead back to life.

units.name: Freeguild Gallants

abilities.name: Break Them Upon the Walls
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is **under orders**, the melee weapons of other visible friendly **SIGMARITE** units, excluding **Freeguild Gallants** units, have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The sight of Freeguild Gallants bringing wrath and ruin to enemy attackers rouses their fellows to bloody deeds.

abilities.name: Not One Step Back
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has not charged this turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic and Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.
abilities.lore: The elite infantry of the Cities of Sigmar lead defensive positions against all manner of terrible foes.

units.lore: Freeguild Gallants are knightly champions who prefer to fight on foot. They favour one-handed weapons and broad shields, intercepting enemy charges with stoic resolve and then slowly driving the foe back with their superior bladecraft. Their skill and dash is an example to all nearby Sigmarite troops.

units.name: Cannonade Cogfort

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
• The Attacks characteristic of its **Crushing Iron Feet** is 3.
• It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilities.name: Full Power!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 or more of the following effects. For each effect you pick, give this unit a number of **heat tokens** equal to the number beside it.

***1 Launch Countermeasures!:*** Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target other friendly **SIGMARITE** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and are **under orders**.

***2 Full Throttle!:*** For the rest of the turn, this unit’s Move characteristic is 10".

***3 Calculate Firing Solution!:*** For the rest of the turn, each time this unit uses a **SHOOT** ability, you can re‑roll 1 hit roll and 1 wound roll for shooting attacks made with this unit’s **Godbreaker Cannon**.

***6 Get Us Out of Here!:*** For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The Castellan-Captain orders their crew to push the Cannonade Cogfort to its absolute limits.

abilities.name: Overheating
abilities.description: Effect: Immediately after resolving this unit’s ‘Full Power!’ ability, you must roll a number of dice equal to the number of **heat tokens** this unit has. For each 5+, allocate 1 damage point to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points), then remove 1 of this unit’s **heat tokens**.
abilities.lore: If pushed too hard, a Cogfort’s arco‑combustor can overheat and cause serious damage.

abilities.name: Special Ammunition
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for this unit
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit is **under orders**, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects.

***Nullshot:*** Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by attacks made with this unit’s **Godbreaker Cannon** this phase.

***Heavy Shot:*** Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Godbreaker Cannon** this phase.

***Grapeshot:*** After that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, if all of the attacks made with this unit’s **Godbreaker Cannon** targeted the same enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within that enemy unit’s combat range.
abilities.lore: At a word, the Cogfort’s crew swiftly load specialised ammunition into the godbreaker cannon.

regimentOptions: Any ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES

units.lore: Built for total battlefield domination, the Cannonade Cogfort towers above the fray like a god of war, grinding enemies to paste beneath its stone and iron feet. When its main godbreaker cannon fires, the report can be heard for miles around – and whatever is unfortunate enough to lie in the Cogfort’s path is reduced to splintered fragments and ash.

units.name: Freeguild Command Corps Whisperblade

abilities.name: Lurking Spymaster
abilities.description:
Effect: This unit cannot use or be picked to be the target of the ‘Form Up!’ ability.

While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **SIGMARITE INFANTRY** unit that has 3 or more models and there are no other friendly **Whisperblades** within that unit’s combat range, this unit cannot be picked to be the target of shooting attacks or combat attacks.
abilities.lore: Whisperblades are adept at remaining hidden amongst ranks of Freeguilders, striking out only when necessary.

details.notes: This unit can only be taken in a regiment that contains a **Freeguild Command Corp Adjutant** unit and no other **Freeguild Command Corp Whisperblades**. This unit does not count towards the number of friendly units that can accompany a **HERO**.

units.lore: It is the duty of the Whisperblades to oversee the internal security of a Freeguild army on the march, ensuring that malevolent entities are excised with ruthless precision. In battle, they often lurk unnoticed amidst friendly formations, emerging only when they see a chance to deliver a killing strike against an enemy leader or champion.

units.name: Mallus Forgepriest

abilities.name: Consecrate the Land
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an objective you control that this unit is contesting to be the target.

Effect: If there are no enemy units contesting the target objective, it is considered by you to be **consecrated**. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, the target objective is considered by you to be **consecrated**.

While they are wholly within 6" of a **consecrated** objective and **under orders**:
• Friendly non-**WAR MACHINE SIGMARITE** units have **WARD (5+)**.
• Friendly **SIGMARITE WAR MACHINES** have **WARD (6+)**.

If your opponent gains control of a **consecrated** objective, it is no longer **consecrated**.
abilities.lore: Bellowing Sigmarite hymns, the Mallus Forgepriest purges the taint of Chaos from the land and consecrates it in the name of the God-King.

units.lore: The clergy of the Brethren of the Forge often serve in Sigmar’s armies as blacksmiths, chaplains and battlefield exorcists. With a chanted hymn and a blessed strike of their warhammers, they can blast the lingering corruption from contested ground, turning it into a haven for Sigmarite troops.

units.name: Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal

abilities.name: 'For Sigmar! For Glory!'
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared the 'Counter-charge' command for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a visible friendly non-**HERO SIGMARITE CAVALRY** unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit, is not in combat and has not used a **RUN** ability this turn to be the target. After the ‘Counter-charge’ command for this unit has been resolved, if this unit is in combat, the target can immediately use the ‘Charge’ ability as if it were your charge phase. In addition, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target for the rest of the phase.
abilities.lore: Raising their blade, the Marshal signals the Cavaliers’ counter-charge and hurls themselves into battle.

abilities.name: Run Down The Foe
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick this unit and up to 2 visible friendly non-**HERO SIGMARITE CAVALRY** units that charged this turn and are wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:

• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Cavalier-Marshals are experts in leading decisive charges on enemy positions and trampling the foe underfoot.

regimentOptions: Any ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES
details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Freeguild Veteran*.

units.lore: Every Cavalier-Marshal is nigh unstoppable on the charge. They gallop hard into the enemy, collapsing battlelines and intercepting charging foes with a sudden burst of speed. Though they often carry the weight of a Dawnbringer Crusade upon their shoulders, they are inspiring champions well used to leading by example.

units.name: Gate Gargants

abilities.name: Aggressive Defenders
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 other visible friendly **SIGMARITE** units in combat with any enemy units that are in combat with this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the targets by **RETREAT** abilities for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Gate Gargants are too large and belligerent for enemies to easily ignore; their allies take advantage of this to retreat in good order.

abilities.name: Open the Gates
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**WAR MACHINE CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 2 to charge rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Gate Gargants part their tower shield, allowing nearby units to hurl themselves forward and wreak havoc on the enemy.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: Stationed as the forbidding core of a Castelite formation, the massive brutes known as Gate Gargants function as a living gatehouse, rebuffing enemy charges with bone-smashing sweeps of their warmauls whilst their tower-mounted handlers open up with multi-barrelled cannons. When the decision is made for the Sigmarites to go on the offensive, the Gate Gargants part their massive shields signalling an all-out assault.

units.name: Alchemite Warforger

abilities.name: Runic Crucible
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **SIGMARITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Make an arcane manipulation roll of D6. On a 3+, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The hefty crucibles carried by these arcane metallurgists harness the elemental magics of Chamon and can be used to give the weapons of their allies a white-hot molten edge.

units.lore: The specialist wizards known as Alchemite Warforgers wield the raw energies of Chamon. They can change the properties of not only metal but reality itself. As muscular and sweaty as blacksmiths, these mages pluck glowing runecubes from their crucibles, channelling metallurgic magic to destroy their foes.

units.name: Runelord

abilities.name: Runes of Spellbreaking
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use the ‘Unbind’ ability as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.
abilities.lore: Runelords dampen the magic of their enemies with ancient sigils of unbinding.

abilities.name: Forgefire
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of each target’s melee weapons.
abilities.lore: Calling upon the latent power of runic engravings, Runelords imbue the weapons of their kin with ancient might.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Runelords have mastered the ancient art of runeshaping. Through rituals of hammercraft, they can unbind hostile magic or imbue the weapons of their kin with fearsome killing power.

units.name: Allies of the Free Cities Vanari Auralan Sentinels

abilities.name: Fire Lofted Shots
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit is **under orders**, for the rest of the turn:

• Add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit’s **Auralan Bows**.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks.
abilities.lore: When the order is given, the Sentinels point their bows to the sky before firing a volley at a distant target.

details.notes: This unit can only be taken in an Allies of the Free Cities Army of Renown.

units.lore: Auralan Sentinels are supreme marksman with their mighty longbows, capable of sending an arrow through an enemy’s eye at a hundred paces. Their arched trajectories perfectly supplement the headlong firepower of a Castelite formation, raining down death amongst the foe.

units.name: Allies of the Free Cities Vanari Auralan Wardens

abilities.name: Protective Pike-Wall
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is **under orders** and has not charged this turn, ignore the effect of the **Charge (+1 Damage)** ability for combat attacks made by enemy units that target this unit.
abilities.lore: Standing shoulder to shoulder with their allied comrades, the Wardens present a bristling wall of pikes to the foe.

details.notes: This unit can only be taken in an Allies of the Free Cities Army of Renown.

units.lore: Auralan Wardens form the glittering spine of the Lumineth Realm-lords’ martial hosts. Armed with long pikes to engage the enemy at a distance, they fight with perfect precision and skill. They might find the human way of war cumbersome and inefficient, but they see the God-King’s folk as key allies in their campaigns against the Dark Gods.

units.name: Allies of the Free Cities Vulkyn Flameseekers

abilities.name: Allied Drothmasters
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: If this unit is **under orders**, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

Subtract 2 from the Damage characteristic of the target’s **Companion** melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Sigmarites’ Vulkyn allies are skilled at dominating monstrous wild beasts.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced. This unit can only be taken in an Allies of the Free Cities Army of Renown.

units.lore: Vulkyn Flameseekers are strange duardin who roam the realms in search of Magmadroth eggs – a precious resource that holds both spiritual and practical significance in Fyreslayer society. Accompanied by hunting beasts and wielding a variety of deadly weaponry, they sometimes join Sigmarite crusades heading into enemy- held territories.

units.name: Freeguild Cavaliers

abilities.name: Storm of Steel
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is in combat and has not charged this turn, pick an enemy unit that it is in combat with and up to 1 friendly **Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal** within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.

Effect: If this unit is **under orders**, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

This unit and the friendly target can use the ‘Charge’ ability even if it is not your charge phase and even if those units are in combat. Both friendly units must end that move in combat with the enemy target.
abilities.lore: Putting the spurs to their war-steeds, the Freeguild Cavaliers plunge into the fray, taking their enemies by surprise with this sudden burst of speed.

units.lore: The battlefield shakes as the heavy cavalry of the Sigmarite cities make their charge. No idle jousters these: theirs is a war of grinding, brutal attrition where man and steed alike are expected to fight for hours at a time without rest.

units.name: Freeguild Fusiliers

abilities.name: Blackpowder Squire
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit and this unit is in combat
abilities.description: Effect: This unit’s **Blackpowder Squire** is a token. Remove this unit’s **Blackpowder Squire** from the battlefield, then add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Blackpowder Squires ensure their fellows are well prepared to deliver point-blank volleys as the enemy closes.

abilities.name: Fortified Position
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit is **under orders**:

• This unit’s ranged weapons have **Shoot in Combat**.
• Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.
abilities.lore: Heavy pavises are slammed into the dirt, forming a wall of oak and iron as strong as a fortification.

units.lore: Planting their pavises in the ground, Freeguild Fusiliers form up into a defensive line that is effectively a fortress battlement brought to the field. From this defensive position, they unleash continuous volleys of fire from their sturdy fusil-cannons amidst drifting clouds of blackpowder smoke.

units.name: Battlemage on Luminark of Hysh

abilities.name: Searing Beam of Light
abilities.description: Effect: Each time this unit attacks with its **Searing Beam of Light**, pick a point on the battlefield within range to be the target. If the attack scores a hit, draw a straight line between that point and the closest point on this unit’s base. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each visible unit (friendly and enemy) that the line passes across.
abilities.lore: As interlocking lenses of aetherquartz click into place, a beam of blinding white light shoots forth to incinerate all before it.

abilities.name: Aura of Protection
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has **WARD (6+)** while it is wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.
abilities.lore: Luminarks of Hysh have a protective magical aura that can be activated in times of need.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Powerful Light Wizards from the upper echelons of the Collegiate Arcane sometimes ride to war upon a Luminark of Hysh, directing its searing beam of light to vaporise the direst threats of the enemy whilst deftly casting scouring sorceries of their own.

units.name: Fusil-Major on Ogor Warhulk

abilities.name: Coordinate Attacks
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
