Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 24" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **SIGMARITE** units that are **under orders** that target that enemy unit.
abilities.lore: Fusil-Majors can direct the attacks of nearby Sigmarites to eliminate priority targets.

regimentOptions: Any ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES
details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Freeguild Veteran.*

units.lore: Forming the mobile watchtowers of the Castelite formations, Fusil-Majors borne by Ogor Warhulks use their vantage points to spy weaknesses in the enemy line and direct the fire of friendly forces. The obvious threat posed by their massive ogor carriers is usually enough to make foes think twice about storming their positions.

units.name: Celestial Hurricanum

abilities.name: Storm of Shemtek
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Make a number of D3 rolls equal to the current battle round number. For each 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: A Celestial Hurricanum can summon a magical storm to batter the foe with the fury of the heavens. As the battle rages, the tempest grows ever stronger.

abilities.name: Portents of Battle
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Celestial Hurricanums leak magical energy, granting nearby soldiers visions of the imminent future that allow them to land their blows with uncanny accuracy.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: One of the most complex and deadly creations of the Collegiate, the Celestial Hurricanum is a gigantic arcane orrery that can summon a furious magical storm to lay waste to enemy warriors.

units.name: Freeguild Marshal on Griffon

weapons.name: Griffon’s Razor Claws and Deadly Beak

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Griffon’s Razor Claws and Deadly Beak** is 4.

abilities.name: Piercing Bloodroar
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 4+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The shrill war cry of a mighty griffon can shatter the enemy’s resolve.

abilities.name: Tactical Acumen
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
abilities.lore: Those Freeguild Marshals who have earned the right to ride a griffon into battle not only are skilled warriors but also possess shrewd tactical minds.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: A Freeguild Marshal mounted upon a noble griffon surveys the battlefield from on high. Identifying where their presence is most required, they descend like a speeding comet to lay waste to their enemies, inspiring their comrades with word and deed.

units.name: Wildercorps Hunters

abilities.name: Prepared Arrival
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is **scouting ahead**.

Effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up each other friendly unit **scouting ahead** wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The Wildercorps lead an advance force deep into the enemy’s flank, prepared to wreak havoc and confusion.

abilities.name: Expert Pathfinders
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 friendly non-**MONSTER** non-**WAR MACHINE SIGMARITE** units if none of them have been deployed.

Effect: Set up those units in reserve **scouting ahead**. They have now been deployed.
abilities.lore: These soldiers are tasked with reconnaissance, setting off ahead of the main advance and ensuring that the paths are clear.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: Trackers, scouts and outdoorsmen, the Wildercorps are experts in attacking from the cover of thick foliage and broken ground. Their hounds surge forward, sinking fangs into flesh even as skilled marksmen pick out their targets with crossbows.

units.name: Flagellants

abilities.name: Glorious Martyrs
abilities.description: Effect: While a friendly **SIGMARITE PRIEST** is wholly within this unit’s combat range, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
abilities.lore: While led by leaders of their faith, Flagellants will hurl themselves into battle with reckless fury.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Entirely consumed by their zealous faith in the God-King, these holy warriors long for nothing more than to martyr themselves in battle. Armed with little more than clubs and flails, they leap upon their foes in a frenzied mob.

units.name: Battlemage on Griffon

weapons.name: Griffon’s Razor Claws and Twin Beaks

abilities.name: Ghurish Ferocity
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Griffon’s Razor Claws and Twin Beaks** for attacks that target enemy **MONSTERS** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The twinheaded griffons of Ghur ridden by Amber Battlemages are alpha predators that prey upon other megafauna.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Griffon’s Razor Claws and Twin Beaks** is 4.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: When mounted atop a furious, twin-headed Ghurish griffon, a Battlemage of the Amber College can lay waste to their foes from afar or strike from on high in a vicious frenzy of stabbing beaks and ripping talons.

units.name: Irondrakes

abilities.name: Cinderblast Bomb
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: This weapon explodes in a burst of shrapnel and flame.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Armed with a terrifying array of heavy weaponry, Irondrakes overwhelm their foes with torrents of f lesh-melting flame and volleys of high-explosive missiles, relying upon master-crafted gromril armour to fend off all retaliation.

units.name: Longbeards

abilities.name: 'I Thought Duardin Were Made Of Sterner Stuff!'
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick another friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. You cannot pick a **Longbeards** unit.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn
abilities.lore: A disgruntled look from a grumbling Longbeard is often enough to galvanise the spirits of younger duardin and keep them in the fight.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Longbeards are the oldest and most experienced duardin warriors, as evidenced by their great, f lowing beards and tendency to grumble on relentlessly about their enemies and allies alike – even in the thick of battle.

units.name: Cogsmith

abilities.name: Direct the Gyrocorps
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **Gyrocopter** or **Gyrobomber** units wholly within 18" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn:
• Add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks.
• Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic.
abilities.lore: With phosphorescent munitions, Cogsmiths can direct bombing runs and counterattacks by the gyro-machines of the Ironweld Arsenal.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join a **Warden King**’s regiment. This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Grizzled combat engineers who know how to squeeze peak performance and killing power from any war machine, Cogsmiths are also proficient warriors capable of cutting down those who would interfere with their field repairs.

units.name: Dark Riders

abilities.name: Sow Havoc
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:

• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
• This unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.
abilities.lore: The speed and discipline of the Dark Riders is unmatched, allowing them to charge the enemy’s weak points and retreat before the foe can react.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: For those marked by the Dark Riders, there is nowhere to flee. These cloaked killers gallop forth upon red-eyed shadowmares, levelling spears and repeater crossbows to deal a fatal blow to their quarry.

units.name: Drakespawn Chariot

abilities.name: Scythed Runners
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Vicious blades are fitted to this chariot, carving apart anything that gets in its way.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Drakespawn Chariots are elegant yet cruel war machines that are highly manoeuvrable thanks to their single-wheel design. Fitted with an array of scything blades and crewed by skilled Order Serpentis knights, they cause dreadful carnage as they plough into the enemy lines.

units.name: Dreadlord on Black Dragon

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Black Dragon’s Jaws Claws** is 4.

abilities.name: Under the Shadow of Black Wings
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR AELF CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Dreadlords send in the cavalry to weaken the enemy before swooping down to deliver the killing blow.

abilities.name: Indiscriminate Slaughter
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each other unit (friendly and enemy) within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: The cruel rituals involved in raising Black Dragons curse them with sadistic urges, causing them to revel in slaughter just as much as their Dreadlord riders.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: The feared warlords of the Order Serpentis delight in inflicting pain and terror upon their foes. They ride to war on obsidian-scaled dragons that can lay waste to entire armies with their dagger-like claws and foul, choking breath.

units.name: Scourgerunner Chariot

abilities.name: Prize Specimens
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks that target enemy **MONSTERS**.
abilities.lore: Having sighted monstrous beasts whose innards fetch a particularly high price on the black market, the aelves will not rest until the monsters’ corpses are in their possession.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Employed to chase down fast-moving prey, Scourgerunner Chariots are swift and deadly war machines armed with a harpoon launcher that can cripple even the most fearsome monster.

units.name: Sorceress

abilities.name: Word of Pain
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The Sorceress utters a forbidden name, wracking her foes with unbearable pain.

abilities.name: Cruel Sacrifice
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR AELF** unit wholly within 6" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the turn. Then, roll a dice. On a 4+, 1 model in the target unit is slain.
abilities.lore: The Sorceress shows no mercy as she slits the throat of a nearby thrall and draws power from the blood that gushes forth.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Despots who rule over the Darkling Covens with unquestioned authority and cruel cunning, Sorceresses wield dark and terrible magic that can blast the life from their foes or wrack them with unimaginable agony.

units.name: Darkshards

abilities.name: Storm of Iron-tipped Bolts
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Master‑crafted** **Repeater Crossbows** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The skies darken moments before the enemy is shredded by a volley of iron bolts.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Armed with fast-firing repeater crossbows, formations of Darkshards unleash a withering hail of iron-tipped bolts into their enemies, each volley piercing eyes and puncturing hearts.

units.name: Dreadspears

abilities.name: Coven Guard
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit did not charge this turn, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: These warriors are trained to wait for the perfect moment before thrusting their spears into the hearts of their foes.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Dreadspear shieldwalls form the armoured core of the Darkling Covens’ armies. Fully enthralled to the service of their masters, these cruel warriors fight and slay with unnerving focus.

units.name: Assassin

abilities.name: Hidden Murderer
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **INFANTRY** unit that has 5 or more models and there are no enemy units within this unit’s combat range, this unit is not visible to enemy units.
abilities.lore: Stalking the shadows, the Assassin only reveals their position when they launch a killing strike.

abilities.name: In For The Kill
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** if it charged in the same turn.
abilities.lore: With their target in sight, the Assassin bursts from the shadows and unleashes a flurry of attacks upon the unsuspecting victim.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: T here is no fortress, city or fortified war camp that the feared Shadowblade Assassins cannot infiltrate, and few foes can hope to survive the potent poisons delivered by their wicked daggers.

units.name: Sorceress on Black Dragon

abilities.name: Dark Sorcery
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for each **dark sorcery token** it has.
abilities.lore: The Sorceress draws power from the blood spilled by her Black Dragon.

abilities.name: Command Underlings
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR AELF INFANTRY** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be targets.

Effect: Add 3" to the Move characteristic of each target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The cold-hearted rulers of the Darkling Covens wield absolute control over their ensorcelled underlings, commanding them to do their bidding unquestioningly.

abilities.name: Feed on Life Force
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If any enemy models are slain by this ability, place a **dark** **sorcery** token next to this unit for the rest of the battle, to a maximum of 3 tokens.
abilities.lore: The Black Dragon tears into the enemy, spilling copious blood as the Sorceress completes her dark ritual.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Black Dragon’s Claws** is 4.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Many Sorceresses go to war upon fearsome Black Dragons, delighting in the terror in the eyes of their enemies as the scaled beasts spit clouds of choking fumes and rip their prey apart with sword-sized talons.

units.name: Hammerers

abilities.name: Oathsworn
abilities.description: Effect: While any friendly **Warden Kings** are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly **Warden Kings** have **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: These warriors are oathsworn to protect their liege.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Hammerers are traditionally tasked with guarding the Warden Kings in battle. The rhythmic rise and fall of their gromril mauls instils fear in their enemies just as it lifts the spirits of their fellow duardin.

units.name: Black Guard

abilities.name: Steel and Sorcery
abilities.description: Effect: While any friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR AELF INFANTRY HEROES** are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Black Guard are often charged with protecting heroes on the field of battle.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: These fanatical warriors guard the rulers of the Darkling Covens. Armed with ebon halberds and clad in ensorcelled plate, they present an impassable and deadly obstacle to any who threaten their wards.

units.name: Steam Tank

abilities.name: More Pressure!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll is less than the number of damage points this unit has, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit. Otherwise, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to this unit until the start of your next turn:

***Power the Wheels:*** This unit can use a **RUN** ability and still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

***Power the Guns:*** Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Steam Gun**.
abilities.lore: Pumping pressure into the valves and pistons of a Steam Tank can improve its performance – but risks a catastrophic backfire.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Clanking monstrosities of steel and iron, Steam Tanks rattle across the battlefield, blasting away at targets with their cannons and steam-spewing guns while grinding yet more to paste beneath their metal-clad wheels.

units.name: Bleakswords

abilities.name: Merciless Conquerors
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while it is contesting an objective you do not control.
abilities.lore: While the Dreadspears hold the line, the Bleakswords are tasked with seizing objectives, viciously cutting down any opponents in a storm of flashing steel.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Bleakswords leap into the fray in a blur of flashing steel. Wielding their duelling swords with unnatural grace, they slice their foes to ribbons with an unstoppable flurry of strikes.

units.name: Freeguild Steelhelms

abilities.name: Steel of Helm and Heart
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has 5 or more models, pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: If this unit is **under orders**, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. Subtract 1 from the roll if the target is a **MONSTER**. On a 4+, apply the effect below.

For the rest of the turn, if this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability:
• This unit must be picked to be the target of pile-in moves made by the target.
• All attacks made by models in the target unit within this unit’s combat range must target this unit.
abilities.lore: The Steelhelms force enemy attention on themselves in a heroic effort to blunt attacks on their allies.

units.lore: While the rank and file of the Freeguilds are often individually outmatched by the myriad threats they face in their mission to retake the realms, they have three things on their side: discipline, gutsy determination and their faith in Sigmar.

units.name: Freeguild Grenadiers

abilities.name: Cinders and Ashes
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit contains a **Cindergout**, pick a terrain feature or objective contested by this unit, then pick any enemy units contesting that terrain feature or objective to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Freeguild Grenadiers carry specialised gear that allows them to reduce a dug-in enemy to a panicked, screaming bonfire of melting flesh and charred hair.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced

units.lore: Experts in close-quarters combat, the Freeguild Grenadiers are always the first into the breach. Outfitted with the finest blackpowder weapons, flame-hurlers and deadly polearms, they rely on overwhelming force to reduce their enemies to charred corpses and smouldering piles of ash.

units.name: Freeguild Command Corps Adjutants

abilities.name: Freeguild Adjutants
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SIGMARITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit and **under orders** to be the target.

Effect: If this unit is in combat, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

Add 5 to the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The adjutants’ trumpets and bellowed speeches are a clarion call to victory for hard-pressed Freeguilders.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: A Freeguild officer's adjutants stand ready to assist them in their martial duties. Arch-Knights employ years of hard-won experience and ruthless skill to ensure that no foe gets within a dozen yards of their superior, while Great Heralds and Mascot Gargoylians embody the fighting spirit of the regiment, encouraging the rank and file to victory in Sigmar's name.

units.name: Battlemage on Celestial Hurricanum

abilities.name: Storm of Shemtek
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Make a number of D3 rolls equal to the current battle round number. For each 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: A Celestial Hurricanum can summon a magical storm to batter the foe with the fury of the heavens. As the battle rages, the tempest grows ever stronger.

abilities.name: Portents of Battle
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **CITIES OF SIGMAR** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Celestial Hurricanums leak magical energy, granting nearby soldiers visions of the imminent future that allow them to land their blows with uncanny accuracy.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Celestial Battlemages harness the cosmic power of High Azyr to bring down storms and send arcs of lightning cascading through the ranks of the enemy, unleashing raw elemental power that is terrible to witness.

units.name: Executioners

abilities.name: Severing Strike
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, this unit’s melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)**.
abilities.lore: Heads roll and crimson arcs of hot blood spurt into the air as these warriors swing their deadly blades.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: T hese skull-masked killers are the most feared warriors of the Darkling Covens. True virtuosos of slaughter, they have mastered the art of severing heads with every swing of their curved Executioner’s draichs.

units.name: Battlemage

abilities.name: Protective Focus
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a **SPELL** ability that this unit can use. For the rest of the battle, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit if it miscasts that spell.
abilities.lore: Such is this Battlemage’s unwavering concentration on one facet of their arcane arsenal that it renders them immune to the adverse effects of spellcasting.

details.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

units.lore: Masters of the arcane arts, the grizzled Battlemages of the Collegiate Arcane summon lethal storms of magic to lay waste to their foes and shield their comrades from harm with protective enchantment.

battleTraits.name: Destined for Battle
battleTraits.phase: Reaction: You declared a **CHARGE** ability for a **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit in your turn
battleTraits.description:
Used By: The unit using that **CHARGE** ability.

Effect: Spend any number of **fate points**. For each **fate point** you spend, add 1 to the charge roll for that **CHARGE** ability.
battleTraits.lore: Hand-to-hand combat is a crude pursuit, but it has its uses.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Disciples of Tzeentch armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Silver Simulacrum
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.description:
Effect: If there is a friendly **Argent Shard** on the battlefield, you can set up 1 additional **Argent Shard** on the battlefield. It must be set up wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.

**Designer’s Note:** *The original Argent Shard is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*
battleTraits.lore: Like some amorphous organism, an Argent Shard splits in two to double its arcane potency.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Disciples of Tzeentch armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Smoke and Mirrors
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**MONSTER DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit that was not set up this turn and was not set up using this ability in the previous turn to be the target, then pick a friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** to be the substitute.

Effect: Set up the substitute wholly within 6" of the target and not in combat. Then, remove the target from the battlefield and set it up in reserve **masked by illusion**.
battleTraits.lore: With sudden and terrible clarity, Tzeentch’s foes realise they have been fighting the wrong enemy all along.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Disciples of Tzeentch armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Destined Arcana
battleTraits.phase: Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit
battleTraits.description:
Used By: The unit using that **SPELL** ability.

Effect: Spend any number of **fate points**. For each **fate point** you spend, add 1 to the casting roll for that spell.
battleTraits.lore: Tzeentch imbues the spell with a fraction of his limitless arcane might.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Disciples of Tzeentch armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Eldritch Illusions
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-**MONSTER DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units on the battlefield to be the targets.

Effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up in reserve **masked by illusion**.

Friendly units that are **masked by illusion** are destroyed at the end of the fifth battle round and not at the start of the fourth battle round.
battleTraits.lore: The Disciples of Tzeentch delight in spreading confusion amongst their foes with cunningly woven glamours.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Disciples of Tzeentch armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: All Part of the Plan
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description:
Effect: You start the battle with 0 **fate points**.
Gain 1 **fate point** each time:

• You lose the priority roll.
• A spell cast by a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit is unbound.
• A friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit miscasts a spell.
• Your opponent gains control of an objective that you controlled at the start of the turn.
• A friendly **Argent Shard** is **demolished**.
battleTraits.lore: Tzeentch is all-seeing and all-knowing, and even setbacks may ultimately serve his destined ends.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Disciples of Tzeentch armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Destined to Serve
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description: Effect: Before allocating damage points to a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit, you can spend any number of **fate points**. For each **fate point** you spend, remove 1 damage point in that unit’s damage pool.
battleTraits.lore: Those chosen by the Change God are not permitted to fall until they have served their fated purpose.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Disciples of Tzeentch armies can use the following abilities:

ability.name: Inevitable Ending
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a unit (friendly or enemy) to be the target.

Effect: If the target is destroyed this turn, gain 1 **fate point**.
ability.lore: It is the duty of some simply to die, for their lifeblood will grease the ever‑turning cogs of fate.

abilities.name: Inevitable Ending
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a unit (friendly or enemy) to be the target.

Effect: If the target is destroyed this turn, gain 1 **fate point**.
abilities.lore: It is the duty of some simply to die, for their lifeblood will grease the ever‑turning cogs of fate.

ability.name: Hideous Unpredictability
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** to be the target.

Effect: Set up the target wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
ability.lore: Tzeentch’s strange blessings allow his malformed servants to outmanoeuvre and outflank their prey.

abilities.name: Hideous Unpredictability
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** to be the target.

Effect: Set up the target wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Tzeentch’s strange blessings allow his malformed servants to outmanoeuvre and outflank their prey.

ability.name: Twist of Fate
ability.description:
Effect: Each time a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit uses an ability that requires you to spend 1 or more **fate points**, after that ability has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 4+, gain 1 **fate point**.

If you remove 1 or more damage points from the damage pool of a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit as a result of the ‘Destined to Serve’ ability, after the damage sequence for that unit has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 4+, gain 1 **fate point**.
ability.lore: Those who dwell within the Silver Towers are suffused by an aura of fate‑altering magic.

abilities.name: Twist of Fate
abilities.description:
Effect: Each time a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit uses an ability that requires you to spend 1 or more **fate points**, after that ability has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 4+, gain 1 **fate point**.

If you remove 1 or more damage points from the damage pool of a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit as a result of the ‘Destined to Serve’ ability, after the damage sequence for that unit has been resolved, roll a dice. On a 4+, gain 1 **fate point**.
abilities.lore: Those who dwell within the Silver Towers are suffused by an aura of fate‑altering magic.

ability.name: Cometh the Hour
ability.description: Effect: If you make a charge roll of 9+ for a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: As moment of preordained glory, these warriors attack with renewed zeal.

abilities.name: Cometh the Hour
abilities.description: Effect: If you make a charge roll of 9+ for a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: As moment of preordained glory, these warriors attack with renewed zeal.

heroicTraits.name: Devolving Aura
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if any damage points were allocated to the target this phase. On a 3+, the target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.
heroicTraits.lore: Enemies that stray close to this hero are stricken by hideous malformations.

heroicTraits.name: Silver Summoner
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**WARFLOCK ARCANITE** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) more than 9" from all enemy units and wholly within 12" of a friendly **ARGENT SHARD** that is visible to this unit.
heroicTraits.lore: This hero can channel an Argent Shard’s eldritch power to create uncanny simulacra of fallen warriors.

heroicTraits.name: Grand Illusionist
heroicTraits.description: Effect: If this unit was set up this turn, it can move D3". That move cannot pass through or end within the combat range of an enemy unit.
heroicTraits.lore: This hero is a supreme mountebank, able to fabricate convincing illusions that allow them to slip away undetected.

artefacts.name: Fate Slicer
artefacts.description: Effect: Gain 1 **fate point** if any models were slain by this unit this turn.
artefacts.lore: This curving crystal blade can cut a victim’s soul from the tapestry of fate.

artefacts.name: Cloaked in Wyrdflame
artefacts.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target this unit.
artefacts.lore: The bearer is engulfed in a wyrdflame blaze so intense that enemies shrink before it.

artefacts.name: Kairic Tome
artefacts.phase: Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit wholly within 6" of this unit
artefacts.description: Effect: Add 1 to or subtract 1 from the casting roll for that spell. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **SPELL** ability.
artefacts.lore: Said to be penned by the Fateweaver himself, this tome is filled with all manner of eldritch secrets.

aqshyArtefacts.name: The Five Verses of Volarian
aqshyArtefacts.description: Effect: This unit has a Move characteristic of 14" and has **FLY**.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: Upon reciting these stanzas, the reader is granted the gift of flight. Some acquire a Disc of Tzeentch; others sprout iridescent wings; others still find themselves propelled through the aether by an invisible force.

aqshyArtefacts.name: The Searing Eye
aqshyArtefacts.phase: Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for a DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH unit wholly within 12" of this unit
aqshyArtefacts.description:
Effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, roll a dice. If the roll is the same as any of the dice in the casting roll, that spell is miscast. Otherwise, add the roll to the casting roll.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: This unblinking orb is said to be the eye of a Lord of Change, its purpose as much to spy on potential rivals as to reward minions with foresight of future events.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Tome of Scorched Insight
aqshyArtefacts.phase: Reaction: You declared a non-SUMMON SPELL ability for this unit
aqshyArtefacts.description: Effect: Change the casting roll for that spell to a value of 12 that cannot be modified. That spell cannot be unbound and this unit cannot use that **SPELL** ability again for the rest of the battle.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: This book is a double-edged gift: it grants incredible arcane prowess but at a steep price, as the book slowly consumes the bearer’s own knowledge of magic.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Vision of Defiant Supremacy
aqshyEnhancements.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: If you won the priority roll this battle round and chose for your opponent to take the first turn or if your opponent seized the initiative this battle round, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: As the tide of battle turns, you and your brethren will find yourselves in the thick of the fighting, but you will have the upper hand.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: Visions of Fate are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO** non-**BEAST** **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units. A unit can only have 1 Vision of Fate.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Vision of Arcane Sacrifice
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Effect: While units (friendly or enemy) are within 6" of this unit:

• Add 1 to unbinding rolls for those units.
• Spells cast by those units are miscast on an unmodified casting roll of 4 or less.

The first time this unit is destroyed, gain D6 **fate points**.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: All around you, incantations will wither on lips and spells will backfire catastrophically – until the moment of your fated demise.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: Visions of Fate are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO** non-**BEAST** **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units. A unit can only have 1 Vision of Fate.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Vision of Destined Conquest
aqshyEnhancements.phase: Once Per Battle, Start of Your Turn
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Effect: If this unit is contesting an objective that you control that is wholly outside friendly territory:

• If you are the **underdog**, gain 1 **fate point** for each command point you have.
• If you are not the **underdog**, roll a dice for each command point you have. For each 3+, gain 1 **fate point**.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: The winds of fate will blow strong as you and your warriors overrun a site of import deep in enemy lands.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: Visions of Fate are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO** non-**BEAST** **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units. A unit can only have 1 Vision of Fate.

spells.name: Transformed to Spawn
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If any models are slain by this ability, you can pick a friendly **CHAOS SPAWN OF TZEENTCH** unit that is **masked by illusion** and set it up on the battlefield in combat with the target and not in combat with any other enemy units.
spells.lore: Tzeentch is the Changer of the Ways; to be in the presence of his minions risks being mutated into a Chaos Spawn.

spells.name: Bolt of Tzeentch
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.
spells.lore: This spell manifests as a prismatic beam of raw magic that tears its victims apart in a display of multispectral colour.

spells.name: Fold Reality
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then you can pick a friendly non-**MONSTER DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit wholly within 12" of the caster to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set the target up in reserve **masked by illusion.** Then, you can pick a friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** and set it up wholly within 12" of the caster or a friendly **Argent Shard** and more than 9" from all enemy units.

**Designer’s Note:** *Both parts of the effect are optional; you can carry out either part or both.*
spells.lore: The sorcerer contorts the very fabric of the cosmos, allowing their minions to slip from hither to thither in an eye-blink.

spells.name: Infernal Gateway
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll either 5 dice or a number of dice equal to the number of **fate points** you have. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
spells.lore: The sorcerer opens a portal to the Realm of Chaos, pulling enemies to their doom.

spells.name: Shield of Fate
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:
• ﻿﻿The target has **WARD (5+)**.
﻿﻿• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit.
spells.lore: There is little better protection than to be guided by destiny itself and to be defended by the very hand of fate.

spells.name: Wyrdflame Haze
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units are not visible to enemy units more than 12" from them while those friendly units are wholly within 12" of a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit that was set up in the same turn.
spells.lore: The caster causes the smoke from arcane blazes to linger on the battlefield, obscuring those lurking within.

manifestations.name: Burning Sigil of Tzeentch

abilities.name: Radiant Transmogrification
abilities.description:
Declare: This **MANIFESTATION** must use this ability in each hero phase. Pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 9" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the targets.

Effect: Roll 2 dice, pick either result, then apply the corresponding effect for the rest of the turn:
1: No effect.
2-3:  **Heal (D3)** each friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy target.
4: Friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** targets can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** ability in the same turn. Enemy targets cannot use **RUN** abilities.
5- Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** targets. Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy targets.
6- Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** targets. Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy targets.
abilities.lore: The Burning Sigil channels the energies of the Impossible Fortress; with each pulse comes a handful of blessings and curses as fickle as the bastion’s master.

manifestations.lore: Drizzling ectoplasm and daemonic fire, the conjured sigil of Tzeentch is so redolent with mutative energies that it can transform those around it into a thousand fleshy forms. To stand close by is to risk horrific transmogrification - though in the final reckoning of battle, some of these mutations are as much a blessing as they are a curse.

summonSpell.name: Summon Burning Sigil of Tzeentch
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Burning Sigil of Tzeentch** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Burning Sigil of Tzeentch** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
summonSpell.lore: Brief incantations in the Dark Tongue see these burning symbols of worship spark into reality.

manifestations.name: Tome of Eyes

abilities.name: Compendium of Dark Knowledge
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target.

Effect: The target can immediately use a **SPELL** ability from the Lore of Change or the Lore of Fate.

**Designer’s Note:** *That spell does not count towards the number of* **SPELL** *or* **BANISH** *abilities the target can use this phase.*
abilities.lore: As the Tome flicks through its endless pages, it peers into the minds of nearby mages and gives knowledge to the loyal.

manifestations.lore: By conjuring a Tome of Eyes, a spellcaster can read knowledge inscribed by daemonic forces as the Tome examines their essence in turn. Tzeentch’s sorcerers can invoke a dizzying variety of dangerous and devious magic by reading from the Tome’s smouldering pages, though they do so at the risk of their immortal soul.

summonSpell.name: Summon Tome of Eyes
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Tome of Eyes** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Tome of Eyes** wholly within 18" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: With a snap of the conjurer’s fingers, the Tome appears at their side from a spark of blue wyrdflame.

manifestations.name: Daemonic Simulacrum

abilities.name: Jaws of Fate
abilities.description: Effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Snapping Jaws** for each **fate point** you have.
abilities.lore: The more potent the aura of Tzeentchian magic, the more terrifyingly corporeal the Simulacrum’s teeth become.

manifestations.lore: The twin-headed monstrosity known as the Daemonic Simulacrum is not a true daemon but a living mirage, a manifestation of the duplicity and cunning of the Lords of Change that guide their Arcanite puppets to war. Though ephemeral, when these illusory creatures bite, they can tear away the minds of the foe to leave them drooling imbeciles.

summonSpell.name: Summon Daemonic Simulacrum
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Daemonic Simulacrum** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Daemonic Simulacrum** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: The wizard draws upon their understanding of change-lore to create a temporary portal for this mirage to enter the fray.
