abilities.name: Sorcerous Duplication
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

• If there is only 1 friendly **Argent Shard** on the battlefield, set up another **Argent Shard** wholly within 12" of this terrain feature, more than 1" from all other terrain features, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 9" from all enemy units.

• Remove this terrain feature from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 1" from all other terrain features, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Argent Shards do not obey the laws of reality. They can phase into and out of existence and split apart into two identical copies.

abilities.name: Magical Focus
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: The next time a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit uses a **SPELL** ability this phase, when picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from this terrain feature instead of from the caster, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to this terrain feature instead of to the caster for the purposes of the ‘Unbind’ ability.
abilities.lore: The Argent Shards act as channelling foci through which Tzeentch’s spellcasters can launch their devastating arcane bombardments.

terrain.lore: Twin splinters of sorcerous crystal chipped from the daemonic core of a Silver Tower, Argent Shards radiate the madness and mutative corruption of Tzeentch. Sorcerers of the Change God can draw from this potent font to fuel their spells. If one of these profane monuments is sundered it will split in two, ensuring that its reign of anarchy continues apace.

units.name: Chaos Spawn of Tzeentch

abilities.name: A Twisted Fate
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit must be deployed using this ability

Effect: Set up this unit in reserve **masked by illusion**. It has now been deployed.
abilities.lore: For some, their destiny is to become a mewling abomination – they just do not know it yet.

abilities.name: Waves of Mutation
abilities.description: Effect: Each time this unit or the replacement of this unit is destroyed, set up a replacement unit in reserve **masked by illusion.** Each friendly **Chaos Spawn of Tzeentch** unit can be replaced any number of times.
abilities.lore: There is no limit to Tzeentch’s appetite for change.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

units.lore: Tzeentch Chaos Spawn are, if anything, even more horrifically mutated than others of their kind. Altered at the whim of the Change God, they tear their prey limb from limb with their freakish array of claws, tentacles and hooked appendages.

units.name: Blue Horrors and Brimstone Horrors

abilities.name: Split Again
abilities.description:
Effect: Roll a dice for each **Blue Horror** model in this unit that is slain. For each 3+, if there are fewer **Brimstone Horrors** models in this unit than its starting size, you can add 1 **Brimstone Horrors** model to this unit.

**Designer’s Note:** *Dice are only rolled for Blue Horror models that are currently slain – models that have been slain and returned to this unit do not count until they are slain once more. When adding Brimstone Horrors to this unit, do not count slain Brimstone Horrors towards the maximum.*
abilities.lore: Should a Blue Horror meet its end at the hands of the enemy, it is capable of splitting itself into two lesser daemons.

abilities.name: Immolation
abilities.description: Effect: Slain Brimstone Horrors cannot be returned to this unit. When setting up a replacement unit for this unit, Brimstone Horror models are ignored when determining the number of models in this unit, and you cannot pick them to be set up.
abilities.lore: Brimstone Horrors are ephemeral things, swiftly self-immolating in an eye-searing blaze after a few delightful moments causing lethal mischief.

units.lore: Blue Horrors are grumbling daemons that despise existence and all who dwell within it, and they delight in burning it down. If they are destroyed, they transform into bounding Brimstone Horrors that continue to attack with mindless spite.

units.name: Magister on Disc of Tzeentch

abilities.name: Spellmaster
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a **WIZARD** within 30" of this unit and the casting roll equalled or exceeded the spell’s casting value and that spell has not been unbound
abilities.description:
Effect: Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved.

If the spell is unbound, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the phase.
abilities.lore: Tzeentch’s foremost mortal disciples are masters of magic, capable of absorbing powerful arcana to fuel their own spells.

abilities.name: Fates Converge
abilities.description: Effect: While you have 6 or more **fate points**, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **ARCANITE** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: As the paths of Tzeentch’s endless plots cross, the Magister imbues their warriors with a sense of destiny.

units.lore: Magisters are powerful sorcerers in service to Tzeentch. Filled with eldritch energies as they ride their Disc of Tzeentch, they unleash a magical onslaught to annihilate the foe, channelling the surging energies of change in order to redouble their own warriors’ attacks.

units.name: Fateskimmer, Herald of Tzeentch on Burning Chariot

weapons.name: Staff of Change and Ritual Dagger

abilities.name: Spread the Inferno
abilities.description: Effect: Companion weapons used by friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The Fateskimmer’s fiery determination to burn reality to ashes incites nearby daemons to a murderous frenzy.

abilities.name: Fuel for the Flames
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: If the target is destroyed this turn, before removing it from play, gain 1 **fate point**.
abilities.lore: Even the blazing ruin of its own kind serves a Fateskimmer’s ends, each death fuelling the spreading fires.

units.lore: Trailing flames and maniacal laughter, a Fateskimmer streaks across the skies on a Burning Chariot, the Screamers at the vehicle’s fore biting their prey as they speed by. This Herald of Tzeentch delights in spreading the sorcerous inferno of the Change God far and wide, and nearby daemons are swept up in its gleeful wake.

units.name: Tzaangor Enlightened on Foot

abilities.name: Vicious Protectors
abilities.description:
Effect: While there is a visible friendly **ARCANITE HERO** within this unit’s combat range:
•  Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target that friendly **ARCANITE HERO** .
• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks.
abilities.lore: As the fiercest of their kind, Tzaangor Enlightened are often tasked with protecting the leaders of the Arcanite Cults. Not only do they excel at slaying those who threaten their charges, but the disturbingly insightful taunts they constantly crow fill their foes with doubt, robbing their strikes of conviction.

details.notes:
Previously Tzaangor Enlightened.
This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027

units.lore: Tzaangor Enlightened are arrogant creatures, for they can see the lessons of the past as easily as mortals see daylight. They gleefully caw out the past mistakes of their enemies, unnerving them before moving in to capitalise with each blow

units.name: Changecaster, Herald of Tzeentch

weapons.name: Staff of Change and Ritual Dagger

abilities.name: Weapon Curse
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target was set up this turn. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target that unit have no effect.
abilities.lore: The Heralds known as Changecasters summon the lurid flames of Tzeentch to engulf their foes. These screaming, living torches are thus marked as the next targets to be annihilated by the Change God’s faithful.

abilities.name: Locus of Command
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
abilities.lore: Granted a fraction of Tzeentch’s authority, Changecasters anchor the battleline with their stern presence.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Tzeentchian Deceiver*.

units.lore: Loping into battle on foot, the sour-tempered Heralds known as Changecasters act as Tzeentch’s infantry generals, browbeating lesser entities into line. Their mere presence seems to strengthen nearby daemons’ connection to reality, while their powers of transmutation melt enemy blades and guns to bubbling liquid.

units.name: Curseling, Eye of Tzeentch

weapons.name: Staff of Tzeentch and Blazing Sword

abilities.name: With Spell and Sword
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, it can use a non-**SUMMON SPELL** ability as if it were your hero phase, as if that ability had the **UNLIMITED** keyword and as if this unit had not cast any spells this turn.
abilities.lore: The Curseling casts deadly spells even in the midst of blade-on-blade combat.

abilities.name: Armour-Bane Curse
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for combat attacks that target that unit until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The Tretchlet mutters an arcane hex, transforming the enemy’s armour into a molten, dripping ruin.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Arcanite Cabalist*.

units.lore: A Curseling is a potent warrior-mage imbued with daemonic power through a conjoined, spell-moulding Tretchlet. They love nothing more than overwhelming their foes with an arcane onslaught, melting their armour to liquid before dealing a killing blow.

units.name: The Changeling

abilities.name: Whispers of Treachery
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: The Changeling spreads thoughts of betrayal amongst the enemy, inciting a bitter spree of bloodshed.

abilities.name: Puckish Misdirection
abilities.description: Effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units can use the ‘Redeploy’ command even if they were set up in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The Changeling uses illusion and misdirection to mask the movements of its accomplices.

abilities.name: Arch-Deceiver
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is **masked by illusion**. Pick a model in a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit to be the target.

Effect: This unit can immediately use a **SPELL** ability. When it does so, measure the range and visibility of that **SPELL** ability from the target. The target is treated as the caster for the purpose of other abilities such as ‘Unbind’.
abilities.lore: None can detect the veil of the Changeling. Assuming the form of an ally, it sows arcane discord before vanishing.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Tzeentchian Deceiver*.

units.lore: A master of illusionary disguise, the Changeling hides amongst its quarry, sowing confusion amongst their ranks. Upon throwing aside its fleshly masquerade, the Changeling uses sorcery and its Trickster’s Staff to openly blast its foes.

units.name: Gaunt Summoner on Disc of Tzeentch

abilities.name: Arcane Imprisonment
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the unmodified casting roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed and cannot be replaced for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: Gaunt Summoners delight in banishing foes to their Silver Towers.

abilities.name: All Belongs to Tzeentch
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an objective you do not control and that you controlled earlier in the battle to be the target.

Effect: You control the target objective.
abilities.lore: The Gaunt Summoners have spent centuries remaking reality in their master’s image.

abilities.name: Masters of the Silver Towers
abilities.description: Effect: Enemy units cannot end a charge move within 1/2" of a friendly **Argent Shard** that is wholly within 12" of this unit and was set up on the battlefield in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Gaunt Summoners are attuned to the esoteric magic of the Argent Shards and can call upon their power to violently repulse charging foes.

units.lore: Tzeentch’s dreaded Gaunt Summoners often go to war atop a daemonic mount known as a Disc of Tzeentch, a flying platform from which they can unleash their most devastating and spectacular spells.

units.name: Tzaangor Skyfires

abilities.name: Destined Quarry
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it by this unit’s attacks this phase to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **WARFLOCK** units that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Skyfires often select a target to utterly obliterate and erase from the tapestry of fate.

abilities.name: Guided by the Future
abilities.description: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks.
abilities.lore: The attacks of these warriors are directed by glimpses of the future.

units.lore: Tzaangor Skyfires soar across the battlefield, raining death upon the foe. Able to catch glimpses of the future, the Skyfires send their Arrows of Fate on baffling trajectories, striking their target’s most vulnerable weak spots with confounding accuracy.

units.name: Flamers of Tzeentch

abilities.name: Capricious Wyrdflame
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.

Effect: The target has the **BURNING** keyword for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: The mutagenic fires expelled by Flamers are most drawn to those already ablaze with the potential for change.

abilities.name: Lingering Burns
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed. Pick any number of **BURNING** enemy units to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 1, the target no longer has the **BURNING** keyword. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Wyrdflame clings to the enemy, near impossible to quench as it agonisingly devours their bodies and souls.

units.lore: Bounding in a disturbing fashion, Flamers of Tzeentch spring towards the foe spouting the warpfires of Chaos. No natural flames, these conjurations twist and warp the victim’s flesh, unable to be quenched by either water or magical means as they eat through everything they touch.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Kairic Acolytes

abilities.name: Vulcharc
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **Kairic Acolytes** units for attacks that target that enemy unit.
abilities.lore: Some Kairic Acolytes train to see through the eyes of Vulcharcs, Tzeentch-touched avians that feed upon magic. These birds are often dispatched by their handlers to spy out a foe’s weaknesses, secrets that are duly shared with their fellow cultists to give them the advantage once battle is joined.

abilities.name: Empowered By Magic
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while this unit is wholly within 12" of any **MANIFESTATIONS** (friendly or enemy).
abilities.lore: Kairic Acolytes absorb power from roving arcane manifestations to strengthen their own bodies.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: Kairic Acolytes are the Change God’s most numerous mortal servants, and thousands of them exist secretly in cities such as Hammerhal Ghyra and Greywater Fastness. Though only human, they use arcane craft to swell their muscles and ignite their blades with sorcerous flames. Such rituals turn them into fearsome killers, and they leap into battle screaming praise to Tzeentch.

units.name: Fatemaster

abilities.name: Long in the Planning
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Spend 2 **fate points**. Then, pick a visible friendly Arcanite unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time an enemy unit ends a charge move within 3" of the target, you can remove the target from the battlefield and set it up in reserve **masked by illusion**.
abilities.lore: Carefully prepared deceptions and illusions pave the way for a merciless Arcanite assault.

abilities.name: Bound Retinue
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is **masked by illusion**. Pick up to 1 other friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** to be the target.

Effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up the target wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The Fatemaster’s Twistwing relays the locations of favoured followers, and when the uprising breaks out, it is these chosen blades who form an honour guard for their master.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Arcanite Cabalist*.

units.lore: The military masterminds of the Arcanite cults, Fatemasters are charismatic firebrands who weave plots and illusions to ensure their enemies’ annihilation. Their cursed glaive carves through flesh and metal with unnatural ease, while a loyal Twistwing familiar provides them with an unimpeded view of the battlefield.

units.name: Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch

abilities.name: Unnatural Heat
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this unit’s shooting attacks this phase to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Add the number of damage points allocated to the target this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks to the roll. On a 5+, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: An Exalted Flamer’s streams of warping fire melt armour to slag and devour defensive wards.

abilities.name: Heart of the Inferno
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 2 visible friendly **FLAMERS OF TZEENTCH** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the targets’ shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Exalted Flamer causes the fires of its lesser kin to reach truly horrific levels of intensity.

units.lore: An Exalted Flamer can project gouts of multicoloured flame, turning entire enemy units into piles of blackened bones. The shifting wyrdflame seems to have a mind of its own, forming hideous faces and ominous sigils with its tongues of fire.

units.name: Kairic Acolytes

abilities.name: Driven by Destiny
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Movement Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is more than 6" from all enemy units, it can move **X**", where **X** is the number of **fate points** you have. It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
abilities.lore: Willing pawns in the Change God’s schemes, Kairic Acolytes are driven by the winds of fate to wherever they can cause the most bloodshed and confusion.

units.lore: Kairic Acolytes are the chosen human cultists of Tzeentch. Each has sworn their immortal soul to the Architect of Fate in exchange for the promise of power. In death or in life, they serve their master’s constantly changing agenda.

units.name: Lord of Change

abilities.name: Summon Daemons of Tzeentch
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: To challenge the fractal plans of the Architect of Fate is to face strange daemons born from chaotic sorcery itself.

abilities.name: Temporal Manipulation
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick another visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit that was not set up this turn and that is wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase, but it must end that move closer to this unit.
abilities.lore: Lords of Change can alter the very flow of time, calling minions to their side in the blink of an eye.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 1 from its power level.

abilities.name: Locus of Impossibility
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit. In addition, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The aura of maddening instability surrounding Tzeentch’s greatest daemons fuels their own power whilst ensuring that foes can scarcely land a telling blow.

units.lore: The greatest of Tzeentch’s daemons, the Lords of Change shimmer with raw magic. With a flick of their claws, they can hurl foes into the nightmarish Realm of Chaos, blast enemies with wyrdfire or drive them insane with illusions and reality-warping spells.

units.name: Burning Chariot of Tzeentch

weapons.name: Flaming Maws and Blue Horrors’ Jabs

abilities.name: Fiery Death From Above
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 1, gain 1 **fate point**. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• This unit can immediately use a **RETREAT** ability as if it were your movement phase. No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by that **RETREAT** ability.
abilities.lore: The Burning Chariot barges through enemy lines, spreading flaming ruin in its wake.

units.lore: Drawn through the skies by a pair of Screamers, a Burning Chariot rides upon a wave of multicoloured flames that scorch all in its wake, while the Exalted Flamer that writhes and twists upon its back breathes out sheets of unnatural, billowing fire.

units.name: Screamers of Tzeentch

abilities.name: Drawn to Magic
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick an enemy **MANIFESTATION** to be the target. Then, make a charge roll of 3D6.

Effect: This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of the target. If it does so, this unit has charged.

Then, if this unit charged this turn, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy **MANIFESTATION** in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: These eldritch creatures like to feast upon arcane manifestations, which they hungrily pursue on sight.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

units.lore: Speeding blurs that leave shimmering trails of change-magic in the air, Screamers streak across the skies with a wailing cry. They slash those foes they pass with razor-sharp horns and fins, and they have a particular taste for enemy spells and conjurations.

units.name: Tzaangor Shaman

weapons.name: Staff of Change and Ritual Dagger

abilities.name: Wit of Beasts
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **MONSTER** or **CAVALRY** unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: The target’s melee weapons have the **Companion** weapon ability for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Shaman curses the enemy with an atavistic madness, causing them to see themselves as the beasts they ride – or as the beast within.

abilities.name: Avian Swiftness
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **ARCANITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The Shaman invests nearby allies with avian speed, allowing them to close with the foe in moments.

units.lore: Tzaangor Shamans are the most powerful of their bestial kind. Born amongst dark omens, they are favoured by the Architect of Fate and granted a daemonic Disc to raise them above their kin. They combine savage strength with instinctive magical prowess, a combination that few can resist.

units.name: Tzaangor Enlightened

abilities.name: All Too Predictable
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit charged this turn, pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the turn:

• This unit’s **Tzeentchian Spear and Vicious Beak** has **Crit (2 Hits)**.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Tzeentchian Spear and Vicious Beak**.
abilities.lore: The Enlightened are able to glimpse snapshots of their enemy’s past battles, giving them a vital edge in combat.

details.notes: Previously Tzaangor Enlightened on Discs of Tzeentch.

units.lore: Tzaangor Enlightened are arrogant creatures, for they can see the lessons of the past as easily as mortals see daylight. They gleefully exploit their prey’s weaknesses in battle, unnerving them with an uncanny understanding of their strategies before moving in to capitalise with a killing blow.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Ogroid Thaumaturge

abilities.name: Soul-Deep Devotion
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit is within a friendly non-**HERO ARCANITE** unit’s combat range:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**HERO ARCANITE** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
abilities.lore: Thaumaturges surround themselves with staunchly faithful cultists who are willing to sacrifice their souls in the defence of their sorcerous idol.

abilities.name: Wrath of the Thaumaturge
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly **ARCANITE** unit in combat to be the target.

Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target and in combat. This unit has charged.
abilities.lore: With a sweep of its staff, the Thaumaturge steps into a rift to the Crystal Labyrinth, only to re-emerge in the midst of foes who have had the temerity to assault its devotees.

details.notes:
This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Arcanite Cabalist*.
This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: An Ogroid Thaumaturge is a hulking brute whose size and terrible strength belies a masterful grasp of sorcery. Amongst the Arcanite Cults of the Jade Kingdoms, they are worshipped as living idols – a status they are all too willing to exploit. Their eldritch wards draw upon the souls of nearby cultists, immolating the weak whilst protecting the ogroid from harm.

units.name: Ogroid Thaumaturge

abilities.name: Thaumaturge Hunger
abilities.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a **SPELL** ability for a unit within 30" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can move 6". It can move into combat and must end that move closer to the caster. If this unit was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: The ogroid senses the coalescence of arcane motes and charges forth in search of this brewing power.

abilities.name: Arcane Absorption
abilities.description:
Effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** by this unit’s attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed:

• **Heal (7)** this unit.
• Add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle.

This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.
abilities.lore: Ogroid Thaumaturges feast upon the eldritch power of those they slay.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Arcanite Cabalist*.

units.lore: Combining bestial strength with dark occult powers, the Ogroid Thaumaturge is a deadly foe. With snarled invocations, it hurls blasts of devastating magic into the enemy ranks, absorbing the eldritch aura of those spellcasters or divine champions that it kills.

units.name: Tzaangors

abilities.name: Eldritch Raiders
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s attacks while it is wholly within enemy territory.
abilities.lore: Tzaangors plunge into enemy lands, desperately seeking the arcane trinkets and treasures they crave – as well as victims to be transformed in their own bird-like image.

units.lore: Tzaangors are savage, avian beastmen dedicated to Tzeentch and gifted with his dark blessings. Eager to impress their duplicitous god, the Tzaangors fight with lunatic energies, hoping to earn further gifts of change.

units.name: Kairos Fateweaver

abilities.name: Master of Destiny
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit has not already **engineered the outcome** this battle round, instead of making a casting roll, unbinding roll, banishment roll, hit roll, wound roll or save roll for a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit, this unit can **engineer the outcome**.

If the roll would have been a D6 roll, you can use a value of 6 for it that cannot be modified. If the roll would have been a 2D6 roll, you can use a value of 9 for it that cannot be modified.
abilities.lore: Kairos sees both past and future, granting him unchecked power of the fate of his victims.

abilities.name: Mastery of Magic
abilities.description: Effect: When you make a casting roll for this unit, you can change the lowest D6 to match the highest D6.
abilities.lore: To master the arcane is to embody Tzeentch’s designs.

abilities.name: Fateful Reverse
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:
• If the target charged in the same turn, friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units in combat with the target have Strike‑first.
• The target’s weapons cannot be affected by the **CHARGE (+1 DAMAGE)** weapon ability.
abilities.lore: Tzeentch’s oracle invades his enemies’ minds with false visions of victory, causing them to charge willingly to their doom.

abilities.name: Beacon of Sorcery
abilities.description:
Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls and unbinding rolls for friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARDS** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

In addition, if a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** wholly within 12" of this unit unbinds a spell, no command points are spent for that **WIZARD** to use the ‘Magical Intervention’ command in that phase.
abilities.lore: Spreading his arms, Kairos saturates the area with magic.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 1 from its power level.

units.lore: Kairos Fateweaver can see the past and the future, and he uses this ability to twist destiny to suit his own malevolent purposes. The twin‑headed terror is a master of magic known as the Oracle of Tzeentch – wherever he goes, change is sure to follow.

units.name: Jade Obelisk

abilities.name: Silver Monoliths
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit while it is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Argent Shard**.
abilities.lore: The Jade Obelisk draw power from Argent Shards to augment their defence, seeing them as sacred monuments to their deity’s glory.

abilities.name: Idolarc
abilities.description: Effect: This unit’s **Idolarc** is a token. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place its **Idolarc** next to it.
abilities.lore: Fashioned from crystal and given life by dark ritual, Idolarcs are the messengers of the Speaker in the Stone.

abilities.name: Chosen by the Stone
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has any models carrying an **Antithete Bow**, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, place the **Idolarcs** of all other friendly **Jade Obelisk** units next to their respective units. Then, place this unit’s **Idolarc** next to the target.

While a friendly **Idolarc** is next to an enemy unit, subtract 1" from that enemy unit’s Move characteristic for each **fate point** you have. This ability cannot reduce an enemy unit’s Move characteristic below half its unmodified value.
abilities.lore: The Jade Obelisk loose a cursed arrow at a chosen foe, marking them out to the Idolarc as a potential sacrifice to the Speaker in the Stone that must be detained.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: Cursed artificers skilled in stonecraft, the Jade Obelisk are acutely aware of their finite time as living flesh. They are single-minded in their purpose to desecrate the idols of false gods before their mortal bodies succumb to inevitable petrification.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Screamers of Tzeentch

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Imperilling Slashes
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Screamers’ sharp fins and horns slice apart shields and armour as if they were parchment, leaving the foe vulnerable to attack.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Flocks of Screamers glide above the battlefields of Aqshy, swooping and soaring through the ash-choked skies with undulating grace before descending to feast upon the flesh of the warriors battling below.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Ogroid Thaumaturge

abilities.name: Wrath of the Thaumaturge
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly **ARCANITE** unit in combat to be the target.

Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target and in combat. This unit has charged.
abilities.lore: With a sweep of its staff, the Thaumaturge steps into a rift to the Crystal Labyrinth, only to re-emerge in the midst of foes who have had the temerity to assault its devotees.

abilities.name: Soul-Deep Devotion
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit is within a friendly non‐**HERO ARCANITE** unit’s combat range:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**HERO ARCANITE** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
abilities.lore: Thaumaturges surround themselves with staunchly faithful cultists who are willing to sacrifice their souls in the defence of their sorcerous idol.

details.notes:
This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Arcanite Cabalist*.

This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Creatures of magic as well as brawn, Ogroid Thaumaturges are proud of their cerebral gifts, and many Arcanite cults in the Bright Realm worship them as living idols. Nevertheless, at heart, they are hulking monsters, ever ready to rip and impale the foe with their colossal horns.

units.name: Magister

abilities.name: Spellmaster
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a **WIZARD** within 30" of this unit and the casting roll equalled or exceeded the spell’s casting value and that spell has not been unbound
abilities.description:
Effect: Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved.

If the spell is unbound, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the phase.
abilities.lore: Magisters are attuned to magical energy and can harness the raw essence of Chaos. There are those however, that delve too deep into this source of power.

abilities.name: Imbued With Arcane Fire
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **ARCANITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: The target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The Magister sets their allies’ blades ablaze with deadly wyrdflame that can melt through steel.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Arcanite Cabalist*.

units.lore: As a central figure of the cabal that leads an Arcanite cult, a Magister will use all their fell powers to inflict change and ruin upon the Mortal Realms in the name of the Great Conspirator. Those who enter battle on foot are master enchanters who can imbue their allies’ blades with arcane flames.

units.name: Gaunt Summoner

abilities.name: Leaden Limbs
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Effect: Until the start of your next turn:

• Halve the target’s Move characteristic.
• The effects of the ‘Fly’ ability do not apply to the target.
abilities.lore: The Gaunt Summoner turns the bones of their foes to heavy lead, slowing them to a pained crawl.

abilities.name: Masters of the Silver Towers
abilities.description: Effect: Enemy units cannot end a charge move within 1/2" of a friendly **Argent Shard** that is wholly within 12" of this unit and was set up on the battlefield in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Gaunt Summoners are attuned to the esoteric magic of the Argent Shards and can call upon their power to violently repulse charging foes.

abilities.name: All Belongs to Tzeentch
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an objective you do not control and that you controlled earlier in the battle to be the target.

Effect: You control the target objective.
abilities.lore: The Gaunt Summoners have spent centuries remaking reality in their master’s image.

units.lore: To the daemonic Gaunt Summoners, reality is but a plaything to be mutilated and twisted according to the desires of Almighty Tzeentch. Gazing into infinity with myriad glistening eyes, these lords of the Silver Towers devastate the enemy with their master spellcraft.

units.name: Pink Horrors

abilities.name: Lunatic Demise
abilities.description:
Effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain, before removing the model from play, pick 1 of the following effects:

***Split:*** Pick a visible friendly **BLUE HORRORS AND BRIMSTONE HORRORS** unit within 12" of this unit. Return up to 2 slain **Blue Horror** models to that unit.

***Petty Vengeance:*** Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target, then roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Should a Pink Horror be slain, it is capable of bursting into two smaller daemons or else detonating in a blast of wyrdflame.

units.lore: Gibbering and warbling, the luminescent Pink Horrors whirl and flail, generating raw magic that can manifest as blasts of unnatural fire that scour the enemy. Should they be slain, Pink Horrors can split in twain to form two lesser incarnations.

armiesOfRenown.name: Change-Cult Uprising
armiesOfRenown.description: There are a thousand Arcanite cults across the Mortal Realms, ranging from a handful of hidden conspirators to entire civilian underclasses who simply await the command of their leaders to begin their long-awaited purge. The greatest of these secret collectives are overseen by charismatic masterminds chosen by the Change God for their cruel cunning and boundless ambition. These Fatemasters and Magisters hold the fates of thousands in their grasping hands. They have learnt from their master how best to exploit the weaknesses and sins of mortals in order to see Tzeentch's will carried out.
armiesOfRenown.lore:
There are a thousand Arcanite cults across the Mortal Realms, ranging from a handful of hidden conspirators to entire civilian underclasses who simply await the command of their leaders to begin their long-awaited purge. The greatest of these secret collectives are overseen by charismatic masterminds chosen by the Change God for their cruel cunning and boundless ambition. These Fatemasters and Magisters hold the fates of thousands in their grasping hands. They have learnt from their master how best to exploit the weaknesses and sins of mortals in order to see Tzeentch's will carried out.

When you pick the Disciples of Tzeentch faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Change-cult Uprising Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Disciples of Tzeentch faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box as described in Army of Renown: Change-Cult Uprising. All units in your army gain the **CHANGE-CULT** keyword.
armiesOfRenown.source: Army of Renown: Change-Cult Uprising

battleTraits.name: Puppet on a String
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** within 24" of and visible to a friendly **CHANGE-CULT HERO** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target uses a **CORE** ability, gain 1 **fate point**.

**Designer’s Note:** *You can only gain fate points using this ability and the ‘Spell-eater Pendant’ ability.*
battleTraits.lore: Whether they know it or not, the enemy hero serves the will of Tzeentch.

battleTraits.name: Illusory Infiltration
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-reinforced **CHANGE-CULT KAIRIC ACOLYTES** units to be the targets.

Effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and not in combat.
battleTraits.lore: Cunning glamours conceal the advance of Kairic cultists.

battleTraits.name: Overtaken by Events
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Spend 1 **fate point**. Then, pick an enemy unit within 24" of and visible to a friendly **CHANGE‑CULT HERO** to be the target.

Effect: The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
battleTraits.lore: Stricken by indecision, the enemy’s leader flails helplessly.

battleTraits.name: Seeds of Discord
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Spend 1 **fate point**. Then, pick an enemy model within 24" of and visible to a friendly **CHANGE-CULT HERO** to be the target, then pick another enemy unit within the target’s combat range to be the victim.

Effect: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. Immediately resolve combat attacks for the target made with that weapon against the victim.
battleTraits.lore: Cunning lies and misdirections cause infighting amongst the foe.

battleTraits.name: Silver Simulacrum
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.description:
Effect: If there is a friendly **Argent Shard** on the battlefield, you can set up 1 additional **Argent Shard** on the battlefield. It must be set up wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.

**Designer’s Note:** *The original Argent Shard is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*
battleTraits.lore: Like some amorphous organism, an Argent Shard splits in two to double its arcane potency.

heroicTraits.name: Call of Anarchy
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a terrain feature within 18" of this unit, then pick a friendly non-**HERO CHANGE-CULT** unit that is **masked by illusion** or that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: If you picked a unit that is **masked by illusion**, set it up wholly within 3" of that terrain feature and more than 6" from all enemy units.

If you picked a unit that has been destroyed, set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 3" of that terrain feature and more than 6" from all enemy units.

**Designer’s Note:** *Units can be set up in reserve masked by illusion using the Fatemaster’s ‘Long in the Planning’ ability.*
heroicTraits.lore: As the uprising swells, its architect calls forth more cultists to join the anarchy.

artefacts.name: Spell-Eater Pendant
artefacts.description: Effect: Each time this unit unbinds a spell or banishes an enemy **MANIFESTATION**, gain 1 **fate point**.
artefacts.lore: This amulet devours magic and channels it to empower its bearer.

spells.name: Eldritch Strength
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CHANGE-CULT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **CHANGE-CULT** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.
spells.lore: The caster imbues their minions with supernatural might.

manifestations.name: Daemonic Simulacrum

abilities.name: Jaws of Fate
abilities.description: Effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Snapping Jaws** for each **fate point** you have.
abilities.lore: The more potent the aura of Tzeentchian magic, the more terrifyingly corporeal the Simulacrum’s teeth become.

manifestations.lore: The twin-headed monstrosity known as the Daemonic Simulacrum is not a true daemon but a living mirage, a manifestation of the duplicity and cunning of the Lords of Change that guide their Arcanite puppets to war. Though ephemeral, when these illusory creatures bite, they can tear away the minds of the foe to leave them drooling imbeciles.

summonSpell.name: Shifting Manifestations
summonSpell.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CHANGE-CULT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly **MANIFESTATIONS** below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

**• Burning Sigil of Tzeentch**
**• Daemonic Simulacrum**
**• Tome of Eyes**

Effect: If there is already a friendly **MANIFESTATION** from the list above on the battlefield, it is immediately banished and removed from play. Then, set up the **MANIFESTATION** you picked within 1" of the caster and visible to them.
summonSpell.lore: In the blink of an eye, the caster banishes one manifestation and uses its power to bring forth another.

manifestations.name: Burning Sigil of Tzeentch

abilities.name: Radiant Transmogrification
abilities.description:
Declare: This **MANIFESTATION** must use this ability in each hero phase. Pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 9" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the targets.

Effect: Roll 2 dice, pick either result, then apply the corresponding effect for the rest of the turn:
1: No effect.
2-3:  **Heal (D3)** each friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy target.
4: Friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** targets can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** ability in the same turn. Enemy targets cannot use **RUN** abilities.
5- Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** targets. Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy targets.
6- Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** targets. Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy targets.
abilities.lore: The Burning Sigil channels the energies of the Impossible Fortress; with each pulse comes a handful of blessings and curses as fickle as the bastion’s master.

manifestations.lore: Drizzling ectoplasm and daemonic fire, the conjured sigil of Tzeentch is so redolent with mutative energies that it can transform those around it into a thousand fleshy forms. To stand close by is to risk horrific transmogrification - though in the final reckoning of battle, some of these mutations are as much a blessing as they are a curse.

summonSpell.name: Shifting Manifestations
summonSpell.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CHANGE-CULT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly **MANIFESTATIONS** below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

**• Burning Sigil of Tzeentch**
**• Daemonic Simulacrum**
**• Tome of Eyes**

Effect: If there is already a friendly **MANIFESTATION** from the list above on the battlefield, it is immediately banished and removed from play. Then, set up the **MANIFESTATION** you picked within 1" of the caster and visible to them.
summonSpell.lore: In the blink of an eye, the caster banishes one manifestation and uses its power to bring forth another.

manifestations.name: Tome of Eyes

abilities.name: Compendium of Dark Knowledge
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target.

Effect: The target can immediately use a **SPELL** ability from the Lore of Change or the Lore of Fate.

**Designer’s Note:** *That spell does not count towards the number of* **SPELL** *or* **BANISH** *abilities the target can use this phase.*
abilities.lore: As the Tome flicks through its endless pages, it peers into the minds of nearby mages and gives knowledge to the loyal.

manifestations.lore: By conjuring a Tome of Eyes, a spellcaster can read knowledge inscribed by daemonic forces as the Tome examines their essence in turn. Tzeentch’s sorcerers can invoke a dizzying variety of dangerous and devious magic by reading from the Tome’s smouldering pages, though they do so at the risk of their immortal soul.

terrain.name: Argent Shard

abilities.name: Sorcerous Duplication
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

• If there is only 1 friendly **Argent Shard** on the battlefield, set up another **Argent Shard** wholly within 12" of this terrain feature, more than 1" from all other terrain features, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 9" from all enemy units.

• Remove this terrain feature from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 1" from all other terrain features, more than 3" from all objectives and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Argent Shards do not obey the laws of reality. They can phase into and out of existence and split apart into two identical copies.

abilities.name: Magical Focus
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: The next time a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit uses a **SPELL** ability this phase, when picking targets for that spell, you can measure range and visibility from this terrain feature instead of from the caster, and your opponent can measure range and visibility to this terrain feature instead of to the caster for the purposes of the ‘Unbind’ ability.
abilities.lore: The Argent Shards act as channelling foci through which Tzeentch’s spellcasters can launch their devastating arcane bombardments.

terrain.lore: Twin splinters of sorcerous crystal chipped from the daemonic core of a Silver Tower, Argent Shards radiate the madness and mutative corruption of Tzeentch. Sorcerers of the Change God can draw from this potent font to fuel their spells. If one of these profane monuments is sundered it will split in two, ensuring that its reign of anarchy continues apace.

units.name: Magister on Disc of Tzeentch

abilities.name: Spellmaster
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a **WIZARD** within 30" of this unit and the casting roll equalled or exceeded the spell’s casting value and that spell has not been unbound

Effect: Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved.

If the spell is unbound, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the phase.
abilities.lore: Tzeentch’s foremost mortal disciples are masters of magic, capable of absorbing powerful arcana to fuel their own spells.

abilities.name: Fates Converge
abilities.description: Effect: While you have 6 or more **fate points**, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **ARCANITE** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: As the paths of Tzeentch’s endless plots cross, the Magister imbues their warriors with a sense of destiny.

units.lore: Magisters are powerful sorcerers in service to Tzeentch. Filled with eldritch energies as they ride their Disc of Tzeentch, they unleash a magical onslaught to annihilate the foe, channelling the surging energies of change in order to redouble their own warriors’ attacks.

units.name: Curseling, Eye of Tzeentch

weapons.name: Staff of Tzeentch and Blazing Sword

abilities.name: With Spell and Sword
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, it can use a non-**SUMMON SPELL** ability as if it were your hero phase, as if that ability had the **UNLIMITED** keyword and as if this unit had not cast any spells this turn.
abilities.lore: The Curseling casts deadly spells even in the midst of blade-on-blade combat.

abilities.name: Armour-Bane Curse
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for combat attacks that target that unit until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The Tretchlet mutters an arcane hex, transforming the enemy’s armour into a molten, dripping ruin.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Arcanite Cabalist*.

units.lore: A Curseling is a potent warrior-mage imbued with daemonic power through a conjoined, spell-moulding Tretchlet. They love nothing more than overwhelming their foes with an arcane onslaught, melting their armour to liquid before dealing a killing blow.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Kairic Acolytes

abilities.name: Vulcharc
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **Kairic Acolytes** units for attacks that target that enemy unit.
abilities.lore: Some Kairic Acolytes train to see through the eyes of Vulcharcs, Tzeentch-touched avians that feed upon magic. These birds are often dispatched by their handlers to spy out a foe’s weaknesses, secrets that are duly shared with their fellow cultists to give them the advantage once battle is joined.

abilities.name: Empowered By Magic
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while this unit is wholly within 12" of any **MANIFESTATIONS** (friendly or enemy).
abilities.lore: Kairic Acolytes absorb power from roving arcane manifestations to strengthen their own bodies.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: Kairic Acolytes are the Change God’s most numerous mortal servants, and thousands of them exist secretly in cities such as Hammerhal Ghyra and Greywater Fastness. Though only human, they use arcane craft to swell their muscles and ignite their blades with sorcerous flames. Such rituals turn them into fearsome killers, and they leap into battle screaming praise to Tzeentch.

units.name: Fatemaster

abilities.name: Long in the Planning
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Spend 2 **fate points**. Then, pick a visible friendly Arcanite unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time an enemy unit ends a charge move within 3" of the target, you can remove the target from the battlefield and set it up in reserve **masked by illusion**.
abilities.lore: Carefully prepared deceptions and illusions pave the way for a merciless Arcanite assault.

abilities.name: Bound Retinue
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is **masked by illusion**. Pick up to 1 other friendly unit that is **masked by illusion** to be the target.

Effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up the target wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The Fatemaster’s Twistwing relays the locations of favoured followers, and when the uprising breaks out, it is these chosen blades who form an honour guard for their master.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Arcanite Cabalist*.

units.lore: The military masterminds of the Arcanite cults, Fatemasters are charismatic firebrands who weave plots and illusions to ensure their enemies’ annihilation. Their cursed glaive carves through flesh and metal with unnatural ease, while a loyal Twistwing familiar provides them with an unimpeded view of the battlefield.

units.name: Kairic Acolytes

abilities.name: Driven by Destiny
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Movement Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is more than 6" from all enemy units, it can move **X**", where **X** is the number of **fate points** you have. It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
abilities.lore: Willing pawns in the Change God’s schemes, Kairic Acolytes are driven by the winds of fate to wherever they can cause the most bloodshed and confusion.

units.lore: Kairic Acolytes are the chosen human cultists of Tzeentch. Each has sworn their immortal soul to the Architect of Fate in exchange for the promise of power. In death or in life, they serve their master’s constantly changing agenda.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Ogroid Thaumaturge

abilities.name: Soul-Deep Devotion
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit is within a friendly non-**HERO ARCANITE** unit’s combat range:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**HERO ARCANITE** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
abilities.lore: Thaumaturges surround themselves with staunchly faithful cultists who are willing to sacrifice their souls in the defence of their sorcerous idol.

abilities.name: Wrath of the Thaumaturge
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly **ARCANITE** unit in combat to be the target.

Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target and in combat. This unit has charged.
abilities.lore: With a sweep of its staff, the Thaumaturge steps into a rift to the Crystal Labyrinth, only to re-emerge in the midst of foes who have had the temerity to assault its devotees.

details.notes:
This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Arcanite Cabalist*.
This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: An Ogroid Thaumaturge is a hulking brute whose size and terrible strength belies a masterful grasp of sorcery. Amongst the Arcanite Cults of the Jade Kingdoms, they are worshipped as living idols – a status they are all too willing to exploit. Their eldritch wards draw upon the souls of nearby cultists, immolating the weak whilst protecting the ogroid from harm.

units.name: Ogroid Thaumaturge

abilities.name: Thaumaturge Hunger
abilities.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a **SPELL** ability for a unit within 30" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can move 6". It can move into combat and must end that move closer to the caster. If this unit was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: The ogroid senses the coalescence of arcane motes and charges forth in search of this brewing power.

abilities.name: Arcane Absorption
abilities.description:
Effect: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** by this unit’s attacks this turn and that enemy unit has been destroyed:

• **Heal (7)** this unit.
• Add 1 to this unit’s power level for the rest of the battle.

This unit can be affected by this ability multiple times and the effects are cumulative.
abilities.lore: Ogroid Thaumaturges feast upon the eldritch power of those they slay.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Arcanite Cabalist*.

units.lore: Combining bestial strength with dark occult powers, the Ogroid Thaumaturge is a deadly foe. With snarled invocations, it hurls blasts of devastating magic into the enemy ranks, absorbing the eldritch aura of those spellcasters or divine champions that it kills.

units.name: Jade Obelisk

abilities.name: Silver Monoliths
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit while it is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Argent Shard**.
abilities.lore: The Jade Obelisk draw power from Argent Shards to augment their defence, seeing them as sacred monuments to their deity’s glory.

abilities.name: Idolarc
abilities.description: Effect: This unit’s **Idolarc** is a token. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place its **Idolarc** next to it.
abilities.lore: Fashioned from crystal and given life by dark ritual, Idolarcs are the messengers of the Speaker in the Stone.

abilities.name: Chosen by the Stone
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has any models carrying an **Antithete Bow**, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, place the **Idolarcs** of all other friendly **Jade Obelisk** units next to their respective units. Then, place this unit’s **Idolarc** next to the target.

While a friendly **Idolarc** is next to an enemy unit, subtract 1" from that enemy unit’s Move characteristic for each **fate point** you have. This ability cannot reduce an enemy unit’s Move characteristic below half its unmodified value.
abilities.lore: The Jade Obelisk loose a cursed arrow at a chosen foe, marking them out to the Idolarc as a potential sacrifice to the Speaker in the Stone that must be detained.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: Cursed artificers skilled in stonecraft, the Jade Obelisk are acutely aware of their finite time as living flesh. They are single-minded in their purpose to desecrate the idols of false gods before their mortal bodies succumb to inevitable petrification.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Ogroid Thaumaturge

abilities.name: Wrath of the Thaumaturge
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly **ARCANITE** unit in combat to be the target.

Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target and in combat. This unit has charged.

• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**HERO ARCANITE** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).

details.notes:
This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Arcanite Cabalist*.

This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Creatures of magic as well as brawn, Ogroid Thaumaturges are proud of their cerebral gifts, and many Arcanite cults in the Bright Realm worship them as living idols. Nevertheless, at heart, they are hulking monsters, ever ready to rip and impale the foe with their colossal horns.

units.name: Magister

abilities.name: Spellmaster
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a **WIZARD** within 30" of this unit and the casting roll equalled or exceeded the spell’s casting value and that spell has not been unbound
abilities.description:
Effect: Make an unbinding roll of 2D6. If the roll exceeds the casting roll for the spell, the spell is unbound and its effect is not resolved.

If the spell is unbound, add 1 to casting rolls for this unit for the rest of the phase.
abilities.lore: Magisters are attuned to magical energy and can harness the raw essence of Chaos. There are those however, that delve too deep into this source of power.

abilities.name: Imbued With Arcane Fire
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **ARCANITE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: The target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The Magister sets their allies’ blades ablaze with deadly wyrdflame that can melt through steel.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Arcanite Cabalist*.

units.lore: As a central figure of the cabal that leads an Arcanite cult, a Magister will use all their fell powers to inflict change and ruin upon the Mortal Realms in the name of the Great Conspirator. Those who enter battle on foot are master enchanters who can imbue their allies’ blades with arcane flames.

armiesOfRenown.name: The Oracles of Fate
armiesOfRenown.description: The daemonic convocations of the Change God are a reflection of their master’s bizarre nature. These sorcerous armies are led by daemons for whom Tzeentch bears a particular fondness. Whether they be masters of intrigue, deranged fire-starters or mutators of living flesh, they all exist solely to bring about the Architect of Fate’s vision of endless, violent alteration.
armiesOfRenown.lore:
The daemonic convocations of the Change God are a reflection of their master’s bizarre nature. These sorcerous armies are led by daemons for whom Tzeentch bears a particular fondness. Whether they be masters of intrigue, deranged fire-starters or mutators of living flesh, they all exist solely to bring about the Architect of Fate’s vision of endless, violent alteration.

When you pick the Disciples of Tzeentch faction for your army, you can choose for it to be the Oracles of Fate Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Disciples of Tzeentch faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box as described in Army of Renown: The Oracles of Fate All units in your army gain the **ORACLES OF FATE** keyword
roster: Fateskimmer, Herald of Tzeentch on Burning Chariot
Gaunt Summoner on Disc of Tzeentch
Scourge of Aqshy: Screamers of Tzeentch
armiesOfRenown.source: Army of Renown: The Oracles of Fate

battleTraits.name: Ninefold Blessings
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Your Turn
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if the total value of your unspent **destiny dice** is exactly 9.

Effect: Re-roll all of your unspent **destiny dice**. Then, until the start of your next turn:

• Friendly **ORACLES OF FATE** units have **WARD (5+)**.
• Subtract 1 from save rolls for enemy units.

**Designer’s Note:** *Add together the values shown on each unspent destiny dice to find the total value.*
battleTraits.lore: Nine is the sacred number of Tzeentch and presages great victories and glories for his servants.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: The Oracles of Fate
battleTraits.groupName: The Oracles of Fate Battle Traits

battleTraits.name: Masters of Destiny
battleTraits.phase: Deployment Phase
battleTraits.description:
Effect: Roll 9 dice and place them to one side. These are your **destiny dice**. **Destiny dice** can be spent during the battle to change certain dice rolls. You can never have more than 9 **destiny dice** at once.

During the battle, instead of making a roll from the list below for a friendly **ORACLES OF FATE** unit, you can spend your **destiny dice**. The roll you would have made is replaced with the roll on the **destiny dice** you spend. If you want to replace a 2D6 roll, 3D6 roll, etc. you must spend a number of destiny dice equal to the number before ‘D6’. Any rolls that have been replaced count as unmodified rolls, and they cannot be re-rolled or modified by other friendly abilities except for those that apply negative modifiers (but they can be modified by enemy abilities). You cannot spend destiny dice to replace re-rolls.

**Destiny dice** can be spent in place of the following dice rolls:

• Casting rolls
• Unbinding rolls
• Banishment rolls
• Run rolls
• Charge rolls in your turn
• Hit rolls
• Wound rolls
• Save rolls
battleTraits.lore: To serve the Changer of the Ways is to instinctively understand the ebb and flow of future events and be able to manipulate their potential to the fullest.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: The Oracles of Fate
battleTraits.groupName: The Oracles of Fate Battle Traits

heroicTraits.name: Nexus of Fate
heroicTraits.description: Effect: Roll a dice. If you have 9 unspent **destiny dice**, you must replace 1 of your **destiny dice** with that roll. Otherwise, place that dice to one side as a **destiny dice**.
heroicTraits.lore: Tzeentch’s favoured servants manipulate what mortals consider ‘destiny’ as if it were a puppet.
heroicTraits.source: Army of Renown: The Oracles of Fate
heroicTraits.groupName: The Oracles of Fate Heroic Trait

artefacts.name: Corrupted Leystone
artefacts.description: Effect: If this unit is contesting an objective, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again contesting an objective and more than 7" from all enemy units.
artefacts.lore: This obsidian stone is attuned to sites of arcane power, allowing the bearer to teleport between ley lines.
artefacts.source: Army of Renown: The Oracles of Fate
artefacts.groupName: The Oracles of Fate Artefact of Power

spellLores.name: The Oracles of Fate Spell Lore

spells.name: Fateweaver's Gift
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ORACLES OF FATE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

***Change the Past:*** Pick an enemy unit within 12" of and visible to the caster, that is in combat and that has not been picked to be the target of this ability this turn to be the target. Roll either 4 dice or a number of dice equal to the number of unspent destiny dice you have. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
***Seize the Present:*** Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **ORACLES OF FATE** units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.
***Predict the Future:*** Roll a dice. You must replace 1 of your **destiny dice** with that roll.
spells.lore: Kairos can bestow his extraordinary insight into the past and future upon those he considers worthy.

manifestations.name: Daemonic Simulacrum

abilities.name: Jaws of Fate
abilities.description: Effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Snapping Jaws** for each **fate point** you have.
abilities.lore: The more potent the aura of Tzeentchian magic, the more terrifyingly corporeal the Simulacrum’s teeth become.

manifestations.lore: The twin-headed monstrosity known as the Daemonic Simulacrum is not a true daemon but a living mirage, a manifestation of the duplicity and cunning of the Lords of Change that guide their Arcanite puppets to war. Though ephemeral, when these illusory creatures bite, they can tear away the minds of the foe to leave them drooling imbeciles.

summonSpell.name: Shifting Manifestations
summonSpell.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ORACLES OF FATE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly Manifestations below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

**• Burning Sigil of Tzeentch**
**• Daemonic Simulacrum**
**• Tome of Eyes**

Effect: If there is already a friendly **MANIFESTATION** from the list above on the battlefield, it is immediately banished and removed from play. Then, set up the **MANIFESTATION** you picked within 1" of the caster and visible to them.
summonSpell.lore: In the blink of an eye, the caster banishes one manifestation and uses its power to bring forth another.

manifestations.name: Burning Sigil of Tzeentch

abilities.name: Radiant Transmogrification
abilities.description:
Declare: This **MANIFESTATION** must use this ability in each hero phase. Pick each unit (friendly and enemy) within 9" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the targets.

Effect: Roll 2 dice, pick either result, then apply the corresponding effect for the rest of the turn:
1: No effect.
2-3:  **Heal (D3)** each friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** target. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy target.
4: Friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** targets can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** ability in the same turn. Enemy targets cannot use **RUN** abilities.
5- Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** targets. Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy targets.
6- Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** targets. Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by enemy targets.
abilities.lore: The Burning Sigil channels the energies of the Impossible Fortress; with each pulse comes a handful of blessings and curses as fickle as the bastion’s master.

manifestations.lore: Drizzling ectoplasm and daemonic fire, the conjured sigil of Tzeentch is so redolent with mutative energies that it can transform those around it into a thousand fleshy forms. To stand close by is to risk horrific transmogrification - though in the final reckoning of battle, some of these mutations are as much a blessing as they are a curse.

summonSpell.name: Shifting Manifestations
summonSpell.description:

**• Daemonic Simulacrum**
**• Tome of Eyes**

summonSpell.lore: In the blink of an eye, the caster banishes one manifestation and uses its power to bring forth another.

manifestations.name: Tome of Eyes

abilities.name: Compendium of Dark Knowledge
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** within 3" of this Manifestation to be the target.

Effect: The target can immediately use a **SPELL** ability from the Lore of Change or the Lore of Fate.

**Designer’s Note:** *That spell does not count towards the number of* **SPELL** *or* **BANISH** *abilities the target can use this phase.*
abilities.lore: As the Tome flicks through its endless pages, it peers into the minds of nearby mages and gives knowledge to the loyal.

manifestations.lore: By conjuring a Tome of Eyes, a spellcaster can read knowledge inscribed by daemonic forces as the Tome examines their essence in turn. Tzeentch’s sorcerers can invoke a dizzying variety of dangerous and devious magic by reading from the Tome’s smouldering pages, though they do so at the risk of their immortal soul.
