summonSpell.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **ORACLES OF FATE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly Manifestations below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

**• Burning Sigil of Tzeentch**
**• Daemonic Simulacrum**
**• Tome of Eyes**

Effect: If there is already a friendly **MANIFESTATION** from the list above on the battlefield, it is immediately banished and removed from play. Then, set up the **MANIFESTATION** you picked within 1" of the caster and visible to them.
summonSpell.lore: In the blink of an eye, the caster banishes one manifestation and uses its power to bring forth another.

units.name: Blue Horrors and Brimstone Horrors

abilities.name: Split Again
abilities.description:
Effect: Roll a dice for each **Blue Horror** model in this unit that is slain. For each 3+, if there are fewer **Brimstone Horrors** models in this unit than its starting size, you can add 1 **Brimstone Horrors** model to this unit.

**Designer’s Note:** *Dice are only rolled for Blue Horror models that are currently slain – models that have been slain and returned to this unit do not count until they are slain once more. When adding Brimstone Horrors to this unit, do not count slain Brimstone Horrors towards the maximum.*
abilities.lore: Should a Blue Horror meet its end at the hands of the enemy, it is capable of splitting itself into two lesser daemons.

abilities.name: Immolation
abilities.description: Effect: Slain Brimstone Horrors cannot be returned to this unit. When setting up a replacement unit for this unit, Brimstone Horror models are ignored when determining the number of models in this unit, and you cannot pick them to be set up.
abilities.lore: Brimstone Horrors are ephemeral things, swiftly self-immolating in an eye-searing blaze after a few delightful moments causing lethal mischief.

units.lore: Blue Horrors are grumbling daemons that despise existence and all who dwell within it, and they delight in burning it down. If they are destroyed, they transform into bounding Brimstone Horrors that continue to attack with mindless spite.

units.name: Fateskimmer, Herald of Tzeentch on Burning Chariot

weapons.name: Staff of Change and Ritual Dagger

abilities.name: Spread the Inferno
abilities.description: Effect: Companion weapons used by friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The Fateskimmer’s fiery determination to burn reality to ashes incites nearby daemons to a murderous frenzy.

abilities.name: Fuel for the Flames
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: If the target is destroyed this turn, before removing it from play, gain 1 **fate point**.
abilities.lore: Even the blazing ruin of its own kind serves a Fateskimmer’s ends, each death fuelling the spreading fires.

units.lore: Trailing flames and maniacal laughter, a Fateskimmer streaks across the skies on a Burning Chariot, the Screamers at the vehicle’s fore biting their prey as they speed by. This Herald of Tzeentch delights in spreading the sorcerous inferno of the Change God far and wide, and nearby daemons are swept up in its gleeful wake.

units.name: Changecaster, Herald of Tzeentch

weapons.name: Staff of Change and Ritual Dagger

abilities.name: Weapon Curse
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target was set up this turn. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for attacks that target that unit have no effect.
abilities.lore: The Heralds known as Changecasters summon the lurid flames of Tzeentch to engulf their foes. These screaming, living torches are thus marked as the next targets to be annihilated by the Change God’s faithful.

abilities.name: Locus of Command
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
abilities.lore: Granted a fraction of Tzeentch’s authority, Changecasters anchor the battleline with their stern presence.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Tzeentchian Deceiver*.

units.lore: Loping into battle on foot, the sour-tempered Heralds known as Changecasters act as Tzeentch’s infantry generals, browbeating lesser entities into line. Their mere presence seems to strengthen nearby daemons’ connection to reality, while their powers of transmutation melt enemy blades and guns to bubbling liquid.

units.name: The Changeling

abilities.name: Whispers of Treachery
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: The Changeling spreads thoughts of betrayal amongst the enemy, inciting a bitter spree of bloodshed.

abilities.name: Puckish Misdirection
abilities.description: Effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units can use the ‘Redeploy’ command even if they were set up in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The Changeling uses illusion and misdirection to mask the movements of its accomplices.

abilities.name: Arch-Deceiver
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is **masked by illusion**. Pick a model in a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit to be the target.

Effect: This unit can immediately use a **SPELL** ability. When it does so, measure the range and visibility of that **SPELL** ability from the target. The target is treated as the caster for the purpose of other abilities such as ‘Unbind’.
abilities.lore: None can detect the veil of the Changeling. Assuming the form of an ally, it sows arcane discord before vanishing.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Tzeentchian Deceiver*.

units.lore: A master of illusionary disguise, the Changeling hides amongst its quarry, sowing confusion amongst their ranks. Upon throwing aside its fleshly masquerade, the Changeling uses sorcery and its Trickster’s Staff to openly blast its foes.

units.name: Gaunt Summoner on Disc of Tzeentch

abilities.name: Arcane Imprisonment
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the unmodified casting roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed and cannot be replaced for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: Gaunt Summoners delight in banishing foes to their Silver Towers.

abilities.name: All Belongs to Tzeentch
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an objective you do not control and that you controlled earlier in the battle to be the target.

Effect: You control the target objective.
abilities.lore: The Gaunt Summoners have spent centuries remaking reality in their master’s image.

abilities.name: Masters of the Silver Towers
abilities.description: Effect: Enemy units cannot end a charge move within 1/2" of a friendly **Argent Shard** that is wholly within 12" of this unit and was set up on the battlefield in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Gaunt Summoners are attuned to the esoteric magic of the Argent Shards and can call upon their power to violently repulse charging foes.

units.lore: Tzeentch’s dreaded Gaunt Summoners often go to war atop a daemonic mount known as a Disc of Tzeentch, a flying platform from which they can unleash their most devastating and spectacular spells.

units.name: Flamers of Tzeentch

abilities.name: Capricious Wyrdflame
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.

Effect: The target has the **BURNING** keyword for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: The mutagenic fires expelled by Flamers are most drawn to those already ablaze with the potential for change.

abilities.name: Lingering Burns
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can use this ability even if it has been destroyed. Pick any number of **BURNING** enemy units to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 1, the target no longer has the **BURNING** keyword. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Wyrdflame clings to the enemy, near impossible to quench as it agonisingly devours their bodies and souls.

units.lore: Bounding in a disturbing fashion, Flamers of Tzeentch spring towards the foe spouting the warpfires of Chaos. No natural flames, these conjurations twist and warp the victim’s flesh, unable to be quenched by either water or magical means as they eat through everything they touch.

units.name: Exalted Flamer of Tzeentch

abilities.name: Unnatural Heat
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that was targeted by this unit’s shooting attacks this phase to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Add the number of damage points allocated to the target this phase by this unit’s shooting attacks to the roll. On a 5+, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: An Exalted Flamer’s streams of warping fire melt armour to slag and devour defensive wards.

abilities.name: Heart of the Inferno
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 2 visible friendly **FLAMERS OF TZEENTCH** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the targets’ shooting attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Exalted Flamer causes the fires of its lesser kin to reach truly horrific levels of intensity.

units.lore: An Exalted Flamer can project gouts of multicoloured flame, turning entire enemy units into piles of blackened bones. The shifting wyrdflame seems to have a mind of its own, forming hideous faces and ominous sigils with its tongues of fire.

units.name: Lord of Change

abilities.name: Summon Daemons of Tzeentch
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: To challenge the fractal plans of the Architect of Fate is to face strange daemons born from chaotic sorcery itself.

abilities.name: Temporal Manipulation
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick another visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit that was not set up this turn and that is wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase, but it must end that move closer to this unit.
abilities.lore: Lords of Change can alter the very flow of time, calling minions to their side in the blink of an eye.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 1 from its power level.

abilities.name: Locus of Impossibility
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit. In addition, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH DAEMON** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The aura of maddening instability surrounding Tzeentch’s greatest daemons fuels their own power whilst ensuring that foes can scarcely land a telling blow.

units.lore: The greatest of Tzeentch’s daemons, the Lords of Change shimmer with raw magic. With a flick of their claws, they can hurl foes into the nightmarish Realm of Chaos, blast enemies with wyrdfire or drive them insane with illusions and reality-warping spells.

units.name: Burning Chariot of Tzeentch

weapons.name: Flaming Maws and Blue Horrors’ Jabs

abilities.name: Fiery Death From Above
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick a visible enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 1, gain 1 **fate point**. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• This unit can immediately use a **RETREAT** ability as if it were your movement phase. No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by that **RETREAT** ability.
abilities.lore: The Burning Chariot barges through enemy lines, spreading flaming ruin in its wake.

units.lore: Drawn through the skies by a pair of Screamers, a Burning Chariot rides upon a wave of multicoloured flames that scorch all in its wake, while the Exalted Flamer that writhes and twists upon its back breathes out sheets of unnatural, billowing fire.

units.name: Screamers of Tzeentch

abilities.name: Drawn to Magic
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick an enemy **MANIFESTATION** to be the target. Then, make a charge roll of 3D6.

Effect: This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units and must end that move within 1/2" of the target. If it does so, this unit has charged.

Then, if this unit charged this turn, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy **MANIFESTATION** in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: These eldritch creatures like to feast upon arcane manifestations, which they hungrily pursue on sight.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

units.lore: Speeding blurs that leave shimmering trails of change-magic in the air, Screamers streak across the skies with a wailing cry. They slash those foes they pass with razor-sharp horns and fins, and they have a particular taste for enemy spells and conjurations.

units.name: Kairos Fateweaver

abilities.name: Master of Destiny
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit has not already **engineered the outcome** this battle round, instead of making a casting roll, unbinding roll, banishment roll, hit roll, wound roll or save roll for a visible friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** unit wholly within 12" of this unit, this unit can **engineer the outcome**.

If the roll would have been a D6 roll, you can use a value of 6 for it that cannot be modified. If the roll would have been a 2D6 roll, you can use a value of 9 for it that cannot be modified.
abilities.lore: Kairos sees both past and future, granting him unchecked power of the fate of his victims.

abilities.name: Mastery of Magic
abilities.description: Effect: When you make a casting roll for this unit, you can change the lowest D6 to match the highest D6.
abilities.lore: To master the arcane is to embody Tzeentch’s designs.

abilities.name: Fateful Reverse
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:
• If the target charged in the same turn, friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH** units in combat with the target have Strike‑first.
• The target’s weapons cannot be affected by the **CHARGE (+1 DAMAGE)** weapon ability.
abilities.lore: Tzeentch’s oracle invades his enemies’ minds with false visions of victory, causing them to charge willingly to their doom.

abilities.name: Beacon of Sorcery
abilities.description:
Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls and unbinding rolls for friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARDS** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

In addition, if a friendly **DISCIPLES OF TZEENTCH WIZARD** wholly within 12" of this unit unbinds a spell, no command points are spent for that **WIZARD** to use the ‘Magical Intervention’ command in that phase.
abilities.lore: Spreading his arms, Kairos saturates the area with magic.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 1 from its power level.

units.lore: Kairos Fateweaver can see the past and the future, and he uses this ability to twist destiny to suit his own malevolent purposes. The twin‑headed terror is a master of magic known as the Oracle of Tzeentch – wherever he goes, change is sure to follow.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Screamers of Tzeentch

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Imperilling Slashes
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Screamers’ sharp fins and horns slice apart shields and armour as if they were parchment, leaving the foe vulnerable to attack.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Flocks of Screamers glide above the battlefields of Aqshy, swooping and soaring through the ash-choked skies with undulating grace before descending to feast upon the flesh of the warriors battling below.

units.name: Gaunt Summoner

abilities.name: Leaden Limbs
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Effect: Until the start of your next turn:

• Halve the target’s Move characteristic.
• The effects of the ‘Fly’ ability do not apply to the target.
abilities.lore: The Gaunt Summoner turns the bones of their foes to heavy lead, slowing them to a pained crawl.

abilities.name: Masters of the Silver Towers
abilities.description: Effect: Enemy units cannot end a charge move within 1/2" of a friendly **Argent Shard** that is wholly within 12" of this unit and was set up on the battlefield in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Gaunt Summoners are attuned to the esoteric magic of the Argent Shards and can call upon their power to violently repulse charging foes.

abilities.name: All Belongs to Tzeentch
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Start of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an objective you do not control and that you controlled earlier in the battle to be the target.

Effect: You control the target objective.
abilities.lore: The Gaunt Summoners have spent centuries remaking reality in their master’s image.

units.lore: To the daemonic Gaunt Summoners, reality is but a plaything to be mutilated and twisted according to the desires of Almighty Tzeentch. Gazing into infinity with myriad glistening eyes, these lords of the Silver Towers devastate the enemy with their master spellcraft.

units.name: Pink Horrors

abilities.name: Lunatic Demise
abilities.description:
Effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain, before removing the model from play, pick 1 of the following effects:

***Split:*** Pick a visible friendly **BLUE HORRORS AND BRIMSTONE HORRORS** unit within 12" of this unit. Return up to 2 slain **Blue Horror** models to that unit.

***Petty Vengeance:*** Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target, then roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Should a Pink Horror be slain, it is capable of bursting into two smaller daemons or else detonating in a blast of wyrdflame.

units.lore: Gibbering and warbling, the luminescent Pink Horrors whirl and flail, generating raw magic that can manifest as blasts of unnatural fire that scour the enemy. Should they be slain, Pink Horrors can split in twain to form two lesser incarnations.

battleTraits.name: Pitiless Assault
battleTraits.phase: Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for a unit that has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase
battleTraits.description:
Used By: The unit using that **FIGHT** ability.

Effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If that unit is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made as part of that **FIGHT** ability.
battleTraits.lore: The Bonereapers deliver blows that make a mockery of enemy defences.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Ossiarch Bonereapers armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Immortal Elite
battleTraits.phase: Per Battle Round (Army), Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You must use this ability if there are any friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HEROES** on the battlefield. Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HERO** to be the target.

Effect: You gain a number of **relentless discipline** points equal to the number after the target's **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** keyword. At the end of the battle round, any unspent **relentless discipline** points are lost.
battleTraits.lore: The Ossiarch legions march to war in perfect unison, efficiently and precisely enacting the will of their generals without the mortal inadequacies of doubt, fear or regret.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Ossiarch Bonereapers armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Ruthless Extermination
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for a unit that has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase
battleTraits.description:
Used By: The unit using that **SHOOT** ability.

Effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If that unit is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. Subtract l from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that **SHOOT** ability.
battleTraits.lore: With the enemy fully engaged, the Ossiarchs send a hail of fire raining down on them with cold efficiency.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Ossiarch Bonereapers armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Remorseless March
battleTraits.phase: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit that has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase to use this ability.

Effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If that unit is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. Add 3" to the Move characteristic of that unit for the rest of the phase. That unit cannot use **RUN** abilities for the rest of the turn.
battleTraits.lore: The Ossiarchs advance into battle swiftly and mercilessly.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Ossiarch Bonereapers armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Impassive Retreat
battleTraits.phase: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit that has not used a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability this phase to use this ability.

Effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If that unit is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. For the rest of the turn, that unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
battleTraits.lore: The Bonereapers disengage and charge back into the fray, heedless of any losses sustained by their own ranks.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Ossiarch Bonereapers armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Inviolate Legions
battleTraits.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared an **ATTACK** ability
battleTraits.description:
Used By: A friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit targeted by that **ATTACK** ability. Friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units can use this ability more than once per phase.

Effect: Spend 1 **relentless discipline** point. If that unit is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 **relentless discipline** points instead. That unit has **WARD (5+)** against damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that **ATTACK** ability.
battleTraits.lore: Ossiarch warriors snap into defensive formations that grant them even greater resilience.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Ossiarch Bonereapers armies can use the following abilities:

ability.name: Silent Empire
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has a maximum control score of 1 while it is within neutral territory or your territory.
ability.lore: To invade the Ossiarch Empire is to enter a realm of doleful columns, grim architecture and deathly silence.

abilities.name: Silent Empire
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has a maximum control score of 1 while it is within neutral territory or your territory.
abilities.lore: To invade the Ossiarch Empire is to enter a realm of doleful columns, grim architecture and deathly silence.

ability.name: Grim Sentinels
ability.description: Effect: Melee weapons used by friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** while they are wholly within neutral territory or wholly within 6" of both enemy and friendly territory.
ability.lore: The borders of the Ossiarch Empire stretch across continents in every Mortal Realm, and they are ever expanding ...

abilities.name: Grim Sentinels
abilities.description: Effect: Melee weapons used by friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** while they are wholly within neutral territory or wholly within 6" of both enemy and friendly territory.
abilities.lore: The borders of the Ossiarch Empire stretch across continents in every Mortal Realm, and they are ever expanding ...

ability.name: Unfaltering Pace
ability.phase: Reaction: You declared a **RUN** ability for a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit
ability.description:
Used By: The unit using that **RUN** ability.

Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
ability.lore: The soldiers of the Ossiarch legions neither rest nor tire; their expansions are limited only to the availability of osseous matter with which to create fresh soldiers.

abilities.name: Unfaltering Pace
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a **RUN** ability for a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit
abilities.description:
Used By: The unit using that **RUN** ability.

Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
abilities.lore: The soldiers of the Ossiarch legions neither rest nor tire; their expansions are limited only to the availability of osseous matter with which to create fresh soldiers.

ability.name: Nadirite Wedge
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit that charged this turn to use this ability.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit's melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: As the attacking speartip of the Ossiarch legions drive home their charge, enemy defences quail and then shatter outright.

abilities.name: Nadirite Wedge
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit that charged this turn to use this ability.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit's melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: As the attacking speartip of the Ossiarch legions drive home their charge, enemy defences quail and then shatter outright.

heroicTraits.name: Manufactured Mind
heroicTraits.phase: Once Per Battle, Start of Battle Round
heroicTraits.description: Effect: When picking a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HERO** to be the target of the 'Immortal Elite' ability this battle round, you can pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS HERO** that has been destroyed.
heroicTraits.lore: This commander's soul-stuff is a blend of some of the realms' finest military minds. This grants them moments of unparalleled insight, even in the face of utter disaster and the complete dissolution of the chain of command.

heroicTraits.name: Immaculate Defender
heroicTraits.description: Effect: Ignore the first damage point allocated to each friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS INFANTRY** unit in the combat phase while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
heroicTraits.lore: This warlord knows precisely how to maximise the peerless resilience of the Ossiarch Bonereapers through defensive formations and overlapping shieldwalls.

heroicTraits.name: Imperious Will
heroicTraits.phase: Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for a non-**HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
heroicTraits.description: Effect: Pick an enemy unit in combat with that non-**HERO** unit and that did not charge this turn to be the target. Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **FIGHT** ability.
heroicTraits.lore: The exacting leadership of this commander inspires their cohorts of Ossiarch soldiery to fight with a ruthless determination to utterly vanquish the enemy.

artefacts.name: Amulet of Gnosis
artefacts.description: Effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units by **RETREAT** abilities while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
artefacts.lore: This talisman contains the siphoned intellects of many esteemed martial leaders distilled into a single black gemstone, which bestows upon the bearer the knowledge of a thousand battles. Such military acumen ensures any troops under their command will act with supreme precision on the battlefield.

artefacts.name: Shard of Necris
artefacts.description: Effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4 and this unit did not charge in the same turn, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
artefacts.lore: This ancient shard is a fragment of the armour known as the Necris Infinus. Though it was shattered in a war long ago, the remaining piece is still imbued with the darkest of Shyishan sorceries. Once worn by Haakesh the Indomitable and Kheramet the Undying, its potent magics render the wearer almost invulnerable. Almost...

artefacts.name: Blade of the Nadir
artefacts.description: Effect: Pick 1 of this unit's non-**Companion** melee weapons. For the rest of the battle, each time you make an unmodified wound roll of 6 for a combat attack made with that weapon, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target of the attack after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
artefacts.lore: Compressed to a barely visible sliver by the metaphysical weight of the Shyish Nadir itself, this weapon is so incomparably sharp that flesh and steel dissolves around it as it sweeps through enemy ranks.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Banner of Old Ossia
aqshyArtefacts.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Rally’ command for a visible **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
aqshyArtefacts.description:
Effect: When resolving that command, you can spend rally points in the following additional ways:

•  For each rally point spent, **Heal (1)** another visible friendly non-**HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
•  You can spend a number of rally points equal to the Health characteristic of that unit to return a slain model to a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: Imbued with a similar enchantment to Katakros’s personal standard, the bearer of this banner can direct the repair and reconstruction of Ossiarch warriors across the battlefield, ensuring that each cohort is at optimal strength.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Scarabaean Cloak
aqshyArtefacts.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
aqshyArtefacts.description: Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: This writhing mantle is formed of thousands of osseous scarabs that can take flight as one, carrying the wearer into the air.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Soulweb Gem
aqshyArtefacts.phase: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
aqshyArtefacts.description:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if it was destroyed this turn.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to this unit on the battlefield wholly within friendly territory and not in combat. Then, allocate a number of damage points to the replacement unit equal to its Health characteristic minus 1 (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
aqshyArtefacts.lore: This construct bears a mastercrafted soultrap gem that has been magically bound to that of a chosen vassal. Should they fall, their animus can inhabit their subordinate’s form, usually at a safer distance from the foe.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Perpetually Empowered Weapons
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: This unit’s melee weapons, including **Companion** weapons, have **Crit (2 Hits)**.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: The Mortisans have permanently imbued these constructs’ and their steeds’ weapons with deadly power.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: Mortisan Refinements are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units.  A unit can only have 1 Mortisan Refinement.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Elongated Tibias
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: These Bonereapers have considerably longer leg bones than many other constructs, allowing for greater bursts of speed on the charge.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: Mortisan Refinements are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units.  A unit can only have 1 Mortisan Refinement.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Utterly Unquestioning
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: Each time this unit uses a **RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE** ability, roll a dice as a reaction. On a 5+, subtract 1 from the number of **relentless discipline** points that must be spent to use that ability.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: The spirit-essence in these Ossiarchs’ soultrap gems is derived from the most loyal of ancient seneschals.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: Mortisan Refinements are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units.  A unit can only have 1 Mortisan Refinement.

spells.name: Soul-Claim
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the enemy target. Then, you can pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of that **WIZARD** to be a friendly target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the enemy target. If any models are slain by this ability, pick 1 of the following:

• **Heal (3)** the friendly target.
• Return a number of slain models to the friendly target with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
spells.lore: The caster drains the spirit-essence from the foe, repurposing it to imbue their constructs with animus.

spells.name: Bolster Creation
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point allocated to the target in each phase.
spells.lore: Power flowing from their talons, the Mortisan hardens the osseous frames of their crafted soldiers.

spells.name: Invigorate the Ranks
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
spells.lore: The Mortisan pours energy into nearby soldiers, multiplying their combat prowess thricefold.

spells.name: Empower Nadirite Weapons
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target's melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** until the start of your next turn. If all of the target's non-**Companion** melee weapons had **Crit (2 Hits)** when they were picked to be the target of this ability, the target's combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ until the start of your next turn instead.

Friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** units can be affected by this ability multiple times.
spells.lore: Mortisans imbue the Bonereapers' blades with deadly power, acting in concert to increase the weapons' lethality to truly fearsome levels.

spells.name: Immolating Flames
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a model in the target unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a number of dice equal to the target's Health characteristic. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
spells.lore: The caster wreathes an Ossiarch cohort in dark, flaming magic that discharges in a burst of fiery energy should any of their number be felled.

spells.name: Drain Vitality
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks and subtract 1 from save rolls for the target.
spells.lore: This cursed spell saps a foe’s strength, leaving them weak and vulnerable.

manifestations.name: Bone-tithe Shrieker

abilities.name: No Escape
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for enemy units while they are within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION**.
abilities.lore: There is no hope for the enemy when a Bone-tithe Shrieker is nearby.

manifestations.lore: The Bone-tithe Shrieker is a four-headed, all-seeing monstrosity conjured to hunt down those who would escape the Ossiarch tithe. When it locates its quarry, it will give vent to an awful, mind-chilling scream that dulls the wits and shivers the bones of those living creatures nearby, making them easy prey for the Ossiarchs themselves.

summonSpell.name: Summon Bone-tithe Shrieker
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Bone‑tithe Shrieker** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Bone-tithe Shrieker** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: The caster conjures a four-headed, all-seeing monstrosity to hunt down those who would escape the Ossiarch tithe.

manifestations.name: Soulstealer Carrion

abilities.name: Aviarch Sentry
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 10 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION**.
abilities.lore: This ethereal monstrosity invokes terror as it swoops over enemy battlelines, causing the foe’s resolve to waver.

manifestations.lore: The Soulstealer Carrion is a soul-linked construct that soars from its caster's spread fingertips to take wing above the battlefield. Its caster can see through the avian conjuration's eyes; when it perceives spiritual energy unclaimed, it will swoop down to capture it.

summonSpell.name: Summon Soulstealer Carrion
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Soulstealer Carrion** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Soulstealer Carrion** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: Soaring from its caster’s spread fingertips, the Soulstealer Carrion takes wing above the battlefield.

manifestations.name: Nightmare Predator

abilities.name: Death Incarnate
abilities.description: Effect: If this **MANIFESTATION** was destroyed or banished this turn and the unit that summoned it is on the battlefield, roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if any enemy models were slain by this **MANIFESTATION'S** combat attacks this turn. On a 4+, set up this **MANIFESTATION** again, wholly within 12" of the unit that summoned it and more than 9" from all enemy units. That unit has summoned that **MANIFESTATION.**
abilities.lore: Even when destroyed, the nightmare predator reforms to continue tormenting its enemies.

manifestations.lore: The Nightmare Predator is a looming conjuration of Shyishan magic that takes the form of a disturbing terror. It floats eerily through the air towards its master's chosen prey, lacerating the flesh of its screaming victims with claws the size of sickles before stripping them to the bone.

summonSpell.name: Summon Nightmare Predator
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Nightmare Predator** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Nightmare Predator** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: The Nightmare Predator is a looming conjuration of Shyishan magic that takes the form of a disturbing terror.
