Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. After this ability has been resolved, you gain a number of **relentless discipline** points equal to the number of total damage points allocated by this ability this turn.
abilities.lore: The Soulreaper sends a surge of deathly energy across the battlefield that can see nearby foes wracked with soul deep agony.

abilities.name: Soulreaper
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: The mere presence of a Soulreaper will sap a foe’s strength, leaving them weak and vulnerable.

units.lore: The Soulreapers are the more destructive members of the Mortisan order. It is their role to cut the souls from the enemy with their magical scythes, using the harvested spirits to sap their enemies' strength or fuel a burst of deathly energy.

battleTraits.name: Ancient Burial Sites
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.description:
Effect: If there is a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre** on the battlefield, you can set up up to 2 additional **Cursed Sepulchres** on the battlefield. The first must be set up more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features. The second must be set up wholly outside enemy territory and more than 3" from all units, objectives and other terrain features.

**Designer’s Note**: *The original* **Cursed Sepulchre** *is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second and third such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*
battleTraits.lore: Across the Mortal Realms stand time-worn mausoleums and barrows, housing the remains of the long dead.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Soulblight Gravelords armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: The Rising Dead
battleTraits.phase: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that is **in the grave**.

Effect: Set up that unit wholly within 6" of a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre** and more than 9" from all enemy units, or wholly within 6" of the edge of the battlefield, wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from all enemy units.
battleTraits.lore: Clawing their way through the soil and rock, more undead warriors join the fight.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Soulblight Gravelords armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Deathly Invocation
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO** to use this ability, then pick up to 3 friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** units wholly within 12" of that **HERO** to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:

• If the target is damaged, **Heal (3)** the target.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
battleTraits.lore: Skilled wielders of death magic can summon hordes of undead.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Soulblight Gravelords armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Endless Legions
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Movement Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit that started the battle with 2 or more models and that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO** or wholly within 6" of a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre**. It must be set up more than 9" from all enemy units.

If it is your movement phase, you can set up the replacement unit more than 3" from all enemy units instead of more than 9", but if you set it up within 9" of any enemy units, it cannot use **CHARGE** abilities this turn.
battleTraits.lore: To the Gravelords, the dead are mere chattel to be raised and expended.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Soulblight Gravelords armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: The Hunger
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **VAMPIRE** unit that used a **FIGHT** ability this turn to be the targets.

Effect: **Heal (D3)** each target. **Heal (2D3)** the target instead if it destroyed an enemy unit this turn using a **FIGHT** ability.
battleTraits.lore: Soulblight vampires are revitalised by feasting upon the blood of their foes.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Soulblight Gravelords armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: The Unquiet Dead
battleTraits.phase: Deployment Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit that has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the grave**. It has now been deployed. You cannot set up more friendly units **in the grave** than there are on the battlefield.
battleTraits.lore: Animated by necromancy, the undead rise from their graves, balefire eyes blazing with dark purpose.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Soulblight Gravelords armies can use the following abilities:

ability.name: Aristocracy of the Night
ability.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **VAMPIRE** units that are not in combat and add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **VAMPIRE** units that charged in the same turn.
ability.lore: These vampires are expected to excel in all martial and mystical disciplines.

abilities.name: Aristocracy of the Night
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **VAMPIRE** units that are not in combat and add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **VAMPIRE** units that charged in the same turn.
abilities.lore: These vampires are expected to excel in all martial and mystical disciplines.

ability.name: Tide of Bones and Blades
ability.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **DEATHRATTLE** units that charged in the same turn for attacks that target a unit that has fewer models than the attacking unit.
ability.lore: The relentless advance of these skeletal undead can overwhelm even the most tenacious resistance.

abilities.name: Tide of Bones and Blades
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **DEATHRATTLE** units that charged in the same turn for attacks that target a unit that has fewer models than the attacking unit.
abilities.lore: The relentless advance of these skeletal undead can overwhelm even the most tenacious resistance.

ability.name: Horror Unending
ability.description: Effect: You can pick 1 additional target when using the ‘Deathly Invocation’ ability.
ability.lore: The never-ending waves of deathly minions summoned by a Legion of Shyish shatter all hopes of victory for those who stand against them.

abilities.name: Horror Unending
abilities.description: Effect: You can pick 1 additional target when using the ‘Deathly Invocation’ ability.
abilities.lore: The never-ending waves of deathly minions summoned by a Legion of Shyish shatter all hopes of victory for those who stand against them.

ability.name: Dragged Down and Torn Apart
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **DEADWALKERS** units in combat to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:

• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
ability.lore: Hordes of shambling Deadwalker Zombies flow around and over their victims like a rotten tide, bearing them to the ground through sheer weight of numbers before tearing them limb from limb.

abilities.name: Dragged Down and Torn Apart
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **DEADWALKERS** units in combat to be the targets.

Effect: For each target:

• Make a pile-in move.
• Then, pick an enemy unit in combat with the target and roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Hordes of shambling Deadwalker Zombies flow around and over their victims like a rotten tide, bearing them to the ground through sheer weight of numbers before tearing them limb from limb.

heroicTraits.name: Unbending Will
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit that has 2 or more models and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add D6 to the target’s control score for the rest of the turn.
heroicTraits.lore: This immortal tyrant and their minions are a force of unliving conquest like no other.

heroicTraits.name: Lash of the Sire
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick another friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+:

•  If the target is not in combat, it can move D6" but cannot move into combat during any part of that move.
•  If the target is in combat, it can make a pile‑in move.
heroicTraits.lore: Such is the domineering force of this undead overlord’s willpower that it can imbue nearby vassals with sudden impetus.

heroicTraits.name: Unhinged Rampager
heroicTraits.description: Effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit in your charge phase.
heroicTraits.lore: This creature’s bestial hunger sees them close on the foe without hesitation.

artefacts.name: Shard of Night
artefacts.description: Effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit (positive and negative).
artefacts.lore: This undead lord’s armour was crafted using elements of an abyssal stalker and grants the bearer that awful creature’s shadowy aura.

artefacts.name: Terminus Clock
artefacts.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy **WIZARDS** while they are within 18" of this unit.
artefacts.lore: Created by a mad clockwright of Ulfenkarn, this bizarre cogwork piece ticks without rhyme or reason. Whenever its eclectic count ends, however, the power of magic seems to deaden across the field.

artefacts.name: Amulet of Graves
artefacts.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
artefacts.description: Effect: If there are fewer than 3 friendly **Cursed Sepulchres** on the battlefield, set up a **Cursed Sepulchre** on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units, more than 1" from all friendly units and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features.
artefacts.lore: The bearer of this amulet can call upon a long-dead soul in Shyish, manifesting their final resting place onto the battlefield in a storm of necromantic energy.

aqshyEnhancements.name: The Empty Graveyard
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units and either wholly within 7" of a terrain feature or wholly within 7" of the battlefield edge. This unit cannot use **MOVE** abilities in the first turn of the first battle round.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: Folks tell of a cemetery where the day after a mass funeral, each newly filled burial plot was found empty, with footprints leading away from them into the wilds...
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: Origins of Terrifying Folk Tales are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Origin of Terrifying Folk Tales

aqshyEnhancements.name: The Never-Dead
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, for the rest of the turn, each time you make an unmodified save roll of 5+ for an attack that targets this unit, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends
aqshyEnhancements.lore: It is said that there is a rampaging band of warriors who yearn for the sweet release of death, but as punishment for transgressions past, Elder Bones refuses to let them die.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: Origins of Terrifying Folk Tales are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Origin of Terrifying Folk Tales

aqshyEnhancements.name: The Incarnadine Killers
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: If this unit is not in combat and an enemy unit was destroyed by its combat attacks this turn, this unit can move up to D6". It can end that move in combat.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: Beware the Incarnadine Killers, for they are cursed with an insatiable lust for slaughter. Do not think that distance shall keep you safe; should you spy their bloodied forms upon the horizon one moment, their blades will be lodged in your throat the next.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: Origins of Terrifying Folk Tales are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Origin of Terrifying Folk Tales

spells.name: Prison of Grief
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** until the start of your next turn.
spells.lore: Victims of this curse relive their tragedies, their will to fight replaced by overwhelming self-pity.

spells.name: Waste Away
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
spells.lore: The wizard causes the muscles of the foe to atrophy, robbing them of their strength.

spells.name: Vile Transference
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit. If any enemy models were slain by this spell, **Heal (D3)** the caster.
spells.lore: The caster siphons the animus from nearby enemies and uses it to restore their deathless form.

manifestations.name: Hand of Nagash

abilities.name: Inescapable Reach
abilities.description:
Declare: This **MANIFESTATION** can only use this ability if it has not been set up this turn.

Effect: Remove this **MANIFESTATION** from the battlefield and set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, roll a D3. On a 2+, this **MANIFESTATION** can move a number of inches equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: From a yawning rift in the fabric of reality, a colossal arm of eldritch bone emerges.

abilities.name: Chill Grasp
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the following effects apply until the start of your next turn:

•  While the target is within 3" of this **MANIFESTATION**, the target has a maximum control score of 1 that cannot be modified.
•  While the target is within 3" of this **MANIFESTATION**, the target cannot use **MOVE** abilities.
abilities.lore: A deathly chill seizes the hearts of the foe, leaving them petrified with fear.

manifestations.lore: A grasping, skeletal arm spears its way into reality, reaching for living beings and seizing them between its bony fingers. Even those who manage to avoid its deathly cold grasp are not safe, for the Hand of Nagash is not so easily denied. Leaving the frozen and crushed corpses of its victims behind, it will disappear – only to emerge somewhere else to continue its murderous rampage.

summonSpell.name: Summon Hand of Nagash
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Hand of Nagash** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Hand of Nagash** wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: From out a yawning portal looms a colossal skeletal arm, infused to its cursed marrow with the magic of Shyish.

manifestations.name: Unholy Reliquary

abilities.name: Draw on Power
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO** wholly within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following:

• **Heal (D3)** the target.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn. Then, this **MANIFESTATION** is banished and removed from play.
abilities.lore: The necromantic energy of this long-perished vampire can be siphoned by their kind for sustenance or drawn upon to grant a temporary rush of power.

manifestations.lore: The corpse of an elder vampire lies within this cursed casket, still smouldering with hatred and hunger. These remains act as a conduit of potent necromantic energies. Soulblight lords often take such a relic into battle with them, drawing upon its profane power in order to heal their wounds or to infuse their undead soldiers with a sudden burst of killing might.

summonSpell.name: Summon Unholy Reliquary
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Unholy Reliquary** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an **Unholy Reliquary** wholly within 18" of the caster, visible to them and more than 3" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: Pulled forth from the underworlds, the remains of a long perished vampire rises from the ground amidst a vortex of death magic.

manifestations.name: Sanguine Swarm

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.description:
Effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **MANIFESTATION**’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **MANIFESTATION** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

Each time this **MANIFESTATION** moves, both its parts must end within 9" of each other.

Each part of this **MANIFESTATION** is armed with **Leeching Bites**.

abilities.name: Leeching Bites
abilities.description: Effect: Each time an attack made by this **MANIFESTATION** scores a critical hit, **Heal (1)** this **MANIFESTATION**.
abilities.lore: Although arcane in nature, these magical creatures still feed on the blood of the living.

manifestations.lore: Sanguine Swarms appear as twin clusters of red-eyed chiropterans, their leathery wings flapping as they descend upon their prey. In truth, these are not beasts but arcane conjurations, though that does not make their leeching bites any less deadly. The spell feeds upon the blood of those it assails, growing ever more potent and increasingly difficult to dispel.

summonSpell.name: Summon Sanguine Swarm
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Sanguine Swarm** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Sanguine Swarm** wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Sanguine Swarm** spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.
summonSpell.lore: The skies darken as screeching swarms of spectral bats descend upon the battlefield, hungry for blood.

manifestations.name: Hand of Nagash

abilities.name: Inescapable Reach
abilities.description:
Declare: This **MANIFESTATION** can only use this ability if it has not been set up this turn.

Effect: Remove this **MANIFESTATION** from the battlefield and set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, roll a D3. On a 2+, this **MANIFESTATION** can move a number of inches equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: From a yawning rift in the fabric of reality, a colossal arm of eldritch bone emerges.

abilities.name: Chill Grasp
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the following effects apply until the start of your next turn:

•  While the target is within 3" of this **MANIFESTATION**, the target has a maximum control score of 1 that cannot be modified.
•  While the target is within 3" of this **MANIFESTATION**, the target cannot use **MOVE** abilities.
abilities.lore: A deathly chill seizes the hearts of the foe, leaving them petrified with fear.

manifestations.lore: A grasping, skeletal arm spears its way into reality, reaching for living beings and seizing them between its bony fingers. Even those who manage to avoid its deathly cold grasp are not safe, for the Hand of Nagash is not so easily denied. Leaving the frozen and crushed corpses of its victims behind, it will disappear – only to emerge somewhere else to continue its murderous rampage.

summonSpell.name: Summon Hand of Nagash
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Hand of Nagash** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Hand of Nagash** wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: From out a yawning portal looms a colossal skeletal arm, infused to its cursed marrow with the magic of Shyish.

manifestations.name: Unholy Reliquary

abilities.name: Draw on Power
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO** wholly within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following:

• **Heal (D3)** the target.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn. Then, this **MANIFESTATION** is banished and removed from play.
abilities.lore: The necromantic energy of this long-perished vampire can be siphoned by their kind for sustenance or drawn upon to grant a temporary rush of power.

manifestations.lore: The corpse of an elder vampire lies within this cursed casket, still smouldering with hatred and hunger. These remains act as a conduit of potent necromantic energies. Soulblight lords often take such a relic into battle with them, drawing upon its profane power in order to heal their wounds or to infuse their undead soldiers with a sudden burst of killing might.

summonSpell.name: Summon Unholy Reliquary
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Unholy Reliquary** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an **Unholy Reliquary** wholly within 18" of the caster, visible to them and more than 3" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: Pulled forth from the underworlds, the remains of a long perished vampire rises from the ground amidst a vortex of death magic.

manifestations.name: Sanguine Swarm

abilities.name: Multiple Parts
abilities.description:
Effect: When a number of damage points equal to this **MANIFESTATION**’s Health characteristic are allocated to it, this **MANIFESTATION** is destroyed and both its parts are removed from play.

Each time this **MANIFESTATION** moves, both its parts must end within 9" of each other.

Each part of this **MANIFESTATION** is armed with **Leeching Bites**.

abilities.name: Leeching Bites
abilities.description: Effect: Each time an attack made by this **MANIFESTATION** scores a critical hit, **Heal (1)** this **MANIFESTATION**.
abilities.lore: Although arcane in nature, these magical creatures still feed on the blood of the living.

manifestations.lore: Sanguine Swarms appear as twin clusters of red-eyed chiropterans, their leathery wings flapping as they descend upon their prey. In truth, these are not beasts but arcane conjurations, though that does not make their leeching bites any less deadly. The spell feeds upon the blood of those it assails, growing ever more potent and increasingly difficult to dispel.

summonSpell.name: Summon Sanguine Swarm
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Sanguine Swarm** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Sanguine Swarm** wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units. A **Sanguine Swarm** spell has 2 parts that must be set up within 9" of each other.
summonSpell.lore: The skies darken as screeching swarms of spectral bats descend upon the battlefield, hungry for blood.

terrain.name: Cursed Sepulchre

abilities.name: Leeching Soil
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a model (friendly or enemy) is slain while it is within 9" of this terrain feature, **Heal (1)** this terrain feature.
abilities.lore: When blood is spilt upon this unhallowed ground, it is hungrily absorbed by the tainted earth and the withered roots running through it.

abilities.name: Locus of Shyish
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** casts a **SUMMON SPELL** from the ‘Manifestations of the Grave’ lore, you can measure the range and visibility from this terrain feature instead.
abilities.lore: A palpable aura of death lingers over these ancient burial sites, dormant necromantic energy that can be harnessed by Shyishan practitioners.

terrain.lore: Across the realms there are many places drenched in the energies of death – sites of necromantic potential where hundreds or even thousands of souls met their tragic end amidst violence and horror. Such areas are rich pickings for the Soulblight Gravelords. They contain bounteous quantities of desiccated flesh and yellowed bone ready to be transformed into undead soldiery or used to patch up damaged warriors. Better still, practitioners of death magic can siphon the grim energies permeating these locations to restore their unnatural vitality.

units.name: Nagash, Supreme Lord of the Undead

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 3 from its power level.

abilities.name: Invocation of Nagash
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick a visible unit wholly within 18" of this unit that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly **DEATH** unit, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Return a number of slain models to the target unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
• The target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: In a storm of morbid sorcery, Nagash blasts his foes’ souls or re-knits his minions’ bodies.

abilities.name: The Staff of Power
abilities.description: Effect: Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit while it has not miscast any spells this turn. If this unit miscasts a spell, ignore the restriction that would stop this unit from casting any more spells this turn.
abilities.lore: Alakanash is capped with gems of purest grave-sand.

abilities.name: Supreme Lord of the Undead
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** non-**UNIQUE DEATH** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Hand of Dust
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Hide a dice in one of your hands or under one of two appropriate containers. Your opponent must pick one of your hands or containers. If they pick the one hiding the dice, this ability has no effect. If they pick the empty one, the target is automatically destroyed.
abilities.lore: Nagash’s touch can turn a foe to a pile of dusty bones in moments.

units.lore: All living beings dread the name of Nagash, the God of Undeath. Cruel and tyrannical, the overlord of Shyish intends to conquer the Mortal Realms and transform them into a lifeless Necrotopia, in which not a speck of dust moves unless it is by his will.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Revenant Draconith

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Draconic Claws** is 5.

abilities.name: Brimming with Rancour
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the target cannot end moves made as part of a non-**CHARGE MOVE** ability within **X**" of this unit, where **X** is equal to your current **fury level**.
abilities.lore: The Revenant Draconith turns towards a foe, the witchlights of its eyes flickering. Radiating pure malevolence, the enemy dares not approach its mouldering form.

abilities.name: Volatile Animus
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, pick 1 of the following effects:

***Retaliatory Posture***: For the rest of the turn:
• Ignore positive modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
• Add 1 to save rolls for this unit.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks, including attacks made with **Companion** weapons, that target an enemy unit that used a **FIGHT** ability this phase.

***Unrelenting Ferocity***: For the rest of the turn:
• Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s attacks.
• Add 1 to the Rend and Damage characteristics of this unit’s **Companion** melee weapons for attacks that target an enemy unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this phase
abilities.lore: The furious energies of Aqshy combine with the forces animating the Revenant Draconith to make it highly unpredictable.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Rotted heirs of the godbeast Dracothion, Revenant Draconith are the decaying corpses of great drakes animated by necromancy. With a deep-seated animosity for all living things, they swoop down through the Aqshian skies to disgorge their flesh-melting breath over the enemy, lashing out with raking talons in a hate-filled frenzy.

units.name: Fell Bats

abilities.name: Fleet and Fell
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.
abilities.lore: Borne swiftly upon huge, tattered wings, Fell Bats are able to swoop down upon and break away from their prey with impunity, their frenzied flapping making it difficult to pin them down.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

units.lore: Leather-winged monstrosities bloated on blood and necrotic sorcery, Fell Bats haunt the cursed forests and battlefields of the realms. Each is large enough to pluck a rider from the saddle and carry them off into the skies, and their dagger-length canine teeth are so sharp that they can puncture solid metal.

units.name: Mortis Engine

abilities.name: The Reliquary
abilities.description: Effect: When this unit is set up for the first time, place a **stored energy dice** beside it with the ‘1’ facing up. Each time a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** successfully casts a spell while it is within 12" of this unit, increase the value of the **stored energy dice** beside this unit by 1 (to a maximum of 6).
abilities.lore: When the amethyst magics that thrum through a Mortis Engine reach a crescendo, its Corpsemaster custodian can unleash them as a lethal bow wave of power.

abilities.name: Nexus of Death Energy
abilities.description: Effect: When a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit is picked to be the target of the ‘Deathly Invocation’ ability, add D3 to the number of damage points that can be healed or the combined Health characteristic of models that can be returned.
abilities.lore: Mortis Engines are constructed around the remains of a slain Necromancer, who acts as a locus for the magics of the underworlds.

abilities.name: Wave of Power
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units within 10" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the value of this unit’s **stored energy dice**. Then, change the value of the **stored energy dice** back to 1.
abilities.lore: With arms held aloft, the Corpsemaster discharges the energy stored within the Mortis Engine, searing the life force from those nearby.

units.lore: When a truly formidable Necromancer is destroyed, their acolytes will reverently collect their remains and inter them within rune-marked caskets and reliquaries. These are then mounted atop the arcane constructs known as Mortis Engines, each guided into battle by a Corpsemaster learned in the ways of the amethyst arts. This dreadful reliquary acts as a wellspring of necromantic power, sending forth waves of life-stealing magic and bolstering the Shyishan energies that animate lesser undead.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Vengorian Lord

abilities.name: Nightmare's Miasma
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: The strange curse of the Vengorians sees shining blades and hallowed relics crumble and patinate in their presence.

abilities.name: Indignant Outburst
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, gain 1 **rage dice**.
abilities.lore: Filled with self-loathing and seething resentment, once the Vengorian Lord has a target for their simmering ire, they let their outrage boil over.

abilities.name: Frenzied Surge
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: You can pick another visible friendly non-**HERO SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY** or **MONSTER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: This unit and the target (if any) can move up to **X**+D3", where **X** is your **fury level**. They can move through enemy models and the combat ranges of enemy units during that move and must end that move in combat.

If you picked a target, after moving, this unit and the target must be in combat with the same enemy unit.
abilities.lore: As the Vengorian Lord tears through the press of combat to sate their desperate hunger, nearby undead find themselves swept along by their rabidity.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Such is the self-hatred felt by the Vengorian Lords that they cannot bear even to see their own reflections. Their forms twisted through exposure to unbound magics, these vampires traverse the Great Parch, feasting messily on the living.

units.name: Wight King

abilities.name: King of Shambling Bones
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: In the presence of their sovereign, the footsoldiers of the Deathrattle kingdoms assume a sliver of their former warlike vigour.

abilities.name: Ancient Strategies
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DEATHRATTLE INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Death does not rob a Wight King of their strategic genius, and they direct their undead thralls with great skill.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Deathrattle Overseer*.

units.lore: Wight Kings are deathless tyrants, ruling over barrow empires populated entirely by skeletal thralls. They exist only to dominate others, having long ago sacrificed emotion and passion on the altar of their obsessive lust for triumph. In battle, few can withstand their relentless assault. Those foolish enough to challenge their supremacy are soon hacked to pieces by the monarch’s cursed blade, a weapon capable of snuffing out a soul with a single scratch.

units.name: Vampire Lord

abilities.name: Sanguine Blur
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy non-**HERO** units and more than 3" from all enemy **HEROES**.
abilities.lore: By the time this vampire’s prey notices the crimson streak heading towards them, it is far too late.

regimentOptions: Any SCIONS OF NULAHMIA Vampire Lord

units.lore: The eldest vampires are granted fearsome powers by the Soulblight curse: unnatural speed, potent arcane power, and strength enough to dismember foes with their bare hands. Peerless duellists and cunning strategists all, they affect an aura of nobility even as their innermost impulses urge them to glut themselves on warm, fresh blood. They sate this hunger in the thick of battle, slicing throats with ornate rapiers or smashing open ribcages with flanged maces to devour the crimson rain that sprays forth.

units.name: Deathrattle Skeletons

abilities.name: Skeleton Legion
abilities.description: Effect: You can return D3 slain models to this unit.
abilities.lore: As necromantic energies blanket the battlefield, long-dead warriors stagger to their feet once more, eye sockets aglow with killing light.

units.lore: Clattering forwards in formation, their yellowed skulls devoid of expression, the Deathrattle Skeletons go forth to annihilate the living. These undead automatons have no free will and are imbued only with the imperative to slay as swiftly and efficiently as possible. Even if a skeletal warrior is smashed to pieces, the horror continues – with the battlefield steeped in necromantic energies, the Deathrattle Skeleton’s bones will lock together once more as it clambers upright, ready to kill again.

units.name: Radukar the Wolf

abilities.name: Master of the Pack
abilities.description:
Declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, you can re-roll charge rolls for friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: His voice redolent with supernatural power, Radukar the Wolf barks the command to charge and his undead minions hurl themselves at the enemy.

abilities.name: Call to the Hunt
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **DEATHRATTLE** and **DEADWALKERS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: With an exultant howl, Radukar leads the charge, his surge of bloodlust filling nearby undead minions with unholy impetus.

details.notes: You cannot include this unit and **Radukar the Beast** in the same army.

units.lore: Broad-shouldered and swollen with the animalistic powers of the Vyrkos bloodline, Radukar the Wolf overwhelms his prey with sheer ferocity, swinging a blade seized from the tomb of the vampiric emperor Morkan. Not for him the role of martial strategist positioned behind a mass of rotting footsoldiers: Radukar delights in the rush and crunch of battle, ripping and tearing at the enemy in a wild frenzy, laughing with the pure thrill of slaughter.

units.name: Vargheists

abilities.name: Death's Descent
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Vargheists swoop down upon their victims from the sky, suddenly overwhelming them in a flurry of claws and fangs.

units.lore: A vampire becomes a Vargheist when they are deprived of the chance to feed, often as a punishment for transgressing against their own kind. They retain an instinctive deference towards the elders of their bloodline, but in battle, they become uncontrollable as soon as the scent of hot gore is in the air. They plummet from on high with bone-breaking force, smashing their prey to the ground and ripping them open with fangs and claws.

units.name: Belladamma Volga, First of the Vyrkos

abilities.name: First of the Vyrkos
abilities.description: Effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly **Radukar the Wolf**, **Radukar the Beast**, **Ivya Volga**, **Lady Annika** and **Kritza** units while they are wholly within 18" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Belladamma is the matriarch of the Vyrkos bloodline, and she commands their conquests with calculating efficiency.

abilities.name: Under a Killing Moon
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **Dire Wolves** units wholly within 18" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons (including **Companion** weapons).
• The targets can ignore the effect of the ‘Beast’ ability.
abilities.lore: Beneath the light of a blood moon, Volga’s wolves attack with mad-eyed ferocity.

abilities.name: Wolfguard
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **Dire Wolves** unit:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **Dire Wolves** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
abilities.lore: Belladamma’s lupine allies will unthinkingly sacrifice themselves to protect their savage mistress.

units.lore: When a bloody moon rises in the sky, Belladamma Volga rides at the head of a Dire Wolf pack to bring death and suffering to mortals. The matriarch of the Vyrkos dynasty has fought alongside many of her brood to overwhelm Sigmarite outposts, though she lingers only for the victory feast. Volga’s secrets are hers to keep, and woe betide any who meddle in her business.

units.name: Neferata, Mortarch of Blood

abilities.name: The Mortarch of Blood
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **DEATHRATTLE INFANTRY** or **DEADWALKERS INFANTRY** units to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
abilities.lore: Neferata has millennia of experience analysing and unpicking her foes’ ploys.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Nagadron’s Claws** is 3.

abilities.name: Dark Mist
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**MONSTER SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for the target (positive and negative) until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Neferata summons tendrils of penumbral mist to coil around her minions, rendering their corporeal forms as insubstantial as smoke.

abilities.name: The Adevore
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** that was allocated any damage points inflicted by this unit’s **Akmet-har** this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, the target is automatically destroyed.
abilities.lore: Should Nagadron sense the impending doom of a foe wounded by the Dagger of Jet, it will fall upon them and hungrily feast on their soul.

abilities.name: Twilight's Allure
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks that target friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** units while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Neferata cloaks her minions in perpetual gloom.

units.lore: Ancient beyond mortal comprehension, Queen Neferata is the progenitor of the Soulblight dynasties. Though she is a being who adores luxury and the intricate schemes of her royal court, Neferata has overseen more war and bloodshed than any of her rivals. Borne into battle atop the dread abyssal Nagadron, she traps her foes in a deadly web of mists and sorcery. As they stagger in confusion, she artfully dispatches them with the dagger Akmet-har and the staff Aken-seth – ritual weapons from another age, imbued with terrible enchantments.

units.name: Prince Vhordrai

abilities.name: Trail of Crimson
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can make a pile-in move (even if it is not in combat). Then, if this unit is in combat, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Shordemaire ploughs into the enemy’s lines, its giant jaws tearing huge chunks from monsters or swallowing smaller foes whole.

abilities.name: Saint of Slaughter
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**MONSTER VAMPIRE** unit that destroyed a unit this turn using a **FIGHT** ability and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle:

• Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

More than 1 effect can apply to a unit at the same time; however, each effect can only be applied to a unit once.
abilities.lore: Under the fierce scrutiny of Prince Vhordrai, vampires revel in displaying their martial skill.

abilities.name: Quickblood
abilities.description:
Declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Vhordrai calls upon the power of the curse running through his veins to strike with impossible speed.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Shordemaire’s Claws** is 5.

units.lore: The most feared vampire cavalier in existence is the legendary Prince Vhordrai, castellan – and prisoner – of the Crimson Keep. When released from his cursed fortress to wage war against the living, Vhordrai rides forth atop the undead Draconith known as Shordemaire. This ancient beast spews gouts of pestilential breath that melt flesh and armour, before swooping in low so that its master can drive his Bloodlance through the ribs of any foes still standing.

units.name: Vampire Lord on Nightmare Steed

abilities.name: Strike At The Heart
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Blood Knights** unit that charged this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit’s **Templar Weapons** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Focusing upon their own cursed hunger, the Vampire Lord stokes the predatory urges of a formation of Blood Knights, whose lances and blades strike with great precision and force as they impact with the foe.

abilities.name: 'For Glory! For Blood!'
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: You can re-roll the charge roll for that **CHARGE** ability. Then, before the charge move is made, you can pick a friendly **Blood Knights** unit that is not in combat, is wholly within 12" of this unit and has not used a **CHARGE** ability this turn to be the target. If this unit charges, then, immediately after the **CHARGE** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can immediately use the ‘Charge’ ability even if it is not your charge phase. In addition, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target this phase.
abilities.lore: The Vampire Lord and their retinue of favoured knights charge into the fray, driving deep into the enemy lines.

units.lore: When mounted upon an undead steed known as a nightmare, a Vampire Lord carves a gory path through the enemy with each thundering charge. The beast’s ironshod hooves cave in chests and grind foes into the mud, while the undead cavalier astride it lays about themself with a blade or axe, opening throats with every blow.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Corpse Cart

abilities.name: Unholy Lodestone
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Deadwalker Zombies** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, while the target is wholly within 12" of this unit, its ‘Mindless Ferocity’ ability inflicts mortal damage on rolls of 5+ instead of 6+.
abilities.lore: Deadwalker Zombies that are driven into battle like loathsome cattle are invigorated by the presence of nearby Corpse Carts.

abilities.name: Necromantic Goad
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Deadwalker Zombies** unit that is wholly within 12" of this unit and not in combat to be the target.

Effect: The target can move up to 3". It can move into combat.
abilities.lore: Corpsemasters are experts at directing the mindless efforts of the recently deceased.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: Trundling wagons piled with corpses dredged up from the Ghyranite swamps, Corpse Carts act as lodestones for deathly magic. They are driven by Corpsemasters skilled in the arts of necromancy, gaunt figures whose cursed goads drive the risen dead onwards with uncanny focus, driving them into the enemy in a mass of rotten, grasping limbs.

units.name: Blades of the Hollow King

abilities.name: Aurelias
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can use this ability while its **Aurelias** is on the battlefield.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to this unit’s power level.
•  Each time a casting roll is made for this unit, you can re-roll 1 of the dice.
abilities.lore: Vizier to Neferata herself, Aurelias is a learned necromancer who lends his arcane expertise to aid Cado in battle – so long as doing so aligns with the Mortarch’s interests as well…

abilities.name: Solia, The Tutor
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can use this ability while its **Cado Ezechiar** is on the battlefield.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following to apply for the rest of the turn:

• This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
• This unit’s **Ezechiarian Greatsword** has **Crit (Mortal)**.
abilities.lore: Teacher and tutor to Cado when he was a mortal prince, the spirit of Solia is now bound to one of his iron rings, offering him guidance on his path.

abilities.name: Retribution or Salvation
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can cast this spell while its **Cado Ezechiar** is on the battlefield. Pick a visible unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit, subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks that target that unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Cado’s quest for both vengeance and self-control manifests as two forms of sorcery: bolts of killing judgement and an aura of regal authority that augments nearby undead.

details.notes: You cannot include this unit and **Cado Ezechiar, the Hollow King** in the same army.

units.lore: Known as the Hollow King, Cado Ezechiar seeks both vengeance and redemption. Once a mortal king, his lands were ravaged by Chaos. Now he hunts the servants of ruin alongside a band of mismatched companions. The vampire Sissendra is a graceful killer who delights in reckless bloodshed, while the death priest Aurelias wields fearsome eldritch power and is accompanied by the twin-headed serpent Kennistrix. Then there is the spirit Solia, bound to one of Ezechiar’s iron rings and sworn to guide her student on his fateful path.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Sekhar, Fang of Nulahmia

abilities.name: Irresistible Demand
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** within 18" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within 3" of the target.
abilities.lore: Sekhar locks eyes across the battlefield with her victim, who falls hopelessly under her control, lashing out wildly even as their allies struggle to hold them down.

abilities.name: Lest You Forget...
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL or CHARGE ability for a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick 1 dice from the charge roll or casting roll for that ability. Your opponent must re-roll that dice.
abilities.lore: Sekhar’s presence is a tangible reminder of hidden obligations to the vampiric nation of Nulahmia, causing foes to deliberately foul their own forces’ efforts so that their clandestine allegiances remain undiscovered.

abilities.name: Allow Me to Remind You...
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use it are still lost.
abilities.lore: As Neferata’s premier agent in the Mortal Realms, Sekhar’s authority and near matchless powers of hypnotism ensure few have the willpower to resist her demands.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: The ruthless vampire Sekhar is one of Mortarch Neferata’s most formidable agents. Dispatched to the endless green of Ghyran on a mission to advance the cause of Nulahmia, she seeks to dominate her foes through sheer, hypnotic force of will. Those who defy her are spitted on the end of her glaive or fed to the coiling god-serpent Ouboroth.

units.name: Deadwalker Zombies

abilities.name: Mindless Ferocity
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 6+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Heedless of pain and knowing nothing of fear, Deadwalker Zombies are relentless in their efforts to slay the foe, and they will continue to hack, claw and bite even as they meet their final end.

units.lore: Shambling and groaning, flesh sagging off yellowed bones, a single zombie is a disconcerting sight. A horde of them can unnerve even the most steadfast warriors. Individually, a zombie is a clumsy and slow adversary, but in bulk they become a significant threat. Bludgeoning aside enemy defences, they lash out with filthy fingernails and crude improvised weapons, heedless of their losses.

units.name: Barrow Guard

abilities.name: Guardians of the King
abilities.description: Effect: While any friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY HEROES** are within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: The Barrow Guard stand alongside the liege lord to whom they are bound.

units.lore: Surrounding a Wight King is a coterie of favoured praetorians, champions and housecarls: the Barrow Guard. These are the elite footsoldiers of the Deathrattle legions, imbued with memories of loyalties pledged and oaths of eternal service. Some favour the traditional sword and shield of a monarch’s bodyguard, while others swing huge two-handed blades to carve foes in twain.

units.name: Coven Throne

abilities.name: Scrying Pool
abilities.description: Effect: If a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Redeploy’ command, you can pick another friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit that has not used a command this phase to use the ‘Redeploy’ command immediately after the first has been resolved (this is an exception to Commands, 1.2). No command point is spent the second time that command is used.
abilities.lore: Within this pool of shimmering gore, the vampire foresees the shape of the battle to come.

abilities.name: Tactical Insight
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **DEATHRATTLE** and **DEADWALKERS** units have **WARD (5+)** while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The vampire and their acolytes employ their divinatory abilities to manipulate and aid their undying servants.

abilities.name: A Promising Concoction
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **VAMPIRE** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The gory contents of the Coven Throne’s scrying bowl can be consumed by its riders and other vampires nearby, giving them a flush of power.

regimentOptions: Any SCIONS OF NULAHMIA Vampire Lord

units.lore: Coven Thrones are a symbol of macabre splendour prized by the most egotistical vampires, those who see the dirt and filth of a churning battlefield as beneath them. Drifting forth upon a surging mass of bound spirits, this necro-crafted palanquin allows its occupants to observe and partake in the slaughter whilst reclining in comfort. Sipping from goblets of freshly drained blood, they pour the rest into an unholy font, reading the bubbling liquid within for signs and portents regarding the battle’s outcome.

units.name: Vengorian Lord

abilities.name: Festering Feast
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description: Effect: If any damage points were allocated to enemy units by this unit’s attacks this turn, **Heal (D3)** this unit and each other friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS MONSTER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Vengorians bid their monstrous broods indulge in gory feasts even as battle rages.

abilities.name: Scything Talons
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: As the Vengorian Lord crashes into the foe, it lays about itself with frenzied sweeps of its huge talons, cutting down droves of lesser foes.

abilities.name: Nightmare's Miasma
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: The strange curse of the Vengorians sees shining blades and hallowed relics crumble and patinate in their presence.

units.lore: Twisted by the power of unbound arcana, Vengorian Lords embody the nightmarish true nature of the Soulblight vampires. Unable to bear the sight of their own reflection, they wield magics of rust and corrosion, revelling in their own self-loathing. Those who rouse a Vengorian’s dark appetite are torn to pieces in a frenzied fit of hunger, their blood gulped down and their bones left crushed and scattered across the ground.

units.name: Blood Knights

abilities.name: Riders of Ruin
abilities.description: Effect: When this unit moves, it can pass through models in enemy **INFANTRY** units and can pass through the combat ranges of enemy **INFANTRY** units, but it cannot end a move in combat unless specified in the ability used.
abilities.lore: Blood Knights trample clean over lesser foes to strike at more worthy challengers.

abilities.name: Trampled to Dust
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Infantrymen who find themselves in the Blood Knights’ path are crushed beneath the hooves of their Nightmare steeds.

units.lore: Resplendent in gleaming armour, vampiric chevaliers charge into battle, crushing their foes beneath the thundering hooves of their skeletal mounts. These are the Blood Knights, the elite warriors of the Soulblight hosts. They claim to follow a code of honour, but in truth, their self-proclaimed chivalry is nothing but a shining veneer that corrodes as soon as the killing starts.

units.name: Necromancer

abilities.name: Vanhel's Danse Macabre
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: The target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The undead are filled with magical energy that causes them to jerk forwards and attack with tireless, unnatural speed.

abilities.name: Undead Minions
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit:

• This unit has **WARD (4+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** or **DEADWALKERS** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
abilities.lore: Necromancers are obsessed with staving off death and will sacrifice any number of their resurrected servants to protect themselves.

units.lore: At first glance, one might number a Necromancer amongst the dead. Their faces are sallow and their limbs wizened, but a vestige of life still glints in their eyes – though it is all but smothered by morbid arcana. Even as they are corrupted by these energies, a Necromancer wields them to bolster the legions of Nagash and place enervating curses on the foe, sapping them of vitality with the hunger of the Shyish Nadir.

units.name: Ivya Volga, The Outcast

abilities.name: Behemoth's Bane
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 2 from the Attacks characteristic of enemy **MONSTERS’** melee weapons while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: Ivya has spent centuries roaming the forests of Shyish and beyond, and she has triumphed over some of the most heinous beasts imaginable.

abilities.name: Shrieking Swarm
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.
abilities.lore: Wherever Iyva goes, a flight of screeching bats accompanies her.

abilities.name: Total Dominance
abilities.description:
Declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy **MONSTERS** while they are within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: With a swift and precise gesture, Ivya exerts her powerful influence over nearby monsters.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Vyrkos Retainer*.

units.lore: An outcast amongst a dynasty renowned for the strength of its blood ties, the rebellious Ivya Volga has spent centuries roaming across the deadliest wilds of Shyish and beyond, hacking down its most ferocious denizens with her woodcutter’s axe and drinking from their opened veins. She surrounds herself with a swarm of needle-fanged bats, which will sacrifice themselves without hesitation to protect their mistress.

units.name: Revenant Draconith

abilities.name: Death on Tattered Wings
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up this unit in reserve **high above the battlefield**. It has now been deployed.
abilities.lore: The Revenant Draconith circles above the arrayed armies, eye sockets aglow with unholy energy.

abilities.name: Red Ruin
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, resolve the following effects:
•  Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
•  **Heal (X)** this unit where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.
•  This unit can be removed from the battlefield and set up in reserve **high above the battlefield**.
abilities.lore: Tearing free of the press with talons and teeth, the Revenant Draconith leaves a trail of gory destruction behind as it takes to the skies once more, searching for fresh prey.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Draconic Claws** is 5.

abilities.name: Loathsome Descent
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is **high above the battlefield**.

Effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The Revenant Draconith plunges into battle with a roar, slamming into its prey with bone-shattering force.

units.lore: Creatures both tragic and horrifying, the Revenant Draconith are titans from another age, raised from death by the foulest necromantic rituals. They still possess the strength of Dracothion’s true spawn, but all nobility has been scoured from them. They now exist only to kill, and at this there are few beings in existence more proficient. Descending from the skies like the image of death itself, they fall upon their prey spewing gouts of flesh-melting gas and shredding mortal flesh with claws and teeth.

units.name: Wight King on Skeletal Steed

abilities.name: Ancient Barrow Curse
abilities.description:
Effect: If an attack made with this unit’s **King’s Relic Weapon** scores a critical hit, the target unit becomes **cursed** for the rest of the battle. Subtract 1 from save rolls for **cursed** units even if this unit has been destroyed.

**Designer’s Note**: *Multiple enemy units can become cursed by this ability but the same enemy unit cannot become cursed more than once.*
abilities.lore: The weapons of the most powerful Wight Kings leave a scar on the soul that causes the victim to slowly crumble to dust.

abilities.name: Immortal Conqueror
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an objective or terrain feature within enemy territory.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **DEATHRATTLE** units while they are wholly within 6" of that objective or terrain feature.
abilities.lore: A mighty general in life, in undeath, the endless need to wage war and conquer the lands of the living lingers on in this ancient wight as a thirst that can never be quenched.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Deathrattle Overseer*.

units.lore: Most powerful of all the Deathrattle tyrants are the Wight Kings, those undead sovereigns whose domains encompass dozens – sometimes hundreds – of barrow kingdoms. The embodiment of endless conquest, they possess the willpower to defy all save Nagash and the military might to bring entire continents into their iron grasp.

units.name: Dire Wolves

abilities.name: On The Hunt
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use a **RUN** ability and still use **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.
abilities.lore: Unlike most undead, Dire Wolves have lost almost none of the swiftness they possessed in life and are forever hungry for warm flesh.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

units.lore: It is said that to hear a Dire Wolf’s howl is to be damned. These lupine undead are tireless hunters, and when they finally run their prey to ground, their powerful jaws ensure that the kill comes swiftly indeed.

units.name: Kritza, the Rat Prince

abilities.name: The Verminous Court
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target, then pick an artefact of power that the target has.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target no longer has that artefact of power.
abilities.lore: Kritza believes himself an appreciator of the finer things in undeath, and his rodent servants are adept in snatching away trinkets and treasures for his collection.

abilities.name: Scurrying Retreat
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.
abilities.lore: Just when a foe has him cornered, Kritza transfigures into a swarm of scurrying rats, only to rematerialise elsewhere and drive his blade into an enemy’s back.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Vyrkos Retainer*.

units.lore: The repellent Kritza is a vampire that has feasted upon so many rodents that he has adopted many of the traits of these hardy and cunning creatures. Hiding his sewer stench behind a thick cloud of equally nauseating perfume, this gaunt and unsettling creature preys upon mortals without restraint. Whenever he feels outmatched, he will simply transform into a swarm of vermin and slip away through cracks in the walls.

units.name: Wight Lord on Skeletal Steed

abilities.name: Royal Companions
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DEATHRATTLE CAVALRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Mounted Wight Lords fight accompanied by their most skilled cavaliers, tearing through enemy battlelines.

abilities.name: Lord of Trampling Bones
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **DEATHRATTLE CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The knights who ride alongside a Wight Lord will be the most trusted and skilful of all their housecarls.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Deathrattle Overseer*.

units.lore: Wight Lords often ride to war atop fleshless steeds, taking command of the household cavalry and overseeing the annihilation of their liege’s foes first-hand. These undead champions observe the battle with passionless focus, waiting for the moment that an opening presents itself. Then they ride forth to exploit that weakness, plunging deep into the enemy’s line at the tip of an armoured wedge.

units.name: Barrow Knights

abilities.name: Knights of the King
abilities.description: Effect: While any friendly **DEATHRATTLE CAVALRY HEROES** are within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Buried alongside their liege in ancient times, these deathly knights are still bound by arcane ward and ancient oath to ride into battle at their side.

abilities.name: Cursed To Rise Once More
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description: Effect: You can return 1 slain model to this unit.
abilities.lore: Necrotic flames wreathe the shattered remains of an undead knight, compelling them to rejoin the battle.

units.lore: The finest warriors of a Deathrattle kingdom are granted the rank of Barrow Knight and a prestigious place at the side of their undead monarch. These skeletal cavaliers ride forth to conquer in the name of their liege, and rare are the warriors who can withstand their charge. Even if knocked from the saddle or shattered by cannonfire, these elite riders shall eventually rise again, for the oaths they have sworn will last until the end of time itself.

units.name: Askurgan Trueblades

abilities.name: Creed of the Askurga Renkai
abilities.description:
Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy **MONSTERS** that target this unit.

Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by this unit that target enemy **MONSTERS**.
abilities.lore: Faithful to the teachings of ancient masters long slain, Trueblades test themselves against the most powerful adversaries, feasting solely on monstrous blood to bolster their strength and speed.

abilities.name: Gut-wrenching Howl
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit’s **Curseblood** to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The howl of a Curseblood resounds with the force of long-repressed bloodlust finally finding release, staggering even the bravest souls.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: Rather than deny their thirst, the Askurgan Trueblades harness it by feasting upon the blood of beasts and monsters, using the inherent power of these potent fluids to enhance their already devastating combat skills. Few can stand in the face of an Askurgan Trueblade’s efficient strikes, which come so swiftly and precisely that the foe is often reduced to a ruined corpse before they can even draw a breath.

units.name: Lady Annika, the Thirsting Blade

abilities.name: Starving Nightmare
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is **lying in wait**.

Effect: Set up this unit wholly within enemy territory and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Unable to contain her hunger any longer, Lady Annika springs forth from hiding, eager to glut herself on the blood of the foe.

abilities.name: Supernatural Speed
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up this unit in reserve **lying in wait**. It has now been deployed.
abilities.lore: Lady Annika’s near-permanent state of starvation drives her ahead of the main battlelines, ready to pounce as soon as prey draws near.

abilities.name: Kiss of the Blade Proboscian
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that was allocated any damage points inflicted by this unit’s combat attacks this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: This pitted and corroded blade should not endure – and yet, it does. The same cannot be said for anything scratched by its mouldering point.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Vyrkos Retainer*.

units.lore: Annika fights as though suffused by some arcane swiftness, for she is faster and more agile than any of her Vyrkos kin. She wields the Blade Proboscian, slicing open the veins of her prey and letting the enchanted weapon drain their blood dry in moments. Yet for every foe exsanguinated in this manner, Annika gains only fleeting succour. Whether caused by her consumption of exotic substances or simply a side-effect of the Soulblight curse, her unique, haemovoric mania can never be satisfied.

units.name: Mannfred von Carstein, Mortarch of Night

weapons.name: Gheistvor, the Sword of Unholy Power

abilities.name: Ashigaroth's Hunger
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit has **STRIKE‑FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Mannfred’s dread abyssal is afflicted by a hunger as indiscriminate as it is unending, and it strikes with lightning-fast speed to attempt in vain to satiate that hunger.

abilities.name: Wind of Death
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a point on the battlefield within 18" of the caster, pick up to 3 enemy units within 6" of that point and visible to the caster to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Mannfred conjures a howling gust of spectral wind that tears the souls from the bodies of those who feel its chilling bite.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Ashigaroth’s Claws** is 3.

abilities.name: The Mortarch of Night
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: The unit using the ‘Redeploy’ command can move into combat when using that ability.
abilities.lore: Mannfred’s ancient cunning is rightly feared throughout the Mortal Realms.

abilities.name: The Sword of Unholy Power
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has slain any enemy models this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **DEATHRATTLE** and **DEADWALKERS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Gheistvor drinks deep of its victims’ souls, bolstering the power of Mannfred’s risen minions.

units.lore: A cunning military mastermind and a skilled wielder of the darkest magic, Mannfred von Carstein is feared and reviled across the Mortal Realms. In his wake lie the corpses of untold thousands, slaughtered because they stood in the path of his vaulting ambition. The Mortarch of Night rides into battle atop the dread abyssal Ashigaroth, carving a bloody path through his terrified prey with lightning slashes of Gheistvor, the Sword of Unholy Power. Any foes able to fend off this deadly assault are subjected to a soul-withering storm of amethyst sorcery that seals their demise.

units.name: Corpse Cart

abilities.name: Locus of Undeath
abilities.description: Effect: Melee weapons used by other friendly **DEADWALKERS** units have **Crit (Auto-wound)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Corpse Carts are wellsprings of necromantic power that bestow greater vigour upon the resurrected corpses of the freshly slain.

units.lore: Across those territories ruled by the Midnight Aristocracy travel macabre conveyances, filled to the brim with decomposing flesh and drawn by groaning cadavers.
