These are the Corpse Carts, unspeakable devices that function as locus points for deathly magic, imbuing nearby undead with terrible vigour and might.

units.name: Radukar the Beast

abilities.name: The Beast Will Out
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is not in combat, it can move D6". It can move into combat.
abilities.lore: In his hulking bestial form, Radukar is a frenzied abomination concerned only with tearing apart everything in his path.

abilities.name: Call to the Hunt
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **DEATHRATTLE** and **DEADWALKERS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: With an exultant howl, Radukar leads the charge, his surge of bloodlust filling nearby undead minions with unholy impetus.

abilities.name: Armour of the Night
abilities.description:
Declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: With a mere thought, Radukar the Beast summons wisps of pure darkness to form a penumbral shield around his body, protecting him from harm.

details.notes: You cannot include this unit and **Radukar the Wolf** in the same army.

units.lore: The vampire Radukar became ever more monstrous as the full power of his curse manifested. He transformed into a terrifying berserker-beast, the injuries that threatened to end him eclipsed by raw strength. This altered Radukar is a towering creature with dagger-length claws, capable of moving with a swiftness that seems impossible for his size.

units.name: Sekhar, Fang of Nulahmia

abilities.name: The Time-Swallower's Maw
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.

Effect: This unit cannot use the ‘Serpentine Agility’ ability for the rest of the battle. Roll 2D6 for each target. If the roll exceeds the target’s Move characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the difference between the roll and its Move characteristic.
abilities.lore: Though Sekhar is loath to let Ouboroth feast upon souls, sometimes, needs must.

abilities.name: Death's Construction
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, while they are wholly within 6" of this unit, friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** units cannot be picked to be the target of abilities used by the target other than **FIGHT** abilities.
abilities.lore: Through the subtlest arcane suggestion, Sekhar implants her will in vulnerable minds – supplanting their former purpose with the undying will of Nulahmia.

abilities.name: Serpentine Agility
abilities.description: Effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
abilities.lore: Sekhar moves as a blinding blur, her unnatural speed obscuring her form from even the keenest gaze.

regimentOptions: Any SCIONS OF NULAHMIA Vampire Lord

units.lore: Sekhar is one of the most lethally skilled agents of the Mortarch Neferata and the most prominent member of the elite order known as the Fangs of Nulahmia. She is a master manipulator and spy whose honeyed whispers have seen more kingdoms crumble to dust than she can recall. Sekhar travels the realms at the behest of her mistress, advancing the cause of the Nulahmian elite and ensuring – through subterfuge, trickery or outright slaughter – that Neferata’s enemies are bled white.

units.name: Lauka Vai, Mother of Nightmares

abilities.name: Impaling Talons
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the target’s Health characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Lauka Vai thrusts her massive talons into her prey with lethal precision, inflicting horrendous wounds upon them.

abilities.name: Nightmare's Miasma
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: The strange curse of the Vengorians sees shining blades and hallowed relics crumble and patinate in their presence.

abilities.name: The Queen's Dictat
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**UNIQUE SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS MONSTER** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. If the target has any **Companion** melee weapons, you must pick 1 of those. Add D3 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Lauka summons an arcane blood-mist that drives a beast among her brood into a terrible frenzy.

units.lore: Not for nothing is Lauka Vai known as the Mother of Nightmares, for she is the matron of the bestial and maligned Avengorii dynasty. Though she refuses to give in to the vile urges that thunder in her cursed blood, Vai is swift to respond to threats or insults with overwhelming violence. Foes are ripped to shreds by her talons and her dancing rapier, their gory remains tossed to the menagerie of twisted horrors that serves as her court.

armiesOfRenown.name: Knights of the Crimson Keep
armiesOfRenown.description: Grim and blood-drenched are the tales of the Crimson Keep, the cursed fortress of Prince Vhordrai and his Kastelai knights. It has existed since before Vhordrai even came to prominence, a potent symbol of vampiric military dominance that has been turned by Nagash into a gaol and a realm-shifting weapon. Legend has it that it was forged by the Blood Emperor during the Age of Myth and once stood at the centre of an entire Soulblight civilisation.
armiesOfRenown.lore:
Grim and blood-drenched are the tales of the Crimson Keep, the cursed fortress of Prince Vhordrai and his Kastelai knights. It has existed since before Vhordrai even came to prominence, a potent symbol of vampiric military dominance that has been turned by Nagash into a gaol and a realm-shifting weapon. Legend has it that it was forged by the Blood Emperor during the Age of Myth and once stood at the centre of an entire Soulblight civilisation.

That empire, and with it the Crimson Keep, would be brought to heel by the Undying King. Nagash’s sorcery dragged the entire structure out of synchronisation with reality, transforming its stones into spectral matter and allowing the Keep to manifest out of the ruins of shattered castles across the Mortal Realms. From this lair, Prince Vhordrai launches murderous crusades against the living whilst also seeking the means to free himself from the curse that binds him to the macabre fortress.

When you pick the Soulblight Gravelords faction for your army, you can choose it to be a Knights of the Crimson Keep Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules as described in Army of Renown: Knights of the Crimson Keep instead of the Soulblight Gravelords faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed as described in Army of Renown: Knights of the Crimson Keep. All units in your army gain the Crimson Keep keyword.
armiesOfRenown.source: Army of Renown: Knights of the Crimson Keep

battleTraits.name: The Crimson Keep
battleTraits.phase: Deployment Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CRIMSON KEEP** unit that has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up that unit in reserve **in the Crimson Keep**. It has now been deployed. You cannot set up more friendly units **in the Crimson Keep** than there are on the battlefield.
battleTraits.lore: None can predict where the Crimson Keep will manifest next, but wherever it appears, the slaughter its occupants will wreak will be total.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Knights of the Crimson Keep
battleTraits.groupName: Knights of the Crimson Keep Battle Traits

battleTraits.name: Blood Rampage
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CRIMSON KEEP MONSTER** that is in combat and has not used any **RAMPAGE** abilities this turn to use this ability, then pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: This unit can make a move of 2D6". It must end that move in combat with the target unit. Then, roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target unit’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.

After this ability has been resolved, this unit cannot use **RAMPAGE** abilities for the rest of the turn.
battleTraits.lore: The nightmarish behemoths that roost among the upper spires of the Crimson Keep tear through the enemy’s ranks, sending bloody chunks and gore flying in all directions.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Knights of the Crimson Keep
battleTraits.groupName: Knights of the Crimson Keep Battle Traits

battleTraits.name: Carve A Bloody Path
battleTraits.phase: Your Charge Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Blood Knights** unit that is in combat to use this ability.

Effect: That unit can use a **CHARGE** ability even though it is in combat and even if it has already used a **CHARGE** ability this turn.
battleTraits.lore: With unstoppable force, a wedge of Blood Knights punches through the enemy’s lines leaving a trail of broken foes in their wake.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Knights of the Crimson Keep
battleTraits.groupName: Knights of the Crimson Keep Battle Traits

battleTraits.name: From A Quarter Unseen
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Movement Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You cannot use this ability in the first battle round. Pick each friendly unit that is **in the Crimson Keep** to be the targets.

Effect: Set up each target wholly within 9" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. If you set up any units using this ability in the third or a subsequent battle round, do not spend any command points when using the ‘Carve a Bloody Path’ command this turn.
battleTraits.lore: Prince Vhordrai has mastered the art of trapping the foe between his main force and reserves that sally forth from the Crimson Keep at his signal.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Knights of the Crimson Keep
battleTraits.groupName: Knights of the Crimson Keep Battle Traits

heroicTraits.name: Immortal Dedication
heroicTraits.description:
Effect: This unit receives D3 **martial prowess tokens**. Each **martial prowess token** can be spent to do 1 of the following:

• Re-roll a hit roll for this unit.
• Re-roll a wound roll for this unit.
• Re-roll a save roll for this unit.

At the start of the next turn, remove all this unit’s **martial prowess tokens**.
heroicTraits.lore: Having spent centuries in undeath honing their martial skill, this Gravelord is a master of combat.
heroicTraits.source: Army of Renown: Knights of the Crimson Keep
heroicTraits.groupName: Knights of the Crimson Keep Heroic Trait

artefacts.name: Chalice of the Blood Dragon
artefacts.phase: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
artefacts.description: Effect: **Heal (3D3)** this unit.
artefacts.lore: Said to have been possessed by the Crimson Keep’s first castellan, this chalice can be drained to renew a vampire’s vigour.
artefacts.source: Army of Renown: Knights of the Crimson Keep
artefacts.groupName: Knights of the Crimson Keep Artefact of Power

spells.name: Siphon Strength
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CRIMSON KEEP WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by the caster.
spells.lore: The vampire draws on the life essence of the enemy to flood their limbs with strength and heighten their senses.

spells.name: Deathly Gale
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CRIMSON KEEP WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **CRIMSON KEEP** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a maximum of 3.
spells.lore: A foul wind carrying a stench of death and decay races across the battlefield, speeding the charge of the Knights of the Crimson Keep.

spells.name: Awakened Fury
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CRIMSON KEEP WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly Crimson Keep unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s **Companion** melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
spells.lore: At the sorcerer’s gesture, hooves are wreathed in balefire and monstrous talons grow elongated and wickedly sharp.

manifestations.name: Unholy Reliquary

abilities.name: Draw on Power
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS HERO** wholly within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following:

• **Heal (D3)** the target.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn. Then, this **MANIFESTATION** is banished and removed from play.
abilities.lore: The necromantic energy of this long-perished vampire can be siphoned by their kind for sustenance or drawn upon to grant a temporary rush of power.

manifestations.lore: The corpse of an elder vampire lies within this cursed casket, still smouldering with hatred and hunger. These remains act as a conduit of potent necromantic energies. Soulblight lords often take such a relic into battle with them, drawing upon its profane power in order to heal their wounds or to infuse their undead soldiers with a sudden burst of killing might.

summonSpell.name: Summon Unholy Reliquary

Declare: If there is not a friendly **Unholy Reliquary** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **CRIMSON KEEP WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an **Unholy Reliquary** wholly within 18" of the caster.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Revenant Draconith

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Draconic Claws** is 5.

abilities.name: Brimming with Rancour
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the target cannot end moves made as part of a non-**CHARGE MOVE** ability within **X**" of this unit, where **X** is equal to your current **fury level**.
abilities.lore: The Revenant Draconith turns towards a foe, the witchlights of its eyes flickering. Radiating pure malevolence, the enemy dares not approach its mouldering form.

abilities.name: Volatile Animus
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, pick 1 of the following effects:

***Retaliatory Posture***: For the rest of the turn:
• Ignore positive modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
• Add 1 to save rolls for this unit.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks, including attacks made with **Companion** weapons, that target an enemy unit that used a **FIGHT** ability this phase.

***Unrelenting Ferocity***: For the rest of the turn:
• Ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s attacks.
• Add 1 to the Rend and Damage characteristics of this unit’s **Companion** melee weapons for attacks that target an enemy unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this phase
abilities.lore: The furious energies of Aqshy combine with the forces animating the Revenant Draconith to make it highly unpredictable.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Rotted heirs of the godbeast Dracothion, Revenant Draconith are the decaying corpses of great drakes animated by necromancy. With a deep-seated animosity for all living things, they swoop down through the Aqshian skies to disgorge their flesh-melting breath over the enemy, lashing out with raking talons in a hate-filled frenzy.

units.name: Fell Bats

abilities.name: Fleet and Fell
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.
abilities.lore: Borne swiftly upon huge, tattered wings, Fell Bats are able to swoop down upon and break away from their prey with impunity, their frenzied flapping making it difficult to pin them down.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

units.lore: Leather-winged monstrosities bloated on blood and necrotic sorcery, Fell Bats haunt the cursed forests and battlefields of the realms. Each is large enough to pluck a rider from the saddle and carry them off into the skies, and their dagger-length canine teeth are so sharp that they can puncture solid metal.

units.name: Prince Vhordrai

abilities.name: Trail of Crimson
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can make a pile-in move (even if it is not in combat). Then, if this unit is in combat, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Shordemaire ploughs into the enemy’s lines, its giant jaws tearing huge chunks from monsters or swallowing smaller foes whole.

abilities.name: Saint of Slaughter
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**MONSTER VAMPIRE** unit that destroyed a unit this turn using a **FIGHT** ability and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply for the rest of the battle:

• Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic.
• Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

More than 1 effect can apply to a unit at the same time; however, each effect can only be applied to a unit once.
abilities.lore: Under the fierce scrutiny of Prince Vhordrai, vampires revel in displaying their martial skill.

abilities.name: Quickblood
abilities.description:
Declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Vhordrai calls upon the power of the curse running through his veins to strike with impossible speed.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Shordemaire’s Claws** is 5.

units.lore: The most feared vampire cavalier in existence is the legendary Prince Vhordrai, castellan – and prisoner – of the Crimson Keep. When released from his cursed fortress to wage war against the living, Vhordrai rides forth atop the undead Draconith known as Shordemaire. This ancient beast spews gouts of pestilential breath that melt flesh and armour, before swooping in low so that its master can drive his Bloodlance through the ribs of any foes still standing.

units.name: Vampire Lord on Nightmare Steed

abilities.name: Strike At The Heart
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Blood Knights** unit that charged this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit’s **Templar Weapons** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Focusing upon their own cursed hunger, the Vampire Lord stokes the predatory urges of a formation of Blood Knights, whose lances and blades strike with great precision and force as they impact with the foe.

abilities.name: 'For Glory! For Blood!'
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: You can re-roll the charge roll for that **CHARGE** ability. Then, before the charge move is made, you can pick a friendly **Blood Knights** unit that is not in combat, is wholly within 12" of this unit and has not used a **CHARGE** ability this turn to be the target. If this unit charges, then, immediately after the **CHARGE** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can immediately use the ‘Charge’ ability even if it is not your charge phase. In addition, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target this phase.
abilities.lore: The Vampire Lord and their retinue of favoured knights charge into the fray, driving deep into the enemy lines.

units.lore: When mounted upon an undead steed known as a nightmare, a Vampire Lord carves a gory path through the enemy with each thundering charge. The beast’s ironshod hooves cave in chests and grind foes into the mud, while the undead cavalier astride it lays about themself with a blade or axe, opening throats with every blow.

units.name: Blood Knights

abilities.name: Riders of Ruin
abilities.description: Effect: When this unit moves, it can pass through models in enemy **INFANTRY** units and can pass through the combat ranges of enemy **INFANTRY** units, but it cannot end a move in combat unless specified in the ability used.
abilities.lore: Blood Knights trample clean over lesser foes to strike at more worthy challengers.

abilities.name: Trampled to Dust
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across this turn to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Infantrymen who find themselves in the Blood Knights’ path are crushed beneath the hooves of their Nightmare steeds.

units.lore: Resplendent in gleaming armour, vampiric chevaliers charge into battle, crushing their foes beneath the thundering hooves of their skeletal mounts. These are the Blood Knights, the elite warriors of the Soulblight hosts. They claim to follow a code of honour, but in truth, their self-proclaimed chivalry is nothing but a shining veneer that corrodes as soon as the killing starts.

units.name: Revenant Draconith

abilities.name: Death on Tattered Wings
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it has not been deployed.

Effect: Set up this unit in reserve **high above the battlefield**. It has now been deployed.
abilities.lore: The Revenant Draconith circles above the arrayed armies, eye sockets aglow with unholy energy.

abilities.name: Red Ruin
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, resolve the following effects:
•  Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
•  **Heal (X)** this unit where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.
•  This unit can be removed from the battlefield and set up in reserve **high above the battlefield**.
abilities.lore: Tearing free of the press with talons and teeth, the Revenant Draconith leaves a trail of gory destruction behind as it takes to the skies once more, searching for fresh prey.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Draconic Claws** is 5.

abilities.name: Loathsome Descent
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is **high above the battlefield**.

Effect: Set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The Revenant Draconith plunges into battle with a roar, slamming into its prey with bone-shattering force.

units.lore: Creatures both tragic and horrifying, the Revenant Draconith are titans from another age, raised from death by the foulest necromantic rituals. They still possess the strength of Dracothion’s true spawn, but all nobility has been scoured from them. They now exist only to kill, and at this there are few beings in existence more proficient. Descending from the skies like the image of death itself, they fall upon their prey spewing gouts of flesh-melting gas and shredding mortal flesh with claws and teeth.

armiesOfRenown.name: Barrow Legion
armiesOfRenown.description: The barrow kingdoms of the Deathrattle represent undeath in all its sterile glory. Echoes of a glorious past, these civilisations exist in a constant state of atrophy, awaiting the summons of a Wight King master to fight in another of their endless wars.
armiesOfRenown.lore:
The barrow kingdoms of the Deathrattle represent undeath in all its sterile glory. Echoes of a glorious past, these civilisations exist in a constant state of atrophy, awaiting the summons of a Wight King master to fight in another of their endless wars.

If one wished to glimpse into the future that Nagash intends for the Chaos-tormented lands of the realms, they would need look no further than the kingdoms of the Deathrattle. Once, these domains obeyed the rigid structures of feudal order, with thousands of peasants living out their harsh and short-lived existences in farms and guildhalls in service of their regent. In death, that order has remained intact, though all meaning and purpose beyond eternal service has long been lost. Skeletal fingers rake the dirt of barren fields, grasping not for tubers but for decaying corpses. Millstones grind on unceasingly, crushing bones to dust. And while this macabre mockery of feudal existence continues, the Wight King and his inner circle plot their next conquest.

When you pick the Soulblight Gravelords faction for your army, you can choose it to be a Barrow Legion Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules as described in Army of Renown: Barrow Legion instead of the Soulblight Gravelords faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed as described in Army of Renown: Barrow Legion. All units in your army gain the Barrow Legion keyword. Wight King and Wight King on Skeletal Steed units in your army gain Warmaster.
armiesOfRenown.source: Army of Renown: Barrow Legion

battleTraits.name: The Royal Crypt
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle, Deployment Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: This ability must be used instead of the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain Feature’ ability.

Effect: Set up 3 **Cursed Sepulchres** wholly within friendly territory, each within ½" of any of the others and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, they have been deployed and they are considered to be a single **Cursed Sepulchre** terrain feature that has a Health characteristic of 24 instead of 8.
battleTraits.lore: These crumbling ruins marks the ancient holdings of a powerful wight.

battleTraits.name: All to Dust
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description: Effect: In the third and subsequent battle rounds, while a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre** is on the battlefield, subtract 1 from save rolls for enemy units.
battleTraits.lore: Acting as a conduit to the Shyish Nadir, the death magic that swirls around this barrow legion’s tomb causes trespassers to atrophy and their armour to corrode under the weight of ages.

battleTraits.name: Endless Legions of Bone
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle Round (Army), Any Movement Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE BARROW LEGION** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a friendly **BARROW LEGION HERO** or wholly within 6" of a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre**. It must be set up more than 9" from all enemy units.

If it is your movement phase, you can set up the replacement unit more than 3" from all enemy units instead of more than 9", but if you set it up within 9" of any enemy units, it cannot use **CHARGE** abilities this turn.
battleTraits.lore: When the Deathrattle armies are roused to war, their numbers are unending.

battleTraits.name: Grave Sentinels
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description: Effect: The melee weapons used by friendly **BARROW LEGION** units have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** while they are wholly within 9" of a friendly **Cursed Sepulchre**.
battleTraits.lore: Unwavering in their eternal vigilance, the deathly warriors of this legion’s overlord guard his ancient resting place.

battleTraits.name: Gifts to the Petty Kingdoms
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle, Deployment Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick up to 2 friendly non-**UNIQUE BARROW LEGION HEROES** that do not have an artefact of power to be the targets (you can pick units in reserve).

Effect: Give each target 1 artefact of power from the ‘Barrow Legion’ Army of Renown rules.

**Designer’s Note**: *These artefacts of power are given to the* **HEROES** *during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*
battleTraits.lore: To each of his vassal kingdoms, this legion’s monarch bestowed a gift bearing a curse that bound them to his service for evermore.

heroicTraits.name: Lord of the Arcane Aegis
heroicTraits.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following keywords:

• **INFANTRY**
• **CAVALRY**
• **MONSTER**
• **BEAST**

For the rest of the battle, each time an attack targets this unit, if the attacking unit has the keyword you picked, an unmodified save roll of 4+ for that attack is always successful.
heroicTraits.lore: Even in undeath, this wight still recalls all manner of warding cantrips to protect his forces from the enemy.

heroicTraits.name: Spirit-eater
heroicTraits.description: Effect: If any models were slain by your general this turn, **Heal (D6)** your general.
heroicTraits.lore: The souls of slain enemies are drawn into this king of undeath, imbuing him with unholy might.

heroicTraits.name: Restless Tyrant
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BARROW LEGION** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn.
heroicTraits.lore: The skeletal warriors under this one’s command are driven ever forward.

artefacts.name: Crypt Dagger
artefacts.phase: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
artefacts.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.
artefacts.lore: Foul sorcery flickers and dances across the ancient iron of this cursed blade, and its bite can bring instant death.

artefacts.name: Crown of Cold Command
artefacts.phase: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase
artefacts.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **BARROW LEGION** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:

• If the target is damaged, **Heal (3)** the target.
•  If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
artefacts.lore: This eldritch crown compels this king’s warriors from ages past to rise from their graves and fight once more.

artefacts.name: Grave-sand Pendant
artefacts.description: Effect: If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, **Heal (1)** this unit. This unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.
artefacts.lore: When shattered, the Shyishan realmstone within this talisman can forestall the bearer’s final destruction, granting them one last chance to claim revenge.

artefacts.name: Amulet of Nightmares
artefacts.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
artefacts.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within 9" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** this phase.
artefacts.lore: The nightmares of the bearer, who endures a torturous existence trapped in their mouldering undead form, are projected into the minds of the living by this onyx talisman.

artefacts.name: Ring of Stricken Souls
artefacts.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
artefacts.lore: Violet clouds swirl within the Shyishan amethyst set in this ring, which grants the bearer uncanny protection.

terrain.name: Cursed Sepulchre

abilities.name: Leeching Soil
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a model (friendly or enemy) is slain while it is within 9" of this terrain feature, **Heal (1)** this terrain feature.
abilities.lore: When blood is spilt upon this unhallowed ground, it is hungrily absorbed by the tainted earth and the withered roots running through it.

abilities.name: Locus of Shyish
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS WIZARD** casts a **SUMMON SPELL** from the ‘Manifestations of the Grave’ lore, you can measure the range and visibility from this terrain feature instead.
abilities.lore: A palpable aura of death lingers over these ancient burial sites, dormant necromantic energy that can be harnessed by Shyishan practitioners.

terrain.lore: Across the realms there are many places drenched in the energies of death – sites of necromantic potential where hundreds or even thousands of souls met their tragic end amidst violence and horror. Such areas are rich pickings for the Soulblight Gravelords. They contain bounteous quantities of desiccated flesh and yellowed bone ready to be transformed into undead soldiery or used to patch up damaged warriors. Better still, practitioners of death magic can siphon the grim energies permeating these locations to restore their unnatural vitality.

units.name: Wight King

abilities.name: King of Shambling Bones
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DEATHRATTLE** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: In the presence of their sovereign, the footsoldiers of the Deathrattle kingdoms assume a sliver of their former warlike vigour.

abilities.name: Ancient Strategies
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DEATHRATTLE INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Death does not rob a Wight King of their strategic genius, and they direct their undead thralls with great skill.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Deathrattle Overseer*.

units.lore: Wight Kings are deathless tyrants, ruling over barrow empires populated entirely by skeletal thralls. They exist only to dominate others, having long ago sacrificed emotion and passion on the altar of their obsessive lust for triumph. In battle, few can withstand their relentless assault. Those foolish enough to challenge their supremacy are soon hacked to pieces by the monarch’s cursed blade, a weapon capable of snuffing out a soul with a single scratch.

units.name: Deathrattle Skeletons

abilities.name: Skeleton Legion
abilities.description: Effect: You can return D3 slain models to this unit.
abilities.lore: As necromantic energies blanket the battlefield, long-dead warriors stagger to their feet once more, eye sockets aglow with killing light.

units.lore: Clattering forwards in formation, their yellowed skulls devoid of expression, the Deathrattle Skeletons go forth to annihilate the living. These undead automatons have no free will and are imbued only with the imperative to slay as swiftly and efficiently as possible. Even if a skeletal warrior is smashed to pieces, the horror continues – with the battlefield steeped in necromantic energies, the Deathrattle Skeleton’s bones will lock together once more as it clambers upright, ready to kill again.

units.name: Barrow Guard

abilities.name: Guardians of the King
abilities.description: Effect: While any friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS INFANTRY HEROES** are within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: The Barrow Guard stand alongside the liege lord to whom they are bound.

units.lore: Surrounding a Wight King is a coterie of favoured praetorians, champions and housecarls: the Barrow Guard. These are the elite footsoldiers of the Deathrattle legions, imbued with memories of loyalties pledged and oaths of eternal service. Some favour the traditional sword and shield of a monarch’s bodyguard, while others swing huge two-handed blades to carve foes in twain.

units.name: Wight King on Skeletal Steed

abilities.name: Ancient Barrow Curse
abilities.description:
Effect: If an attack made with this unit’s **King’s Relic Weapon** scores a critical hit, the target unit becomes **cursed** for the rest of the battle. Subtract 1 from save rolls for **cursed** units even if this unit has been destroyed.

**Designer’s Note**: *Multiple enemy units can become cursed by this ability but the same enemy unit cannot become cursed more than once.*
abilities.lore: The weapons of the most powerful Wight Kings leave a scar on the soul that causes the victim to slowly crumble to dust.

abilities.name: Immortal Conqueror
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an objective or terrain feature within enemy territory.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **DEATHRATTLE** units while they are wholly within 6" of that objective or terrain feature.
abilities.lore: A mighty general in life, in undeath, the endless need to wage war and conquer the lands of the living lingers on in this ancient wight as a thirst that can never be quenched.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Deathrattle Overseer*.

units.lore: Most powerful of all the Deathrattle tyrants are the Wight Kings, those undead sovereigns whose domains encompass dozens – sometimes hundreds – of barrow kingdoms. The embodiment of endless conquest, they possess the willpower to defy all save Nagash and the military might to bring entire continents into their iron grasp.

units.name: Wight Lord on Skeletal Steed

abilities.name: Royal Companions
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DEATHRATTLE CAVALRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Mounted Wight Lords fight accompanied by their most skilled cavaliers, tearing through enemy battlelines.

abilities.name: Lord of Trampling Bones
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **DEATHRATTLE CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The knights who ride alongside a Wight Lord will be the most trusted and skilful of all their housecarls.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Deathrattle Overseer*.

units.lore: Wight Lords often ride to war atop fleshless steeds, taking command of the household cavalry and overseeing the annihilation of their liege’s foes first-hand. These undead champions observe the battle with passionless focus, waiting for the moment that an opening presents itself. Then they ride forth to exploit that weakness, plunging deep into the enemy’s line at the tip of an armoured wedge.

units.name: Barrow Knights

abilities.name: Knights of the King
abilities.description: Effect: While any friendly **DEATHRATTLE CAVALRY HEROES** are within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Buried alongside their liege in ancient times, these deathly knights are still bound by arcane ward and ancient oath to ride into battle at their side.

abilities.name: Cursed To Rise Once More
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description: Effect: You can return 1 slain model to this unit.
abilities.lore: Necrotic flames wreathe the shattered remains of an undead knight, compelling them to rejoin the battle.

units.lore: The finest warriors of a Deathrattle kingdom are granted the rank of Barrow Knight and a prestigious place at the side of their undead monarch. These skeletal cavaliers ride forth to conquer in the name of their liege, and rare are the warriors who can withstand their charge. Even if knocked from the saddle or shattered by cannonfire, these elite riders shall eventually rise again, for the oaths they have sworn will last until the end of time itself.

armiesOfRenown.name: Scions of Nulahmia
armiesOfRenown.description: The hosts of Nulahmia seek to emulate the majesty of Queen Neferata, both in the macabre glory of their heraldry and the contemptuous ease with which they dispose of their enemies. To these aristocratic vampires, the battlefield represents an opportunity to see their devious schemes come to fruition, as their opponents are overwhelmed by sorcery, misdirection and flocks of ravenous grave-beasts.
armiesOfRenown.lore:
The hosts of Nulahmia seek to emulate the majesty of Queen Neferata, both in the macabre glory of their heraldry and the contemptuous ease with which they dispose of their enemies. To these aristocratic vampires, the battlefield represents an opportunity to see their devious schemes come to fruition, as their opponents are overwhelmed by sorcery, misdirection and flocks of ravenous grave-beasts.

When you pick the Soulblight Gravelords faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Scions of Nulahmia Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Soulblight Gravelords faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options, as described in Army of Renown: Scions of Nulahmia. All units in your army gain the Scions of Nulahmia keyword.
roster: Scourge of Ghyran Sekhar, Fang of Nulahmia
armiesOfRenown.source: Army of Renown: Scions of Nulahmia

battleTraits.name: Recruitment Drive
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **EXQUISITE PLOT** abilities this turn. Pick a friendly unit to be the **hunter** and an enemy unit with 5 or more models to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls for the **hunter**’s combat attacks that target that enemy unit. In addition, if the target is destroyed this turn by the **hunter**, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the **hunter**’s melee weapons for the rest of the battle.
battleTraits.lore: The butchery of a few peons yields a reserve of future ‘recruits’.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Scions of Nulahmia

battleTraits.name: Seek Worthy Blood
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **EXQUISITE PLOT** abilities this turn. Pick a friendly unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, the target’s weapons have **Anti-HERO (+1 Rend)**. In addition, if the target destroys any enemy **HEROES** this turn, the target’s weapons have **Anti-HERO (+1 Rend)** for the rest of the battle.
battleTraits.lore: Only the finest ichor will suffice for the vampires of Nulahmia. It is considered an art to eviscerate an enemy champion whilst collecting as much of their blood as possible.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Scions of Nulahmia

battleTraits.name: The Queen's Prize
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **EXQUISITE PLOT** abilities this turn. Pick a friendly unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 5 to the target’s control score.

In addition, at the end of this turn, after determining control of objectives, if the target is contesting an objective that you control and that was controlled by your opponent at the start of this turn, add 5 to the target’s control score for the rest of the battle.
battleTraits.lore: What Neferata desires, Neferata receives.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Scions of Nulahmia

battleTraits.name: Thaumic Realignment
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **EXQUISITE PLOT** abilities this turn. Pick a friendly **WIZARD** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to casting rolls for the target. In addition, at the end of this turn, if the target successfully cast any spells this turn, add 1 to its power level for the rest of the battle.
battleTraits.lore: The seeding of deathly energies soon sees the fell winds rise…
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Scions of Nulahmia

heroicTraits.name: Keeper of the Royal Menagerie
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Dire Wolves** or **Fell Bats** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
heroicTraits.lore: Those vampires who maintain the bleak menageries of Nulahmia have an instinctive bond with undead beasts.
heroicTraits.source: Army of Renown: Scions of Nulahmia

artefacts.name: Amulet of Leeches
artefacts.description:
Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly **Dire** **Wolves** or **Fell Bats** unit:

• This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
• Each time you make a successful ward roll for this unit, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly **Dire Wolves** or **Fell** **Bats** unit within this unit’s combat range after the damage sequence for this unit has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
artefacts.lore: This ancient and corroded talisman allows the wielder to draw upon the necromantic energies of their minions for protection.
artefacts.source: Army of Renown: Scions of Nulahmia
artefacts.groupName: Scions of Nulahmia Artefact of Power

spells.name: Invocation of Nulahmia
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SCIONS OF NULAHMIA WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **Dire Wolves** or **Fell Bats** unit wholly within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: You can return 1 slain model to that unit.
spells.lore: This ancient spell, said to hail from the sun-blasted birthplace of necromancy, is wielded by each of Neferata’s chosen.

spells.name: Scarlet Thirst
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SCIONS OF NULAHMIA WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **SCIONS OF NULAHMIA Vampire** units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster.
spells.lore: At the wizard’s command, a fierce compulsion to feed flares up inside the vampiric court, who eagerly await the chance to indulge their blood hunger without restraint.

spells.name: Thrall Drain
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SCIONS OF NULAHMIA WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: D3 models in the target are slain. Then, remove all damage points from the caster.
spells.lore: Vampires are consummate and ruthless survivors; they will gladly drain the energy of their subordinates in order to heal their own wounds.

units.name: Fell Bats

abilities.name: Fleet and Fell
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.
abilities.lore: Borne swiftly upon huge, tattered wings, Fell Bats are able to swoop down upon and break away from their prey with impunity, their frenzied flapping making it difficult to pin them down.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

units.lore: Leather-winged monstrosities bloated on blood and necrotic sorcery, Fell Bats haunt the cursed forests and battlefields of the realms. Each is large enough to pluck a rider from the saddle and carry them off into the skies, and their dagger-length canine teeth are so sharp that they can puncture solid metal.

units.name: Vampire Lord

abilities.name: Sanguine Blur
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy non-**HERO** units and more than 3" from all enemy **HEROES**.
abilities.lore: By the time this vampire’s prey notices the crimson streak heading towards them, it is far too late.

regimentOptions: Any SCIONS OF NULAHMIA Vampire Lord

units.lore: The eldest vampires are granted fearsome powers by the Soulblight curse: unnatural speed, potent arcane power, and strength enough to dismember foes with their bare hands. Peerless duellists and cunning strategists all, they affect an aura of nobility even as their innermost impulses urge them to glut themselves on warm, fresh blood. They sate this hunger in the thick of battle, slicing throats with ornate rapiers or smashing open ribcages with flanged maces to devour the crimson rain that sprays forth.

units.name: Vampire Lord on Nightmare Steed

abilities.name: Strike At The Heart
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Blood Knights** unit that charged this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit’s **Templar Weapons** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Focusing upon their own cursed hunger, the Vampire Lord stokes the predatory urges of a formation of Blood Knights, whose lances and blades strike with great precision and force as they impact with the foe.

abilities.name: 'For Glory! For Blood!'
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: You can re-roll the charge roll for that **CHARGE** ability. Then, before the charge move is made, you can pick a friendly **Blood Knights** unit that is not in combat, is wholly within 12" of this unit and has not used a **CHARGE** ability this turn to be the target. If this unit charges, then, immediately after the **CHARGE** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can immediately use the ‘Charge’ ability even if it is not your charge phase. In addition, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target this phase.
abilities.lore: The Vampire Lord and their retinue of favoured knights charge into the fray, driving deep into the enemy lines.

units.lore: When mounted upon an undead steed known as a nightmare, a Vampire Lord carves a gory path through the enemy with each thundering charge. The beast’s ironshod hooves cave in chests and grind foes into the mud, while the undead cavalier astride it lays about themself with a blade or axe, opening throats with every blow.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Sekhar, Fang of Nulahmia

abilities.name: Irresistible Demand
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** within 18" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each other enemy unit within 3" of the target.
abilities.lore: Sekhar locks eyes across the battlefield with her victim, who falls hopelessly under her control, lashing out wildly even as their allies struggle to hold them down.

abilities.name: Lest You Forget...
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL or CHARGE ability for a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick 1 dice from the charge roll or casting roll for that ability. Your opponent must re-roll that dice.
abilities.lore: Sekhar’s presence is a tangible reminder of hidden obligations to the vampiric nation of Nulahmia, causing foes to deliberately foul their own forces’ efforts so that their clandestine allegiances remain undiscovered.

abilities.name: Allow Me to Remind You...
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use it are still lost.
abilities.lore: As Neferata’s premier agent in the Mortal Realms, Sekhar’s authority and near matchless powers of hypnotism ensure few have the willpower to resist her demands.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: The ruthless vampire Sekhar is one of Mortarch Neferata’s most formidable agents. Dispatched to the endless green of Ghyran on a mission to advance the cause of Nulahmia, she seeks to dominate her foes through sheer, hypnotic force of will. Those who defy her are spitted on the end of her glaive or fed to the coiling god-serpent Ouboroth.

units.name: Coven Throne

abilities.name: Scrying Pool
abilities.description: Effect: If a friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Redeploy’ command, you can pick another friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit that has not used a command this phase to use the ‘Redeploy’ command immediately after the first has been resolved (this is an exception to Commands, 1.2). No command point is spent the second time that command is used.
abilities.lore: Within this pool of shimmering gore, the vampire foresees the shape of the battle to come.

abilities.name: Tactical Insight
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **DEATHRATTLE** and **DEADWALKERS** units have **WARD (5+)** while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The vampire and their acolytes employ their divinatory abilities to manipulate and aid their undying servants.

abilities.name: A Promising Concoction
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **VAMPIRE** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The gory contents of the Coven Throne’s scrying bowl can be consumed by its riders and other vampires nearby, giving them a flush of power.

regimentOptions: Any SCIONS OF NULAHMIA Vampire Lord

units.lore: Coven Thrones are a symbol of macabre splendour prized by the most egotistical vampires, those who see the dirt and filth of a churning battlefield as beneath them. Drifting forth upon a surging mass of bound spirits, this necro-crafted palanquin allows its occupants to observe and partake in the slaughter whilst reclining in comfort. Sipping from goblets of freshly drained blood, they pour the rest into an unholy font, reading the bubbling liquid within for signs and portents regarding the battle’s outcome.

units.name: Dire Wolves

abilities.name: On The Hunt
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use a **RUN** ability and still use **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.
abilities.lore: Unlike most undead, Dire Wolves have lost almost none of the swiftness they possessed in life and are forever hungry for warm flesh.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

units.lore: It is said that to hear a Dire Wolf’s howl is to be damned. These lupine undead are tireless hunters, and when they finally run their prey to ground, their powerful jaws ensure that the kill comes swiftly indeed.

units.name: Sekhar, Fang of Nulahmia

abilities.name: The Time-Swallower's Maw
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the targets.

Effect: This unit cannot use the ‘Serpentine Agility’ ability for the rest of the battle. Roll 2D6 for each target. If the roll exceeds the target’s Move characteristic, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the difference between the roll and its Move characteristic.
abilities.lore: Though Sekhar is loath to let Ouboroth feast upon souls, sometimes, needs must.

abilities.name: Death's Construction
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, while they are wholly within 6" of this unit, friendly **SOULBLIGHT GRAVELORDS** units cannot be picked to be the target of abilities used by the target other than **FIGHT** abilities.
abilities.lore: Through the subtlest arcane suggestion, Sekhar implants her will in vulnerable minds – supplanting their former purpose with the undying will of Nulahmia.

abilities.name: Serpentine Agility
abilities.description: Effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-4, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
abilities.lore: Sekhar moves as a blinding blur, her unnatural speed obscuring her form from even the keenest gaze.

regimentOptions: Any SCIONS OF NULAHMIA Vampire Lord

units.lore: Sekhar is one of the most lethally skilled agents of the Mortarch Neferata and the most prominent member of the elite order known as the Fangs of Nulahmia. She is a master manipulator and spy whose honeyed whispers have seen more kingdoms crumble to dust than she can recall. Sekhar travels the realms at the behest of her mistress, advancing the cause of the Nulahmian elite and ensuring – through subterfuge, trickery or outright slaughter – that Neferata’s enemies are bled white.

battleTraits.name: Leave the Land in Ruin
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Any Turn
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a terrain feature or objective that does not have a friendly **desolation token** and is contested by a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit that is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Give the target a **desolation token**.
battleTraits.lore: Both raw resources and esoteric pain are needed to fuel the Helsmiths’ forge-craft, demanding they lay lands to waste.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Helsmiths of Hashut armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Harness Daemonic Power
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Your Turn
battleTraits.description:
Effect: You must use this ability at the start of each of your turns. Remove all **daemonic power points** from each friendly unit. Then, gain 1 **daemonic power point** for each friendly **desolation token** on the battlefield.

Then, allocate your daemonic power points to friendly non-**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** units. Each unit can have a maximum of 3 **daemonic power points**. Then, all unallocated **daemonic power points** are lost.

**Designer’s Note:** *Non*-**HOBGROT** *units have abilities that become more powerful depending on how many daemonic power points they have. We recommend using coloured dice to track the number of points each unit has.*
battleTraits.lore: The Helsmiths of Hashut believe themselves above the fell influence of Chaos and readily harness daemonic power to embolden their spellcraft and ensorcelled weapons.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Helsmiths of Hashut armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Reserves of Daemonic Power
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HOBGROT HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit that has no **daemonic power points** to be the target.

Effect: Give 2 **daemonic power points** to the target.
battleTraits.lore: When venturing forth into the untainted reaches of the realms, the Helsmiths of Hashut draw upon reserves of daemonic power to establish a foothold.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Helsmiths of Hashut armies can use the following abilities:

ability.name: Arcane Dominance
ability.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls, unbinding rolls, banishment rolls and chanting rolls for friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WIZARDS** and **PRIESTS** while they have 3 **daemonic power points**.
ability.lore: Despite all that its pursuit costs them, the sorcerers of the ziggurats are ever lusting for greater power.

abilities.name: Arcane Dominance
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls, unbinding rolls, banishment rolls and chanting rolls for friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WIZARDS** and **PRIESTS** while they have 3 **daemonic power points**.
abilities.lore: Despite all that its pursuit costs them, the sorcerers of the ziggurats are ever lusting for greater power.

ability.name: Bulls of the Ziggurat
ability.description: Effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT CAVALRY** and **MONSTER** units while they have 3 **daemonic power points**.
ability.lore: When unleashed, those warriors and constructs shaped in Hashut’s image are relentless.

abilities.name: Bulls of the Ziggurat
abilities.description: Effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT CAVALRY** and **MONSTER** units while they have 3 **daemonic power points**.
abilities.lore: When unleashed, those warriors and constructs shaped in Hashut’s image are relentless.

ability.name: Amassed Legions
ability.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** unit with 3 **daemonic power points** uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
ability.lore: The hosts of the ziggurats march to conquer and claim, advancing into verdant lands and leaving them barren.

abilities.name: Amassed Legions
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** unit with 3 **daemonic power points** uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.
abilities.lore: The hosts of the ziggurats march to conquer and claim, advancing into verdant lands and leaving them barren.

ability.name: Experimental Munitions
ability.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons used by friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WAR MACHINES** while they have 3 **daemonic power points**.
ability.lore: In trying to control Chaos, duardin engineers have crafted all manner of eldritch ammunition for their war machines. In doing so, they have given the power of ruin even more destructive outlets.

abilities.name: Experimental Munitions
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons used by friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WAR MACHINES** while they have 3 **daemonic power points**.
abilities.lore: In trying to control Chaos, duardin engineers have crafted all manner of eldritch ammunition for their war machines. In doing so, they have given the power of ruin even more destructive outlets.

heroicTraits.name: 'Fire, You Worms!'
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: The target can immediately use the ‘Shoot’ ability as if it were your shooting phase. All attacks must target the same enemy unit, and the enemy unit picked to be the target of the attacks must have charged this phase. If the unmodified hit roll for any of those attacks is 1-5, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
heroicTraits.lore: A pitiless enforcer of discipline, this duardin expects their underlings to keep firing even as the foe bears down on them.

heroicTraits.name: Servile Automaton
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT AUTOMATON** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, the target is this unit’s bodyguard and the following effects apply:

•  While this unit is in combat and its bodyguard is within its combat range, its bodyguard has **STRIKE-FIRST**.
•  If this unit is **INFANTRY**, it has **WARD (5+)** while its bodyguard is within its combat range.
heroicTraits.lore: This paranoid overlord shuns traditional bodyguards, instead favouring a looming daemon engine entirely bound to them through burning Zharralid carvings.

heroicTraits.name: An Eye for Weakness
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** units that target that enemy unit.
heroicTraits.lore: Whether bargaining a Wage of Toil or considering the press of battle, this duardin can readily sense vulnerability.

artefacts.name: Gauntlets of Punishment
artefacts.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
artefacts.lore: Cooled in the blood of duardin who sought to betray their sworn overlords, a spiteful gesture from these gauntlets can wrack a soul with unbearable pain.

artefacts.name: Crucible of Spite
artefacts.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
artefacts.description: Effect: Give up to 3 **daemonic power points** to this unit. However, you cannot allocate or give any more **daemonic power points** to this unit for the rest of the battle.
artefacts.lore: This charm, a hollowed and profane statuette of Grungni, contains raging daemon essences that can be drawn on for strength. Yet such eager blasphemy does not go unpunished…

artefacts.name: Scroll of Petrification
artefacts.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
artefacts.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

•  The target has **WARD (2+)**.
•  The target cannot use non-passive abilities or be picked to be the target of friendly abilities.
•  Enemy units can ignore the target’s combat range for the purposes of movement and charging.
• Enemy units can ignore the target for the purposes of setting up on the battlefield but cannot be set up on the target.
artefacts.lore: Though they cannot control the stone-flesh curse, the Zharrdron still believe it can be harnessed. This scroll is the result of such a belief. One who reads from it can transform themselves or their minions into stone for a fleeting moment.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Gem of Utorak
aqshyArtefacts.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
aqshyArtefacts.description:
Effect: If this unit is not a **WIZARD**, it has **WIZARD (2)** until the start of your next turn.

If this unit is a **WIZARD**, until the start of your next turn:
• Add 1 to this unit’s power level.
• Add D3 to casting rolls for this unit.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: Utorak created many of these crystals, each of which grants a measure, albeit fleeting, of arcane power. His censure and eradication followed swiftly after.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Casque of Belittlement
aqshyArtefacts.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your **fury level**. If this unit charged this turn, add 1 to each roll. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: The wearer of this helm hears a constant scornful voice in their ear, one that sneers at and derides them until they explode in a fit of pique.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Horn of the Bullfather
aqshyArtefacts.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit to be the target. Then, you can pick a visible friendly **Hobgrot Vandalz** unit to be a second target.

Effect: Remove each target from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within 7" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: Using this dread clarion, duardin warriors and disposable lackeys across the battlefield can be sent to outflank the enemy.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Infernal Motivators
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: Add 2" to this unit’s Move characteristic.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: The daemonic matter that powers this machine consistently provides it with feverish animation.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText:
Accursed Devices are unique enhancements that can be given to **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WAR MACHINES**.
A unit can only have 1 Accursed Device.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Earthwrack Stabilisers
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons if it has not charged in the same turn.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: Large metal rods embedded in this war machine’s frame plunge deep into the earth, reducing its mobility but providing incredible stability while attacking.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText:
Accursed Devices are unique enhancements that can be given to **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WAR MACHINES**.
A unit can only have 1 Accursed Device.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Bullfather's Scorn
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Effect: You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

This unit’s ranged weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** until the start of your next turn. If each of this unit’s ranged weapons already have **Crit (2 Hits)**, this unit’s shooting attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ until the start of your next turn instead.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: This war machine has been stamped with infernal runes of contempt that grant immense power on command.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText:
Accursed Devices are unique enhancements that can be given to **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WAR MACHINES**.
A unit can only have 1 Accursed Device.

spells.name: Hateful Fractures
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Halve the target’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn.
spells.lore: The sorcerer clenches a contemptuous fist, seeing firm ground beneath their foes suddenly splinter and crack.

spells.name: Ashen Smog
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible terrain feature within 18" of them that has a friendly **desolation token** to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: That terrain feature has the ‘Obscuring’ ability (Terrain, 1.2) until the start of your next turn. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit contesting the target terrain feature. On a 2+, inflict an amount of damage equal to the roll on that unit.
spells.lore: Clouds of choking ash seep from the sorcerer’s outstretched talon before settling across the lands as an impenetrable, blinding pall.

spells.name: Molten Metal
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the unmodified casting roll. Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each roll that equals or exceeds the target’s Save characteristic.
spells.lore: A wave of hellish, liquid metal that strips armour and melts flesh surges forth into the enemy line.

prayers.name: Black Flames of Hashut
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 8+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target for each 4+ instead.
prayers.lore: Spitting the Bullfather’s contempt, the priest causes their enemies to be wreathed in abyssal fire – a worthy punishment for the weak.

prayers.name: Storm of Obsidian Shards
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target and subtract 3 from the target’s control score for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.
prayers.lore: The sheer vitriol of this duardin priest is incarnated as a tumult of flesh-shredding stone splinters.

prayers.name: Furnace Blessing
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn. If the chanting roll was 8+, that unit’s melee weapons also have **Crit (Mortal)** for the rest of the turn.
prayers.lore: The priest pours burning scorn upon the daemonic essences bound in duardin steel, seeing the weapons of the Hashutites blaze in molten outrage.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Anointed Sentinels

abilities.name: Zealous Acolytes
abilities.description:
Effect: • Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while it is contesting an objective you do not control.
• Add 10 to this unit’s control score while it is contesting an objective you control.
abilities.lore: Those who disturb the Anointed Sentinels as they protect or claim Hashut’s sacred ground quickly discover their mistake.

abilities.name: Daemonic Resilience
abilities.description:
Effect: Apply the effect below that corresponds with the number of **daemonic power points** (DPP) this unit has:

**DPP Effect**
**1** This unit has **WARD (6+)**.
**2** This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
**3** This unit has **WARD (4+)** against damage inflicted by **SPELLS**, **PRAYERS** and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**. Otherwise, it has **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Spitting contempt from between their tusks, these duardin refuse to show the slightest shred of weakness.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: The zealous Anointed Sentinels keep vigil over the desolations wrought in Hashut’s name across the Great Parch and beyond, quoting diabolic scripture while goring and impaling any who draw near.

units.name: Anointed Sentinels

abilities.name: Crush the Unworthy
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for this unit for each **daemonic power point** it has.
abilities.lore: The raw arrogance of the Bull Centaurs sees them crash through foes with wanton abandon.

abilities.name: Zealous Counter-Attack
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Counter-charge’ command for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Anointed Sentinels are furious, eager combatants that use their sheer size to meet charging armies head on.

units.lore: Anointed Sentinels are chosen from the most zealous of the Bull Centaur herds. Flesh glistening with sacred blood-oils, they preside over the desolations wrought in Hashut’s name, quoting diabolic scripture while goring and impaling any who draw near. Within their gleaming Hashutaar masks swirl vapours that grant the Sentinels even greater focus in their devotion – at the cost of deadening imagination, independent will and, some say, their very souls.

units.name: Infernal Razers with Flamehurlers

abilities.name: Manglers of Metal
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s ranged weapons for each **daemonic power point** this unit has.
abilities.lore: The weapons of the Zharrdron can be infernally empowered until they burn and blast clean through armour.

abilities.name: Scorched Remains
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability this turn and all of its attacks targeted the same enemy **INFANTRY** unit, that enemy unit is the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract an amount equal to the roll from the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The grim aftermath left behind by the Helsmiths’ flamehurlers is enough to shake even the most stolid warrior to their very core.

units.lore: Bred amongst the choking foundries and production lines of their ziggurats, Razers are a dour and spiteful breed. They are responsible for physically crafting the weapons that are later empowered with a daemonic spark, and the chance to unleash them is a rare and greedily accepted boon. Especially popular are the flame-hurling Karagthrun – guns that roar like accursed volcanoes and spit forth sheets of fire that can melt clean through hardened gromril.

units.name: War Despot

abilities.name: 'Fight, You Scum!"
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A Despot demands a tireless, pitiless aggression from their underlings.

abilities.name: Black-hearted Conqueror
abilities.description: Effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly **HELSMITHS OF HASHUT INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 6" of this unit. Add 6" to the range of this ability for each **daemonic power point** this unit has.
abilities.lore: Those sworn to serve beneath a Despot must offer them conquest and tribute or suffer the consequences…

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Hashutite Commander.*

units.lore: The lords of a ziggurat’s royal clans are also its commanders in times of war. Swollen by dark power and clad in imposing armour, they see their thrall hosts as extensions of their own conquering ambition. Underlings are driven on relentlessly, expected to triumph or perish, while a Despot’s rivals fall beneath their blades – weapons acquired at a terrible price and empowered by the most dangerous daemonic essences.

units.name: Dominator Engine with Bane Maces

abilities.name: Daemonic Strength
abilities.description:
Effect: For each **daemonic power point** this unit has:
