terrain.name: Nexus Chaotica

abilities.name: Infernal Sorcery
abilities.description:
Declare: If this terrain feature has 3 or more **power points**, pick a friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS WIZARD** within 3" of this terrain feature to be the target.

Effect: Remove 3 **power points** from this terrain feature, then add 1 to casting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A sorcerer of Chaos can draw upon the bound daemons of the Nexus Chaotica to empower their spellcasting.

abilities.name: Corrupt The Realms
abilities.description:
Declare: If this terrain feature has 9 or more **power points**, pick an objective or terrain feature within 24" of this terrain feature to be the source. Then, pick any number of enemy units within 3" of the source to be the targets.

Effect: Remove 9 **power points** from this terrain feature, then roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: These diabolical constructs use harnessed daemonic power to corrupt the geomantic energy of the Mortal Realms.

abilities.name: Draw Power
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. Give a number of **power points** to this terrain feature equal to the roll. This terrain feature can have a maximum of 12 **power points** at once.
abilities.lore: Constructed at confluences where magical ley lines converge, a Nexus Chaotica can draw power from the realms and into a floating crucible.

terrain.lore: True champions of Chaos recognise that the gods demand more than simple slaughter. The realms themselves must be laced with taint; the arcane ley lines must be inundated with corruption. This is the purpose of the Nexus Chaotica, a shrine raised at a geomantic confluence for the express purpose of withering it.

units.name: Fomoroid Crusher

abilities.name: Cursed Destroyers
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a terrain feature within 1" of this unit, then pick each other unit (friendly and enemy) within 3" of that terrain feature to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Once skilled masons, these creatures have been cursed by the Everchosen to now live only to destroy.

units.lore: Brutish creatures from a lost age, the Fomoroid Crushers now exist only to tear down and destroy. In battle they fly into a terrible rage, torturous memories of the creatures they once were lending their blows a maddened strength.

units.name: Chaos Lord on Daemonic Mount

abilities.name: The Knights of Chaos
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO WARRIORS OF CHAOS CAVALRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: At the head of a charge, this Chaos Lord leads their cavalry to crush any foe before them.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Ruinous Champion*.

units.lore: Particularly favoured Chaos Lords may be granted a daemonic steed to bear them into battle. These champions become the rulers of feared cavalry warbands, driving their mounted brethren into battle with roared oaths to the Dark Gods.

units.name: Darkoath Chieftain

abilities.name: Tribal Warleader
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DARKOATH INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: With strength and fierce purpose, the rulers of the Darkoath tribes lead those sworn to their banners into the fray to fulfil their oaths.

abilities.name: Oath of Murder
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit destroyed an enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** this turn, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: Darkoath Chieftains offer up the souls of enemy lords and champions in exchange for divine power.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Oathsworn*.

units.lore: Darkoath Chieftains lead their barbarian tribes to war with the fury and conviction of the truly devoted. These masterful warriors are always seeking greater challenges, and their skill at arms is spoken of in awe by their followers.

units.name: Singri Brand

abilities.name: Swift As The Wind
abilities.description: Effect: Only critical hits score successful hits for shooting attacks that target this unit.
abilities.lore: Singri’s horsemanship is unrivalled by any of the Darkoath. She weaves deftly across the battlefield, avoiding enemy fire and loosing deadly accurate shots with her bow in return..

abilities.name: Uncanny Shot
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Singri’s Warbow** for attacks that target enemy units that are within 6" of a friendly **Gunnar Brand**.
abilities.lore: Gunnar Brand has been saved on more than one occasion by a well-placed arrow from Singri.

details.notes: This unit can only be taken in **Gunnar Brand**’s regiment.

units.lore: Singri is the daughter of Gunnar Brand, heir apparent to the Darkoath tribes of the Snow Peaks. She charges into battle with a brash ferocity, one that often vexes her father, yet none are as capable as she at teasing out speed from a warhorse, nor as skilled in loosing pinpoint arrows while galloping at full tilt as Singri.

units.name: Be'lakor, the Dark Master

abilities.name: The Dark Master
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target is picked to use an ability, roll a dice as a reaction. On a 3+, that ability has no effect.
abilities.lore: Many puppets dance on Be’lakor’s infernal strings. Few realise as much until their fate is sealed.

abilities.name: Enfeeble Foe
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:

• Subtract 1 from hit rolls from the target’s combat attacks.
• The target’s combat attacks cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).
abilities.lore: With a series of hissed incantations, Be’lakor instils visions of loss and despair in the minds of his enemies to drain them of their fighting spirit.

abilities.name: Shadow Form
abilities.description: Effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for this unit (positive and negative).
abilities.lore: Be’lakor can shift his physical form to be as insubstantial as the mists of Ulgu – and just as hard to land a telling blow upon.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Blade of Shadows** is 6.

abilities.name: Deadly Trap
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS** units within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 4+, that target has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Dark Master delights in lethal reversals of expectation and fate.

regimentOptions: Any LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE

units.lore: Once, Be’lakor – first of the Daemon Princes – stood paramount before the Ruinous Powers. How he fell from these heights is not known; likely his ambitions played a part, for Be’lakor craves godhood. His punishment was to crown each Everchosen but be denied the mantle himself. Yet Be’lakor is a creature of matchless cunning; even as he raged at his predicament, nursing hatred for the ‘False King’ Archaon, he schemed to reclaim his place at the forefront of the hordes of Chaos.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Chaos Lord on Karkadrak

abilities.name: Ferocious Influence
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if this unit charged this turn. Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Companion** weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit.
• Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with **Companion** weapons used by friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS CAVALRY** and **WAR MACHINE** units while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.
abilities.lore: When a Karkadrak enters a blood frenzy, other creatures are swept up in its bloody mania, ripping chunks of flesh from limbs and torsos and caving in skulls with their hooves.

abilities.name: Wrathful Abandon
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick this unit and a friendly non-**HERO WARRIORS OF CHAOS** unit that charged this turn and is wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can move a number of inches equal to your **fury level**. If a target was in combat at the start of the move, it must end that move in combat with all of the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move. It cannot move into combat with units it was not already in combat with at the start of that move.
abilities.lore: Imbued with the eager fury of battle, the Chaos Lord and their warriors are and swiftly fall upon their foes.

details.notes:
This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Ruinous Champion*.

This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General's Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Those Chaos Lords who succeed in dominating a Karkadrak, a drake-like creature known for its frenzied rampages, are rewarded with a terrifying mount that inspires bloodlust in their warriors’ dark steeds.

units.name: Chaos Chariot

abilities.name: Swift Death
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Chaos Chariots are at their most deadly on the charge, where their considerable bulk and bladed wheels can cause untold devastation.

units.lore: The chariots of Chaos are implements of crushing death that leave a wake of corpses. Forged from black iron, they are capable of attaining remarkable speed in spite of their bulk, converting gathered momentum into deadly force as they hurtle into the enemy ranks. It is considered a great honour to make war from a chariot, for these constructs are as pulpits from which the murderous will of the Dark Gods can be enacted.

units.name: Chaos Spawn

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Drawn to Power
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **Daemon Prince**, you can re-roll the random characteristic rolls for this unit’s Move and Attacks characteristics.
abilities.lore: Even cursed with their hideous and twisted form, Chaos Spawn still covet the boons of the Dark Gods and are drawn to those most favoured by their patron.

units.lore: Those who receive too many gifts from the gods may degenerate into a hideous Chaos Spawn. Lumpen and misformed, these creatures lurch from their lairs when death is on the wind, slaughtering all before them with flailing tentacles and crooked claws.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Chaos Warriors

abilities.name: For the Glory of the Dark Gods
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Until the start of your next turn, the following cumulative effects apply depending on your **fury level**.

***1+ Riled***: This unit has **WARD (6+)**.

***4+ Seething***: This unit’s melee weapons have **Anti‐charge (+1 Rend)**.

***7 Enraged***: This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** while it has not charged in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The more these warriors embrace the fervour within, the greater the favour that is bestowed upon them by the Ruinous Powers.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General's Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Across the Great Parch, legions of Chaos Warriors march into battle in search of divine favour. No ordinary soldiers, their blackened armour has fused with their flesh and their cursed weapons leave indelible marks of corruption on those they strike.

units.name: Chaos Lord

abilities.name: Glory In Battle
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO WARRIORS OF CHAOS INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Under the command of their warlord, the warriors sworn to them waste no time in slaying the enemy.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Ruinous Champion*.

units.lore: Chaos Lords are dark champions who have walked the Path to Glory and are now only one step away from glory or damnation. They are the rulers of great warbands and hordes, and their followers will die before failing these fearsome warlords.

units.name: Abraxia, Spear of the Everchosen

abilities.name: Roar of Domination
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Thanatorg is quick to put potential usurpers of Abraxia’s power in their place.

abilities.name: Blood of Molten Varanite
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice each time a damage point inflicted by a combat attack is allocated to this unit. On a 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Any who wound the Thanatorg risk being splashed by its highly mutative blood.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **the Thanatorg’s Claws and Fangs** is 4.

abilities.name: Gorbolga the Accurs'd
abilities.description:
Effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect:

***1 - Uncontrollable Power:***
Allocate 1 damage point to this unit.

***2 - The Spear Slumbers:***
No effect.

***3-5 - White-hot Varanite:***
Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Gorbolga** for the rest of the turn.

***6 - Rampant Mutation:***
The effect of ‘White-hot Varanite’ applies and this unit’s **Gorbolga** has **Crit (Mortal)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A ‘gift’ from the Everchosen, Gorbolga is a varanite spear that carries a potent mutative curse – but should its wielder’s will slip, they too will learn of its hunger…

abilities.name: Warlord of the First Circle
abilities.description: Effect: If a friendly **Varanguard** unit uses the ‘Relentless Killers’ ability while it is wholly within 12" of this unit, that unit does not have **STRIKE-LAST** as a result of that ability.
abilities.lore: Abraxia commands the Swords of Chaos with relentless brutality.

units.lore: Once a whelp in the Varanspire’s fighting pits, Abraxia has risen to command the Swords of Chaos – the infamous First Circle of the Varanguard. She is a warrior of matchless willpower, convinced that there is no challenge she cannot best through bloody-minded grit. To Abraxia, Chaos represents a state of perpetual testing rather than being embodied in four insane gods. Such an anti-deific attitude pleases Archaon, who offers Abraxia that rarest of boons – a measure of his trust. In her conquest of the Sigmarite city of the Phoenicium, Abraxia consumed the sacred fire at the bastion’s heart. Cinder now flickers when she speaks, while in her eyes rages a tortured and captive flame.

units.name: Gunnar Brand

abilities.name: Oath of Bloodshed
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if any enemy **HEROES** were slain by this unit’s combat attacks this turn.

Effect: Friendly **GUNNAR’S OATHSWORN** units have **WARD (4+)** for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: Though he is contemptuous of the gods, Gunnar is still Darkoath; he is not so foolish as to reject their boons should they seek to reward his murder-making.

abilities.name: Carve a Path To Glory
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can only use this ability if it is in combat with an enemy **HERO**.

Effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn. When using the second **FIGHT** ability, this unit must pick an enemy **HERO** to be the target of all of its attacks.
abilities.lore: Ruthless in battle, Gunnar Brand closes in on the enemy’s champions, claiming skulls and earning glory with each swing of his axes.

units.lore: Gunnar Brand is a legend amongst the Darkoath tribes of the eastern Great Parch. His warrior skills, coarse charisma and raw grit have seen him emerge triumphant against seemingly impossible odds time and again. Many whisper that Gunnar’s brother forged a deal with a Wilderfiend and that the Chaos Gods have their gaze upon him.

units.name: Gaunt Summoner

abilities.name: Divert Realmgate
abilities.description:
Declare: Make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Units set up this turn using this unit’s ‘Book of Profane Secrets’ ability can be set up wholly within 18" of this unit and more than 7" from all enemy units instead of the distances in the ability.
abilities.lore: Whispering fell incantations, a Gaunt Summoner can temporarily divert the path of a realmgate, allowing malefic Chaos entities to storm the battlefield.

abilities.name: Minions of the Silver Tower
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not been deployed to be the target.

Effect: The target is set up in reserve **in a Silver Tower**. It has now been deployed.
abilities.lore: The warped fortresses of the Gaunt Summoners are infested with their thrall hosts.

abilities.name: Book of Profane Secrets
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit **in a Silver Tower** to be the target.

Effect: Set up the target on the battlefield wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Using this arcane tome, the Gaunt Summoner calls forth minions from their Silver Tower.

units.lore: To the daemonic Gaunt Summoners, reality is but a plaything. At the will of their master Archaon they lead armies of mortals to wreak terrible havoc. They can consume their foes in hellfire and manipulate realmgates to summon minions to their side in a matter of moments.

units.name: Daemon Prince

abilities.name: The Mounted Skulls of the Fallen
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has a **Trophy Rack**, its **Hellforged Weapons** also have **Anti‑HERO (+1 Rend)**.
abilities.lore: Some Daemon Princes revel in glory with each worthy foe slain by their hands.

abilities.name: Immortal Champion
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Those favoured enough to ascend to daemonhood are among the most deadly servants of the Ruinous Powers.

abilities.name: Airborne Horror
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has **Wings**, it has a Move characteristic of 10" and has **FLY**.
abilities.lore: Carried aloft by ragged leathery wings, this favoured champion of the Chaos Gods will bring ruin wherever they descend.

regimentOptions: Any LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE

units.lore: Daemon Princes are those champions who, through determination and countless atrocities, have surpassed the heights of the Path to Glory. Only the most vanishingly rare souls can hold the gods’ attention long enough to achieve this apotheosis, joining the infernal ranks of daemonkind as an embodiment of Chaos itself. The earth rebels at their presence, for they are things that should not exist. Palls of shadow surround a Daemon Prince as the land cracks and vomits torrents of hellflame. With talon and cursed blade, the Daemon Prince brings ruin to the realms, assured that there are none who might challenge them.

units.name: Eternus, Blade of the First Prince

abilities.name: Veins of Black Lightning
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can use this ability if it has been destroyed.

Effect: Roll 2D6. Add 1 to the roll if a friendly **Be’lakor** is on the battlefield. On an 8+, set up a replacement unit on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Reborn in the Cursed Skies above the realms, Eternus’s soul is tethered to the Mortal Realms through the dark magics of his master; whenever he is struck down, a flash of black lightning sees him stand defiant once more.

abilities.name: Network of Spies
abilities.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 12" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the enemy unit is in combat with a friendly **Chaos Legionnaires** or **Chaos Furies** unit. On a 5+, that command has no effect. The command still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.
abilities.lore: Eternus commands a legion of agents and operatives to ensure he is always one step ahead of his enemies.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join **Be’lakor’s** regiment.

units.lore: Sworn to Be’lakor and granted immortality, Eternus rides at the head of First Prince’s legions, crushing those who oppose his ascension. His mighty weapons are not his only means of waging war, for Eternus commands a vast network of spies and warriors loyal to the Dark Master.

units.name: Ogroid Myrmidon

abilities.name: Myrmidon Rage
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is damaged, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons.
abilities.lore: Every wound inflicted on a Myrmidon only serves to stoke its rage further.

abilities.name: Pit Master
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **Ogroid Theridons** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Myrmidons are given governance over the gladiatorial pits of the Varanspire, and all who have fought there willingly follow them into the fray.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Ruinous Champion*.

units.lore: Myrmidons are masters of the Varanspire’s fighting pits, and have spent decades mastering the gladiatorial arts. In battle they lead those who seek to join the Everchosen’s legions, for to impress a Myrmidon is to be marked for glory.

units.name: Darkoath Wilderfiend

abilities.name: Feed on Flesh
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a model (friendly or enemy) is slain within 12" of this unit, give this unit a **sacrifice point**, to a maximum of 6. If there are more than 1 friendly **Darkoath Wilderfiend** units within 12" of the slain model, only 1 of them can be given a **sacrifice point** for that slain model.
abilities.lore: Having been appeased with sacrificial blood, this creature may bestow dark blessings upon its kin.

abilities.name: Primal Sorcery
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

***Mind Shroud:*** Pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target and roll a number of dice equal to the number of **sacrifice points** this unit has. If any of the rolls are a 5+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

***Warping Balefire:*** Pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target and roll a number of dice equal to the number of **sacrifice points** this unit has. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

***Dark Might:*** **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is the number of sacrifice points this unit has.

After applying the effect you picked, reset this unit’s **sacrifice points** to 0.
abilities.lore: Though bestial, Darkoath Wilderfiends possess innate powers of sorcery.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

units.lore: Wilderfiends are both guardians and persecutors of the Darkoath tribes. Once mortal heroes themselves, they have been warped and twisted into hunched abominations that crave flesh and wield powers of primal sorcery to annihilate their prey.

units.name: Darkoath Marauders

abilities.name: Glorious Death
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of any friendly **DARKOATH HEROES**, each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking unit, roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Ever keen to earn the favour of their tribe, when the eyes of the fiercest fighters are upon them, these warriors will not go down without a fight.

abilities.name: Oath of the Marauder
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this phase and the unmodified charge roll was 8+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s weapons for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: These bloodthirsty tribal warriors loudly declare vows of violence and slaughter as they race after their foes.

units.lore: Each and every Darkoath warrior is trained in the way of the axe and the sword from the youngest age. Having sworn bloody oaths to their patron gods, they seek to fulfil them by any means necessary, their bodies flushed with power by every pledge completed.

units.name: Darkoath Chieftain on Warsteed

abilities.name: Oath of Murder
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit destroyed an enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** this turn, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: Darkoath Chieftains offer up the souls of enemy lords and champions in exchange for divine power.

abilities.name: Cavalry Warleader
abilities.description: Effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for friendly **DARKOATH CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The Darkoath Chieftain leads the cavalry swiftly into the enemy ranks.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Oathsworn*.

units.lore: Only the mightiest and most ruthless Darkoath warriors may rise to command their tribe in battle. Their killing prowess honed by years of strife and slaughter, they lead their people to victory after bloody victory, claiming heads with every swing of their cursed weapons.

units.name: Varanguard

abilities.name: Relentless Killers
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Varanguard have slaughtered foes beyond counting, butchering their way across the battlefields of the Mortal Realms without mercy.

units.lore: Each of the Varanguard is a mighty champion who has passed the many tests set for them by Archaon and sworn themselves to his service. Riding atop their hulking steeds, these lords of darkness bring inescapable death to the Everchosen’s enemies.

units.name: Slaughterbrute

abilities.name: Rampaging Charge
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If the target unit is **INFANTRY**, double the amount of mortal damage inflicted.
abilities.lore: The Slaughterbrute crashes into the enemy’s ranks in a frenzy of destruction.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Razor-tipped Claws** is 5.

abilities.name: Sigils of Domination
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS HERO** within this unit’s combat range to be this unit’s master.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, while this unit is within its master’s combat range:
• Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.
• This unit can ignore the effects of the **Companion** weapon ability on its weapons.
abilities.lore: By carving runes of domination into a Slaughterbrute’s back and driving cursed blades of binding into its flesh, the monster’s will can be bound to a champion of Chaos.

units.lore: Even the greatest champions cannot hope to bind a Slaughterbrute through physical might alone. Only through specially forged blades of binding can these monstrosities be controlled, and their boundless fury directed towards their master’s enemies.

units.name: Darkoath Fellriders

abilities.name: Swift Attackers
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.
abilities.lore: As they close in on the enemy at frightening speed, these skilled horsemen are nigh impossible to hit with missile fire.

abilities.name: Oath of the Raider
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this phase and is only in combat with 1 enemy unit, and that enemy unit is only in combat with this unit, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s weapons for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: Before battle, Fellriders swear oaths to harry the enemy without mercy, showing no mercy to those stragglers who fall beneath their axes.

units.lore: The Darkoath prize speed and agility above all in their light cavalry. Fellriders are mounted daredevils, outflanking their foes on lightning-swift and aggressive mounts, riddling their ranks with volleys of javelins before charging in to deal the killing blow.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Abraxia, Spear of the Everchosen

abilities.name: Champion of the Undivided
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE SLAVES TO DARKNESS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit and that does not have a **Pledge to Chaos** keyword to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by the target while they are contesting an objective you do not control.
abilities.lore: Abraxia’s fell reputation inspires her followers to embark on murderous rampages to gain her attention – perhaps even her approval. Such success is rare, but the resulting carnage is unquestionable.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **The Thanatorg’s Claws and Fangs** is 4.

abilities.name: Mutative Spear
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s combat attacks to be the target.

Effect: The target has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Gorbolga the Accurs’d causes rampant mutation in its victims, their twisted, mewling remains a source of absolute horror to their surviving allies.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Invasion
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, roll 2D6. This unit can move a distance up to the value of the roll. It can pass through models in the target unit but must end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: Demonstrating its legendary ferocity, the Thanatorg smashes through the ranks of the foe.

abilities.name: Unending Will To Conquer
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is contesting an objective you do not control. **Heal (D6)** this unit.
abilities.lore: Abraxia once consumed the flesh of the High Anointed of the Temple of the Ur-Phoenix, an act swiftly followed by her desecration of the sacred flame at the shrine’s heart. Now, when the thrill of battle ignites within her, the power of rebirth sees her wounds rapidly heal over as if they had never occurred.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: Few of the Dark Gods’ champions have wrought more horror upon the Everspring Swathe than Abraxia, the Spear of the Everchosen. She has sworn to drown the jungles in the blood of her foes and charges into battle at the head of a vast Chaos horde. Her warriors dread her anger and will obey whatever order she gives, no matter how likely it is to result in their gruesome deaths.

units.name: Raptoryx

abilities.name: Crazed Flock
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons. This ability also affects **Companion** weapons.
abilities.lore: A flock of snapping, screeching Raptoryx is capable of swiftly bringing down any prey should they catch them unawares.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

units.lore: One of the many forms of wildlife twisted by the power of Chaos, Raptoryx cross the land in vast flocks. Cunning and vicious beasts, they are willing to take on prey many times their size, pulling them down in a frenzy of slashing talons and snapping beaks.

units.name: Gaunt Summoner on Disc of Tzeentch

abilities.name: Minions of the Silver Tower
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit that has not been deployed to be the target.

Effect: The target is set up in reserve **in a Silver Tower**. It has now been deployed.
abilities.lore: The warped fortresses of the Gaunt Summoners are infested with their thrall hosts.

abilities.name: Book of Profane Secrets
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly unit **in a Silver Tower** to be the target.

Effect: Set up the target on the battlefield wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Using this arcane tome, the Gaunt Summoner calls forth minions from their Silver Tower.

abilities.name: Arcane Imprisonment
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the unmodified casting roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed. For the rest of the battle, that unit cannot be picked to be the target of an ability that allows a replacement unit to be set up.
abilities.lore: Gaunt Summoners delight in banishing foes to their Silver Towers.

units.lore: The Gaunt Summoners are strange daemon-sorcerers of Tzeentch bound to the will of the Everchosen. Some glide above the battlefield on scintillating Discs of Tzeentch, laying the enemy low with arcane power and cursed daggers.

units.name: Chaos Knights

abilities.name: Impaling Charge
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of its **Cursed Lances**.
abilities.lore: A charging Chaos Knight is capable of spitting several enemies at once with the point of their ensorcelled polearm.

units.lore: The coming of the Chaos Knights heralds a crushing defeat for their adversaries. These dreaded champions charge fearlessly into the deadliest of battles, striking down foes all around them with sundering blows from their ensorcelled weapons.

units.name: Exalted Hero of Chaos

abilities.name: Glory-seeker
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target **HEROES** or **MONSTERS**.
abilities.lore: To earn the favour of their patron, these formidable warriors ruthlessly hunt down enemy monsters and champions.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Ruinous Champion*.

units.lore: Exalted Heroes are those warriors who have caught the notice of the gods and now seek to make a true name for themselves. Their favoured prey are monsters and enemy champions, for by slaying these foes an Exalted Hero proves their own might.

units.name: Centaurion Marshal

abilities.name: Marshal of the Legions
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DAEMON** or **Chaos Legionnaires** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Not only formidable combatants, Centaurion Marshals lead the forces of the First Prince into battle with an iron fist.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Ruinous Champion*.

units.lore: The Centaurion Marshals are creatures of terrifying stature that serve as focal points for the First Prince’s legions, commanding warriors sworn to them with cunning and tactical guile before charging headlong into the fray, where they wreak havoc upon the enemy.

units.name: Chaos Chosen

abilities.name: Heralds of Ruination
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Paragons of the Dark Gods, Chaos Chosen cut a swathe through the enemy lines, leaving nothing but blood and ruin in their wake.

units.lore: Devotees of Chaos who garner many dark rewards may rise to the ranks of the Chosen. Armed with wicked soul-cleaving weapons, these champions fight at the forefront of the Chaotic hordes, inspiring their brethren through acts of brutal violence.

units.name: Archaon, the Everchosen

abilities.name: The Eye of Sheerian
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. This roll replaces the priority roll of the next battle round. On a 1-3, your opponent must take the first turn of that battle round. On a 4-6, you must take the first turn of that battle round. This ability cannot be used if there is an enemy **Archaon** on the battlefield.
abilities.lore: Torn from the corpse of a mighty dragon, this artefact grants Archaon visions of future events.

abilities.name: The Slayer of Kings
abilities.description: Effect: Each time this unit uses a **FIGHT** ability, if the unmodified wound roll for 2 or more attacks made with **The Slayer of Kings** that target the same **HERO** is 6, that **HERO** is automatically destroyed.
abilities.lore: This ancient daemonblade thirsts for the souls of champions and warlords.

abilities.name: Three-headed Titan
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects:

***Filth-spewer:*** Pick an enemy unit within 6" of this unit and roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in that unit, to a maximum of 7. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on that unit.

***Skull-gorger:*** Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and roll a dice. If the roll exceeds that unit’s Health characteristic, 1 model in that unit is slain and you can **Heal (X)** this unit, where **X** is that unit’s Health characteristic.

***Spell-eater:*** Pick a **MANIFESTATION** within 12" of this unit and roll a dice. On a 2+, it is banished and removed from play. In addition, inflict D3 mortal damage on the unit that summoned it.
abilities.lore: The greater daemons consumed by Dorghar imbue the Everchosen’s steed with unlimited power.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of **Dorghar’s Claws and Tails** is 4.

units.lore: Archaon is the Everchosen, champion of the Ruinous Powers, anointed in the blood of butchered empires. Many worship him as a demigod of Chaos, the primordial ruin of the false god Sigmar. It is true that the Everchosen despises the God-King – but he reserves similar loathings for the Brothers in Darkness, and indeed all deities. Were Archaon’s ultimate goals to be realised, it would be his banners alone rising over the charred corpse of the realms.

units.name: Ogroid Theridons

abilities.name: Unleashed Savagery
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Suppressing their savage spirit no more, these ferocious warriors hack at the foe in a bestial frenzy.

units.lore: Serving as shock troops to the armies of Chaos, these formidable warriors are found where the fighting is thickest, wielding both monstrous strength and honed martial skill to carve swathes of ruin through the ranks of the enemy.

units.name: The Oathsworn Kin

abilities.name: Withering Death
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on the target and subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: Nadja spits a vile curse in the Dark Tongue, drawing unnatural shadows to coil around an enemy champion and sap their life force.

abilities.name: Broken Nadja
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit’s **Broken Nadja** is on the battlefield, it has **WIZARD (1)**.
abilities.lore: Broken Nadja wields the energies of ruin itself through dark incantations.

details.notes: This unit can only be taken in **Gunnar Brand**’s regiment. This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: Gunnar Brand is a hero amongst the Darkoath tribes of Aqshy, but he could not have won his greatest victories without the aid of his companions. The Oathsworn Kin form his closest circle of confidants – Dendrel Direbrand and Warqueen Tanari cave in skulls with hammer and spear while Broken Nadja trails behind, her deadly incantations reducing foes to madness.

units.name: Darkoath Warqueen

abilities.name: Oath of Supremacy
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Charge Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is wholly within enemy territory and charged this phase, for the rest of the battle, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **DARKOATH** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: By the will of the gods, this warrior leads her barbarous horde into the lands of the enemy, allowing none to oppose them.

abilities.name: Ruin-blessed Conqueror
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an objective that this unit is contesting.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, friendly **DARKOATH** units have **WARD (5+)** while they are contesting that objective.
abilities.lore: A Warqueen heeds the whispers of the gods, ravaging lands in their name and drawing their gaze onto her warrior hordes.

units.lore: A Darkoath Warqueen has proven herself the rightful ruler of her barbarian tribesfolk time and again. She has sworn dread pacts to bring carnage to the Mortal Realms, and all who stand in her way must face both her wrath and that of her devoted warriors.

units.name: Chaos Lord on Karkadrak

abilities.name: Brutish Rampage
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick up to 3 enemy units within 1" of it to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: A charging Karkadrak is an almost unstoppable force, capable of smashing straight through even the most determined shieldwall.

abilities.name: Drive The Legions Forward
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 friendly non-**HERO** non-**CAVALRY WARRIORS OF CHAOS** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Add 2 to charge rolls for the targets for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Mounted atop a mighty Karkadrak, the Chaos Lord signals the charge.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Ruinous Champion*.

units.lore: Karkadraks are monstrous lizard-beasts clad in thick scales, whose destructive rampages are almost impossible to stop. Only the strongest Chaos Lords can dominate a Karkadrak, but those who succeed become truly deadly linebreakers.

units.name: Chaos Furies

abilities.name: Sneaky Little Devils
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.
abilities.lore: Chaos Furies are spiteful creatures that utterly loathe the idea of engaging in a fair fight, much preferring – where possible – to stab distracted enemies in the back.

units.lore: Furies are spiteful daemonic imps that throng those lands under the sway of Chaos. Though individually weak, when they swarm they can prove surprisingly deadly, waiting until the foe’s back is turned before launching vicious hit-and-run attacks.

units.name: Chaos Sorcerer Lord

abilities.name: Oracular Visions
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **WARRIORS OF CHAOS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target and roll a dice.

Effect: On a 3+, the target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: A sorcerer can temporarily bestow the gift of foresight upon their allies, helping them ward against enemy blows.

units.lore: The very air around a Sorcerer Lord is saturated with dark magic. With their command of daemonic powers and gift of foresight, these warlocks bolster the power of their allies while unleashing their own devastating spellcraft on the enemy.

units.name: Chaos Legionnaires

abilities.name: Sow Confusion
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: To the disciples of Be’lakor, subterfuge and lies are as keen as any blade.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: Sworn to Be’lakor, these warriors wage war on two different fronts. They openly march alongside the legions of Chaos, bringing ruin to the Mortal Realms, yet serve ulterior motives, seeking to undermine the Everchosen and secure the ascension of the First Prince in his stead.

units.name: Mutalith Vortex Beast

abilities.name: Aura of Mutation
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice and apply the corresponding effect below. If this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly **PLEDGED TO TZEENTCH WIZARD**, you can roll 2 dice instead, pick either result, then apply the corresponding effect below.

**1 - *Untouched***
No effect.

**2 - *Hideous Disfigurement***
Subtract 3 from the target’s control score until the start of your next turn.

**3 - *Troggbrains***
The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

**4 - *Gift of Mutations***
Subtract 1" from the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the battle.

**5 - *Horrific Absorption***
Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target. Then, **Heal (D6)** this unit.

**6 - *Transmogrification***
Pick any other effect.
abilities.lore: To stand near a Mutalith can have horrific consequences.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Betentacled Maw** is 8.

abilities.name: Mutant Regeneration
abilities.description: Effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.
abilities.lore: This unnatural abomination is invigorated by the raw power of Chaos.

units.lore: Within the pulsating star suspended above the back of a Mutalith Vortex Beast can be found a portal to the Realm of Chaos itself. These horrific monsters constantly seethe with the power of mutation, those around them rewrought into horrific forms.

units.name: Chaos Warriors

abilities.name: Bringers of Desolation
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Rune-etched Weapons** while it is contesting an objective you control.
abilities.lore: Chaos Warriors fight with relentless ferocity in those places consecrated to the Dark Gods.

units.lore: Clad in hellforged iron and swollen with dark blessings, Chaos Warriors are the bane of civilisation. Entire legions of these armoured killers march into battle in search of divine favour, each warrior the equal of several lesser mortals.

units.name: Mindstealer Sphiranx

abilities.name: Dominate Mind
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A Sphiranx can manipulate the actions of its enemies with a simple glance.

units.lore: Mindstealer Sphiranxes are powerful and sinister telepaths. These cruel-hearted beasts enjoy nothing more than toying with their prey, plundering their innermost secrets before summarily ripping them to shreds with sharpened claws.

units.name: Gorebeast Chariot

abilities.name: Brutal Momentum
abilities.description: Effect: When this unit uses the ‘Power Through’ command, inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on the target and add 3" to the distance this unit can move as part of that ability.
abilities.lore: The ferocity of Gorebeasts is terrible to behold as they carve a path of bloody destruction through the enemy ranks.

units.lore: Only the most brutal of champions can hope to yoke one of the grotesque Gorebeasts to their will. These unnatural creatures lie somewhere between a monstrous simian and a Ghurish rokodile, and one swing of their fists can punch clean through a mortal’s chest. Once bludgeoned into submission, a Gorebeast’s strength allows them to pull a Chaos Chariot with relative ease. It is often more difficult to get the creature to stop, as they smash aside enemy regiments and barrel onwards in search of more foes to crush.

units.name: Darkoath Savagers

abilities.name: Oath of Conquest
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is contesting an objective you control that is wholly within enemy territory, this unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: Heeding their Godspeaker’s proclamations, these warriors seek to earn glory by driving back the enemy.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: Screaming blood-curdling vows to the Ruinous Powers, the Darkoath Savagers make brutal war across the length and breadth of the Mortal Realms. To these barbarous marauders, each new dawn is an opportunity to win the favour of the gods.

armiesOfRenown.name: Legion of the First Prince
armiesOfRenown.description:
Be’lakor, first of the Daemon Princes, is a being of boundless darkness. His titanic form was wrought aeons ago by all four of the Brothers in Darkness, each pouring a portion of their might into him. For centuries, he was their perfect instrument of destruction and harbinger
of corruption, beckoning countless supplicants into the shadows of Chaos worship and bringing about the ruin of innumerable empires.
armiesOfRenown.lore:
Be’lakor, first of the Daemon Princes, is a being of boundless darkness. His titanic form was wrought aeons ago by all four of the Brothers in Darkness, each pouring a portion of their might into him. For centuries, he was their perfect instrument of destruction and harbinger
of corruption, beckoning countless supplicants into the shadows of Chaos worship and bringing about the ruin of innumerable empires.

Then came the Everchosen, and Be’lakor was cast aside.

When you pick the Slaves to Darkness faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Legion of the First Prince Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Slaves to Darkness faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box opposite. All units in your army gain the Legion of the First Prince keyword except for those in a Regiment of Renown.

battleTraits.name: First-Damned Prince
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description:
Effect: While a friendly **Be’lakor** is within the combat range of any friendly non-**HERO LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE DAEMON** units:

• That friendly **Be’lakor** has **WARD (4+)**.

• In addition, each time you make a successful ward roll for that friendly **Be’lakor**, allocate 1 damage point to a friendly non-**HERO LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE DAEMON** unit within **Be’lakor**’s combat range after the damage sequence for **Be’lakor** has been resolved (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
battleTraits.lore: Be’lakor courts the favour of all of the Chaos Gods to crush his foes. In battle, he surrounds himself with their lesser daemons to do his bidding.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Legion of the First Prince
battleTraits.groupName: Legion of the First Prince Battle Traits

battleTraits.name: Daemonic Reinforcements
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Movement Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE DAEMON INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) wholly within 12" of a friendly **Be’lakor** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
battleTraits.lore: Lesser daemons bound to the Dark Master’s will are summoned forth from the Realm of Chaos to swell Be’lakor’s ranks.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Legion of the First Prince
battleTraits.groupName: Legion of the First Prince Battle Traits

battleTraits.name: Storm of Blackened Blades
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Combat Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Eternus** that is in combat and up to 2 friendly non-**HERO** non-**DAEMON LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE** units wholly within 12" of that **Eternus** to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
battleTraits.lore: Eternus commands the mortal legions sworn to Be’lakor to bring ruin to all who dare oppose the First Prince.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Legion of the First Prince
battleTraits.groupName: Legion of the First Prince Battle Traits

battleTraits.name: Bestow Favour
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: If a friendly **Be’lakor** is on the battlefield, pick a non-**HERO LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE** unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:
• Add 5 to the target’s control score.
• If the target is a **DAEMON** unit, add 1 to save rolls for the target.
• If the target is a non-**DAEMON** unit, it has **WARD (6+)**.
battleTraits.lore: The Great Game plays out in the blackened skies above the First Prince’s legions as oaths are sworn, enemies are crushed, and dark rewards are granted.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Legion of the First Prince
battleTraits.groupName: Legion of the First Prince Battle Traits

heroicTraits.name: Dread Marshal
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly units wholly within 12" of this unit to be targets.

Effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for the targets for the rest of the turn.
heroicTraits.lore: This mighty warrior has proved their devotion to Be’lakor above all, and their loyalty has been rewarded with a host of warriors to command.
heroicTraits.source: Army of Renown: Legion of the First Prince
heroicTraits.groupName: Legion of the First Prince Heroic Trait

artefacts.name: Black Ritual Dagger
artefacts.phase: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared a SPELL ability for a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit
artefacts.description: Effect: Allocate 1 damage point to this unit. Then, you can re-roll the casting roll.
artefacts.lore: Dark tendrils of chaotic magic coil around this obsidian blade. The bearer’s mind is filled with promises of arcane power if its thirst for blood is quenched.
artefacts.source: Army of Renown: Legion of the First Prince
artefacts.groupName: Legion of the First Prince Artefact of Power

spellLores.name: Legion of the First Prince Spell Lore

spells.name: Dark Cantrip
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 18" of them to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Inflict 1 mortal damage on each target.
spells.lore: Uttering blasphemous words in the Dark Tongue, the sorcerer calls forth bolts of black chaotic energy that strike the foe, searing flesh, melting armour and leaving them as a bubbling mass of tentacles.

spells.name: Shroud in Darkness
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE** unit that is not in combat and is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat. In addition, until the start of your next turn, the target is not visible to enemy units while they are more than 12" away.
spells.lore: At the sorcerer’s bidding, unnatural shadows fall upon Be’lakor’s warriors, allowing them to move unseen.

manifestations.name: Eightfold Doom-Sigil

abilities.name: Empowered By Atrocity
abilities.description: Effect: If 2 or more units (friendly or enemy) were destroyed this turn, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION**.
abilities.lore: The souls of those slain in the presence of an Eightfold Doom-Sigil are absorbed by the magical manifestation, feeding the Dark Gods’ eternal hunger and inspiring their servants to battle all the harder, even as their own lives are offered in tribute.

manifestations.lore: Eightfold Doom-Sigils are icons of Chaos in all its glory, blazing symbols of pure ruin. To fall in the presence of such a sorcerous construct is to be damned, for these lingering spells hungrily suck souls into the Realm of Chaos for the gods to feast upon.

summonSpell.name: Summon Eightfold Doom-Sigil
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Eightfold Doom-Sigil** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an **Eightfold Doom-Sigil** wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.
summonSpell.lore: Eightfold Doom-Sigils are icons of Chaos in all its glory, blazing symbols of pure ruin. To fall in the presence of such a sorcerous construct is to be damned, for these lingering spells hungrily suck souls into the Realm of Chaos for the gods to feast upon.

terrain.name: Nexus Chaotica

abilities.name: Infernal Sorcery
abilities.description:
Declare: If this terrain feature has 3 or more **power points**, pick a friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS WIZARD** within 3" of this terrain feature to be the target.

Effect: Remove 3 **power points** from this terrain feature, then add 1 to casting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A sorcerer of Chaos can draw upon the bound daemons of the Nexus Chaotica to empower their spellcasting.

abilities.name: Corrupt The Realms
abilities.description:
Declare: If this terrain feature has 9 or more **power points**, pick an objective or terrain feature within 24" of this terrain feature to be the source. Then, pick any number of enemy units within 3" of the source to be the targets.

Effect: Remove 9 **power points** from this terrain feature, then roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: These diabolical constructs use harnessed daemonic power to corrupt the geomantic energy of the Mortal Realms.

abilities.name: Draw Power
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. Give a number of **power points** to this terrain feature equal to the roll. This terrain feature can have a maximum of 12 **power points** at once.
abilities.lore: Constructed at confluences where magical ley lines converge, a Nexus Chaotica can draw power from the realms and into a floating crucible.

terrain.lore: True champions of Chaos recognise that the gods demand more than simple slaughter. The realms themselves must be laced with taint; the arcane ley lines must be inundated with corruption. This is the purpose of the Nexus Chaotica, a shrine raised at a geomantic confluence for the express purpose of withering it.

units.name: Be'lakor, the Dark Master

abilities.name: The Dark Master
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target is picked to use an ability, roll a dice as a reaction. On a 3+, that ability has no effect.
abilities.lore: Many puppets dance on Be’lakor’s infernal strings. Few realise as much until their fate is sealed.

abilities.name: Enfeeble Foe
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn:

• Subtract 1 from hit rolls from the target’s combat attacks.
• The target’s combat attacks cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).
abilities.lore: With a series of hissed incantations, Be’lakor instils visions of loss and despair in the minds of his enemies to drain them of their fighting spirit.

abilities.name: Shadow Form
abilities.description: Effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for this unit (positive and negative).
abilities.lore: Be’lakor can shift his physical form to be as insubstantial as the mists of Ulgu – and just as hard to land a telling blow upon.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Blade of Shadows** is 6.

abilities.name: Deadly Trap
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 friendly **SLAVES TO DARKNESS** units within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 4+, that target has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Dark Master delights in lethal reversals of expectation and fate.

regimentOptions: Any LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE

units.lore: Once, Be’lakor – first of the Daemon Princes – stood paramount before the Ruinous Powers. How he fell from these heights is not known; likely his ambitions played a part, for Be’lakor craves godhood. His punishment was to crown each Everchosen but be denied the mantle himself. Yet Be’lakor is a creature of matchless cunning; even as he raged at his predicament, nursing hatred for the ‘False King’ Archaon, he schemed to reclaim his place at the forefront of the hordes of Chaos.

units.name: Legion of the First Prince Bloodletters

abilities.name: The Thinning Veil
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, you can return D3 slain models to this unit.
abilities.lore: As heads roll and blood flows, more daemons from beyond the veil are summoned forth to partake in the slaughter.

details.notes: This unit can only be taken in a Legion of the First Prince Army of Renown.

units.lore: Beneath unholy icons and blood-soaked banners, letting loose roaring battle cries and terrifying blasts from brazen horns, the Bloodletters of Khorne surge forwards in a tide of corded muscle and hellforged swords to maim and slaughter their foes.

units.name: Legion of the First Prince Beasts of Nurgle

abilities.name: Attention Seekers
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick the closest enemy unit to it to be the target. If 2 or more enemy units are tied to be the closest, you can pick which is the target. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.

Effect: This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll. During that move, this unit can move into combat and can pass through models in the target unit, but it must end that move within 1" of the target. If it does so, this unit has charged. Then, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Beasts of Nurgle seek out playmates with an enthusiasm that is rarely reciprocated by the horrified source of their fascination.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

details.notes: This unit can only be taken in a Legion of the First Prince Army of Renown.

units.lore: s stupid as they are enthusiastic, Beasts of Nurgle bound forth with burbles of joy. Huge, slug-like abominations, they gleefully assail their luckless playmates until their joy proves lethal, before bounding off after new victims.

units.name: Daemon Prince

abilities.name: The Mounted Skulls of the Fallen
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has a **Trophy Rack**, its **Hellforged Weapons** also have **Anti‑HERO (+1 Rend)**.
abilities.lore: Some Daemon Princes revel in glory with each worthy foe slain by their hands.

abilities.name: Immortal Champion
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Those favoured enough to ascend to daemonhood are among the most deadly servants of the Ruinous Powers.

abilities.name: Airborne Horror
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has **Wings**, it has a Move characteristic of 10" and has **FLY**.
abilities.lore: Carried aloft by ragged leathery wings, this favoured champion of the Chaos Gods will bring ruin wherever they descend.

regimentOptions: Any LEGION OF THE FIRST PRINCE

units.lore: Daemon Princes are those champions who, through determination and countless atrocities, have surpassed the heights of the Path to Glory. Only the most vanishingly rare souls can hold the gods’ attention long enough to achieve this apotheosis, joining the infernal ranks of daemonkind as an embodiment of Chaos itself. The earth rebels at their presence, for they are things that should not exist. Palls of shadow surround a Daemon Prince as the land cracks and vomits torrents of hellflame. With talon and cursed blade, the Daemon Prince brings ruin to the realms, assured that there are none who might challenge them.

units.name: Eternus, Blade of the First Prince

abilities.name: Veins of Black Lightning
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can use this ability if it has been destroyed.

Effect: Roll 2D6. Add 1 to the roll if a friendly **Be’lakor** is on the battlefield. On an 8+, set up a replacement unit on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Reborn in the Cursed Skies above the realms, Eternus’s soul is tethered to the Mortal Realms through the dark magics of his master; whenever he is struck down, a flash of black lightning sees him stand defiant once more.

abilities.name: Network of Spies
abilities.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a command for a unit within 12" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the enemy unit is in combat with a friendly **Chaos Legionnaires** or **Chaos Furies** unit. On a 5+, that command has no effect. The command still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.
abilities.lore: Eternus commands a legion of agents and operatives to ensure he is always one step ahead of his enemies.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join **Be’lakor’s** regiment.

units.lore: Sworn to Be’lakor and granted immortality, Eternus rides at the head of First Prince’s legions, crushing those who oppose his ascension. His mighty weapons are not his only means of waging war, for Eternus commands a vast network of spies and warriors loyal to the Dark Master.

units.name: Legion of the First Prince Screamers of Tzeentch

abilities.name: Slashing Fins
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit that passed across the target. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: A pack of Screamers travelling at great speed can slash and eviscerate an enemy formation to ribbons.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

details.notes: This unit can only be taken in a Legion of the First Prince Army of Renown.

units.lore: Speeding blurs that leave shimmering trails of change-magic in the air, Screamers streak across the skies with a wailing cry. They slash any foes they pass with razor-sharp horns and fins before darting down to savage their chosen quarry.

units.name: Varanguard

abilities.name: Relentless Killers
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Varanguard have slaughtered foes beyond counting, butchering their way across the battlefields of the Mortal Realms without mercy.

units.lore: Each of the Varanguard is a mighty champion who has passed the many tests set for them by Archaon and sworn themselves to his service. Riding atop their hulking steeds, these lords of darkness bring inescapable death to the Everchosen’s enemies.

units.name: Legion of the First Prince Fiends

abilities.name: Disruptive Song
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls and unbinding rolls for enemy **WIZARDS** while they are within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Fiends of Slaanesh let out a keening song that disturbs the concentration of spellcasters who hear it.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Soporific Musk
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A Fiend exudes a pervasive and oily musk that numbs a foe to all but the most extreme of stimuli.

details.notes: This unit can only be taken in a Legion of the First Prince Army of Renown.

units.lore: Horrific nightmares given bestial shape, Fiends of Slaanesh emit a harsh, trilling call as they race towards their prey. A dream-inducing scent hangs thick around the Fiends, reducing their foes to a stupor and sapping them of their will to fight.

units.name: Centaurion Marshal

abilities.name: Marshal of the Legions
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DAEMON** or **Chaos Legionnaires** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Not only formidable combatants, Centaurion Marshals lead the forces of the First Prince into battle with an iron fist.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Ruinous Champion*.

units.lore: The Centaurion Marshals are creatures of terrifying stature that serve as focal points for the First Prince’s legions, commanding warriors sworn to them with cunning and tactical guile before charging headlong into the fray, where they wreak havoc upon the enemy.

units.name: Legion of the First Prince Flamers of Tzeentch

abilities.name: Wyrdflame of Tzeentch
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks that target that unit. In addition, if every shooting attack made by this unit this phase targets that enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target after the **SHOOT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Lurid gouts of wyrdflame immolate the enemy when Flamers of Tzeentch are brought to the fore.

details.notes: This unit can only be taken in a Legion of the First Prince Army of Renown.

units.lore: Bounding in a disturbing fashion, Flamers of Tzeentch spring towards the foe spouting the warpfires of Chaos. Yet the Changer of the Ways is fickle, and fires that have burnt out may once more leap to life, guiding even more flames to the target.

units.name: Chaos Furies

abilities.name: Sneaky Little Devils
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.
abilities.lore: Chaos Furies are spiteful creatures that utterly loathe the idea of engaging in a fair fight, much preferring – where possible – to stab distracted enemies in the back.

units.lore: Furies are spiteful daemonic imps that throng those lands under the sway of Chaos. Though individually weak, when they swarm they can prove surprisingly deadly, waiting until the foe’s back is turned before launching vicious hit-and-run attacks.

units.name: Chaos Sorcerer Lord

abilities.name: Oracular Visions
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **WARRIORS OF CHAOS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target and roll a dice.

Effect: On a 3+, the target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: A sorcerer can temporarily bestow the gift of foresight upon their allies, helping them ward against enemy blows.

units.lore: The very air around a Sorcerer Lord is saturated with dark magic. With their command of daemonic powers and gift of foresight, these warlocks bolster the power of their allies while unleashing their own devastating spellcraft on the enemy.

units.name: Chaos Legionnaires

abilities.name: Sow Confusion
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: To the disciples of Be’lakor, subterfuge and lies are as keen as any blade.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: Sworn to Be’lakor, these warriors wage war on two different fronts. They openly march alongside the legions of Chaos, bringing ruin to the Mortal Realms, yet serve ulterior motives, seeking to undermine the Everchosen and secure the ascension of the First Prince in his stead.

units.name: Legion of the First Prince Plaguebearers

abilities.name: Cloud of Flies
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.
abilities.lore: Plaguebearers are surrounded by a cloud of swarming flies that feast on their rotting bodies.

details.notes: This unit can only be taken in a Legion of the First Prince Army of Renown.

units.lore: Plaguebearers trudge to battle amidst the drone of flies’ wings and endless counting. These daemons tally the diseases unleashed upon the realms, all the while stabbing and hacking at their enemies with filthy plagueswords.

units.name: Legion of the First Prince Bloodcrushers

abilities.name: Slaughterous Charge
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Make a crushing charge roll of D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: The crushing mass and stamping hooves of Khorne’s Juggernauts are a threat to all in their path.

details.notes: This unit can only be taken in a Legion of the First Prince Army of Renown.

units.lore: The ground shakes beneath the onrushing fury of the Bloodcrushers before they crash into the enemy with the force of a falling mountain. Those not crushed beneath the Juggernauts’ hooves are slain by the swinging hellblades of the beasts’ riders.

units.name: Legion of the First Prince Hellflayer

abilities.name: Threshing Doom
abilities.description: Effect: When this unit moves, it can pass through models in enemy **INFANTRY** units and can pass through the combat ranges of enemy **INFANTRY** units, but it cannot end a move in combat unless specified in the ability used.
abilities.lore: The wail of an approaching Hellflayer sees enemy infantry diving for cover.

abilities.name: Soulscent
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units that this unit passed across this phase to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If any models are slain by this ability, this unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The whirling blades of this fearsome chariot mow down the enemy, transmuting their souls into an exhilarating incense that drives its riders into an ecstatic frenzy.

details.notes: This unit can only be taken in a Legion of the First Prince Army of Renown.
