terrain.name: Shrine Luminor

abilities.name: Exit the Shrine
abilities.description: Effect: If this terrain feature has a Shrine Guardian that was not placed on it this turn, set up the Shrine Guardian on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a Shrine Guardian.
abilities.lore: The Guardian floats down to the battlefield to rejoin the fray.

abilities.name: Cleansing Rituals
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this terrain feature
abilities.description: Effect: While this terrain feature has a Shrine Guardian, you can re-roll the casting roll for that spell.
abilities.lore: These shrines are instrumental to the Lumineth’s efforts in purging Chaos from the Mortal Realms.

abilities.name: Enter the Shrine
abilities.description:
Declare: If this terrain feature does not have a Shrine Guardian, pick a friendly **LUMINETH REALM‐LORDS INFANTRY HERO** within 3" of it and not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now a Shrine Guardian (see ‘Shrine Guardian’).
abilities.lore: Worthy Lumineth take up position within a Shrine Luminor to help to cleanse the realms.

abilities.name: Shrine Guardian
abilities.description:
Effect: While this terrain feature has a Shrine Guardian:

•  This terrain feature has a Move characteristic of 6" and can use non‑command non-**CHARGE MOVE** abilities as if it were a unit. It cannot end a **MOVE** ability within the combat range of an enemy unit.
•  The Shrine Guardian cannot use **MOVE** abilities and remains on this terrain feature each time it moves.
•  Instead of measuring range and visibility to the Shrine Guardian, measure to this terrain feature instead.
•  All attacks that would target the Shrine Guardian target this terrain feature instead.

If this terrain feature is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the Shrine Guardian. Then, set up the Shrine Guardian on the battlefield wholly within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer a Shrine Guardian. If it is not possible to set up the Shrine Guardian, it is slain.
abilities.lore: Protected from attacks, the Shrine Guardian can move the metalith with but a fleeting thought.

terrain.lore: A Shrine Luminor is built upon a realmstone-rich metalith, a floating island in miniature leaden with geomantic energies. From here, a Lumineth mage can channel this elemental power to cleanse the corrupted land as well as bolster their arcane potential.

units.name: Hurakan Windmage

abilities.name: Transporting Vortex
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **LUMINETH REALM‑LORDS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The caster calls upon a magnanimous whirlwind to sweep up allies and carry them to safety.

abilities.name: Windleap
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **HURAKAN** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, each target can use a **RUN** ability and still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.
abilities.lore: Windmages often accompany Windchargers into battle, allowing the cavalry archers to perform soaring leaps right over the heads of their enemies.

units.lore: True allies of the Hyshian winds, a Hurakan Windmage travels everywhere upon a loyal zephyr- spirit companion. From here, they encourage their aelementors to follow their aelven disciples and unleash the gale-force wrath of the air against their enemies.

units.name: Avalenor, The Stoneheart King

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Firestealer Hammers** is 4.

abilities.name: With the Force of a Landslide
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Firestealer Hammers** for each instance of **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** depicted on your **battle scripture**.
abilities.lore: The Alaithi rune imbues mountain spirits with increasing power.

abilities.name: Unbreakable Bulwark
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, while that enemy unit is in combat with this unit, all attacks made by models in that enemy unit within this unit’s combat range must target this unit.
abilities.lore: Lumineth who fight in Avalenor’s shadow need not fear; as long as he stands, they will come to no harm.

abilities.name: Call of the Mountains
abilities.description:
Effect: While a visible friendly **ALARITH** unit is wholly within 12" of this unit:
•  You are treated as having 1 additional instance of **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** depicted on your **battle scripture** for the purposes of the abilities on that unit’s warscroll.
•  If that unit is picked to be a target of the ‘Depict Rune’ ability, you can apply the enhanced effects of that ability to that unit as if you had an instance of **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** depicted on your **battle scripture**.
abilities.lore: In the presence of Avalenor, the mountains awaken to give protection to their allies.

units.lore: Avalenor is the eldest and wisest of all Hysh's mountain spirits. He alone chose to stand with the aelves of his own accord. Since then, his twin Firestealer Hammers have never rested in the defence of Hysh and its sibling realms - nor shall they while a single servant of the Dark Gods draws breath.

units.name: Alarith Spirit of the Mountain

abilities.name: Rain of Stone
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. Add 2 to the roll if the target charged this turn. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Boulders crash down from the Spirit of the Mountain, crushing foes under the avalanche.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stoneheart Worldhammer** is 3.

abilities.name: With the Force of a Landslide
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Stoneheart Worldhammer** for each instance of **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** depicted on your **battle scripture**.
abilities.lore: The Alaithi rune imbues mountain spirits with increasing power.

units.lore: A Spirit of the Mountain is a war-form adopted by the geomantic animus of one of Hysh’s great peaks. The strength of the realm itself is theirs to wield, but though their hammers can crush walls and reduce enemies to bloody smears, it is their wisdom these spirits are most revered for – ponderous as it can be.

units.name: Sevireth, Lord of the Seventh Wind

abilities.name: Searing Desert Winds
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 6" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll and subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Sevireth is the lord of burning-hot and parching desert winds. If Sevireth whirls around a foe for long enough, only desiccated corpses are left in his wake.

abilities.name: Spirit of the Wind
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability this phase, this unit can move D6". Add 2 to the roll for each instance of **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** depicted on your **battle scripture**. It cannot end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: A Spirit of the Wind never remains in one place for long.

abilities.name: Call of the Winds
abilities.description:
Effect: While a visible friendly **HURAKAN** unit is wholly within 12" of this unit:
•  You are treated as having 1 additional instance of **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** depicted on your **battle scripture** for the purposes of the abilities on that unit’s warscroll.
•  If that unit is picked to be a target of the ‘Depict Rune’ ability, you can apply the enhanced effects of that ability to that unit as if you had an instance of **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** depicted on your **battle scripture**.
abilities.lore: In the presence of Sevireth, the winds awaken to give aid to their allies.

units.lore: The bellicose elementor known as Sevireth is the searing wrath of a desert wind come to life. The sandstorm that whips around him can scour the idols and monuments of his foes clean in moments, while enemies are flayed to the bone - those not struck down by his arrows, that is.

units.name: Alarith Stoneguard

abilities.name: Fortitude of the Earth
abilities.description: Effect: While you have 2 or more instances of **Alaithi, Rune of the Mountain** depicted on your **battle scripture**, this unit’s Save characteristic is 3+.
abilities.lore: When the Stoneguard adopt this unyielding martial stance, even the most ferocious assaults cannot break them.

units.lore: Having accepted the mountains as their spiritual guides, the Alarith Stoneguard are granted immense strength and resilience. In battle, their adversaries find them all but impossible to shift, while the blows of their sacred hammers are like an avalanche crashing into the enemy.

units.name: Alarith Stonemage

abilities.name: Strength of Stone
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **Alarith Stoneguard** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
• The target cannot make pile-in moves.
abilities.lore: The Stonemage focuses upon the stoic majesty of their guardian mountain, imbuing a nearby group of Alarith with its immovability and might.

abilities.name: Raise the Earth
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time a non-**FLY** unit (friendly or enemy) that is contesting the target objective uses a **MOVE** ability, inflict D6 mortal damage on that unit after that ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: With a great rumbling and the grinding of stone upon stone, the caster turns an area of clear ground into a jumble of clefts, scree and jagged terrain that is extremely perilous for warriors to traverse.

units.lore: Alarith Stonemages are experts in the magic of rock and earth, for they have become one with their mountain masters. In battle, they hurl boulders, turn their flesh to impervious stone and even control gravity itself to annihilate their foes.

units.name: Hurakan Spirit of the Wind

abilities.name: Hunters of Majestic Beasts
abilities.description: Effect: The Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Bow of the Wind’s Vengeance** is 3 for attacks that target **MONSTERS**.
abilities.lore: With vindictive glee, wind spirits race across the battlefield in pursuit of mighty behemoths, seeking to lay them low with a well-placed shot.

abilities.name: Hurricane Winds
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The arrows of the Spirits of the Wind are followed by a blast of wind, throwing enemies to the ground.

abilities.name: Spirit of the Wind
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability this phase, this unit can move D6". Add 2 to the roll for each instance of **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** depicted on your **battle scripture**. It cannot end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: A Spirit of the Wind never remains in one place for long.

units.lore: When roused to wrath, the Spirits of the Wind strike like a cyclone. It is all but impossible to track them as they dart through the air, launching arrow after arrow from their elegant but monstrously powerful bows and slipping away before retribution can land, the wind whistling with their laughter.

units.name: Hurakan Windchargers

abilities.name: Guided by the Winds
abilities.description: Effect: While you have 2 or more instances of **Oreali, Rune of the Wind** depicted on your **battle scripture**, add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit’s Windcharger Bows.
abilities.lore: The Windchargers’ arrows are lofted by benevolent winds and sped toward to their targets.

units.lore: There is nowhere to hide from the Windchargers of the Hurakan temple. Their treerunner mounts are capable of deftly navigating the densest terrain to slip past their enemies, while the arrows of the aelves are carried upon loyal winds and almost always find their mark.

units.name: Ydrilan Riverblades

abilities.name: Travel The Waterways
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

If you picked to depict **Ydriliqi, Rune of the River** on your **battle scripture** this battle round, you can instead set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The Ydrilan are able to navigate the realms’ waterways in order to travel as fast as the flow of the rapids.

abilities.name: Relentless as the Driving Current
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 2D6". It can pass through models in enemy units but must end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: An Ydrilan warrior keeps surging forwards, their movements fluid and bewilderingly fast as they embody the momentum of rushing water.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: Leaping into battle with acrobatic finesse, Ydrilan Riverblades are swift and aggressive fighters. They attack with a relentless drive, surging forwards into the enemy with flowing lethality akin to the waterways their aelementiri temple has sworn to protect.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Alarith Stonemage

abilities.name: Earth's Grip
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit that has no more than 1 model and is within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, the target is **gripped** until this unit is destroyed, the target **breaks free** or you pick a different target for this spell.

While the target is **gripped**, each time it uses a **MOVE** ability, your opponent must roll a dice as a reaction and add their **fury level** to the roll. On a 7+, the target **breaks free**. Otherwise, that **MOVE** ability has no effect.
abilities.lore: Spars of rock shoot up from the ground to grasp the legs of a foe, holding them in place unless they manage to free themselves.

abilities.name: Elemental Endurance
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is picked to be a target of the ‘Depict Rune’ ability, for the rest of that battle round, when resolving the damage sequence for a friendly **LUMINETH REALM-LORDS** unit while it is wholly within 12" of this unit, if you spend **rage dice** as part of the ‘Fight Through the Pain’ ability, remove 1 damage point from that unit’s damage pool on a 2+ instead of a 3+.
abilities.lore: Alarith Stonemages can draw on the power of the sigils to impart a measure of their stone-like resilience to their allies.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Many are the Alarith Stonemages who journeyed to the Adamantine Chain to commune with the mountain spirits that dwell there. Having achieved true oneness with the earthbound aelementors, they are masters of geomantic and lithomantic magics.

battleTraits.name: Blessings of Khaine
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you performed any blood rites this turn.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following blessings that is not **active**. That blessing is **active**. While a blessing is **active**, its effect applies to friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** units. The effects of more than 1 blessing can apply to a unit at the same time.

• ***Blessing of Ruthlessness:*** Add 1 to hit rolls for those units’ combat attacks.
• ***Blessing of Hatred:*** Add 1 to wound rolls for those units’ combat attacks.
• ***Blessing of Haste:*** Add 3" to those units’ Move characteristic.
• ***Blessing of Zeal:*** If those units charged in the same turn, they have **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.
• ***Blessing of Shadow:*** Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target those units.
• ***Blessing of Cruelty:*** Those units can use **CHARGE** and/or **SHOOT** abilities even if they have used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
• ***Blessing of Clarity:*** Add 1 to chanting rolls and casting rolls for those units.
battleTraits.lore: As ever more blood is spilt in tribute, so too are the Khainites lavished with ever more blessings from their deity.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Daughters of Khaine armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Anointed Ritualist
battleTraits.phase: Start of First Battle Round
battleTraits.description:
Declare: If there are no friendly **anointed** units on the battlefield, pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE HERO** on the battlefield to be the target.

Effect: The target is **anointed** for the rest of the battle, even if it has been destroyed. Friendly **anointed** units on the battlefield treat **EXALTED** abilities on the warscrolls of friendly **anointed** units that have been destroyed as if they were on their warscrolls.
battleTraits.lore: The skin of a worthy champion is smeared with oil and daubed with sacred blood runes, and they are granted the honour of leading those gory rituals beloved of Morathi-Khaine.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Daughters of Khaine armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Strident War Cry
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **CHARGE** ability for an anointed unit
battleTraits.description:
Used By: That **anointed** unit.

Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit that is not in combat, is wholly within 12" of that **anointed** unit and has not charged this turn to be the target. If that **anointed** unit charges, after that **CHARGE** ability has been resolved, the target can immediately use the ‘Charge’ ability even if it is not your charge phase. In addition, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target for the rest of the phase.
battleTraits.lore: As the anointed champion unleashes a piercing battle cry, her faithful rush to join her in the crucible of combat.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Daughters of Khaine armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Bloody Succession
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **anointed** unit is destroyed, after removing it from play, you can immediately use the ‘Anointed Ritualist’ ability as if it were the start of the first battle round.
battleTraits.lore: As one anointed champion falls, the runes painted on their skin fade away, only to reappear upon the body of another faithful soul.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Daughters of Khaine armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Blood Rites
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description:
Effect: You perform a blood rite each time:

• An enemy unit is destroyed and any damage points were allocated to that unit by a friendly **anointed** unit’s combat attacks in the same turn.
• A friendly **anointed** unit is destroyed.
• A friendly unit contesting an objective you control is destroyed.
• An enemy unit is destroyed by a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit’s attacks and any models in that enemy unit were contesting an objective you do not control in the same phase.
• A unit (friendly or enemy) is destroyed and it was within 3" of a **Place of Power** at the start of the phase.

Only one blood rite can be performed per unit destroyed.
battleTraits.lore: Manifold are the Khainite blood rituals, but no offering holds greater weight than the spilling of gore in a ritualistic bacchanal.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Daughters of Khaine armies can use the following abilities:

ability.name: Final Frenzy
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
ability.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit contesting an objective to be the targets.

Effect: Return up to D3 slain models to each target that has a Health characteristic of up to 2. Return up to 1 slain model to each target that has a Health characteristic of 3 or more.
ability.lore: While in a state of ritualistic frenzy, not even a mortal wound can prevent a Khainite from spilling blood.

abilities.name: Final Frenzy
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick each friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit contesting an objective to be the targets.

Effect: Return up to D3 slain models to each target that has a Health characteristic of up to 2. Return up to 1 slain model to each target that has a Health characteristic of 3 or more.
abilities.lore: While in a state of ritualistic frenzy, not even a mortal wound can prevent a Khainite from spilling blood.

ability.name: Heretic's Bane
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Enemy Turn
ability.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** on the battlefield to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice for each objective you control. For each 3+, subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: Hot blood pours from the eyes and mouths of any who dare counter the Khainites’ divine works with those of their own.

abilities.name: Heretic's Bane
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Enemy Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST** on the battlefield to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice for each objective you control. For each 3+, subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Hot blood pours from the eyes and mouths of any who dare counter the Khainites’ divine works with those of their own.

ability.name: The Breath of Khaine
ability.description: Effect: While each model in a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit is contesting an objective you control, those models are not visible to enemy models more than 9" away.
ability.lore: A blood-red mist billows across the battlefield, obscuring those Khainites consecrating ground in the Bloody‑Handed One’s name.

abilities.name: The Breath of Khaine
abilities.description: Effect: While each model in a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit is contesting an objective you control, those models are not visible to enemy models more than 9" away.
abilities.lore: A blood-red mist billows across the battlefield, obscuring those Khainites consecrating ground in the Bloody‑Handed One’s name.

ability.name: Bloody-Handed Worshippers
ability.phase: Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for an anointed unit
ability.description:
Used By: That **anointed** unit.

Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within that anointed unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by that **anointed** unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for the rest of the turn. If its melee weapons already have **Crit (Auto-wound)**, they have **Crit (Mortal)** for the rest of the turn instead.
ability.lore: This sacrament calls for the anointed champion and their followers to commit murder of the most violent kind.

abilities.name: Bloody-Handed Worshippers
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a **FIGHT** ability for an anointed unit
abilities.description:
Used By: That **anointed** unit.

Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within that anointed unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by that **anointed** unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for the rest of the turn. If its melee weapons already have **Crit (Auto-wound)**, they have **Crit (Mortal)** for the rest of the turn instead.
abilities.lore: This sacrament calls for the anointed champion and their followers to commit murder of the most violent kind.

heroicTraits.name: Murderous Duellist
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that has no more than 1 model and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, for the rest of the turn, if this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a **FIGHT** ability, all of the target’s attacks must target this unit.
heroicTraits.lore: This hero has trained extensively in gladiatorial arenas across the realms and is utterly dedicated to the art of single combat.

heroicTraits.name: Hand of Khaine
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed. If the target is destroyed by this ability, this unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
heroicTraits.lore: This murderer has mastered Khaine’s killing touch, a move so lethal it can sunder plate, body and soul in equal measure.

heroicTraits.name: Shadow-Blooded
heroicTraits.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Redeploy’ command for a **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
heroicTraits.description: Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
heroicTraits.lore: This hero hails from one of the darkest parts of Ulgu, and their heritage grants them a significant aptitude for deception.

artefacts.name: Crimson Draught
artefacts.description: Effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit.
artefacts.lore: This vile mixture grants the drinker incredible bursts of speed. Fatal in all but the most controlled of doses, it is often 'gifted' to those whom Morathi is keeping an eye on.

artefacts.name: Darkling Elixir
artefacts.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
artefacts.lore: Crafted from the blood of creatures best left unnamed, this wicked brew lends the imbiber’s outline a smoky, wispy appearance.

artefacts.name: Witchbrew
artefacts.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly non-**UNIQUE DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.
artefacts.lore: This holy potion drives the imbiber into such an ecstasy of destruction that they will fight on in the face of impossible odds.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Ulguan Reactions
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: Their preternatural movements obscured, these warriors can deflect incoming blows and visit them back upon the attacker.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText:
Boons of Shadow are unique enhancements that can only be given to non-**HERO DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** units.
A unit can only have 1 Boon of Shadow.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Talismans of Shadow
aqshyEnhancements.phase: Reaction: You declared a SPELL, PRAYER or UNBIND ability for a unit within 3" of this unit
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, add 1 to that casting roll, chanting roll or unbinding roll.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: In the presence of these blessed warriors, the potency of shadow magic is amplified and beseechments to Khaine are often answered.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText:
Boons of Shadow are unique enhancements that can only be given to non-**HERO DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** units.
A unit can only have 1 Boon of Shadow.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Tenebrous Aura
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:
• The target cannot use **RETREAT** abilities.
• If an ability would heal or return any slain models to the target unit, that ability does not heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: The darkling nature of these sistren is so unsettling that foes find themselves utterly transfixed... and ultimately vulnerable.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText:
Boons of Shadow are unique enhancements that can only be given to non-**HERO DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** units.
A unit can only have 1 Boon of Shadow.

spells.name: Black Horror of Ulgu
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a point on the battlefield within 18" of them, pick up to 3 enemy units within 3" of that point to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The targets cannot use **RUN** abilities until the start of your next turn.
spells.lore: A writhing mass of shadowy tentacles emerges though a conjured portal to coil around the limbs of nearby foes, who suddenly feel as if they are wading through mud.

spells.name: Steed of Shadows
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target can use **CHARGE** abilities this turn even if it used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.
spells.lore: A coal-black creature with wings of night materialises from the darkness and swoops across the battlefield, hastening the movement of the Khainites below.

spells.name: Mindrazor
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target’s melee weapons have **Charge (+1 Damage)** until the start of your next turn.
spells.lore: The wizard summons spectral blades into their allies’ hands, weapons whose edges are honed by the wielder’s faith as much as the victim’s fear.

prayers.name: Dance of Doom
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly non-**UNIQUE DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 10+, the target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this turn. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
prayers.lore: The priest exhorts their followers to launch themselves into the fray and cut down the enemy in a display of lethal acrobatics.

prayers.name: Catechism of Murder
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: The target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 7+, the target’s combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ until the start of your next turn.
prayers.lore: Khaine’s followers enter a killing frenzy that knows no bounds, lashing out in a slicing storm of razor‑sharp steel.

prayers.name: Covenant of the Iron Heart
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Add 10 to the target’s control score until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to the target in each phase until the start of your next turn.
prayers.lore: The hearts of the Murder God’s followers become as cold and hard as iron, crushing their fears and doubts with a chilling contempt.

prayers.name: Scáthscale
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks that target that friendly unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks that target friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of the target of this ability instead.
prayers.lore: Hissing syllables of vicious intent, the priestess causes the bare flesh of her sisters to shimmer with serpentine scales the hue of iron that turn the blades of their foes.

prayers.name: Exultation of Murder
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks. In addition, if the chanting roll was 9+, until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.
prayers.lore: Shrieking to the skies, the priestess draws upon a divine bloodlust that drives her sisters into a murderous rapture.

prayers.name: Shadowstep
prayers.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of them and that has not been picked to be the target of this prayer this turn to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: The target can move up to 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat. If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.
prayers.lore: Imbibing the blood of a sacrificed leathanam, the priestess calls upon the shadows themselves to speed her flock to where they are needed most.

manifestations.name: Bladewind

abilities.name: Unnatural Edge
abilities.description:
Declare: If this **MANIFESTATION** charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: If any damage points are allocated to the target this phase by this **MANIFESTATION’**s combat attacks, ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: The falchions carve through an enemy’s defences, and even powerful mystical enchantments are hewn asunder.

manifestations.lore: Carried through the air by a crimson tempest of blood, these gleaming falchions carve a bloody path through anything in their way, slicing clean through armour to get to the flesh and blood beneath.

summonSpell.name: Summon Bladewind
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Bladewind** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Bladewind** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: The caster calls upon their mastery of blood magic to conjure a twirling quartet of giant, blood-slick blades.

manifestations.name: Heart of Fury

abilities.name: Locus of the Murder God
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE INFANTRY** units while they are wholly within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION**.
abilities.lore: As the faithful look upon a Heart of Fury, they are imbued with Khaine’s undying rage, a wrath so all encompassing that not even pain can penetrate it.

manifestations.lore: A manifestation of Khaine’s Iron Heart, this blood-dripping icon burns with supernatural rage. Those bathed in its wrathful aura enter a delirious frenzy that sees them inured to pain.

summonSpell.name: Summon Heart of Fury
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Heart of Fury** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Heart of Fury** wholly within 18" of the chanter and visible to them.
summonSpell.lore: The skies turn crimson as this bleeding icon descends upon the battle.

manifestations.name: Bloodwrack Viper

abilities.name: Crushing Coils
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** in combat with this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The coils of the Bloodwrack Viper wrap around an enemy, pinning them in place.

abilities.name: Bind and Bite
abilities.description: Effect: This unit’s combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 4+ if the target of those attacks has **STRIKE-LAST**.
abilities.lore: As the Bloodwrack Viper constricts, the victim is completely at the mercy of its deadly bite.

manifestations.lore: The Bloodwrack Viper is an enormous serpent formed from boiling blood, a manifestation of hatred and bitterness that binds its prey in a crushing embrace before attacking with its monstrous fangs.

summonSpell.name: Summon Bloodwrack Viper
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Bloodwrack Viper** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Bloodwrack Viper** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: The caster weaves their outstretched hand in an elaborate pattern that mimics the structure of a monstrous snake drenched in blood.
