abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
abilities.description: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
abilities.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.

units.lore: The Lord-Vigilants are the commanders and wardens of the Ruination chambers, who sequester their soul-stricken warriors away until the hour of the direst need. Much like their kin, their sense of self has begun to decay, but grim means allow them to maintain enough lucidity to command their brethren in battle.

units.name: Praetors

abilities.name: Soul-bonded
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS HERO** to be this unit’s soul-bonded charge for the rest of the battle. This unit can use this ability while it is in reserve.
abilities.lore: Praetors are exemplary bodyguards, linked to their assigned wards at an arcane, spiritual level.

abilities.name: Soul-forged Guardians
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit’s soul-bonded charge is within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and that soul-bonded charge have **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Praetors will protect their soul-bonded charges with every ounce of their being.

units.lore: The Praetors are the bodyguards of the Stormcast Eternals’ commanders. Their souls are practically entwined with those of their designated ward, allowing them to absorb their master’s wounds into their own flesh through mere physical contact, selflessly enduring while their lord fights on.

units.name: Stormcoven

abilities.name: Gather the Aether
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to this unit’s power level while it is contesting an objective.
abilities.lore: A Stormcoven can harness the aetheric energies from the ley lines that criss-cross the Mortal Realms, ready to be unleashed at a moment’s notice.

abilities.name: Aethershock
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible unit within 12" of the caster to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the target is a friendly unit, it has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn. If the target is an enemy unit, it has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Stormcoven unleash their stored energies across the battlefield, bolstering their allies or blasting enemies to the ground.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: Stormcovens are elite strike teams of arcane specialists who often find themselves operating as part of a larger Stormcast army. Each of a Stormcoven’s Knight-Arcanums has mastered a particular school of celestial sorcery, and when they combine their talents, the effects are truly devastating.

units.name: Lord-Veritant

abilities.name: Ruination Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
abilities.description: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
abilities.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.

abilities.name: Staff of Abjuration
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.
abilities.lore: The blessed light that shines from this staff can banish even the most potent sorceries.

abilities.name: Sense Unholy Sorcery
abilities.description:
Effect: This unit’s **Gryph-crow** is a token. Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for enemy units within 12" of this unit while its **Gryph-crow** is on the battlefield.

If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove its **Gryph-crow** from the battlefield after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).
abilities.lore: Gryph‑crows are sensitive to corruption and immediately alert their masters whenever unholy energies are nearby.

units.lore: The Lord-Veritants are chosen from those whose hatred of Chaos eclipses all else. They have the uncanny ability to detect the merest sliver of corruption: a skill that has seen many reassigned to the Ruination chambers, where their assistance in monitoring warriors after exposure to the most hellish environment has proved invaluable.

units.name: Knight-Questor

abilities.name: His Will Be Done
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit is contesting a questmarked objective:

• Add 3 to this unit’s control score.
• This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Questors will stop at nothing to fulfil the sacred task given to them by the God-King himself.

abilities.name: Ordained Quest
abilities.description: Effect: Pick an objective wholly outside friendly territory. That objective is considered by you to be questmarked.
abilities.lore: Questors travel deep into enemy territory to gain control of vital landmarks with hidden secrets.

abilities.name: Heroic Retribution
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **Questor Soulsworn** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Should the need arise, the Knight-Questor will call upon their Soulsworn brethren to make the God-King’s justice a reality.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Stormcast Exemplar*.

units.lore: Standing apart from their fellow officers, the Knight-Questors are unburdened by the pressures of command; rather, these errant heroes possess more singular burdens. Each has been chosen by the God-King for a mission of the utmost import, and they will go to any lengths to see it done.

units.name: Reclusians

abilities.name: Ruination Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
abilities.description: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
abilities.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.

abilities.name: Memorian Descendants
abilities.description:
Effect: This unit’s **Memorians** are tokens. There are 2 **Memorians** for every 3 models in this unit. While any of this unit’s **Memorians** are on the battlefield, add 1 to this unit’s resistance rolls when using the ‘Ruination Chamber’ ability.

Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove 1 of its **Memorians** from the battlefield after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).
abilities.lore: Reclusians are accompanied by Memorians who serve to remind them of their humanity.

units.lore: The Reclusians are warriors of the Ruination chambers, their identities eroded by countless Reforgings over centuries in service to God-King. Though they are close to becoming more engine of war than human, their lightning-scoured souls are particularly resistant to Chaos as a result, allowing them to tread where no other servant of Sigmar could hope to survive.

units.name: Iridan the Witness

abilities.name: Prayer of the Witness
abilities.description:
Declare: Make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, each time a friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** unit uses a **FIGHT** ability while it is wholly within 18" of this unit, after that ability has been resolved:

• **Heal (D3)** that unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, **Heal (3)** that unit instead.
• That unit has **WARD (6+)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Iridan serves as a beacon of light that guides the souls of those in the Ruination chambers, giving their actions purpose and calming the storm that churns within each of them.

abilities.name: Ruination Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-Core ability
abilities.description: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
abilities.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.

abilities.name: Dark Flight
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic:

• 1 model in the target unit is slain.
• This unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability without any mortal damage being inflicted upon it.
abilities.lore: A hapless foe is crushed in the talons of Ariax before the Morrgryph takes flight once more with a beat of their ebon wings.

units.lore: Iridan the Witness is determined to preserve the memory of the Ruination chambers’ warriors as they once were, before the nightmare of the flaw and the slow degradation of their souls. Through the power of remembrance and the shattering power of their martial might, the Witness will fight for those who have sacrificed everything in the name of the God-King. Accompanying them on this sombre journey is the mighty Morrgryph Ariax, a deadly beast who bears the favour of the Bleak Raven.

units.name: Annihilators

abilities.name: Blazing Impact
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit was set up this turn using the ‘Scions of the Storm’ ability, pick up to 3 enemy units within 10" of it to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Annihilators arrive upon the field with devastating force, twin tailed trails streaking behind them as an earth-shattering shock-wave blasts apart the foes of Sigmar.

abilities.name: Brace for Impact
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit. If any of the rolls are a 6, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Annihilators brace behind their mighty shields to hold off even the most ferocious charge.

units.lore: Wielding hammers and shields hewn from enchanted meteoric rock, Annihilators are sometimes held to be unkillable. They do not descend from the heavens but emerge horizontally through rifts of crackling lightning, and their brutal momentum is a weapon in itself.

units.name: Stormstrike Chariot

abilities.name: Azyr Unleashed
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: The impact of a Stormstrike Chariot on the charge can obliterate even the most durable of shieldwalls.

abilities.name: Celestial Blaze
abilities.description: Effect: When this unit uses the ‘Power Through’ command, inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on the target and add D6" to the distance this unit can move as part of that ability.
abilities.lore: The Stormstrike Chariot smashes through lesser foes in a blaze of celestial power.

units.lore: Swift war-carriages of the Angelos conclaves, Stormstrike Chariots are potent linebreakers. As they build up speed, they draw the energies of Azyr to themselves before unleashing them in thunderous blasts amidst the enemy ranks.

units.name: Vindictors

abilities.name: Hold the Shieldwall
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit did not charge this turn and is in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 4+, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Vindictor retinues form the unyielding shieldwalls upon which the forces of ruin shatter.

units.lore: Vindictors were amongst the first Stormcasts to be equipped with thunderstrike armour, their wargear designed by Grungni to defend against even the most aggressive enemy assaults. They are the shieldwall upon which the forces of ruin shatter. Forged from the most unrelenting souls, Vindictors will endure come what may and spit defiance until the last.

units.name: Liberators

abilities.name: Stalwart Defenders
abilities.description: Effect: Add 3 to this unit’s control score while it is contesting an objective wholly within friendly territory.
abilities.lore: Liberators fiercely guard the lands brought into Sigmar’s domain.

units.lore: The Liberators are the backbone of the God-King’s battlelines, trained to both enact sudden assaults and form unbreakable shieldwalls. To them falls the duty of casting down the warlords of ruin and stamping Sigmar’s claim upon the lands once more.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Iridan the Witness

abilities.name: Demands of the Witness
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of each target’s melee weapons.
abilities.lore: Iridan understands better than any that the most assured way to avoid the incremental erosion of the flaw in the Reforging process is to avoid being cut down, and so they exhort their charges to vanquish their foes quickly, mercilessly and without hesitation.

abilities.name: The Flames of Hope
abilities.description: Effect: You can re-roll resistance rolls for friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The billowing flames borne by Iridan are instantly recognisable by all of Sigmar’s greatest warriors, even those who have lost nearly every part of themselves in his name.

abilities.name: On Wings of Death
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: If the target charged this turn, apply the effects below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effects below:

• You can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Ariax swoops over the heads of the foe, robbing them of their will to fight.

abilities.name: Guardian of the Final Threshold
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked to be the target of a non-**CORE** ability
abilities.description: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 3+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
abilities.lore: Iridan does battle where others cannot tread, fighting in lands transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on this shepherd of lost souls, their faith granting them near immunity to such impurities.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Able to endure the horrors of the Gnaw for far longer than their brethren, Iridan the Witness leads the Stormcasts of the Ruination chambers into battle with the resurgent Skaven in the easternmost Great Parch. Champion of the death god Morrda, they ride atop the Morrgryph Ariax and seek to reawaken their companions’ memories of past glories.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Stormstrike Palladors

abilities.name: Lightning Quick
abilities.description: Effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.
abilities.lore: One of the swiftest and most agile mounts in the realms, Gryph-chargers deftly speed their riders away from danger.

abilities.name: Shock Cavalry
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with both of the following units to be the target:
• This unit.
• A friendly unit that did not charge this turn.

Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Stormstrike Palladors are masters at performing devastating charges into the unguarded flanks of enemies already engaged in combat.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: The hard-hitting cavalry of the Warrior chambers, Stormstrike Palladors are outfitted not solely to administer a devastating charge but also to engage in extended periods of melee fighting in which their heavy blades and the talons of their Gryph-chargers prove most effective killing tools.

battleTraits.name: Swift Tide
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you used the ‘Concealing Tide’ ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round, friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units can use Run abilities and still use Shoot and/or Charge abilities later in the turn.
battleTraits.lore: The sheer rapidity of the sea’s advance sees the Idoneth outpace their foes.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Idoneth Deepkin armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Sea's Embrace
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you used the ‘Swift Tide’ ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round.

Effect: Friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units have **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
battleTraits.lore: Those engulfed by the vast ocean can do nothing but await their fate.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Idoneth Deepkin armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Concealing Tide
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you did not use it in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units that did not use any **CHARGE** abilities in the same turn.
battleTraits.lore: Freezing and impenetrable mists descend across the battlefield.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Idoneth Deepkin armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Storm's Wrath
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you used the ‘Inexorable Tide’ ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round.

Effect: Friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units’ melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** for the rest of the turn.
battleTraits.lore: Woe to those caught in the path of the storm’s destructive fury.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Idoneth Deepkin armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Inexorable Tide
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you used the ‘Unpredictable Tide’ ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round.

Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units for the rest of the battle round.
battleTraits.lore: When the tide sweeps in, no force of nature or magic can keep it at bay.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Idoneth Deepkin armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Unpredictable Tide
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you did not use it in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round. Pick a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit that is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
battleTraits.lore: Only the Deepkin can anticipate the mercurial currents of the ocean.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Idoneth Deepkin armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Twin Tides
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared an **ATTACK** ability for a friendly **AKHELIAN** unit
battleTraits.description:
Used By: The friendly **AKHELIAN** unit using that **ATTACK** ability.

Effect: Pick a visible friendly **NAMARTI** unit that has not used an **ATTACK** ability this phase to be the target.

•  If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability, immediately after the **SHOOT** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use a **SHOOT** ability as if it were your shooting phase.

•  If this unit used a **FIGHT** ability, immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability. If the target does so, for the rest of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its weapons but all of its attacks must target enemy units that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit’s attacks.
battleTraits.lore: Though the Idoneth’s military structure is uncompromisingly rigid, their fluidity in battle is astounding. The Akhelians lead; the Namarti follow. Such discipline, alloyed to aelven speed and grace, has spelled the doom of numberless foes.

ability.name: Surge Forward
ability.description: Effect: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **NAMARTI** units while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **AKHELIAN** unit.
ability.lore: The Namarti are the lowest caste in Idoneth society, but when formed into a Namarti Corps and led to battle by their Akhelian masters, they strike swiftly and with devastating effect.

abilities.name: Surge Forward
abilities.description: Effect: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **NAMARTI** units while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **AKHELIAN** unit.
abilities.lore: The Namarti are the lowest caste in Idoneth society, but when formed into a Namarti Corps and led to battle by their Akhelian masters, they strike swiftly and with devastating effect.

ability.name: Fade Like Mist
ability.description: Effect: When using the ‘Unpredictable Tide’ ability, you can pick up to 2 eligible targets instead of 1.
ability.lore: The Soul-raid Ambushers are experts in hit-and-run tactics, riding the currents of the ethersea to strike the foe from new directions.

abilities.name: Fade Like Mist
abilities.description: Effect: When using the ‘Unpredictable Tide’ ability, you can pick up to 2 eligible targets instead of 1.
abilities.lore: The Soul-raid Ambushers are experts in hit-and-run tactics, riding the currents of the ethersea to strike the foe from new directions.

ability.name: Ferocious Predators
ability.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made with **Companion** weapons by friendly **AKHELIAN** units.
ability.lore: With the aid of the Embailors, the Akhelian Beastmasters are able to turn oceanic carnivores into truly terrifying weapons of war.

abilities.name: Ferocious Predators
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made with **Companion** weapons by friendly **AKHELIAN** units.
abilities.lore: With the aid of the Embailors, the Akhelian Beastmasters are able to turn oceanic carnivores into truly terrifying weapons of war.

ability.name: Wisdom of the Deep
ability.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls, Isharann ritual rolls and lurelight rolls for friendly **ISHARANN** units while they are within the combat ranges of any other friendly **ISHARANN** units.
ability.lore: The Isharann are born with a talent for harnessing arcane forces. This power is only amplified when these aelves convene an Isharann Council and head to war.

abilities.name: Wisdom of the Deep
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls, Isharann ritual rolls and lurelight rolls for friendly **ISHARANN** units while they are within the combat ranges of any other friendly **ISHARANN** units.
abilities.lore: The Isharann are born with a talent for harnessing arcane forces. This power is only amplified when these aelves convene an Isharann Council and head to war.

heroicTraits.name: Form of the Fangmora
heroicTraits.description: Effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-3, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
heroicTraits.lore: This champion has mastered a defensive sword-art that mimics the fluid movements of the swift Fangmora Eels.

heroicTraits.name: Hunter of Souls
heroicTraits.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following weapon abilities for this unit’s melee weapons to have this battle:
•  **Anti-CAVALRY (+1 Rend)**
•  **Anti-INFANTRY (+1 Rend)**
•  **Anti-MONSTER (+1 Rend)**
heroicTraits.lore: This hero seeks neither glory nor territory; their only interest is the capture of potent soul-stuff.

heroicTraits.name: Nightmare Legacy
heroicTraits.description: Effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.
heroicTraits.lore: The repressed horror of the Idoneth’s long incarceration emanates from this dark-visaged warrior in palpable waves of doom.

artefacts.name: Lifekelp Pod
artefacts.description: Effect: **Heal (D3)** each friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN CAVALRY** unit within this unit’s combat range.
artefacts.lore: Radiant with Ghyranite energy, this golden seed pod bursts in a spray of vital power.

artefacts.name: Dritchleech
artefacts.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy **WIZARDS** while they are within 18" of this unit. In addition, each time an enemy spell fails, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal (1)** this unit.
artefacts.lore: Incredibly rare, these worms feed upon magic and are capable of draining arcane energies.

artefacts.name: Armour of the Cythai
artefacts.description: Effect: If this unit has not charged this turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
artefacts.lore: This gleaming panoply was given by Teclis to the ancestors of the Idoneth. Upon the command of its bearer, it can radiate the power of Hysh – a fitting property for a gift from the Great Illuminator.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Ironshell Barnacles
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Effect: • If this unit is **INFANTRY**, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target it.

• If this unit is **CAVALRY**, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target it.

• If this unit is a **MONSTER**, ignore negative modifiers to run rolls and charge rolls for it.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: Attaching themselves to hides and armour, the extra durability granted by these crustaceans is welcomed.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText:
Ethersea Companions are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO IDONETH DEEPKIN** units.
A unit can only have 1 Ethersea Companion.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Stonefoot Anemone
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use **MOVE** abilities for the rest of the turn.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: The toxins in this creature’s sting render foes briefly immobile.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText:
Ethersea Companions are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO IDONETH DEEPKIN** units.
A unit can only have 1 Ethersea Companion.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Aqshian Sea Nettles
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.

Effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, for the rest of the turn:
• Other enemy units cannot use **FIGHT** abilities if the target is eligible to be picked.
• If possible, this unit must be picked to be the target of pile-in moves made by the target.
• All attacks made by models in the target unit within this unit’s combat range must target this unit.

**Designer’s Note**: *This ability does not override the* **STRIKE-FIRST** *or* **STRIKE-LAST** *constraints.*
aqshyEnhancements.lore: Floating around their owners, these jellyfish instinctively lash out at nearby foes, causing panic and confusion.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText:
Ethersea Companions are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO IDONETH DEEPKIN** units.
A unit can only have 1 Ethersea Companion.

spells.name: Pressure of the Deep
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
spells.lore: The wizard enfolds their victims in a shimmering bubble of crushing force.

spells.name: Steed of Tides
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit wholly within 12" of them and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
spells.lore: The wizard conjures an agile elemental to transport comrades through the ethersea.

spells.name: Counter-Current
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, halve run rolls and charge rolls for the target.
spells.lore: The wizard summons a powerful current to hold their enemies at bay.

manifestations.name: Incarnate of the Deep

abilities.name: Wild Form
abilities.description: Effect: Each time this **MANIFESTATION** is targeted by the ‘Banish Manifestation’ ability, if it would be banished, it is not banished. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
abilities.lore: This manifestation is notoriously wilful, resisting any effort by sorcerers to tame or banish it.

abilities.name: Grasping Tendrils
abilities.description:
Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if it is your turn. On a 4+:

•  You can remove 1 friendly **ABYSSAL TENDRIL** from the battlefield.
•  If there are fewer than 2 friendly **Abyssal Tendrils** on the battlefield, you can set up an **ABYSSAL TENDRIL** wholly within 9" of this **MANIFESTATION**.
abilities.lore: The Incarnate reaches out across the ethersea to conjure tendrils of freezing, coiling water.

abilities.name: Surrender to the Sea
abilities.description: Effect: When this **MANIFESTATION** is removed from play, each friendly **ABYSSAL TENDRIL** on the battlefield is automatically removed from play.
abilities.lore: If the Incarnate is driven back from the enemy, its tendrils slink back into the ethersea too.

manifestations.lore: Conjured through elemental ritual and empowered by the spirits of the ocean, an Incarnate of the Deep is a ship-breaking tempest given physical form. Reaching out with serpent-like appendages, it seizes its prey and draws them inexorably in, drowning them within its turbulent mass.

summonSpell.name: Summon Incarnate of the Deep
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Incarnate of the Deep** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an **Incarnate of the Deep** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: The spellcaster awakens a terrifying manifestation of the ocean’s wrath.

terrain.name: Gloomtide Shipwreck

abilities.name: Phantasmal Ruin
abilities.description:
Effect: Models can pass through this terrain feature but cannot be set up on or end moves on any part of this terrain feature.

Each time an enemy unit ends a move that passed through or across this terrain feature, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Gloomtide Shipwrecks are apparitions of sunken vessels filled with ethereal creatures that strike out at those who stray too close.

abilities.name: Rise From The Depths
abilities.description:
Declare: This ability must be used instead of the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability.

Effect: Set up this faction terrain either as 1 terrain feature consisting of 2 scenery pieces (that must be set up within 3" of each other) or as 2 separate terrain features. Set up each terrain feature wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

If this faction terrain is set up as 1 terrain feature consisting of 2 scenery pieces, it has a Health characteristic of 14 instead of 7.
abilities.lore: Ancient wreckages adrift in the great currents of the ethersea provide a haven for Idoneth.

abilities.name: Guardians of the Deep
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN INFANTRY** and **CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 6" of this terrain feature.
abilities.lore: Shoals of small sea creatures infest this wreck, instinctively swarming out to shield Idoneth Deepkin that are nearby.

terrain.lore: A Gloomtide Shipwreck is a supernatural manifestation in the ethersea, a barnacle-encrusted ruin swarming with vicious deep-sea creatures that provides nearby Idoneth with cover from which to launch their attacks.

units.name: Akhelian King

weapons.name: Deepmare’s Fangs, Talons and Lashing Tails

abilities.name: Crest of the Wave
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by other friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units for attacks that target enemy units in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: Riding the momentum of the ethersea, the Akhelian King leads a glorious charge to shatter the enemy ranks.

abilities.name: Wave Rider
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Akhelian Royal Weapons** for attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: When an Akhelian King charges the foe, they hit with the power of a crashing wave.

units.lore: Akhelian Kings are the war leaders of the Idoneth enclaves. Mounted atop fierce and intelligent Deepmares, these inspiring commanders fight at the forefront of every battle, urging their Phalanxes forward as they wield their blades with deadly skill.

units.name: Lotann, Warden of the Soul Ledgers

abilities.name: Empowered By Memory
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Lotann draws on the accumulated memories of his people to grant his allies supernatural strength and resolve.

abilities.name: Catalogue of Souls
abilities.description: Effect: Each time an enemy unit is destroyed, give this unit a **soul‑quota token**.
abilities.lore: The Soul Wardens keep records of the souls that are harvested by the phalanxes.

abilities.name: Fount of Willpower
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a friendly **ISHARANN** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Remove 1 of this unit’s **soul-quota tokens**. Then, you can re‑roll the casting roll.
abilities.lore: Such is Lotann’s obsessive commitment to his duty that his willpower bleeds out into the ethersea, a potent magical force that can be drawn upon to empower his fellow Isharann.

units.lore: Lotann is the Warden of the Soul Ledgers, whose task it is to oversee the reaping of spirit-essences across the enclaves. A skilled arcanist in his own right, Lotann channels the gestalt memories of the Idoneth to empower his kin.

units.name: Akhelian Ishlaen Guard

abilities.name: Galv-shields
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)** if it charged in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Thanks to their protective aura, the Ishlaen have greater staying power in prolonged combat than their spear-armed kin.

abilities.name: Biovoltaic Barrier
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target unit’s weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The biovoltaic energy produced by Fangmora Eels is channelled by Ishlaen Guard into a crackling luminescent energy field that protects them from harm.

units.lore: Ishlaen Guard channel the bioelectricity of Fangmora mounts into their galv-shields, manifesting this energy as a sparking field that turns aside enemy blows. Thanks to this protective aura, the Ishlaen are often assigned as the bodyguards of Akhelian Kings or other high-ranking Idoneth, seeking the closest threats and laying them low with sweeps of their helsabres.

units.name: Akhelian Morrsarr Guard

abilities.name: Biovoltaic Blast
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in this unit. Add 1 to each roll if there are more models in the target unit than this unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: The biovoltaic energy produced by Fangmora Eels is stored by Morrsarr Guard, ready to be discharged as a bolt of energy when the time is right.

units.lore: Armed with voltspears and galv-shields, the Morrsarr Guard function as heavy shock cavalry, their fearsome weapons channelling the powerful electrical energy given off by the Fangmoras. This shockwave is loosed moments before the Morrsarr crash into the enemy, blasting the front ranks even as the Akhelians’ spears strike home.

units.name: Akhelian Thrallmaster

abilities.name: Akhelian Insights
abilities.description: Effect: Melee weapons used by friendly **NAMARTI** units have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Thrallmasters are cunning and sea-scarred Akhelians who lead the Namarti hosts into battle. Master duellists skilled with all manner of exotic weaponry, they scythe through their foes with contemptuous ease.

abilities.name: Thrallmaster
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **NAMARTI THRALLS** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Thrallmasters are cunning and sea-scarred Akhelians who lead the Namarti hosts into battle.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Akhelian Raidmaster*.

units.lore: Thrallmasters are cunning and sea-scarred Akhelians who lead the Namarti hosts into battle. Master duellists skilled with all manner of exotic weaponry, they scythe through their foes with contemptuous ease.

units.name: Namarti Thralls

abilities.name: Sweeping Blows
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: If any damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that **FIGHT** ability are allocated to any enemy units, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by those enemy units for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A Namarti Thrall’s aggressive swiping strikes are intended to knock their enemies off their feet.

units.lore: The core infantry of the Idoneth Deepkin, Namarti Thralls advance into battle brandishing vast two-handed weapons known as lanmari. Despite their blindness and the heft of their blades, they whirl and chop with aelven grace.

units.name: Akhelian Leviadon

weapons.name: Leviadon’s Scythed Fins and Crushing Jaws

abilities.name: Crushing Charge
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target unit has more than 10 models. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: When a Leviadon charges into battle, it crushes the foe with its sheer mass.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Leviadon’s Scythed Fins and Crushing Jaws** is 5.

abilities.name: Void Drum
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units have **WARD (5+)** while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.
abilities.lore: A void drummer rides on the back of every Akhelian Leviadon. The mesmerising rhythm that they beat out sends rippling currents through the air, distorting the outlines of the drummer’s comrades and making them hard to see.

units.lore: A monstrous undersea titan, the Leviadon is covered in thick scales and protected by an impenetrable shell. In addition to its powerful jaws and bladed fins, it carries a hard-bitten crew and twin harpoon launchers, making it a veritable living fortress.

units.name: Eidolon of Mathlann, Aspect of the Sea

abilities.name: Dormant Energies
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
abilities.lore: The Isharann aspect of an Eidolon of Mathlann seethes with suppressed energies that it can draw upon at need.

abilities.name: Tranquillity of the Abyss
abilities.description: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to the control scores of friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: An Eidolon in its aspect of the sea radiates an aura of unnatural tranquillity, calming any fears that nearby Idoneth may harbour.

abilities.name: Tsunami of Terror
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 different visible enemy units within 12" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for combat attacks that target those units until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: With a wave of its sceptre, the Eidolon sends forth invisible waves of fear that cause even the bravest of opponents to cower.

abilities.name: Vengeful Waves
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has not charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: When threatened, the Eidolon causes the ethersea to crash around it, overwhelming its enemies.

units.lore: An Eidolon of Mathlann is a mystical conjuration that embodies a long-forgotten god. When summoned in its aspect of the sea, this entity can call upon the magic of the ocean to bolster allies or send enemies fleeing in terror.

units.name: Isharann Soulrender

abilities.name: Lurelight
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 different friendly **NAMARTI** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.

Effect: Make a lurelight roll of D3 for each target unit. On a 2+, return a number of slain models to the target unit equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Isharann Soulrenders possess a mystical lure that is used to draw unto them the souls of slain opponents so that they can be captured. Should the Soulrender act quickly enough, the stolen essence can be repurposed to resurrect fallen Namarti mid-battle.

abilities.name: Hangman's Knot
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed.
abilities.lore: The noose on a talúnhook can be used to ensnare a victim, ensuring they cannot escape their doom at the hands of the Soulrender.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Isharann Emissary*.

units.lore: Unlike the rest of their Isharann kin, Soulrenders fight face to face with their foes, reaping spirit-matter with every swing of their scythe-like talúnhooks. In battle, they can channel their mystical powers to revive fallen Namarti.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Namarti Thralls

abilities.name: Hit-and-Run Tactics
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is in combat or charged this turn, this unit can make a pile-in move. Then, if this unit is in combat, you must pick 1 or more enemy units to be the target(s) of this unit’s attacks.

Effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s). Then, if this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move. It does not have to end the move in combat.
abilities.lore: The Namarti Thralls strike at their foes before using the ethersea to fall back to a safer position.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: Namarti Thralls have proved as skilled in waging strike-and-fade war amidst the jungles of Ghyran as they are in the kelp forests of their undersea home. Enhanced by the ethersea, their extrasensory powers allow them to isolate their prey, lashing out with their lanmari blades before retreating into the shadows under the cover of briny mists.

units.name: Isharann Tidecaster

abilities.name: Master of the Ethersea
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Make an Isharann ritual roll of D6.

Effect: On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:

***Creeping Mist:*** Friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 12" of them.

***Surging Stream:*** Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units.

***Spiteful Riptide:*** Each time an enemy unit uses a **RETREAT** ability, after the effect of that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit.
abilities.lore: A Tidecaster can manipulate the ethersea like no other.

units.lore: Isharann Tidecasters are the Idoneth’s most potent frontline wizards, capable of directing the surging currents of the ethersea in order to alter the momentum of battle or to steal the very breath from their foes.

units.name: Ikon of the Storm

abilities.name: Whirlpool's Fury
abilities.description:
Effect: Enemy units cannot use **RETREAT** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

Friendly units that use a **RETREAT** ability while they are wholly within 12" of this unit can still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units by **RETREAT** abilities while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: An Ikon of the Storm is a vortex of rage, overwhelming enemies and inspiring their kin to fight ever harder.

abilities.name: Storm of Blades
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Channelling the frothing violence of a maelstrom, the Ikon of the Storm lashes out again and again.

details.notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as an *Akhelian Raidmaster*.

units.lore: Ikons of the Storm aim to embody the destructive force of a raging ocean. Wielding twin blades, they hurl themselves into battle, heedless of any personal danger as they carve their enemies apart. Foes are helpless in the face of the Ikon’s whirling maelstrom of steel, and those with a mind to flee are cut down before they can take a single step.

units.name: Isharann Soulscryer

abilities.name: Finder of Ways
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Unpredictable Tide’ ability or the ‘Steed of Tides’ ability
abilities.description: Effect: Instead of setting up the targets as described in the ability used, set them up on the battlefield wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 7" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Soulscryers are the Idoneth’s navigators, helping them divine hidden paths through the realmseas.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Isharann Emissary*.

units.lore: Soulscryers work their strange magics to navigate the utter darkness of the deep places. Their eldritch senses allow them to guide other Idoneth along hidden paths in the realms’ oceans and rivers, so that they can strike the foe from unexpected angles.

units.name: Mathaela, Oracle of the Abyss

abilities.name: Crushing Pressure
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic, to a maximum of 10. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Mathaela subjects their foes to the devastating pressure of the deepest trenches, causing bones to shatter and metal to crumple like paper.

abilities.name: Siren Song of the Abyss
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ **Companion** weapons.
abilities.lore: More attuned to the heartbeat of the ocean than any Isharann, Mathaela can stir the seas to thrashing life with but a gesture.

units.lore: Mysterious and terrifying, the Oracle of the Abyss only rises from their lightless domain when the existence of the Deepkin is threatened. Wielding the crushing magic of the deepest ocean planes, Mathaela annihilates the Idoneth’s foes and stirs the very realmseas into violent motion.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Isharann Tidecaster

abilities.name: Master of the Ethersea
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: If the target is **NAMARTI**, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn. Otherwise, make an Isharann ritual roll of D6. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn.

***Torrent of Blows***: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. That weapon has **Crit (2 Hits)**.

***Protection of the Waves***: While this unit is within 3" of and visible to the target, both units have **WARD (5+)**.

***Frenzy of the Ethersea***: For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets that friendly unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: The Tidecaster channels and manipulates the deep-sea magic of the ethersea in order to empower and defend their kin.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: True masters of the ethersea, Isharann Tidecasters can manipulate this eldritch ocean to protect their allies and destroy their foes. They bring the Searing Sea to the Charrwind Coast, ensuring it is they who control the ebb and flow of battle.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Namarti Reavers

abilities.name: Merciless Hunters
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for this unit
abilities.description:
Effect: After that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, if all of this unit’s attacks targeted the same enemy unit and any models in that unit were slain, pick 1 of the effects below to apply for the rest of the turn. If all of this unit’s attacks targeted the same enemy unit and no models in that unit were slain, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the effects below to apply for the rest of the turn:

• Subtract 1 from ward rolls for the target.
• Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.
abilities.lore: Namarti Reavers can fire arrows with such accuracy as to impair any defence, no matter how strong.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Fast‐moving scouts and archers, the eyeless Namarti Reavers are as uncannily accurate with their whisperbows upon the scorched earth of the Great Parch as they are beneath the waves.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Akhelian Thrallmaster

abilities.name: Raider Captain
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 3 friendly **Namarti Thralls** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
abilities.lore: Thrallmasters are often among the first of the Idoneth’s forces to arrive on the battlefield, leading Namarti scouting parties to establish forward positions from which they can launch their raid.

abilities.name: Way of the Vortex
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit and friendly **NAMARTI** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The riptide’s undertow pulls allies from harm, a hidden bulwark against the enemy’s raging storm. Within its grasp, Namarti endure, shielded by the Akhelian’s unwavering stance.

details.notes:
This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Akhelian Raidmaster*.
This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: Many ruthless Akhelian Thrallmasters ply the coasts of the Everspring Swathe, seeking out the rich accumulations of souls that can be found there. Masters of guerrilla warfare, these swordmasters and their Namarti warriors use the environment to protect them against enemy attacks as they advance, before charging in to deliver a killing strike.

units.name: Ikon of the Sea

abilities.name: Rapid Approach
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use a **RUN** ability and still use **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.
abilities.lore: Moving with liquid speed and uncanny agility, the Ikon is on its foes before they have a chance to react.

abilities.name: The Surging Sea
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the targets, to a maximum of 3.
abilities.lore: The Ikon’s aura of calm yet fearsome power sweeps up nearby Idoneth, carrying them into battle like a racing current.

details.notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as an *Akhelian Raidmaster*.

units.lore: Channelling the unfathomable calm and foreboding immensity of the deepest waters, Ikons of the Sea surge into battle alongside their Idoneth kin, overwhelming the enemy with their unwavering focus and terrifying momentum. To witness such martial perfection is an inspiration to any Idoneth warrior.

units.name: Eidolon of Mathlann, Aspect of the Storm

weapons.name: Spear of Repressed Fury and Crulhook

abilities.name: Drench With Hate
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The mere presence of an Eidolon in its warrior aspect is enough to imbue nearby Idoneth with a fierce and bitter hate.

abilities.name: Crashing Upon The Foe
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT**  abilities.
abilities.lore: The Eidolon surges up into the sky before crashing down like a tidal wave, reforming to dive again and again until nothing is left of the enemy.

abilities.name: Pulled Into The Depths
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The viciously barbed crulhook can ensnare unfortunate foes.

units.lore: In its aspect of the storm an Eidolon of Mathlann is the vengeance of the Idoneth made manifest, a living tempest that surges upwards before crashing upon the foe with tidal‑wave force.

units.name: Volturnos, High King of the Deep

weapons.name: Uasall’s Fangs, Talons and Lashing Tails

abilities.name: First Among Akhelians
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by other friendly **AKHELIAN** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Volturnos is the greatest Akhelian King to have ever lived. His supreme skill and vast experience serve as an inspiration to all members of the Idoneth’s warrior caste.

abilities.name: Supreme Lord of Tides
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 other friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: At the High King’s command, his warriors will attack with unrelenting fury.

abilities.name: Cealith, the High King's Shield
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (3+)** against mortal damage inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities or abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**.

units.lore: Volturnos is the last of the Cythai, a warrior whose cunning and prowess are legendary. Riding to battle atop Uasall, Prince of Deepmares, the High King carves a path through the foe, inspiring the Idoneth to ever greater deeds.

units.lore: Allopexes are vicious predators of the deep, known for their voracious appetites. As Akhelian bond-beasts, they are more dangerous still, boasting scythed fins and deadly back-mounted harpoon launchers. Even the bravest fear these finned menaces.

abilities.lore: Namarti Reavers are experts at running out from cover to unleash a hail of deadly arrows.

units.lore: Armed with silent‑firing whisperbows, Namarti Reavers are the fast‑moving scouts and archers of the Idoneth Deepkin Phalanxes. Despite their eerie and disturbing lack of eyes, they are uncannily accurate, using senses other than sight to pinpoint their targets.

armiesOfRenown.name: The First Phalanx of Ionrach
armiesOfRenown.description: The Ionrach see themselves as the epitome of what it means to be Idoneth. They retain the noble demeanour of the lost Cythai, befitting their self-proclaimed status as the right and true inheritors of that glorious legacy. Warriors of other enclaves are often angered by this arrogance, yet even the wilful renegades of Dhom-hain would not decry the Ionrach’s many achievements. They are supreme pioneers with an innate sense of their own destiny, and their colonies are wider spread and more prosperous than any of their fellow enclaves.
armiesOfRenown.lore:
The Ionrach see themselves as the epitome of what it means to be Idoneth. They retain the noble demeanour of the lost Cythai, befitting their self-proclaimed status as the right and true inheritors of that glorious legacy. Warriors of other enclaves are often angered by this arrogance, yet even the wilful renegades of Dhom-hain would not decry the Ionrach’s many achievements. They are supreme pioneers with an innate sense of their own destiny, and their colonies are wider spread and more prosperous than any of their fellow enclaves.

The ultimate wish of every Ionrach is to see the Idoneth’s fractious undersea empire truly united behind the vision of High King Volturnos – the sole remaining Cythai who has chosen them to be the future of the Deepkin race.

When you pick the Idoneth Deepkin faction for your army, you can choose for it to be the First Phalanx of Ionrach Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Idoneth Deepkin faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options as described in Army of Renown: The First Phalanx of Ionrach. All units in your army gain the First Phalanx keyword.

armiesOfRenown.name: Wardens of the Chorrileum
armiesOfRenown.description: It is the task of the Isharann order known as the Soul Wardens to maintain the sacred chorrileums. These repositories contain the souls of long-dead Idoneth, including those of the legendary Cythai, and are of the utmost importance to Deepkin society. The soul-reefs are places of prayer and sanctuary that protect fallen Idoneth from the depredations of the Chaos Gods. They are also vital to the defence of the enclaves, for if an Idoneth city is threatened, its Isharann priests can call upon the souls of the Cythai to raise Eidolons of Mathlann and other spiritual wardens to protect it.
armiesOfRenown.lore:
It is the task of the Isharann order known as the Soul Wardens to maintain the sacred chorrileums. These repositories contain the souls of long-dead Idoneth, including those of the legendary Cythai, and are of the utmost importance to Deepkin society. The soul-reefs are places of prayer and sanctuary that protect fallen Idoneth from the depredations of the Chaos Gods. They are also vital to the defence of the enclaves, for if an Idoneth city is threatened, its Isharann priests can call upon the souls of the Cythai to raise Eidolons of Mathlann and other spiritual wardens to protect it.

So revered are the soul-reefs that a recent decree of Volturnos calling for the Soul Wardens to risk the souls of the Cythai was met with great resistance. Nevertheless, under the guidance of Mathaela, Oracle of the Abyss, the power of the chorrileums is now being siphoned off to enact rituals of awakening, giving form and fury to the terrifying Incarnates of the Deep.

When you pick the Idoneth Deepkin faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Wardens of the Chorrileum Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Idoneth Deepkin faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options as described in Army of Renown: Wardens of the Chorrileum. All units in your army gain the Chorrileum keyword.

spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **CHORRILEUM WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **CHORRILEUM** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the target is **NAMARTI**, you can return D6 slain models to it. Otherwise, **Heal (D3)** the target
spells.lore: The powerful energies of an Idoneth soul-reef can heal flesh and mend shattered bones.

manifestations.name: Incarnate of the Deep

abilities.name: Wild Form
abilities.description: Effect: Each time this **MANIFESTATION** is targeted by the ‘Banish Manifestation’ ability, if it would be banished, it is not banished. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
abilities.lore: This manifestation is notoriously wilful, resisting any effort by sorcerers to tame or banish it.

abilities.name: Grasping Tendrils
abilities.description:
Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if it is your turn. On a 4+:

•  You can remove 1 friendly **ABYSSAL TENDRIL** from the battlefield.
•  If there are fewer than 2 friendly **Abyssal Tendrils** on the battlefield, you can set up an **ABYSSAL TENDRIL** wholly within 9" of this **MANIFESTATION**.
abilities.lore: The Incarnate reaches out across the ethersea to conjure tendrils of freezing, coiling water.

abilities.name: Surrender to the Sea
abilities.description: Effect: When this **MANIFESTATION** is removed from play, each friendly **ABYSSAL TENDRIL** on the battlefield is automatically removed from play.
abilities.lore: If the Incarnate is driven back from the enemy, its tendrils slink back into the ethersea too.

manifestations.lore: Conjured through elemental ritual and empowered by the spirits of the ocean, an Incarnate of the Deep is a ship-breaking tempest given physical form. Reaching out with serpent-like appendages, it seizes its prey and draws them inexorably in, drowning them within its turbulent mass.

summonSpell.name: Summon Incarnate of the Deep
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Incarnate of the Deep** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **CHORRILEUM WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an **Incarnate of the Deep** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: The spellcaster awakens a terrifying manifestation of the ocean’s wrath.

terrain.name: Gloomtide Shipwreck

abilities.name: Phantasmal Ruin
abilities.description:
Effect: Models can pass through this terrain feature but cannot be set up on or end moves on any part of this terrain feature.

Each time an enemy unit ends a move that passed through or across this terrain feature, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Gloomtide Shipwrecks are apparitions of sunken vessels filled with ethereal creatures that strike out at those who stray too close.

abilities.name: Rise From The Depths
abilities.description:
Declare: This ability must be used instead of the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability.

Effect: Set up this faction terrain either as 1 terrain feature consisting of 2 scenery pieces (that must be set up within 3" of each other) or as 2 separate terrain features. Set up each terrain feature wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

If this faction terrain is set up as 1 terrain feature consisting of 2 scenery pieces, it has a Health characteristic of 14 instead of 7.
abilities.lore: Ancient wreckages adrift in the great currents of the ethersea provide a haven for Idoneth.

abilities.name: Guardians of the Deep
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN INFANTRY** and **CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 6" of this terrain feature.
abilities.lore: Shoals of small sea creatures infest this wreck, instinctively swarming out to shield Idoneth Deepkin that are nearby.

terrain.lore: A Gloomtide Shipwreck is a supernatural manifestation in the ethersea, a barnacle-encrusted ruin swarming with vicious deep-sea creatures that provides nearby Idoneth with cover from which to launch their attacks.

units.name: Lotann, Warden of the Soul Ledgers

abilities.name: Empowered By Memory
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Lotann draws on the accumulated memories of his people to grant his allies supernatural strength and resolve.

abilities.name: Catalogue of Souls
abilities.description: Effect: Each time an enemy unit is destroyed, give this unit a **soul‑quota token**.
abilities.lore: The Soul Wardens keep records of the souls that are harvested by the phalanxes.

abilities.name: Fount of Willpower
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a friendly **ISHARANN** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Remove 1 of this unit’s **soul-quota tokens**. Then, you can re‑roll the casting roll.
abilities.lore: Such is Lotann’s obsessive commitment to his duty that his willpower bleeds out into the ethersea, a potent magical force that can be drawn upon to empower his fellow Isharann.

units.lore: Lotann is the Warden of the Soul Ledgers, whose task it is to oversee the reaping of spirit-essences across the enclaves. A skilled arcanist in his own right, Lotann channels the gestalt memories of the Idoneth to empower his kin.

units.name: Akhelian Thrallmaster

abilities.name: Akhelian Insights
abilities.description: Effect: Melee weapons used by friendly **NAMARTI** units have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Thrallmasters are cunning and sea-scarred Akhelians who lead the Namarti hosts into battle. Master duellists skilled with all manner of exotic weaponry, they scythe through their foes with contemptuous ease.

abilities.name: Thrallmaster
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **NAMARTI THRALLS** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Thrallmasters are cunning and sea-scarred Akhelians who lead the Namarti hosts into battle.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Akhelian Raidmaster*.

units.lore: Thrallmasters are cunning and sea-scarred Akhelians who lead the Namarti hosts into battle. Master duellists skilled with all manner of exotic weaponry, they scythe through their foes with contemptuous ease.

units.name: Namarti Thralls

abilities.name: Sweeping Blows
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: If any damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that **FIGHT** ability are allocated to any enemy units, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by those enemy units for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A Namarti Thrall’s aggressive swiping strikes are intended to knock their enemies off their feet.

units.lore: The core infantry of the Idoneth Deepkin, Namarti Thralls advance into battle brandishing vast two-handed weapons known as lanmari. Despite their blindness and the heft of their blades, they whirl and chop with aelven grace.

units.name: Eidolon of Mathlann, Aspect of the Sea

abilities.name: Dormant Energies
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
abilities.lore: The Isharann aspect of an Eidolon of Mathlann seethes with suppressed energies that it can draw upon at need.

abilities.name: Tranquillity of the Abyss
abilities.description: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to the control scores of friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: An Eidolon in its aspect of the sea radiates an aura of unnatural tranquillity, calming any fears that nearby Idoneth may harbour.

abilities.name: Tsunami of Terror
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 different visible enemy units within 12" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for combat attacks that target those units until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: With a wave of its sceptre, the Eidolon sends forth invisible waves of fear that cause even the bravest of opponents to cower.

abilities.name: Vengeful Waves
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has not charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: When threatened, the Eidolon causes the ethersea to crash around it, overwhelming its enemies.

units.lore: An Eidolon of Mathlann is a mystical conjuration that embodies a long-forgotten god. When summoned in its aspect of the sea, this entity can call upon the magic of the ocean to bolster allies or send enemies fleeing in terror.

units.name: Isharann Soulrender

abilities.name: Lurelight
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 different friendly **NAMARTI** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.

Effect: Make a lurelight roll of D3 for each target unit. On a 2+, return a number of slain models to the target unit equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Isharann Soulrenders possess a mystical lure that is used to draw unto them the souls of slain opponents so that they can be captured. Should the Soulrender act quickly enough, the stolen essence can be repurposed to resurrect fallen Namarti mid-battle.

abilities.name: Hangman's Knot
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed.
abilities.lore: The noose on a talúnhook can be used to ensnare a victim, ensuring they cannot escape their doom at the hands of the Soulrender.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Isharann Emissary*.

units.lore: Unlike the rest of their Isharann kin, Soulrenders fight face to face with their foes, reaping spirit-matter with every swing of their scythe-like talúnhooks. In battle, they can channel their mystical powers to revive fallen Namarti.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Namarti Thralls

abilities.name: Hit-and-Run Tactics
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is in combat or charged this turn, this unit can make a pile-in move. Then, if this unit is in combat, you must pick 1 or more enemy units to be the target(s) of this unit’s attacks.

Effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s). Then, if this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move. It does not have to end the move in combat.
abilities.lore: The Namarti Thralls strike at their foes before using the ethersea to fall back to a safer position.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: Namarti Thralls have proved as skilled in waging strike-and-fade war amidst the jungles of Ghyran as they are in the kelp forests of their undersea home. Enhanced by the ethersea, their extrasensory powers allow them to isolate their prey, lashing out with their lanmari blades before retreating into the shadows under the cover of briny mists.

units.name: Isharann Tidecaster

abilities.name: Master of the Ethersea
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Make an Isharann ritual roll of D6.

Effect: On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:

***Creeping Mist:*** Friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 12" of them.

***Surging Stream:*** Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units.

***Spiteful Riptide:*** Each time an enemy unit uses a **RETREAT** ability, after the effect of that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit.
abilities.lore: A Tidecaster can manipulate the ethersea like no other.

units.lore: Isharann Tidecasters are the Idoneth’s most potent frontline wizards, capable of directing the surging currents of the ethersea in order to alter the momentum of battle or to steal the very breath from their foes.

units.name: Ikon of the Storm

abilities.name: Whirlpool's Fury
abilities.description:
Effect: Enemy units cannot use **RETREAT** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

Friendly units that use a **RETREAT** ability while they are wholly within 12" of this unit can still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units by **RETREAT** abilities while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: An Ikon of the Storm is a vortex of rage, overwhelming enemies and inspiring their kin to fight ever harder.

abilities.name: Storm of Blades
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Channelling the frothing violence of a maelstrom, the Ikon of the Storm lashes out again and again.

details.notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as an *Akhelian Raidmaster*.

units.lore: Ikons of the Storm aim to embody the destructive force of a raging ocean. Wielding twin blades, they hurl themselves into battle, heedless of any personal danger as they carve their enemies apart. Foes are helpless in the face of the Ikon’s whirling maelstrom of steel, and those with a mind to flee are cut down before they can take a single step.

units.name: Isharann Soulscryer

abilities.name: Finder of Ways
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Unpredictable Tide’ ability or the ‘Steed of Tides’ ability
abilities.description: Effect: Instead of setting up the targets as described in the ability used, set them up on the battlefield wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 7" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Soulscryers are the Idoneth’s navigators, helping them divine hidden paths through the realmseas.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Isharann Emissary*.

units.lore: Soulscryers work their strange magics to navigate the utter darkness of the deep places. Their eldritch senses allow them to guide other Idoneth along hidden paths in the realms’ oceans and rivers, so that they can strike the foe from unexpected angles.

units.name: Mathaela, Oracle of the Abyss

abilities.name: Crushing Pressure
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic, to a maximum of 10. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
