Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Woe betide those who charge a Grundstok gunline.

abilities.name: Long-line Slings
abilities.description: Effect: When you use the ‘Transport Skyfarers’ ability for this unit, you can pick units in combat to be targets.
abilities.lore: Specialised harnesses allow Kharadron to rapidly deploy from fast-moving vessels.

abilities.name: Transport Capacity
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can transport 1 friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** unit with a model count of up to 5 (see Battle Traits).

abilities.name: Light Bomb Racks
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have **FLY** and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.

Effect: Roll 4 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: This skyvessel carries a variety of bombs that can be dropped onto the battlefield.

units.lore: Small, manoeuvrable and deadly, the Grundstok Gunhauler is an escortclass ship tasked with ensuring the safety of the airfleets’ larger skyvessels. They perform this role well, swarming in defence before peeling off to launch blistering attack runs.

units.name: Vongrim Salvagers

abilities.name: Spotter's Flaregun
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an objective within 9" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the following effects for the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **SKYFARER** units that target a unit that is contesting the target objective.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **Vongrim Salvagers** and **Vongrim Harpoon Crew** units for attacks that target a unit that is contesting the target objective.
abilities.lore: Firing this flaregun sends a message to all nearby Kharadron: this place is claimed and must be defended.

units.lore: Bonded by the shared trauma of lost ships and a sense of unity forged by hard times, Vongrim Salvagers go about their dangerous work with customary efficiency. With pistol, steel and cudgel, they cut down their foes and seize hold of profitable territory, refusing to give up their gains at any cost.

armiesOfRenown.name: Grundstok Expeditionary Force
armiesOfRenown.description: There is no more august body of the Kharadron military than the Grundcorps. These hardened mercenaries are contracted to the sky-fleets for missions of vital importance, and are often organised into Expeditionary Forces – vanguard companies designed to move swiftly and unleash devastating salvoes. Typically led by an Admiral, these potent formations focus the Grundcorps’ superior firepower on a specific target, utilising swift Gunhaulers to keep one step ahead.
armiesOfRenown.lore:
There is no more august body of the Kharadron military than the Grundcorps. These hardened mercenaries are contracted to the sky-fleets for missions of vital importance, and are often organised into Expeditionary Forces – vanguard companies designed to move swiftly and unleash devastating salvoes. Typically led by an Admiral, these potent formations focus the Grundcorps’ superior firepower on a specific target, utilising swift Gunhaulers to keep one step ahead.

When you pick the Kharadron Overlords faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Grundstok Expeditionary Force Army of Renown. If you do so, use these faction rules instead of the Kharadron Overlords faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options, as described in Army of Renown: Grundstok Expeditionary Force. All units in your army gain the Expeditionary Force keyword.
armiesOfRenown.source: Army of Renown: Grundstok Expeditionary Force

battleTraits.name: Gun Butt Low Blow
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description: Effect: While a friendly **EXPEDITIONARY FORCE INFANTRY** unit is contesting an objective that you control, its melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)**.
battleTraits.lore: Grizzled veterans all, the Grundcorps are used to fighting dirty if it means getting what they want.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Grundstok Expeditionary Force

battleTraits.name: Grudgefire Rounds
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Shooting Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **EXPEDITIONARY FORCE INFANTRY** unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the target’s ranged weapons. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the phase.
battleTraits.lore: This ammunition bursts into white-hot flames when it hits its target.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Grundstok Expeditionary Force

battleTraits.name: No Safe Haven
battleTraits.phase: End of Any Turn
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from the control score of that unit for each damage point allocated to it this turn by a shooting attack made by a friendly **EXPEDITIONARY FORCE** unit, to a maximum of 10 damage points.
battleTraits.lore: The firepower of the Grundcorps pelts the ground so aggressively that no cover can protect their targets for long.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Grundstok Expeditionary Force

battleTraits.name: Transport Skyfarers
battleTraits.phase: Reaction: You declared a non-CHARGE MOVE ability for a friendly SKYVESSEL
battleTraits.description:
Used By: The **SKYVESSEL** using that **MOVE** ability.

Effect: Pick a number of units up to that **SKYVESSEL**’s Transport Capacity (see its warscroll) that are wholly within 6" of it to be the targets. Units that have been transported this turn cannot be targets.

Remove the targets from the battlefield. After the **SKYVESSEL** ends its move, you must set up each target unit on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of that **SKYVESSEL** and not in combat. Those units have been transported. A unit cannot use **CHARGE** abilities if it was transported in the same turn.
battleTraits.lore: The Kharadron rule the skies of the realms with fleets of fearsome airships crewed by hardened duardin.
battleTraits.source: Army of Renown: Grundstok Expeditionary Force

heroicTraits.name: Entrenchment Expert
heroicTraits.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘All-out Defence’ command for a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this HERO
heroicTraits.description: Effect: That friendly unit has **WARD (5+)** for the rest of the turn.
heroicTraits.lore: This hero prefers to engage their foes from heavy cover, keeping their own losses to a minimum.
heroicTraits.source: Army of Renown: Grundstok Expeditionary Force

artefacts.name: Aetheric Nullifier
artefacts.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a SHOOT or FIGHT ability for a MANIFESTATION within 9" of the bearer
artefacts.description: Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on the **MANIFESTATION**’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play. You cannot pick the same **MANIFESTATION** to be the target of this ability more than once per phase.
artefacts.lore: This unassuming cylindrical tool is fashioned from a potent anti-magic alloy.
artefacts.source: Army of Renown: Grundstok Expeditionary Force
artefacts.groupName: Grundstok Expeditionary Force Artefact of Power

terrain.name: Zontari Endrin Dock

abilities.name: Endrinworks Outpost
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **AUTO-ENDRIN** or replacement **AUTO‑ENDRIN** that has been removed from the battlefield to be the target.

Effect: Make a manufacturing roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if there is a friendly **Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit** or **Endrinmaster with Endrinharness** within 3" of this terrain feature. On a 4+, set up a replacement **AUTO-ENDRIN** on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and more than 3" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The Endrin Dock continuously assembles new drones, a process that is expedited if a skilled endrineer is overseeing its operation.

abilities.name: Repair Routines
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** within 3" of this terrain feature to be the target.

Effect: Make a repair roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if there is a friendly **Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit** or **Endrinmaster with Endrinharness** within 3" of this terrain feature. On a 4+, **Heal (3)** the target.
abilities.lore: Auto-Endrins can be used to assist with combat repairs.

abilities.name: Release The Auto-Endrins
abilities.description: Effect: Set up a friendly **Nullifier Auto‑Endrin**, **Stuncloud Auto‑Endrin** and **Grudgeblast Auto‑Endrin** (see the Auto-Endrin warscroll) on the battlefield within friendly territory, wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Automated defence drones spill from the dock like wasps from a nest.

terrain.lore: A cutting-edge innovation from the finest endrineering minds in the sky-empire, the Zontari Endrin Dock is designed to allow the Kharadron to defend their most precious assets. It deploys aether-powered auto-endrins that seek out enemy formations before detonating or deploying anti-magic measures.

units.name: Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit

abilities.name: Combat Engineers
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly **Endrinriggers** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, combat attacks made by the targets against enemy units that charged this turn have **Crit (2 Hits)**.
abilities.lore: Endrinmasters are trained in combat and possess a natural flair for command – bad news for would-be attackers.

abilities.name: Mobile Repairs
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, **Heal (3)** the target.
abilities.lore: An Endrinmaster is well equipped to carry out emergency repairs in the midst of battle.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

units.lore: Many Endrinmasters take to the skies in master-crafted dirigible suits, their aetherturbines allowing them to zoom through the air towards skyvessels in need of repair even as an in-built weapon array blasts their enemies into pieces.

units.name: Aetheric Navigator

abilities.name: Aethersight
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.
abilities.lore: Aetheric Navigators can unpick enemy spells by harnessing the arcane jet streams.

abilities.name: Read the Winds
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **AUTO-ENDRIN** within this unit’s combat range and that is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, if the target is a **SKYVESSEL**, you can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the target and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Navigators can signal to nearby Kharadron airships, helping them to steer into prevailing currents.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

units.lore: Utilising cutting-edge aethermatic science in order to decipher the ever-changing wind patterns of the Mortal Realms, Aetheric Navigators are an invaluable presence upon any Kharadron skyvessel.

units.name: Arkanaut Admiral

abilities.name: Bring Every Gun to Bear!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** wholly within 24" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s ranged weapons.
abilities.lore: At the Admiral’s order, the skyvessel is steered into position to deliver a devastating salvo.

abilities.name: The Admiral's Flagship
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **FLAGSHIP** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the phase, each time the target uses a **SHOOT** ability, you can re-roll 1 of the hit rolls made for that ability.
abilities.lore: Every Admiral designates one of their vessels in the airfleet to be their flagship.

units.lore: Arkanaut Admirals are the cream of the sky-ports’ officer class, intrepid leaders and battle-hardened veterans of countless aerial engagements whose booming commands inspire their crews to mighty deeds in the search for profit.

units.name: Endrinmaster with Endrinharness

abilities.name: 'Aye Aye, Captain!'
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

•  The target can use a **RETREAT** or **RUN** ability and still use **SHOOT** abilities later in the turn.
•  No mortal damage is inflicted on the target by **RETREAT** abilities.
abilities.lore: Under orders of the ship’s Captain, the Endrinmaster attempts to squeeze every bit of power out of a vessel’s endrin.

abilities.name: Mobile Repairs
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, **Heal (3)** the target.
abilities.lore: An Endrinmaster is well equipped to carry out emergency repairs in the midst of battle.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

units.lore: Endrinmasters are peerless combat mechanics, well used to conducting emergency repairs in the white heat of battle. Many equip themselves with a strength-enhancing endrinharness that allows them to wield a fearsome aethermight hammer.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Codewright

abilities.name: Alright, Listen Up
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly non-**HERO KHARADRON OVERLORDS** unit, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target. Then, choose to spend either 3 or 6 **vexed points**.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply to the target for the rest of the turn:

• ***Do you see how fast they are going?!***: If you spent 3 **vexed points**, subtract D3 from the target’s Move characteristic. If you spent 6 **vexed points**, halve the target’s Move characteristic.
• ***Those weapons are against regulation!***: If you spent 3 **vexed points**, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks. If you spent 6 **vexed points**, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons and subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
abilities.lore: The Codewright’s fury at such blatant disregard for the precepts and carefully laid-out clauses of the Code is so infectious that nearby Kharadron unleash a barrage of hastily aimed ‘warning shots’, both to appease their surly charge and to force the enemy’s heads down.

abilities.name: I'm Watching You
abilities.description: Effect: Give this unit D3 **vexed points**.
abilities.lore: Squinting and scowling, the Codewright watches with hawkish scrutiny for any breaches of the Code.

details.notes:
This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.
This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: The Kharadron’s profitable wars in the Everspring Swathe have led to a great demand for Codewrights, experts skilled in debating the finer points of the Kharadron Code. Their utter dedication to the rule of law is so intense that a bellowed quote from the Code can cause enemies to falter in confusion and sudden panic, rendering them easy targets.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Grundstok Gunhauler

abilities.name: Fighter Vessel
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability this phase, this unit can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: Gunhaulers are built for speed and manoeuvrability, zipping around larger vessels in the fleet to identify and eliminate priority targets.

abilities.name: Attack Squadron
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of any other friendly **Grundstok Gunhaulers**, it can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used the ‘Run’ ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Groups of Gunhaulers range ahead to clear the way for larger skyvessels.

abilities.name: Transport Capacity
abilities.description: Effect: This unit cannot transport any friendly units.

details.notes:
This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.
This unit can be reinforced even though it has a minimum unit size of 1.

units.lore: State-of-the-art two-duardin attack craft, Grundstok Gunhaulers are the signature vessels of the Grundcorps. Both sturdy and swift, they have proved deadly above the tangled canopies of the Jade Kingdoms, taking on agile foes in aerial combat and laying waste to ground targets with a barrage of high-explosive bombs.

units.name: Grundstok Thunderers

abilities.name: Specialist Grundstok Ammunition
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase, Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick **Shieldbreaker** ammunition or **Thunderdrakk** ammunition.

Effect: If all of the attacks made for that **SHOOT** ability target the same enemy unit, after that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, roll a dice and add the number of damage points allocated to the target by that **SHOOT** ability. If the roll is higher than the target’s Control characteristic, apply the following effect to the target based on the ammunition type picked:

***Shieldbreaker:*** Ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.

***Thunderdrakk:*** That target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The Gruncorps outfits its soldiers with the latest in experimental munitions.

units.lore: Grundstok Thunderers are heavily armoured marines employed by the airfleets to defend it from hostiles. Expert marksmen and battle-hardened veterans of many voyages, they obliterate their foes in a storm of aethershot and mortar rounds.

units.name: Aether-Khemist

abilities.name: Atmospheric Isolation
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units within 9" of this unit.
abilities.lore: An Atmospheric Anatomiser can create a localised vacuum steals the breath from an advancing enemy or depletes the arcane currents that impel foes of unnatural origin.

abilities.name: Aetheric Augmentation
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Arkanaut Company** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: An Aether-Khemist can use their Anatomiser to augment the weapons of nearby skyfarers.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

units.lore: Masters of alchemy and atmospheric analysis, Aether-Khemists not only augment their comrades’ weapons with a boost of aether-gold, but they can also turn their esoteric devices against their foes to drain the air from their lungs.

units.name: Codewright

abilities.name: Advisory Role
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **SKYFARERS** units to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that target for the rest of the turn:

***Seek New Prospects:*** Add 5 to the target’s control score.

***Don’t Argue with the Wind:*** Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target.

***There’s No Trading With Some People:*** The target can use a **RETREAT** ability and still use **SHOOT** abilities later in the turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the target by **RETREAT** abilities.
abilities.lore: With the right tome at their fingertips, a shrewdly worded recommendation from a Codewright can have as much of an impact on a battle as a direct order from an Admiral.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

units.lore: With every artycle, every amendment and every footnote of the Kharadron Code learnt by heart, Codewrights are adept at not only citing obscure sections of the Code that can expedite the completion of their airfleet’s current objectives but also at adding ‘clarifications’ on the fly.

armiesOfRenown.name: Pioneer Outpost
armiesOfRenown.description: The meritocratic society of the Kharadron builds up its armies not only during times of war but also to continue the eternal and dangerous hunt for aether‑gold, a legendary substance that glimmers like frost-laden clouds and is lighter than air. These doughty skyfarers are also renowned merchants amongst the rest of mortalkind, for the Kharadron’s never-ending ventures call for the backing of immense wealth.
armiesOfRenown.lore:
The meritocratic society of the Kharadron builds up its armies not only during times of war but also to continue the eternal and dangerous hunt for aether‑gold, a legendary substance that glimmers like frost-laden clouds and is lighter than air. These doughty skyfarers are also renowned merchants amongst the rest of mortalkind, for the Kharadron’s never-ending ventures call for the backing of immense wealth.

Due to the twin tenets of mercantile and martial prowess that hold Kharadron society aloft, an individual’s status is measured primarily by skill. Traders amongst the Kharadron who seek glory must be strong enough to weather any storm and intelligent enough to negotiate the best deals. This requires an encyclopaedic grasp of the Kharadron Code, the universal set of rules that governs every aspect of their society. Many Kharadron Captains and Admirals are so cunning that they can negotiate their way into or out of any situation, and an arsenal full of aethermatic weapons to deal with any threats to their profit margins.

When you pick the Kharadron Overlords faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Pioneer Outpost Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Kharadron Overlords faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box as described in Army of Renown: Pioneer Outpost. All units in your army gain the Pioneer keyword.
armiesOfRenown.source: Army of Renown: Pioneer Outpost

battleTraits.name: Secure Investments
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **CODE** abilities this turn and if any enemy units that were within 3" of your **Zontari Endrin Dock** this turn were destroyed this turn.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, ignore the Rend characteristic of combat attacks that target friendly non-**INFANTRY PIONEER** units or friendly faction terrain features.
battleTraits.lore: The wise profiteer ensures that their assets are well protected.

battleTraits.name: Market Dominance
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **CODE** abilities this turn and if you control every objective that is not wholly within enemy territory.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, each time you use your **Zontari Endrin Dock**’s ‘Endrinworks Outpost’ ability, you can set up a replacement **AUTO-ENDRIN** on a manufacturing roll of 3+ instead of 4+.
battleTraits.lore: Even if you have secured an unassailable monopoly, it is vital to aggressively defend your interests.

battleTraits.name: Aggressive Acquisitions
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **CODE** abilities this turn and if there is a friendly **PIONEER** unit in each large quarter of the battlefield. Each of those units must be more than 6" from all other large quarters of the battlefield and not in combat.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, enemy units cannot be set up within your territory or within 9" of an objective that you control.
battleTraits.lore: In war and profit, leave no avenue for your enemies to progress.

battleTraits.name: Initial Investment
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.description: Effect: Each friendly **AUTO-ENDRIN** can move 2D6" but cannot finish that move in combat.
battleTraits.lore: Kharadron doctrine emphasises the importance of good reconaissance.

battleTraits.name: Settling Accounts
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **CODE** abilities this turn and if a friendly **AUTO-ENDRIN** was destroyed this turn by an enemy unit.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, each time a friendly **AUTO-ENDRIN** is removed from the battlefield, before removing it, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 3" of that **AUTO-ENDRIN**.
battleTraits.lore: The artycles of engagement encourage the settling of one’s debts through the application of heavy explosives.

battleTraits.name: Hostile Takeover
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you have not used any **CODE** abilities this turn and if an enemy **HERO** was destroyed by shooting attacks made by a friendly **PIONEER** unit this turn.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **PIONEER** units or friendly faction terrain features.
battleTraits.lore: The simplest route to profit is the elimination of one’s main rivals.

heroicTraits.name: Copper Fingers
heroicTraits.phase: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared the ‘Endrinworks Outpost’ ability for a Zontari Endrin Dock
heroicTraits.description: Effect: If this unit is wholly within 9" of that **Zontari Endrin Dock**, instead of resolving the effect of the ‘Endrinworks Outpost’ ability, set up a replacement **AUTO-ENDRIN** on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of that **Zontari Endrin Dock** and more than 3" from all enemy units.
heroicTraits.lore: Though not a qualified member of the Endrineers Guild, this officer comes from a long line of tinkerers with an aptitude for aethermatics.

heroicTraits.name: Territorial Trailblazer
heroicTraits.description: Effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
heroicTraits.lore: This stubborn and audacious duardin is surrounded by an almost tangible aura of defiance that makes enemies think twice about challenging them for control of resources.

artefacts.name: Thorgsson's Universal Automaton Actuator
artefacts.description: Effect: Add 6" to the Move characteristic of friendly **AUTO-ENDRINS** while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.
artefacts.lore: This portable cartridge radiates an energy field that gives nearby Auto-Endrins that extra bit of spark and verve. No batteries necessary.

artefacts.name: Rockbuster Charges
artefacts.description:
Declare: Pick a terrain feature that this unit passed across this turn. Each enemy unit within 1" of that terrain feature is a target.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.
artefacts.lore: Dropped from on high, these drill-tipped bomblets bore into the ground before detonating in shredding storms of rock and shrapnel.

abilities.name: Repair Routines
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** within 3" of this terrain feature to be the target.

Effect: Make a repair roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if there is a friendly **Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit** or **Endrinmaster with Endrinharness** within 3" of this terrain feature. On a 4+, **Heal (3)** the target.
abilities.lore: Auto-Endrins can be used to assist with combat repairs.

abilities.name: Release The Auto-Endrins
abilities.description: Effect: Set up a friendly **Nullifier Auto‑Endrin**, **Stuncloud Auto‑Endrin** and **Grudgeblast Auto‑Endrin** (see the Auto-Endrin warscroll) on the battlefield within friendly territory, wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Automated defence drones spill from the dock like wasps from a nest.

terrain.lore: A cutting-edge innovation from the finest endrineering minds in the sky-empire, the Zontari Endrin Dock is designed to allow the Kharadron to defend their most precious assets. It deploys aether-powered auto-endrins that seek out enemy formations before detonating or deploying anti-magic measures.

units.name: Aetheric Navigator

abilities.name: Aethersight
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.
abilities.lore: Aetheric Navigators can unpick enemy spells by harnessing the arcane jet streams.

abilities.name: Read the Winds
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **AUTO-ENDRIN** within this unit’s combat range and that is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, if the target is a **SKYVESSEL**, you can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the target and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Navigators can signal to nearby Kharadron airships, helping them to steer into prevailing currents.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

units.lore: Utilising cutting-edge aethermatic science in order to decipher the ever-changing wind patterns of the Mortal Realms, Aetheric Navigators are an invaluable presence upon any Kharadron skyvessel.

units.name: Vongrim Harpoon Crew

abilities.name: Light Endrinpacks
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 2D6" but must end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: The aether-powered backpacks worn by the Vongrim allow them to travel light and swift.

units.lore: A Vongrim Harpoon Crew is a supreme monster-hunting machine, a gathering of grizzle-bearded veterans who have seen, fought and killed some of the meanest horrors to ply the sky-lanes. They pursue their prey with light endrinpacks, hurling skydrake harpoons that can punch through the armoured hide of a megalofin with ease.

units.name: Arkanaut Admiral

abilities.name: Bring Every Gun to Bear!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** wholly within 24" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s ranged weapons.
abilities.lore: At the Admiral’s order, the skyvessel is steered into position to deliver a devastating salvo.

abilities.name: The Admiral's Flagship
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **FLAGSHIP** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the phase, each time the target uses a **SHOOT** ability, you can re-roll 1 of the hit rolls made for that ability.
abilities.lore: Every Admiral designates one of their vessels in the airfleet to be their flagship.

units.lore: Arkanaut Admirals are the cream of the sky-ports’ officer class, intrepid leaders and battle-hardened veterans of countless aerial engagements whose booming commands inspire their crews to mighty deeds in the search for profit.

units.name: Endrinmaster with Endrinharness

abilities.name: 'Aye Aye, Captain!'
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

•  The target can use a **RETREAT** or **RUN** ability and still use **SHOOT** abilities later in the turn.
•  No mortal damage is inflicted on the target by **RETREAT** abilities.
abilities.lore: Under orders of the ship’s Captain, the Endrinmaster attempts to squeeze every bit of power out of a vessel’s endrin.

abilities.name: Mobile Repairs
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, **Heal (3)** the target.
abilities.lore: An Endrinmaster is well equipped to carry out emergency repairs in the midst of battle.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

units.lore: Endrinmasters are peerless combat mechanics, well used to conducting emergency repairs in the white heat of battle. Many equip themselves with a strength-enhancing endrinharness that allows them to wield a fearsome aethermight hammer.

units.name: Endrinriggers

abilities.name: Emergency Field Repairs
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Make a field repairs roll of D6 for each model in this unit. For each 4-5, **Heal (1)** the target. For each 6, **Heal (2)** the target.
abilities.lore: Endrinriggers conduct intricate repair work even as battle rages around them.

units.lore: With aether-endrins strapped to their backs, Endrinriggers conduct repairs on their beloved airships miles above ground. In battle, their aether-powered tools become lethal weapons capable of punching through armour or messily sawing off limbs.

units.name: Arkanaut Company

abilities.name: Grizzled Buccaneers
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:
•  This unit can immediately use a **SHOOT** ability as if it were your shooting phase but all of its attacks must target the target enemy unit.
•  For the rest of the phase, this unit’s **Privateer Heavy Weapons** have **Shoot in Combat**.
abilities.lore: Arkanauts learn to fight with cutlass and pistol, combining the two to fearsome effect.

units.lore: The backbone of the Kharadron airfleets are the Arkanaut Companies. These grizzled privateers crew the sky-ports’ vessels and are armed with a variety of aether-powered firearms and deck tools with which to repel boarders or take the fight to the enemy.

units.name: Skywardens

abilities.name: Timed Charges
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• This unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.
abilities.lore: Skywardens hurl explosive devices that shred the enemy and provide cover for their own retreat.

units.lore: Skywardens are elite formations of Arkanaut warriors granted the power of flight by portable aether-endrins. They swoop from on high to skewer enemies upon long-hafted skypikes or hover at short range to incinerate them with vulcaniser pistols.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Grundstok Gunhauler

abilities.name: Fighter Vessel
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability this phase, this unit can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: Gunhaulers are built for speed and manoeuvrability, zipping around larger vessels in the fleet to identify and eliminate priority targets.

abilities.name: Attack Squadron
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of any other friendly **Grundstok Gunhaulers**, it can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used the ‘Run’ ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Groups of Gunhaulers range ahead to clear the way for larger skyvessels.

abilities.name: Transport Capacity
abilities.description: Effect: This unit cannot transport any friendly units.

details.notes:
This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.
This unit can be reinforced even though it has a minimum unit size of 1.

units.lore: State-of-the-art two-duardin attack craft, Grundstok Gunhaulers are the signature vessels of the Grundcorps. Both sturdy and swift, they have proved deadly above the tangled canopies of the Jade Kingdoms, taking on agile foes in aerial combat and laying waste to ground targets with a barrage of high-explosive bombs.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Endrinriggers

abilities.name: We're Working Here!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Until the start of your next turn, if this unit has not charged in the same turn, the following cumulative effects apply depending on your **fury level**.

**1+ *Irked***: This unit’s **Aethermatic Saws** have **Crit (Auto-wound)**.
**4+ *Exasperated***: This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
**7 *Incensed***: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.
abilities.lore: Burdened with the dangerous job of repairing skyvessels on the move, an Endrinrigger wants nothing more than to focus on the task in hand; engaging them in combat is a surefire way to garner their anger.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General's Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: With aether-endrins strapped to their backs, Endrinriggers conduct repairs on their beloved airships miles above ground. In battle, their aether-powered tools become lethal weapons capable of punching through armour or messily sawing off limbs.

units.name: Grundstok Gunhauler

abilities.name: Aethershot Overwatch
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Woe betide those who charge a Grundstok gunline.

abilities.name: Long-line Slings
abilities.description: Effect: When you use the ‘Transport Skyfarers’ ability for this unit, you can pick units in combat to be targets.
abilities.lore: Specialised harnesses allow Kharadron to rapidly deploy from fast-moving vessels.

abilities.name: Transport Capacity
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can transport 1 friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** unit with a model count of up to 5 (see Battle Traits).

abilities.name: Light Bomb Racks
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have **FLY** and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.

Effect: Roll 4 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: This skyvessel carries a variety of bombs that can be dropped onto the battlefield.

units.lore: Small, manoeuvrable and deadly, the Grundstok Gunhauler is an escortclass ship tasked with ensuring the safety of the airfleets’ larger skyvessels. They perform this role well, swarming in defence before peeling off to launch blistering attack runs.

units.name: Grundstok Thunderers

abilities.name: Specialist Grundstok Ammunition
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase, Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick **Shieldbreaker** ammunition or **Thunderdrakk** ammunition.

Effect: If all of the attacks made for that **SHOOT** ability target the same enemy unit, after that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, roll a dice and add the number of damage points allocated to the target by that **SHOOT** ability. If the roll is higher than the target’s Control characteristic, apply the following effect to the target based on the ammunition type picked:

***Shieldbreaker:*** Ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.

***Thunderdrakk:*** That target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The Gruncorps outfits its soldiers with the latest in experimental munitions.

units.lore: Grundstok Thunderers are heavily armoured marines employed by the airfleets to defend it from hostiles. Expert marksmen and battle-hardened veterans of many voyages, they obliterate their foes in a storm of aethershot and mortar rounds.

units.name: Vongrim Salvagers

abilities.name: Spotter's Flaregun
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an objective within 9" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the following effects for the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **SKYFARER** units that target a unit that is contesting the target objective.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **Vongrim Salvagers** and **Vongrim Harpoon Crew** units for attacks that target a unit that is contesting the target objective.
abilities.lore: Firing this flaregun sends a message to all nearby Kharadron: this place is claimed and must be defended.

units.lore: Bonded by the shared trauma of lost ships and a sense of unity forged by hard times, Vongrim Salvagers go about their dangerous work with customary efficiency. With pistol, steel and cudgel, they cut down their foes and seize hold of profitable territory, refusing to give up their gains at any cost.

battleTraits.name: Ethereal
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units, excluding **Nagash.**
battleTraits.lore: Nighthaunt spirits can rarely be harmed by blows delivered by those caught in the grip of a spiritual terror.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Nighthaunt armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Ethereal Translocation
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit that is not in combat to use this ability.

Effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
battleTraits.lore: The Nighthaunt appear and disappear from sight to torment their prey.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Nighthaunt armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Mounting Dread
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description: Effect: Subtract the current battle round number from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units.
battleTraits.lore: The keening wails and harrowing shrieks of the Nighthaunt are a continuous assault on the courage of those who face them in battle, until their will to fight has all but crumbled.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Nighthaunt armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Sepulchral Apparitions
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.description:
Effect: If there is a friendly **Nexus of Grief** on the battlefield, you can set up up to 2 additional **Nexuses of Grief** on the battlefield. Each must be set up wholly outside enemy territory, more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features, and more than 12" from all other friendly **Nexuses of Grief**.

**Designer’s Note:** *The original* **Nexus of Grief** *is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second and third such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*
battleTraits.lore: Like sinister visions intruding upon reality, the haunted crypts of the Nighthaunt shimmer into existence wherever there are souls to be captured and tortured.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Nighthaunt armies can use the following abilities:

ability.name: Lethal Rancour
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units to be the targets.

Effect: The targets' melee weapons have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: The gheists of this horde are drawn from haughty nobles and obsequious courtiers who refused to admit fault even at the very end. They rail constantly at their kingdom's doom, and their undying bitterness renders their spectral touch even more deadly against those they perceive as interlopers.

abilities.name: Lethal Rancour
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units to be the targets.

Effect: The targets' melee weapons have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The gheists of this horde are drawn from haughty nobles and obsequious courtiers who refused to admit fault even at the very end. They rail constantly at their kingdom's doom, and their undying bitterness renders their spectral touch even more deadly against those they perceive as interlopers.

ability.name: Petrify
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT HERO** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, enemy units cannot use **RETREAT** abilities while they are in combat with the target.
ability.lore: The screams and wails of this procession's bloodthirsty champions are so terrifying that their foes often become rooted in place, ripe for the slaughter.

abilities.name: Petrify
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT HERO** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, enemy units cannot use **RETREAT** abilities while they are in combat with the target.
abilities.lore: The screams and wails of this procession's bloodthirsty champions are so terrifying that their foes often become rooted in place, ripe for the slaughter.

ability.name: Vanish and Reappear
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit that is in combat to use this ability.

Effect: Roll a dice. The unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic added to the roll. It can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, and it can end that move in combat.
ability.lore: These mercurial spirits are feared for their ability to dissolve into nothingness before suddenly reappearing elsewhere - often right behind their next targets' backs.

abilities.name: Vanish and Reappear
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit that is in combat to use this ability.

Effect: Roll a dice. The unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic added to the roll. It can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, and it can end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: These mercurial spirits are feared for their ability to dissolve into nothingness before suddenly reappearing elsewhere - often right behind their next targets' backs.

ability.name: There Is No Escape
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

• The target can use **CHARGE** and **SHOOT** abilities even if it has used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
• The target can use the 'Retreat' ability without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.
ability.lore: Death Stalkers are spectral killers that relentlessly hunt down a chosen enemy. They are constantly on the move in pursuit of their quarry and nigh impossible to pin down.

abilities.name: There Is No Escape
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

• The target can use **CHARGE** and **SHOOT** abilities even if it has used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
• The target can use the 'Retreat' ability without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.
abilities.lore: Death Stalkers are spectral killers that relentlessly hunt down a chosen enemy. They are constantly on the move in pursuit of their quarry and nigh impossible to pin down.

heroicTraits.name: Ruler of the Spectral Hosts
heroicTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly non-**HERO NIGHTHAUNT** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+:

• If the target is damaged, **Heal (X)** the target, where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.
• If the target is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to **X,** where **X** is an amount equal to the roll.
heroicTraits.lore: The deathly power of this spirit is like a siren call, an unseen signal that beckons to those who have passed beyond the grave.

heroicTraits.name: Deathly Possessor
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target, then pick another enemy unit within the target's combat range to be the victim.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the target's melee weapons. Immediately resolve combat attacks for the target with that weapon against the victim.
heroicTraits.lore: In a flash ofbalefire, the Nighthaunt vanishes. An instant later, a nearby foe's eyes glow with spectral power and they lash out at their allies, cackling in a voice not their own.

heroicTraits.name: Shadowy Aura
heroicTraits.phase: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a friendly NIGHTHAUNT unit wholly within 12" of this unit
heroicTraits.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit.
heroicTraits.lore: A pall of gloom hangs over this champion, concealing the movements of nearby gheists and allowing them to ambush their victims.

artefacts.name: Brazier of Nagashizzar
artefacts.phase: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a friendly NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit
artefacts.description: Effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.
artefacts.lore: Green flames billow from this brazier, lashing at nearby gheists and ensuring that there is no rest for the wicked.

artefacts.name: Lightshard of the Harvest Moon
artefacts.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
artefacts.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit for the rest of the turn.
artefacts.lore: This lightshard is filled with a baleful gloom that, upon release, casts the battlefield in an eerie glow, readying the enemy for the reaping.

artefacts.name: Mirror of Echoing Failures
artefacts.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL or PRAYER ability for a WIZARD or PRIEST within 12" of this unit
artefacts.description:
Declare: Pick each enemy **WIZARD** and **PRIEST** within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, for the rest of the phase:

• Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the targets.
• Each time any of the targets fails to cast a spell or chant a prayer, inflict 1 mortal damage on that target.
artefacts.lore: To fail in front of this awful artefact is to have those miseries echoed in excruciating detail by a caterwauling reflection of your own face deriding your futile efforts.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Tome of the Restless Crypts
aqshyArtefacts.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
aqshyArtefacts.description: Effect: If there are fewer than 3 friendly **Nexuses of Grief** on the battlefield, set up a **Nexus of Grief** within 3" of a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit, more than 3" from all objectives and enemy units, more than 1" from all other terrain features, and more than 12" from all other friendly **Nexuses of Grief**.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: This volume holds the secrets to calling forth more hungering mausoleums.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Ethereal Fetters
aqshyArtefacts.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, if possible, this unit must be picked to be the target of pile-in moves made by the target.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: Spectral chains erupt from this Nighthaunt’s form to temporarily shackle the souls of nearby foes, ensuring they cannot escape.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Urn of Despondency
aqshyArtefacts.description:
Effect: Spend up to 3 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, roll **X**D6, where **X** is the number of **rage dice** spent. This unit can move a distance in inches up to the roll but must end that move in combat with a damaged enemy unit and/or an enemy unit that has fewer models than its starting size.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: From this funerary urn emerge swirling spirits that feed upon negative emotions. Empowered by resentment, they become as a spectral whirlwind, speeding the bearer to new sources of suffering.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Vociferous Defamers
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARDS** while they are wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit. Add 2 to casting rolls instead if this unit is also in combat with an enemy **WIZARD** or **PRIEST**.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: These wretches denied the Great Necromancer’s arcane might; as punishment, they are beholden to Nagash’s mages.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: Crimes of the Condemned are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Crime of the Condemned.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Backstabbing Betrayers
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while it is more than 12" from all other friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: Condemned to eternal solitude for their traitorous deeds, these spectres take out their loneliness on the enemy.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: Crimes of the Condemned are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Crime of the Condemned.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Cowards and Deserters
aqshyEnhancements.phase: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for this unit
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Effect: After that **FIGHT** ability has been resolved, roll a dice. You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:
• Add 1 to the roll.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.

On a 3+, this unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: Fearful and craven in life, these gheists continue to flee from their enemies beyond the grave.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: Crimes of the Condemned are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY** or **CAVALRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Crime of the Condemned.

spells.name: Fell Blades
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target uses a **FIGHT** ability, if all of its attacks targeted the same enemy unit, after that ability has been resolved, subtract 1 from save rolls for that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.
spells.lore: A malignant curse screeched to blackened skies coalesces on spectral blades, causing the weapons to glow with the magics of ending.

spells.name: Chains of Death
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy **HERO** within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
spells.lore: With an unearthly howl, hundreds of spectral chains burst from the caster's billowing form, ensnaring their straining victim from head to foot.

spells.name: Wrench Souls
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly non-**HERO** **NIGHTHAUNT INFANTRY** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target can immediately use the 'Normal Move' or 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase.
spells.lore: With a clasped fist and a horrible twist, the caster drags a horde of gheists to their desired location.

manifestations.name: Vault of Souls

abilities.name: Siphon Souls
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a model from a friendly or enemy unit is slain within 12" of this **MANIFESTATION,** give this **MANIFESTATION** a **soul point,** to a maximum of 6.
abilities.lore: This summoned chest siphons souls, filling itself to overflowing with the rich spirits of mortalkind.

abilities.name: Soul Eruption
abilities.description:
Declare: If this **MANIFESTATION** has 6 **soul points,** pick any number of enemy units within 6" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the targets.

Effect: Roll 6 dice for each target. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. Then, reset this **MANIFESTATION**'s **soul points** to 0.
abilities.lore: Should a Vault of Souls glut itself too greedily, the captured spirits within will burst free, tearing at those nearby in their desperation to escape.

manifestations.lore: The Vault of Souls is a spectral chest that hungrily draws into itself the spirits of those slain in its vicinity. Filled to overflowing and ever greedy for more, it eventually burst, violently expelling a storm of frenzied, harrowed gheists.

summonSpell.name: Summon Vault of Souls
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Vault of Souls** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Vault of Souls** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
summonSpell.lore: This summoned chest siphons souls, filling itself to overflowing with the rich spirits of mortalkind.

manifestations.name: Shyish Reaper

abilities.name: Soul Reaper
abilities.description: Effect: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this **MANIFESTATION**'s **Almighty Reap** if it charged in the same turn.
abilities.lore: A Shyish Reaper is always on the hunt for souls, sweeping through its prey to cleave flesh and rip away the spirit, sending it screaming into the underworlds.

manifestations.lore: The soul-hungering Shyish Reaper is the ultimate manifestation of finality and death. This is no lingering premonition of far-off doom, but a screaming scythe that arcs towards its victims with terrifying speed, hewing through their physical form and spirit alike.

summonSpell.name: Summon Shyish Reaper
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Shyish Reaper** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Shyish Reaper** wholly within 12" of and visible to the caster and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: The wizard sweeps down their arm as they utter this spell’s final incantation, and a fearsome scythe formed of purest amethyst magic tears through their foes with unstoppable force.

manifestations.name: Mortalis Terminexus

abilities.name: Keeper of Mortality
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit within 3" of this **MANIFESTATION** to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for target for the rest of the turn.
• **Heal (3)** the target.
abilities.lore: A Mortalis Terminexus is a catalyst of deathly magic that invigorates surrounding Nighthaunt.

manifestations.lore: A looming, phantasmal hourglass, the Mortalis Terminexus can distort the very passage of time, its mere presence hastening the advance of the Nighthaunt processions. Should its flow be reversed, it can even undo harm done to the spectral forms of nearby gheists, much to the horror of their enemies.

summonSpell.name: Summon Mortalis Terminexus
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Mortalis Terminexus** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up a **Mortalis Terminexus** wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.
summonSpell.lore: A spectral hourglass filled with shifting grave-sand takes shape, promising temporal grace or doom to mortal and immortal alike.
